		end
		local ok, result = pcall(chunk)

			return result
		end
		return nil, result

	local function fn11(instance)
		while instance and instance ~= v.ScreenGui do
			if instance:IsA("GuiObject") and instance.Visible == false then
				return false

	local function fn12(instance)
		if instance.AutomaticCanvasSize ~= Enum.AutomaticSize.None then
			return
		end
		local uiListLayout = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")
		if not uiListLayout then
			return
		end
		local y = math.ceil(uiListLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 1)

		if y > 0 and instance.CanvasSize.Y.Offset < y then
			instance.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
		end
	end

	local function fn13(instance)
		if not instance or not instance:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
			return
		end

		for _, instance2 in ipairs(instances) do
			if instance2 == instance then
				return
			end
		end

		instances[#instances + 1] = instance
		fn12(instance)
		local uiListLayout = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIListLayout")

		if uiListLayout then
			uiListLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
				fn12(instance)
			end)
		end
	end

	local function getInstance(x, y)
		local v2 = nil
		local instance2 = nil

		for _, instance in ipairs(instances) do
			if not instance.Parent then
				continue
			end
			local absolutePosition = instance.AbsolutePosition
			local absoluteSize = instance.AbsoluteSize

			if
				absoluteSize.X > 0
				and absoluteSize.Y > 0
				and x >= absolutePosition.X
				and x <= absolutePosition.X + absoluteSize.X
				and y >= absolutePosition.Y
				and y <= absolutePosition.Y + absoluteSize.Y
				and fn11(instance)
			then
				local n3 = absoluteSize.X * absoluteSize.Y

				if not v2 or n3 < v2 then
					v2 = n3
					instance2 = instance
				end
			end
		end

		return instance2
	end

	local function onInputBegan(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end

		if tbl4 then
			return
		end
		local instance = getInstance(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		if not instance then
			return
		end
		fn12(instance)
		if instance.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - instance.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 2 then
			return
		end

		tbl4 = {
			Input = input,
			Frame = instance,
			X = input.Position.X,
			Y = input.Position.Y,
			Canvas = instance.CanvasPosition.Y,
			Moved = false,
		}
	end

	local function onInputChanged(input)
		if not tbl4 or input ~= tbl4.Input then
			return
		end
		local frame = tbl4.Frame
		if not frame or not frame.Parent then
			tbl4 = nil
			return
		end
		local n3 = input.Position.X - tbl4.X
		local n4 = input.Position.Y - tbl4.Y

		if not tbl4.Moved then
			if math.abs(n3) + math.abs(n4) < 8 then
				return
			end
			local n5 = math.abs(n3)
			if math.abs(n4) < n5 then
				tbl4 = nil
				return
			end
			tbl4.Moved = true
			fn12(frame)
			tbl4.Canvas = frame.CanvasPosition.Y
			tbl4.Y = input.Position.Y
			return
		end

		local n5 = frame.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y - frame.AbsoluteSize.Y
		if n5 <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local y = math.clamp(tbl4.Canvas - n4, 0, n5)
		frame.CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(frame.CanvasPosition.X, y)
	end

	local function onInputEnded(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return
		end

		if tbl4 and tbl4.Input == input then
			tbl4 = nil
		end
	end

	GluTouch.sweep = function(instance)
		if not instance then
			return
		end

		if instance:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
			fn13(instance)
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
				fn13(descendant)
			end
		end
	end

	GluTouch.install = function(instance)
		if not UserInputService2.TouchEnabled then
			return
		end
		instance = instance or v.ScreenGui
		if not instance then
			return
		end
		UserInputService2.InputBegan:Connect(onInputBegan)
		UserInputService2.InputChanged:Connect(onInputChanged)
		UserInputService2.InputEnded:Connect(onInputEnded)

		instance.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(descendant)
			if descendant:IsA("ScrollingFrame") then
				fn13(descendant)
			end
		end)

		GluTouch.sweep(instance)
	end

			str3 = string.sub(str3, 1, v2 - 1)

	tbl.FitWindow = function(arg, arg2)
		local rootFrame = arg2
			and (arg2.RootFrame or arg2.Items and arg2.Items.MainFrame and arg2.Items.MainFrame.Instance)
		if not rootFrame or not rootFrame.Parent then
			return
		end
		local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local viewportSize = currentCamera and currentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
		arg2 = arg2 and arg2.BaseSize or Vector2.new(640, 480)
		local scale = math.clamp(
			math.min(
				1,
				(math.floor(viewportSize.X) - 16) / math.max(arg2.X, 1),
				(math.floor(viewportSize.Y) - 40) / math.max(arg2.Y, 1)
			),
			0.4,
			1
		)
		local gluUiScale = rootFrame:FindFirstChild("GluUiScale")

		if not gluUiScale then
			gluUiScale = Instance.new("UIScale")
			gluUiScale.Name = "GluUiScale"
			gluUiScale.Parent = rootFrame
		end

		gluUiScale.Scale = scale
	end

				tbl9.Key = fn15()
				tbl9.Value = tbl9.Key

				if v4 then
					tbl2[v4] = tbl9.Key
				end

				tbl9.GetValue = function(arg4)
					return arg4.Key
				end

				tbl9.SetValue = function(arg4, arg5)
					if typeof(arg5) == "EnumItem" then
						arg5 = arg5.Name
					end

					local key = tostring(arg5 or "None")

					pcall(function()
						real:Set(fn4(key))
					end)

					arg4.Key = key
					arg4.Value = key

					if v4 then
						tbl2[v4] = key
					end

					if tbl8.OnSet then
						pcall(tbl8.OnSet, key)
					end
				end

				tbl9.Get = function(arg4)
					return arg4:GetValue()
				end

				tbl9.Set = function(arg4, arg5)
					arg4:SetValue(arg5)
				end

				task.spawn(function()
					local key = tbl9.Key

					while true do
						task.wait(0.5)
						local key2 = fn15()

						if key2 ~= key then
							tbl9.Key = key2
							tbl9.Value = key2

							if v4 then
								tbl2[v4] = key2
							end

							if tbl8.OnSet then
								pcall(tbl8.OnSet, key2)
								key = key2
								continue
							end

							key = key2
						end
					end
				end)

				if tbl8.OnSet then
					pcall(tbl8.OnSet, tbl9.Key)
				end

				fn12(v4, tbl9)
				return tbl9
			end,
			Label = function(arg2, arg3)
				local name

				if type(arg3) == "table" then
					name = arg3.Name or arg3.Text or ""
				else
					name = arg3
				end

				local str3 = tostring(name or "")
				local v4 = section:Label({ Name = str3 })
				local tbl8 = { value = str3 }
				local item2 = nil

				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					local items = v4.Items
					local text = items and items.Text
					return text and text.Instance or nil
				end)

				if ok and result then
					item2 = result
				else
					pcall(function()
						local v5 = pairs
						local items = v4.Items or {}

						for _, item in v5(items) do
							item = item and item.Instance
							if item and item:IsA("TextLabel") then
								item2 = item
								break
							end
						end
					end)
				end

				local function fn15(arg4)
					local value = tostring(arg4 or "")
					if value == tbl8.value then
						return
					end
					tbl8.value = value

					pcall(function()
						v4:SetText(value)
					end)
				end

				local tbl9 = {
					Real = v4,
					Object = item2,
					Set = function(arg4, arg5)
						fn15(arg5)
					end,
					SetText = function(arg4, arg5)
						fn15(arg5)
					end,
					SetValue = function(arg4, arg5)
						fn15(arg5)
					end,
					Get = function()
						return tbl8.value
					end,
					GetValue = function()
						return tbl8.value
					end,
				}

				return setmetatable(tbl9, {
					__index = function(arg4, arg5)
						if arg5 == "Text" then
							return tbl8.value
						end
						return nil
					end,
					__newindex = function(arg4, arg5, arg6)
						if arg5 == "Text" then
							fn15(arg6)
						else
							rawset(tbl9, arg5, arg6)
						end
					end,
				})
			end,
			Button = function(arg2, arg3)
				local tbl8 = arg3 or {}

				return section:Button({
					Name = tostring(tbl8.Text or ""),
					Size = tbl8.Size,
					NewRow = tbl8.NewRow == true,
					Tooltip = tbl8.Hint and tostring(tbl8.Hint) or nil,
					Callback = tbl8.Callback or function() end,
				})
			end,
			ButtonRow = function(arg2, arg3)
				local tbl8 = arg3 or {}
				local count = 0

				for i in ipairs(tbl8) do
					count += 1
				end

				local str3

				if count == 2 then
					str3 = "Medium"
				else
					str3 = "Large"

					if count >= 3 then
						str3 = "Small"
					end
				end

				local v4, v5, v6 = ipairs(tbl8)
				local v7 = nil

				for k, v8 in v4, v5, v6 do
					local v9 = tbl7:Button({
						Text = v8.Text,
						Hint = v8.Hint,
						Size = v8.Size or str3,
						NewRow = k == 1,
						Callback = v8.Callback,
					})

					if k == 1 then
						v7 = v9
					end
				end

				return v7
			end,
		}

		return fn10(tbl7)
	end

	local getSettingsTab = nil

				str4 = str3

				str4 = str3 .. "•" .. str5
			end
		else
			str4 = str3
		end

		local tbl8 = { Real = v4, Tabs = {}, ActiveTab = nil }

			end)
		end

		return tbl8
	end

	tbl5.GetConfig = function(arg, arg2)

	tbl5.LoadConfig = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		local tbl7 = arg3 or {}
		if type(arg2) ~= "table" then
			return 0
		end
		flag2 = true
		local count = 0

		for k, v4 in pairs(arg2) do
			local v5 = tbl3[k]

			if v5 and not tbl7[k] then
				if pcall(v5.Set, v4) then
					count += 1
				end
			end
		end

		flag2 = false
		return count
	end

	local function fn13(folder)
		if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(makefolder) ~= "function" then
			return
		end
		local match = ""

		for match2 in string.gmatch(tostring(folder), "[^/\\]+") do
			match = match == "" and match2 or match .. "/" .. match2

			pcall(function()
				if not isfolder(match) then
					makefolder(match)
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	local themeManager = { Folder = "Slayers2Glu/game", Section = nil }

	local function fn14()
		return string.format("%s/theme.json", themeManager.Folder)
	end

	themeManager.SetLibrary = function() end

	themeManager.SetFolder = function(arg, arg2)
		arg.Folder = tostring(arg2 or "Slayers2Glu/game")
	end

	themeManager.ApplyTheme = function(arg, arg2)
		local ok = pcall(function()
			return tbl:SetTheme(tostring(arg2))
		end)

		if ok then
			fn8()
			tbl5.Colors = tbl.Theme
		end

		return ok
	end

	themeManager.Save = function()
		local tbl7 = {}

		for _, v4 in ipairs(v3) do
			local v5 = tbl.Theme[v4]

			if typeof(v5) == "Color3" then
				tbl7[v4] = {
					tonumber(string.format("%.4f", v5.R)),
					tonumber(string.format("%.4f", v5.G)),
					tonumber(string.format("%.4f", v5.B)),
				}
			end
		end

		return (pcall(function()
			writefile(fn14(), HttpService:JSONEncode(tbl7))
		end))
	end

	themeManager.Load = function()
		pcall(function()
			tbl:SetTheme("Neverlose")
		end)

		fn8()
		local ok, result = pcall(readfile, fn14())
		if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" then
			tbl5.Colors = tbl.Theme
			return
		end

		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			return HttpService:JSONDecode(result)
		end)

		if not ok2 or type(result2) ~= "table" then
			tbl5.Colors = tbl.Theme
			return
		end

		for k, v4 in pairs(result2) do
			if tbl.Theme[k] ~= nil and type(v4) == "table" and #v4 >= 3 then
				pcall(function()
					tbl:ChangeTheme(k, Color3.new(tonumber(v4[1]) or 1, tonumber(v4[2]) or 1, tonumber(v4[3]) or 1))
				end)
			end
		end

		tbl5.Colors = tbl.Theme
	end

	themeManager.Mount = function(arg, arg2)
		local window = arg2 or tbl5.Windows[1]
		local settings_ = window and window.Tabs and window.Tabs.settings
		if not settings_ then
			return
		end
		local theme2 = settings_:Section("theme", 2)
		arg.Section = theme2

		theme2:Dropdown({
			Text = "preset theme",
			Flag = false,
			Options = tbl.PresetOrder or { "Neverlose" },
			Default = str,
			Hint = "the pink accent is kept on top of whichever preset you pick",
			Callback = function(arg3)
				themeManager:ApplyTheme(arg3)
			end,
		})

		for _, v4 in ipairs(v3) do
			local v5 = tbl.Theme[v4]

			theme2:ColorPicker({
				Text = v4,
				Flag = false,
				Default = typeof(v5) == "Color3" and v5 or Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
				Callback = function(arg3)
					if typeof(arg3) ~= "Color3" then
						return
					end

					pcall(function()
						tbl:ChangeTheme(v4, arg3)
					end)
				end,
			})
		end

		theme2:Button({
			Text = "save theme to disk",
			Callback = function()

					tbl5:Success("Theme", "Theme saved", 3)
				else
					tbl5:Warn("Theme", "Theme could not be saved", 3)
				end
			end,
		})

		theme2:Button({
			Text = "reload saved theme",
			Callback = function()
				themeManager:Load()
				tbl5:Success("Theme", "Saved theme applied", 3)
			end,
		})

	end

	local interfaceManager

	tbl5.SaveManager = {
		Ignore = {},
		Folder = "Slayers2Glu/game/configs",
		Section = nil,
		SetLibrary = function() end,
		IgnoreThemeSettings = function() end,
		SetIgnoreIndexes = function(arg, ignore)
			arg.Ignore = ignore or {}
		end,
		SetFolder = function(arg, arg2)
			arg.Folder = tostring(arg2 or "Slayers2Glu/game") .. "/configs"
		end,
		SetSubFolder = function(arg, arg2)
			arg.Folder ..= "/" .. tostring(arg2 or "configs")
		end,
		GetList = function(arg)
			local matches = {}

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return listfiles(arg.Folder)
			end)

			if ok and type(result) == "table" then
				for _, v4 in ipairs(result) do
					local match = tostring(v4):match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")

					if match then
						matches[#matches + 1] = match
					end
				end
			end

			table.sort(matches)
			return matches
		end,
		Save = function(arg, arg2)
			local str3 = tostring(arg2 or "")
			if str3 == "" then
				return false
			end
			fn13(arg.Folder)

			return (
				pcall(function()
					writefile(
						string.format("%s/%s.json", arg.Folder, str3),
						HttpService:JSONEncode(tbl5:GetConfig(arg.Ignore))
					)
				end)
			)
		end,
		Load = function(arg, arg2)
			local str3 = tostring(arg2 or "")
			if str3 == "" then
				return false
			end
			local ok, result = pcall(readfile, string.format("%s/%s.json", arg.Folder, str3))
			if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" then
				return false
			end

			local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONDecode(result)
			end)

			if not ok2 or type(result2) ~= "table" then
				return false
			end
			tbl5:LoadConfig(result2, arg.Ignore)
			return true
		end,
		Delete = function(arg, arg2)
			local str3 = tostring(arg2 or "")
			if str3 == "" then
				return false
			end
			return (pcall(delfile, string.format("%s/%s.json", arg.Folder, str3)))
		end,
		SaveAutoloadConfig = function(arg, arg2)
			fn13(arg.Folder)
			pcall(writefile, string.format("%s/autoload.txt", arg.Folder), tostring(arg2 or ""))
		end,
		LoadAutoloadConfig = function(arg)
			local ok, result = pcall(readfile, string.format("%s/autoload.txt", arg.Folder))
			if not ok or type(result) ~= "string" or result == "" then
				return false
			end
			return arg:Load(result)
		end,
		BuildConfigSection = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
			if not (arg2 and arg2.Section) then
				return
			end
			local configs = arg2:Section("configs", arg3 or 2)
			arg.Section = configs

			local list = configs:Dropdown({

					arg.Selected = tostring(arg4 or "")
				end,
			})

			arg.List = list
			local nameBox = configs:Input({
				Text = "config name",
				Flag = false,
				Default = "",
				Placeholder = "name for save / load / delete",
			})
			arg.NameBox = nameBox

			configs:ButtonRow({
				{
					Text = "save",
					Callback = function()
						local str3 = tostring(nameBox:Get() or "")

						if str3 == "" then
							str3 = tostring(arg.Selected or "")
						end

						if str3 == "" then
							tbl5:Warn("Config", "Give the config a name first", 3)
							return
						end

						if arg:Save(str3) then
							list:SetOptions(arg:GetList())
							tbl5:Success("Config", "Saved " .. str3, 3)
						else
							tbl5:Warn("Config", "Save failed", 3)
						end
					end,
				},
				{
					Text = "load",
					Callback = function()
						local str3 = tostring(nameBox:Get() or "")

						if str3 == "" then
							str3 = tostring(arg.Selected or "")
						end

						if str3 == "" then
							tbl5:Warn("Config", "Pick or name a config first", 3)
							return
						end

						if arg:Load(str3) then
							tbl5:Success("Config", "Loaded " .. str3, 3)
						else
							tbl5:Warn("Config", "Load failed", 3)
						end
					end,
				},
				{
					Text = "delete",
					Callback = function()
						local str3 = tostring(nameBox:Get() or "")

						if str3 == "" then
							str3 = tostring(arg.Selected or "")
						end

						if str3 == "" then
							return
						end

						if arg:Delete(str3) then
							list:SetOptions(arg:GetList())
							tbl5:Warn("Config", "Deleted " .. str3, 3)
						end
					end,
				},
				{
					Text = "refresh list",
					Callback = function()
						list:SetOptions(arg:GetList())
					end,
				},
			})

			configs:Toggle({
				Text = "autoload this config on start",
				Flag = false,
				Callback = function(arg4)
					if not arg4 then
						return
					end
					local str3 = tostring(nameBox:Get() or "")

					if str3 == "" then
						str3 = tostring(arg.Selected or "")
					end

					if str3 == "" then
						tbl5:Warn("Config", "Name a config before setting autoload", 3)
						return
					end
					arg:SaveAutoloadConfig(str3)
					tbl5:Success("Config", "Autoload set to " .. str3, 3)
				end,
			})

			return configs
		end,
	}

	tbl5.ThemeManager = themeManager
	tbl5.InterfaceManager = interfaceManager
	tbl5.MobileTapFix = tbl.MobileTapFix == true
	v = tbl5
end

Toggles = setmetatable({}, {
	__index = function(arg, arg2)
		local registry = v.Registry and v.Registry[arg2]
		if not registry then
			return nil
		end

		return {
			Value = v.Flags[arg2],
			Toggled = v.Flags[arg2],
			SetValue = function(arg3, arg4)
				if type(registry.Set) == "function" then
					registry.Set(arg4 == true)
				end
			end,
		}
	end,
})

GluPrompt = {}
GluPrompt.MIN_HOLD = 0.1
GluPrompt.MAX_HOLD = 2.6
GluPrompt.Instant = false
GluPrompt.RateMax = 14
GluPrompt.RateAt = 0
GluPrompt.RateFires = 0
GluPrompt.Gap = 0.03
GluPrompt.Cool = 0.15
GluPrompt.LastFire = 0
GluPrompt.CoolMap = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
GluPrompt.Blocked = 0

GluLoot = {
	Instant = false,
	Reach = 6,
	RateMax = 14,
	NoTp = true,
	Walk = true,
	Moves = 0,
	LastMove = 0,
	Status = "idle",
}

GluLoot.moveTo = function(arg, arg2)
	if typeof(arg) ~= "Vector3" then
		return false
	end

	if TeleportFix and TeleportFix.holding and TeleportFix.holding() then
		return false
	end
	local character = Player.Character
	local humanoidRootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not humanoidRootPart then
		return false
	end

	if (humanoidRootPart.Position - arg).Magnitude <= (GluLoot.Reach or 18) then
		return false
	end

	if not (GluLoot.Walk and GluHold and GluHold.go) then
		return false
	end
	GluLoot.Moves = (GluLoot.Moves or 0) + 1
	GluLoot.LastMove = os.clock()
	GluLoot.Status = "moving to loot"
	return GluHold.go(CFrame.new(arg), tonumber(arg2) or 1.2)
end

GluPrompt.paced = function()
	local now = os.clock()

	if now - (GluPrompt.RateAt or 0) >= 1 then
		GluPrompt.RateAt = now
		GluPrompt.RateFires = 0
	end

	if (GluPrompt.RateFires or 0) < (tonumber(GluLoot and GluLoot.RateMax) or tonumber(GluPrompt.RateMax) or 14) then
		return true
	end
	GluPrompt.Blocked = (GluPrompt.Blocked or 0) + 1

	if GluLoot then
		GluLoot.Status = "pacing prompts"
	end

	return false
end

GluPrompt.guard = function(arg)
	if not GluPrompt.Instant then
		return true
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local v2 = GluPrompt.CoolMap[arg]
	if v2 and now - v2 < (GluPrompt.Cool or 0.15) then
		GluPrompt.Blocked = (GluPrompt.Blocked or 0) + 1
		return false
	end

	if now - (GluPrompt.LastFire or 0) < (GluPrompt.Gap or 0.03) then
		return false
	end
	return GluPrompt.paced()
end

GluPrompt.note = function(arg)
	GluPrompt.LastFire = os.clock()
	GluPrompt.CoolMap[arg] = GluPrompt.LastFire
	GluPrompt.RateFires = (GluPrompt.RateFires or 0) + 1
end

GluPrompt.cold = function(instance)
	local attribute

	pcall(function()
		attribute = instance:GetAttribute("OnCooldown")
	end)

	return attribute == true
end

GluPrompt.hold = function(instance, arg)
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then
		return false
	end
	local minHold = tonumber(instance.HoldDuration) or 0

	if minHold < GluPrompt.MIN_HOLD then
		minHold = GluPrompt.MIN_HOLD
	end

	if GluPrompt.MAX_HOLD < minHold then
		minHold = GluPrompt.MAX_HOLD
	end

	local ok = pcall(function()
		instance:InputHoldBegin()
	end)

	if ok then
		if GluPrompt.Instant then
			local delay = task.delay
			arg = arg or 0

			delay(minHold + arg, function()
				pcall(function()
					instance:InputHoldEnd()
				end)
			end)

			return true
		end

		task.wait(minHold + (arg or 0))
	end

	pcall(function()
		instance:InputHoldEnd()
	end)

	return ok
end

GluPrompt.keyHit = function(arg)
	local keyboardKeyCode = nil

	pcall(function()
		keyboardKeyCode = arg.KeyboardKeyCode
	end)

	if
		not (
			VirtualInputManager
			and keyboardKeyCode
			and typeof(keyboardKeyCode) == "EnumItem"
			and keyboardKeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
		)
	then
		return false
	end

	pcall(function()
		VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, keyboardKeyCode, false, game)
	end)

	task.wait(GluPrompt.MIN_HOLD)

	pcall(function()
		VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, keyboardKeyCode, false, game)
	end)

	return true
end

GluPrompt.fire = function(instance, arg)
	local tbl2 = arg or {}
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then
		return false
	end

	if tbl2.force ~= true and not GluPrompt.guard(instance) then
		return false
	end

	if GluPrompt.Instant and tbl2.keepHold ~= true then
		pcall(function()
			instance.HoldDuration = 0
		end)
	end

	local minHold = tonumber(tbl2.min) or GluPrompt.MIN_HOLD
	local maxHold = tonumber(tbl2.max) or GluPrompt.MAX_HOLD
	local minHold2 = tonumber(tbl2.hold) or tonumber(instance.HoldDuration) or 0

	if minHold2 < minHold then
		minHold2 = minHold
	end

	if not (maxHold < minHold2) then
		maxHold = minHold2
	end

	pcall(function()
		instance.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if (tonumber(instance.MaxActivationDistance) or 10) < 14 then
			instance.MaxActivationDistance = 14
		end
	end)

	GluPrompt.note(instance)

	if tbl2.fast then
		pcall(function()
			instance:InputHoldBegin()
		end)

		task.delay(maxHold, function()
			pcall(function()
				instance:InputHoldEnd()
			end)
		end)

		if type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
			pcall(fireproximityprompt, instance, tbl2.duration or 1)
		end

		return true
	end

	if LootHold and tbl2.pin ~= false then
		LootHold.grab(instance, maxHold + 0.5)
		LootHold.mark()
	end

	if tbl2.holdOnly then
		local ok = pcall(function()
			instance:InputHoldBegin()
		end)

		if ok then
			local n3 = os.clock() + maxHold + (tbl2.extra or 0.25)

			while os.clock() < n3 do
				if not tbl2.inst or tbl2.inst.Parent then
					if instance.Parent then
						task.wait(0.05)
						continue
					end
				end

				break
			end
		end

		pcall(function()
			instance:InputHoldEnd()
		end)

		return ok
	end

	local v2 = GluPrompt.hold(instance, tbl2.extra)
	if tbl2.inst and not tbl2.inst.Parent or tbl2.cold and GluPrompt.cold(instance) then
		return true
	end
	local ok = false

	if type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
		ok = pcall(fireproximityprompt, instance, tbl2.duration or 1)
	end

	if tbl2.inst and not tbl2.inst.Parent or tbl2.cold and GluPrompt.cold(instance) then
		return true
	end

	if type(firesignal) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			if instance.PromptButtonHoldBegan then
				firesignal(instance.PromptButtonHoldBegan)
			end
		end)
	end

	if not v2 and not ok then
		if GluPrompt.keyHit(instance) then
			return true
		end
	end

	if type(firesignal) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			if instance.Triggered then
				firesignal(instance.Triggered, Player)
			end
		end)
	end

	return v2 or ok
end

GluResumeSaved = function()
	local registry = v.Registry
	if type(registry) ~= "table" then
		return 0
	end
	local tbl2 = {}
	local count = 0

	local function fn3(arg)
		if tbl2[arg] then
			return
		end
		local v2 = registry[arg]
		if not v2 or type(v2.Set) ~= "function" then
			return
		end
		local flag2 = v.Flags[arg]
		if flag2 == nil then
			return
		end
		tbl2[arg] = true

		if pcall(v2.Set, flag2) then
			count += 1
		end
	end

	local tbl3 = {}

	for _, v2 in ipairs(GluResumeOrder) do
		tbl3[v2] = true
	end

	for k in pairs(registry) do
		if not tbl3[k] then
			fn3(k)
		end
	end

	for _, v2 in ipairs(GluResumeOrder) do
		fn3(v2)
	end

	return count
end

	local function fn4(xOffset, yOffset)
		local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local viewportSize = currentCamera and currentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
		return math.clamp(
			math.min(
				1,
				(math.floor(viewportSize.X) - 24) / math.max(xOffset, 1),
				(math.floor(viewportSize.Y) - 40) / math.max(yOffset, 1)
			),
			0.45,
			1
		)
	end

GluThreads = {}
GluThreadCap = 150
GluTask = task
local tbl2 = { __index = GluTask }

task = setmetatable({
	spawn = function(arg, ...)
		local spawn_ = GluTask.spawn
		local v2 = table.pack(...)
		v2.n = 2 + v2.n - 1
		table.move(v2, 1, v2.n, 2, v2)
		v2[1] = arg
		local v3 = spawn_(table.unpack(v2, 1, v2.n))

		if #GluThreads >= GluThreadCap then
			local gluThreads = {}

			for _, gluThread in ipairs(GluThreads) do
				if coroutine.status(gluThread) ~= "dead" then
					gluThreads[#gluThreads + 1] = gluThread
				end
			end

			GluThreads = gluThreads
			GluThreadCap = math.max(150, #gluThreads * 2)
		end

		if coroutine.status(v3) ~= "dead" then
			GluThreads[#GluThreads + 1] = v3
		end

		return v3
	end,
}, tbl2)

SafeSpawn = function(arg, arg2)
	task.spawn(function()
		while not GluUnloaded do
			local ok, result = pcall(arg2)
			if ok then
				return
			end
			local loopFault = (LoopFaults[arg] or 0) + 1
			LoopFaults[arg] = loopFault

			if loopFault == 1 or loopFault % 5 == 0 then
				warn(string.format("[Glu] %s loop recovered (%d): %s", tostring(arg), loopFault, tostring(result)))
			end

			task.wait(math.min(0.5 * loopFault, 5))
		end
	end)
end

SafePivot = function(model, arg)
	if not model or not model.Parent then
		return nil
	end

	if model:IsA("BasePart") then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return model.CFrame
		end)

		if ok and result then
			return result
		end
	else
		local humanoidRootPart = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if not humanoidRootPart and model:IsA("Model") then
			humanoidRootPart = model.PrimaryPart
		end

		if humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart.Parent then
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return humanoidRootPart.CFrame
			end)

			if ok and result then
				return result
			end
		end
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return model:GetPivot()
	end)

	if ok and result then
		return result
	end

	if arg then
		return CFrame.new(arg)
	end
	return nil
end

GluRespawnAt = 0

GluTryRespawn = function(now)
	local now2 = now or os.clock()
	if now2 - (GluRespawnAt or 0) < 2 then
		return false
	end
	GluRespawnAt = now2
	local flag2 = false

	pcall(function()
		for _, descendant in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
			if not (descendant:IsA("GuiButton") and descendant.Visible) then
				continue
			end

			if
				string.find(
					string.lower(tostring(descendant.Name) .. " " .. tostring(descendant.Text or "")),
					"respawn",
					1,
					true
				)
			then
				if type(firesignal) == "function" then
					pcall(function()
						firesignal(descendant.MouseButton1Click)
					end)

					pcall(function()
						firesignal(descendant.Activated)
					end)
				end

				pcall(function()
					descendant:Activate()
				end)

				flag2 = true
			end
		end
	end)

	if not flag2 then
		pcall(function()
			localPlayer:LoadCharacter()
		end)
	end

	return flag2
end

World.detect = function()
	local override

	if World.Override == "dungeon" or World.Override == "main" or World.Override == "menu" then
		override = World.Override
	elseif World.PlaceId == World.DungeonId then
		override = "dungeon"
	elseif World.MenuId ~= 0 and World.PlaceId == World.MenuId then
		override = "menu"
	elseif World.MainId ~= 0 and World.PlaceId == World.MainId then
		override = "main"
	else
		override = "main"
	end

	World.Key = override
	World.IsDungeon = override == "dungeon"
	World.IsMain = override == "main"
	World.IsMenu = override == "menu"
	return override
end

World.label = function()
	return string.format(
		"%s - place %s%s%s",
		World.IsDungeon and "dungeon world" or World.IsMenu and "main menu" or "main world",
		tostring(World.PlaceId),
		World.Override and " [forced]" or "",
		World.IsMain and World.MainId == 0 and " - farm id not set" or ""
	)
end

World.loadMessage = function()
	if World.IsDungeon then

	return "glu hub loaded"
end

	)
end

local function fn3()
	local tbl3 = {
		owner = true,
		ownername = true,
		player = true,
		playername = true,
		username = true,
		userid = true,
		ownerid = true,
		playerid = true,
		creator = true,
		creatorid = true,
		assignedto = true,
		assigned = true,
		assignedplayer = true,
		recipient = true,
		droppedfor = true,
		droppedby = true,
		lootowner = true,
		killer = true,
	}

	local function fn4(arg)
		return string.lower(tostring(arg or "")):gsub("[^%w]", "")
	end

	local function fn5(instance)
		if typeof(instance) == "Instance" then
			if instance:IsA("ValueBase") then
				return fn5(instance.Value)
			end

			if instance:IsA("Player") then
				return instance == localPlayer
			end
			return nil
		end

		if type(instance) == "number" then
			if instance == 0 then
				return nil
			end

			if instance == localPlayer.UserId then
				return true
			end

			if instance > 100000 then
			end

			return nil
		end

		if type(instance) ~= "string" then
			return nil
		end
		local v2 = fn4(instance)
		if v2 == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local v3 = fn4(localPlayer.Name)
		if v2 == v3 or v2 == tostring(localPlayer.UserId) then
			return true
		end
		local v4 = fn4(localPlayer.DisplayName)
		if v4 ~= "" and v2 == v4 then
			return true
		end

		if #v3 >= 4 and v2:find(v3, 1, true) then
			return true
		end

		for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player ~= localPlayer then
				local v5 = fn4(player.Name)
				if #v5 >= 4 and (v2 == v5 or v2:find(v5, 1, true) or v5:find(v2, 1, true)) then
					return false
				end
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function fn6(instance)
		if not instance then
			return nil
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return instance:GetAttributes()
		end)

		ok = ok and type(result) == "table"
		local flag2 = nil

		if ok then
			flag2 = nil

			for k, v2 in pairs(result) do
				if not tbl3[fn4(k)] then
					continue
				end
				local v3 = fn5(v2)
				if v3 == true then
					return true
				end

				if v3 == false then
					flag2 = false
				end
			end
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			if tbl3[fn4(child.Name)] then
				local v2 = fn5(child)
				if v2 == true then
					return true
				end

				if v2 == false then
					flag2 = false
				end
			end
		end

		return flag2
	end

	local function fn7(instance)
		local count = 0

		for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
			if not descendant:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				continue
			end
			count += 1
			if count > 3 then
				break
			end
			local v2 =
				string.lower(tostring(descendant.ObjectText or "") .. " " .. tostring(descendant.ActionText or ""))
			if v2 == " " or v2 == "" then
				continue
			end
			local name = string.lower(localPlayer.Name)
			if name ~= "" and string.find(v2, name, 1, true) then
				return false
			end
			local displayName = string.lower(localPlayer.DisplayName)
			if displayName ~= "" and string.find(v2, displayName, 1, true) then
				return false
			end

			for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if player == localPlayer then
					continue
				end
				local name2 = string.lower(player.Name)
				if #name2 >= 4 and string.find(v2, name2, 1, true) then
					return true
				end
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local obj = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

	return {
		isOurs = function(instance)
			if not instance or not instance.Parent then
				return false
			end
			local attribute = instance:GetAttribute("DropClaimedBy")
			if typeof(attribute) == "number" and attribute ~= 0 then
				return attribute == localPlayer.UserId
			end
			local attribute2 = instance:GetAttribute("DropOwnerUserId")

			if typeof(attribute2) == "number" then
				if attribute2 ~= 0 then
					return attribute2 == localPlayer.UserId
				end
			end

			local attribute3 = instance:GetAttribute("DropReservedFor")
			if typeof(attribute3) == "string" and attribute3 ~= "" then
				local str3 = tostring(localPlayer.UserId)
				return attribute3 == str3 or string.find(attribute3, str3, 1, true) ~= nil
			end
			local v2 = obj[instance]
			if v2 ~= nil then
				return v2
			end
			local flag2 = fn6(instance)
			if flag2 == true then
				obj[instance] = true
				return true
			end

			if fn7(instance) then
				obj[instance] = false
				return false
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				local v3 = fn6(child)
				if v3 == true then
					obj[instance] = true
					return true
				end

				if v3 == false and flag2 == nil then
					flag2 = false
				end
			end

			local flag3 = flag2 ~= false
			obj[instance] = flag3
			return flag3
		end,
		check = fn6,
	}
end

GluBossOrder = function()
	local tbl4 = {}
	local ordered = GluBossPriority.Ordered

	if type(ordered) == "table" and #ordered > 0 then
		for _, v2 in ipairs(ordered) do
			table.insert(tbl4, v2)
		end

		return tbl4
	end

	local base = GluBossPriority.Base
	local list = GluBossPriority.List

	if GluBossPriority.On == true and type(list) == "table" and #list > 0 then
		local tbl5 = {}

		for _, v2 in ipairs(base) do
			tbl5[v2] = true
		end

		for _, v2 in ipairs(list) do
			if tbl5[v2] then
				table.insert(tbl4, v2)
				tbl5[v2] = nil
			end
		end

		for _, v2 in ipairs(base) do
			if tbl5[v2] then
				table.insert(tbl4, v2)
				tbl5[v2] = nil
			end
		end
	else
		for _, v2 in ipairs(base) do
			table.insert(tbl4, v2)
		end
	end

	return tbl4
end

GluSignal = { Remote = nil, Proxy = nil, Path = "none", At = 0, Sends = 0, Fails = 0, TTL = 8 }

GluSignal.callable = function(remote)
	if remote == nil then
		return false
	end

	if type(remote) == "table" then
		if type(remote.FireServer) == "function" then
			return true
		end
		return type(remote.ToServer) == "function"
	end

	if typeof(remote) ~= "Instance" then
		return false
	end

	if remote:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		return true
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return remote.FireServer
	end)

	return ok and type(result) == "function"
end

GluSignal.module = function(instance)
	if typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" or not instance:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		return nil
	end
	local v3 = nil
	local ok, result = pcall(require, instance)

	if ok and type(result) == "table" and GluSignal.callable(result) then
		v3 = result
	end

	if not v3 then
		pcall(function()
			if type(getrenv) ~= "function" then
				return
			end
			local v4 = getrenv()
			local require_ = v4 and v4.require
			if type(require_) ~= "function" then
				return
			end
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(require_, instance)

			if ok2 and type(result2) == "table" and GluSignal.callable(result2) then
				v3 = result2
			end
		end)
	end

	return v3
end

GluSignal.from = function(instance)
	if typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" then
		return nil
	end
	local event = instance:FindFirstChild("Event")
	if GluSignal.callable(event) then
		return event, instance.Name .. "/Event"
	end
	local v3 = GluSignal.module(instance)
	local event2 = instance:FindFirstChild("Event") or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("RemoteEvent", true)
	if GluSignal.callable(event2) then
		return event2, instance.Name .. "/Event"
	end

	for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
			return descendant, instance.Name .. "/child"
		end
	end

	if v3 then
		return v3, instance.Name .. "/module"
	end
	return nil
end

GluSignal.resolve = function(arg)
	local now3 = os.clock()
	local remote = GluSignal.Remote

	if remote ~= nil and not arg then
		local ok

		if type(remote) == "table" then
			ok = true
		else
			local result

			ok, result = pcall(function()
				return remote.Parent
			end)

			ok = ok and result ~= nil
		end

		if ok and now3 - (GluSignal.At or 0) < (tonumber(GluSignal.TTL) or 8) then
			return remote
		end
		GluSignal.Remote = nil
	end

	GluSignal.At = now3
	local communication = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Communication")
	local serverAndClient = communication and communication:FindFirstChild("ServerAndClient")
	local signals = serverAndClient and serverAndClient:FindFirstChild("Signals")
	local signalEvent = signals and signals:FindFirstChild("SignalEvent")
		or ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("SignalEvent", true)

	if typeof(signalEvent) == "Instance" then
		local remote2, path = GluSignal.from(signalEvent)

		if remote2 then
			GluSignal.Remote = remote2
			GluSignal.Path = path
			return remote2
		end
	end

	pcall(function()
		for _, descendant in ipairs(ReplicatedStorage:GetDescendants()) do
			if
				descendant:IsA("RemoteEvent")
				and descendant.Name == "Event"
				and descendant.Parent
				and descendant.Parent.Name == "SignalEvent"
			then
				signalEvent = descendant
				return
			end
		end
	end)

	if typeof(signalEvent) == "Instance" and signalEvent:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
		GluSignal.Remote = signalEvent
		GluSignal.Path = "scan/Event"
		return signalEvent
	end

	GluSignal.Remote = nil
	GluSignal.Path = "missing"
	return nil
end

GluSignal.send = function(...)
	local v3 = table.pack(...)
	local value = select("#", ...)
	local v4 = table.pack(table.unpack(v3, 1, v3.n))

	local function getOk(remote)
		if remote == nil then
			return false
		end

		if type(remote) == "table" then
			if type(remote.FireServer) == "function" then
				return pcall(function()
					remote:FireServer(table.unpack(v4, 1, value))
				end)
			end

			if type(remote.ToServer) == "function" then
				return pcall(function()
					remote.ToServer(table.unpack(v4, 1, value))
				end)
			end
			return false
		end

		return pcall(function()
			remote:FireServer(table.unpack(v4, 1, value))
		end)
	end

	if getOk(GluSignal.resolve()) then
		GluSignal.Sends = (GluSignal.Sends or 0) + 1
		GluSignal.Fails = 0
		return true
	end

	GluSignal.Remote = nil

	if getOk(GluSignal.resolve(true)) then
		GluSignal.Sends = (GluSignal.Sends or 0) + 1
		GluSignal.Fails = 0
		return true
	end

	GluSignal.Fails = (GluSignal.Fails or 0) + 1
	return false
end

GluSignal.label = function()
	return string.format(
		"signal %s | %s | sent %d | held %d",
		tostring(GluSignal.Path or "none"),
		GluSignal.Remote ~= nil and "ready" or "missing",
		GluSignal.Sends or 0,
		GluSignal.Fails or 0
	)
end

local function fn6()
	local remote = GluSignal.resolve()

	if remote ~= nil then
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return remote.FireServer
		end)

		if ok and type(result) == "function" then
			return remote
		end

		if GluSignal.Proxy == nil then
			GluSignal.Proxy = {
				Name = "GluSignal",
				FireServer = function(...)
					return GluSignal.send(select(2, ...))
				end,
				InvokeServer = function(...)
					return GluSignal.send(select(2, ...))
				end,
			}
		end

		return GluSignal.Proxy
	end

	return nil
end

local function getHolder()
	local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
	local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local child = data and (data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name) or data:FindFirstChild(tostring(localPlayer.UserId)))
	if not child then
		return nil
	end
	local slots = child:FindFirstChild("slots") or child:FindFirstChild("Slots")
	if not slots then
		local quests = child:FindFirstChild("Quests", true)
		return quests and quests:FindFirstChild("Holder")
	end
	local holder = nil

	for _, child2 in ipairs(slots:GetChildren()) do
		local quests = child2:FindFirstChild("Quests")
		local holder2 = quests and quests:FindFirstChild("Holder")

		if holder2 then
			if #holder2:GetChildren() > 0 then
				return holder2
			end
			holder = holder or holder2
		end
	end

	return holder
end

local function getChild(arg)
	local holder = getHolder()
	if not holder then
		return nil
	end

	for _, child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
		local questString = child:FindFirstChild("QuestString")
		if child.Name == arg or (questString and questString.Value or "") == arg then
			return child
		end
	end

	return nil
end

OpenAnyContainer = function(instance)
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then
		return false
	end
	local proximityPrompt = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)

	if proximityPrompt and proximityPrompt.Enabled then
		local ok = false

		if type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
			ok = pcall(fireproximityprompt, proximityPrompt, 1)
		end

		pcall(function()
			proximityPrompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
		end)

		local delay = tonumber(proximityPrompt.HoldDuration) or 0

		if delay < 0.1 then
			delay = 0.1
		end

		if delay > 2.6 then
			delay = 2.6
		end

		LootHold.grab(proximityPrompt, delay + 0.5)
		LootHold.mark()

		if
			pcall(function()
				proximityPrompt:InputHoldBegin()
				task.wait(delay)
				proximityPrompt:InputHoldEnd()
			end) or ok
		then
			return true
		end
	end

	local clickDetector = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector", true)

	if clickDetector then
		local ok = false

		if type(fireclickdetector) == "function" then
			ok = pcall(fireclickdetector, clickDetector, 1)
		end

		ok = ok or pcall(function()
			clickDetector:Activate()
		end)

		if not ok then
			pcall(function()
				if firesignal then
					firesignal(clickDetector.MouseClick, localPlayer)
				end
			end)

			ok = true
		end

		if ok then
			return true
		end
	end

	local v3, v4, v5 = fn13()
	local basePart = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

	if basePart and v5 and type(firetouchinterest) == "function" then
		if
			pcall(function()
				firetouchinterest(basePart, v5, 0)
				task.wait(0.05)
				firetouchinterest(basePart, v5, 1)
			end)
		then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

GluGroundUnder = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
	if typeof(arg) ~= "Vector3" then
		return nil
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
		raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = arg2 and { arg2 } or {}
		raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
		return workspace:Raycast(arg, Vector3.new(0, -(arg3 or 400), 0), raycastParams)
	end)

	if ok and result then
		return result.Position
	end
	return nil
end

GluFloorNear = function(arg, character2)
	if typeof(arg) ~= "Vector3" then
		return nil
	end
	local v3 = (GluFloorUnder or GluGroundUnder)(arg + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0), character2, 28)
	if v3 and math.abs(v3.Y - arg.Y) <= 12 then
		return v3
	end
	return nil
end

GluLootStand = function(arg, arg2)
	if typeof(arg) ~= "Vector3" then
		return nil
	end
	arg2 = arg2 or localPlayer.Character
	local params = GluFloorParams and GluFloorParams(arg2) or RaycastParams.new()

	local function getVector(arg3)
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return workspace:Raycast(arg3 + Vector3.new(0, 8, 0), Vector3.new(0, -22, 0), params)
		end)

		local y = arg.Y + 3

		if ok and result then
			y = result.Position.Y + 3

			if arg.Y + 7 < y then
				y = arg.Y + 3
			end

			if y < arg.Y - 10 then
				y = arg.Y + 3
			end
		end

		return Vector3.new(arg3.X, y, arg3.Z)
	end

	local function fn14(vector)
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
			overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = arg2 and { arg2 } or {}
			return workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(vector, 1.5, overlapParams)
		end)

		if not ok or not result then
			return false
		end

		for i = 1, #result do
			local part = result[i]
			if part.CanCollide and math.abs(part.Position.Y - vector.Y) < 5 then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local tbl12 = {
		Vector3.zero,
		Vector3.new(4, 0, 0),
		Vector3.new(-4, 0, 0),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, 4),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, -4),
		Vector3.new(3, 0, 3),
		Vector3.new(-3, 0, 3),
		Vector3.new(3, 0, -3),
		Vector3.new(-3, 0, -3),
		Vector3.new(6, 0, 0),
		Vector3.new(-6, 0, 0),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, 6),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, -6),
	}

	for i = 1, #tbl12 do
		local vector = getVector(arg + tbl12[i])
		if not fn14(vector) then
			return vector
		end
	end

	return Vector3.new(arg.X, arg.Y + 3, arg.Z)
end

local function getCframe(arg)
	if typeof(arg) ~= "Vector3" then
		return nil
	end
	return CFrame.new(GluLootStand(arg, localPlayer.Character) or arg + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
end

local function fn14(model)
	if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then
		return false
	end
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return false
	end
	return model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") ~= nil
		or model.PrimaryPart ~= nil
		or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true) ~= nil
end

local function fn15(model)
	if not model then
		return nil
	end

	if model:IsA("BasePart") then
		return model
	end
	local humanoidRootPart = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if humanoidRootPart then
		return humanoidRootPart
	end

	if not model:IsA("Model") then
		return model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end
	return model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
end

Aim = {
	Lead = 0.2,
	LeadMax = 36,
	Moving = 6,
	LastPos = nil,
	LastAt = 0,
	TeleportedAt = 0,
	remember = function(lastPos)
		if not lastPos then
			return
		end
		Aim.LastPos = lastPos
		Aim.LastAt = os.clock()
	end,
	at = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
		if TeleportFix.holding() then
			local character2 = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if humanoidRootPart then
				TeleportFix.Status = "farm paused"
				return humanoidRootPart.CFrame
			end
		end

		local v3 = arg2(arg4, arg3)
		local part = arg and fn15(arg)
		if not part or not part.Parent then
			Aim.remember(v3.Position)
			return v3
		end
		local position = part.Position

		pcall(function()
			local assemblyLinearVelocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity

			if typeof(assemblyLinearVelocity) == "Vector3" and assemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > Aim.Moving then
				local vector = assemblyLinearVelocity * Aim.Lead

				if Aim.LeadMax < vector.Magnitude then
					vector = vector.Unit * Aim.LeadMax
				end

				position += vector
			end
		end)

		local position2 = position - v3.Position
		if position2.Magnitude < 0.05 then
			Aim.remember(v3.Position)
			return v3
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(
			CFrame.lookAt,
			v3.Position,
			position,
			math.abs(position2.Unit.Y) > 0.99 and Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) or Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
		)
		Aim.remember(v3.Position)
		if ok and result then
			return result
		end
		return v3
	end,
	running = function(arg)
		local part = arg and fn15(arg)
		if not part or not part.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		end)

		return ok and typeof(result) == "Vector3" and result.Magnitude > Aim.Moving
	end,
}

tbl5.alive = function(instance)
	if not instance or not instance.Parent then
		return false
	end

	if not instance:IsA("Model") then
		return false
	end
	local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if humanoid then
		return humanoid.Health > 0
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		for _, name in ipairs({ "Health", "HP", "MaxHealth" }) do
			local child = instance:FindFirstChild(name, true)
			if child and child:IsA("ValueBase") and tonumber(child.Value) then
				return tonumber(child.Value) > 0
			end
		end

		return nil
	end)

	if ok and result ~= nil then
		return result
	end

	if instance:GetAttribute("IsMob") == true then
		local attribute = instance:GetAttribute("Health") or instance:GetAttribute("MaxHealth")
		if type(attribute) == "number" then
			return attribute > 0
		end
		return true
	end

	return fn14(instance)
end

local function fn16(instance)
	local v3, v4, v5 = fn13()
	if not v5 then
		return math.huge
	end

	if typeof(instance) ~= "Vector3" then
		if typeof(instance) == "CFrame" then
			instance = instance.Position
		else
			local v6 = nil

			if typeof(instance) ~= "Instance" then
				instance = v6
			elseif instance:IsA("BasePart") then
				instance = instance.Position
			else
				local v7 = nil

				if instance:IsA("Model") then
					instance = fn15(instance)
					instance = instance and instance.Position
				else
					instance = v7
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return instance and (v5.Position - instance).Magnitude or math.huge
end

end

	end

	fn19(workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree"))

local function getInstances(arg)
	local tbl12 = {}

	for _, v3 in ipairs(arg) do
		local v4 = fn11(v3)

		if v4 ~= "" then
			tbl12[v4] = true
		end
	end

	local instances = {}

	local function fn19(instance)
		local v3 = fn11(instance.Name)
		local v4 = fn11(instance:GetAttribute("Title"))
		local v5 = fn11(instance:GetAttribute("NpcCode"))
		local flag15 = tbl12[v3] or v4 ~= "" and tbl12[v4] or v5 ~= "" and tbl12[v5]

		if not flag15 then
			for k in pairs(tbl12) do
				if #v3 >= 4 and #k >= 4 and (string.find(v3, k, 1, true) or string.find(k, v3, 1, true)) then
					flag15 = true
					break
				end
			end
		end

		return flag15
	end

	local function fn20(instance)
		if not instance:IsA("Model") then
			return
		end
		local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end

		if fn19(instance) then
			table.insert(instances, instance)
		end
	end

	local function fn21(instance)
		fn20(instance)
		if not (instance:IsA("Model") or instance:IsA("Folder")) then
			return
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			fn20(child)

			if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("Folder") then
				for _, child2 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
					fn20(child2)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, instance in ipairs(fn18()) do
		for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			fn21(child)
		end
	end

	return instances
end

local function getInstances2()
	local instances = {}
	local instances2 = {}

	local function fn19(instance)
		if not instance or instances2[instance] or not instance:IsA("Model") or fn17(instance) then
			return
		end
		local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
			instances2[instance] = true
			table.insert(instances, instance)
		end
	end

	local function fn20(instance, arg)
		if not instance or arg > 4 then
			return
		end
		fn19(instance)

		if instance:IsA("Model") or instance:IsA("Folder") then
			for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				fn20(child, arg + 1)
			end
		end
	end

	for _, instance in ipairs(fn18()) do
		for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			fn20(child, 0)
		end
	end

	return instances
end

	return temporary and temporary:FindFirstChild("ActiveNpcs")
end

getAllBossFolders = function()
	local tbl12 = {}
	local tbl13 = {}

	local function fn19(arg)
		if arg and not tbl13[arg] then
			tbl13[arg] = true
			table.insert(tbl12, arg)
		end
	end

	fn19(getActiveNpcs())
	fn19(getTemporaryBossFolder())

	for _, name in ipairs({ "Humanoids", "Debree" }) do
		local child = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
		local regions = child and child:FindFirstChild("Regions")

		if regions then
			for _, child2 in ipairs(regions:GetChildren()) do
				fn19(child2:FindFirstChild("ActiveNpcs"))
			end
		end
	end

	return tbl12
end

findBossFolderAnywhere = function(name)
	for _, allBossFolder in ipairs(getAllBossFolders()) do
		local child = allBossFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
		if child then
			return child
		end
	end

	return nil
end

local function getNames()
	local names3 = {}
	local tbl12 = {}
	local activeNpcs = getActiveNpcs()

	for _, allBossFolder in ipairs(getAllBossFolders()) do
		if not allBossFolder then
			continue
		end
		local flag15 = allBossFolder == activeNpcs

		for _, child in ipairs(allBossFolder:GetChildren()) do
			if flag15 or child:FindFirstChild("BossInfo") then
				if not tbl12[child.Name] then
					tbl12[child.Name] = true
					table.insert(names3, child.Name)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, v3 in ipairs(GluBossCatalog) do
		if not tbl12[v3] then
			tbl12[v3] = true
			table.insert(names3, v3)
		end
	end

	table.sort(names3)
	return names3
end

local fn19

do
	local function fn20(instance)
		if not instance then
			return nil
		end

		if typeof(instance) == "Vector3" then
			return instance
		end

		if typeof(instance) == "CFrame" then
			return instance.Position
		end

		if typeof(instance) == "Instance" then
			if instance:IsA("Vector3Value") then
				return instance.Value
			end

			if instance:IsA("CFrameValue") then
				return instance.Value.Position
			end

			if instance:IsA("StringValue") then
				local match, v3, v4 = instance.Value:match("([%-%d%.]+)%s*,%s*([%-%d%.]+)%s*,%s*([%-%d%.]+)")
				if match and v3 and v4 then
					return Vector3.new(tonumber(match), tonumber(v3), tonumber(v4))
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		if type(instance) == "string" then
			local match, v3, v4 = instance:match("([%-%d%.]+)%s*,%s*([%-%d%.]+)%s*,%s*([%-%d%.]+)")
			if match and v3 and v4 then
				return Vector3.new(tonumber(match), tonumber(v3), tonumber(v4))
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function getAttribute(instance, attribute)
		if not instance then
			return nil
		end
		local attribute2 = instance:GetAttribute(attribute)
		if attribute2 ~= nil then
			return attribute2
		end
		local attribute3 = string.lower(attribute)

		for k, attribute4 in pairs(instance:GetAttributes()) do
			if string.lower(k) == attribute3 then
				return attribute4
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	fn19 = function(arg)
		local bossFolderAnywhere = findBossFolderAnywhere(arg)
		if not bossFolderAnywhere then
			return GluBossCenter(arg)
		end
		local attribute = getAttribute(bossFolderAnywhere, "center")

		if attribute then
			local v3 = fn20(attribute)
			if v3 then
				return v3
			end
		end

		local bossInfo = bossFolderAnywhere:FindFirstChild("BossInfo")

		if bossInfo then
			local v3 = fn20(bossInfo)
			if v3 then
				return v3
			end
			local attribute2 = getAttribute(bossInfo, "center")

			if attribute2 then
				local v4 = fn20(attribute2)
				if v4 then
					return v4
				end
			end

			local center = bossInfo:FindFirstChild("Center") or bossInfo:FindFirstChild("center")

			if center then
				local v4 = fn20(center)
				if v4 then
					return v4
				end
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(bossInfo:GetChildren()) do
				local attribute3 = getAttribute(child, "center")

				if attribute3 then
					local v4 = fn20(attribute3)
					if v4 then
						return v4
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local center = bossFolderAnywhere:FindFirstChild("Center") or bossFolderAnywhere:FindFirstChild("center")

		if center then
			local v3 = fn20(center)
			if v3 then
				return v3
			end
		end

		local center2 = bossFolderAnywhere:FindFirstChild("Center", true)
			or bossFolderAnywhere:FindFirstChild("center", true)

		if center2 then
			local v3 = fn20(center2)
			if v3 then
				return v3
			end
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(bossFolderAnywhere:GetDescendants()) do
			local attribute2 = getAttribute(descendant, "center")

			if attribute2 then
				local v3 = fn20(attribute2)
				if v3 then
					return v3
				end
			end
		end

		return GluBossCenter(arg)
	end
end

local fn20, fn21

do
	local function getBroadHits()
		if os.clock() - tbl6.BroadAt < 3 then
			return tbl6.BroadHits
		end
		tbl6.BroadAt = os.clock()
		local broadHits = {}

		for _, allBossFolder in ipairs(getAllBossFolders()) do
			if not allBossFolder then
				continue
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(allBossFolder:GetDescendants()) do
				if not (descendant:IsA("Model") and fn14(descendant)) then
					continue
				end
				local v3 = fn11(descendant.Name)

				if v3 ~= "" and not broadHits[v3] then
					broadHits[v3] = descendant
				end

				local attribute = descendant:GetAttribute("NpcCode")

				if typeof(attribute) == "string" and attribute ~= "" then
					local v4 = fn11(attribute)

					if not broadHits[v4] then
						broadHits[v4] = descendant
					end
				end
			end
		end

		tbl6.BroadHits = broadHits
		return broadHits
	end

	local tbl12 = {}

	fn20 = function(arg, arg2)
		if not arg then
			return false
		end
		arg2 = arg2 or string.format("%.0f,%.0f,%.0f", arg.X, arg.Y, arg.Z)
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if tbl12[arg2] and now3 - tbl12[arg2] < 8 then
			return false
		end

		if (StreamPrunedAt or 0) == 0 or now3 - StreamPrunedAt > 60 then
			StreamPrunedAt = now3

			for k, v3 in pairs(tbl12) do
				if now3 - v3 > 60 then
					tbl12[k] = nil
				end
			end
		end

		tbl12[arg2] = now3
		return true
	end

	fn21 = function(name, arg)
		if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local allBossFolders = getAllBossFolders()
		if #allBossFolders == 0 then
			return nil
		end
		local child = nil

		for _, allBossFolder in ipairs(allBossFolders) do
			child = allBossFolder:FindFirstChild(name)
			if child then
				break
			end
			child = nil
		end

		if child then
			if child:IsA("Model") and fn14(child) then
				return child
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("Model") and fn14(descendant) then
					return descendant
				end
			end
		end

		for _, allBossFolder in ipairs(allBossFolders) do
			for _, child2 in ipairs(allBossFolder:GetChildren()) do
				if child2:IsA("Model") and fn14(child2) then
					if
						child2.Name == name
						or child2:GetAttribute("NpcCode") == name
						or fn11(child2.Name) == fn11(name)
					then
						return child2
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if child then
			local v3 = fn11(name)

			for _, descendant in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("Model") and fn14(descendant) and fn11(descendant.Name) == v3 then
					return descendant
				end
			end
		end

		local broadHit = getBroadHits()[fn11(name)]
		if broadHit then
			return broadHit
		end

		if not arg then
			return nil
		end
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if not (now3 - tbl6.FallbackAt >= 1.5) then
			return nil
		end
		tbl6.FallbackAt = now3

		for _, allBossFolder in ipairs(allBossFolders) do
			for _, descendant in ipairs(allBossFolder:GetDescendants()) do
				if not (descendant:IsA("Model") and fn14(descendant)) then
					continue
				end
				local humanoid = descendant:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

				if humanoid and humanoid.MaxHealth >= 300 then
					local ok, result = pcall(function()
						return descendant:GetPivot().Position
					end)

					if ok and result and (result - arg).Magnitude <= 30 then
						return descendant
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return nil
	end
end
