	GluHold.Fixes = 0
	GluHold.FixWindow = 0
	GluHold.SlowUntil = 0
	GluHold.LastWrite = nil
	GluHold.LastStep = 0
	GluHold.Stable = 0
	GluPace = { Mobile = false, Fps = 60, Weak = false, Acc = 0, Frames = 0 }

	task.spawn(function()
		local UserInputService2 = game:GetService("UserInputService")
		GluPace.Mobile = UserInputService2.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService2.KeyboardEnabled
		GluPace.Weak = GluPace.Mobile

		GluTrack(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(deltaTime)
			GluPace.Frames = GluPace.Frames + 1
			GluPace.Acc = GluPace.Acc + (tonumber(deltaTime) or 0)
			if GluPace.Acc < 0.6 then
				return
			end
			GluPace.Fps = GluPace.Frames / GluPace.Acc
			GluPace.Frames = 0
			GluPace.Acc = 0
			GluPace.Weak = GluPace.Mobile or GluPace.Fps < 26
		end))
	end)

	GluHold.killVelocity = function(instance, part, arg)
		if not part or not part.Parent then
			return
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return part.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
		end)

		ok = ok and tonumber(result) or 0

		pcall(function()
			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end)

		if not arg and ok < GluHold.Fling then
			return
		end

		if GluPace and GluPace.Weak then
			return
		end

		if not instance or not instance.Parent then
			return
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
				local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
					return descendant.AssemblyLinearVelocity
				end)

				if ok2 and typeof(result2) == "Vector3" and result2.Magnitude > 0.5 then
					pcall(function()
						descendant.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						descendant.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	GluHold.finite = function(arg)
		if typeof(arg) ~= "CFrame" then
			return false
		end
		local position = arg.Position
		local x = position.X
		local y = position.Y
		local z = position.Z
		if x ~= x or y ~= y or z ~= z then
			return false
		end

		if math.abs(x) == math.huge or math.abs(y) == math.huge or math.abs(z) == math.huge then
			return false
		end

		if math.abs(x) > 1000000 or math.abs(y) > 1000000 or math.abs(z) > 1000000 then
			return false
		end
		return true
	end

	GluHold.solve = function(arg)
		if typeof(arg) == "CFrame" then
			if GluHold.finite(arg) then
				return arg
			end
			return nil
		end

		if typeof(arg) == "Vector3" then
			local cframe = CFrame.new(arg)
			if GluHold.finite(cframe) then
				return cframe
			end
			return nil
		end

		if type(arg) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end
		local ok, cframe = pcall(arg)

		if ok then
			if typeof(cframe) ~= "CFrame" then
				local v10 = nil

				if typeof(cframe) == "Vector3" then
					cframe = CFrame.new(cframe)
				else
					cframe = v10
				end
			end

			if cframe and GluHold.finite(cframe) then
				return cframe
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	GluHold.free = function()
		local lock = GluHold.Lock
		GluHold.Lock = nil
		GluHold.LockCharacter = nil
		GluHold.Goal = nil

		if lock then
			pcall(function()
				lock:Destroy()
			end)
		end

		local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart.Anchored then
			pcall(function()
				humanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
			end)
		end
	end

	GluHold.release = function()
		GluHold.Until = 0
		GluHold.Source = nil
		GluHold.Status = "idle"
		GluHold.Mode = "idle"
		GluHold.Sticky = false
		GluHold.Pulse = 0
		GluHold.LastWrite = nil
		GluHold.LastStep = 0
		GluHold.Stable = 0
		GluHold.HoldUntil = 0
		GluHold.Lease = 0
		GluHold.Pose = false
		GluHold.Instant = false
		GluHold.Anchor = nil
		GluHold.AnchorUntil = 0

		if GluHold.clearStick then
			GluHold.clearStick()
		end

		GluHold.free()
		GluHold.aimBody(false)

		if GluHold.frameCamera then
			GluHold.frameCamera(nil)
		end

		local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if humanoidRootPart then
			GluHold.Home = humanoidRootPart.Position
		end

		GluHold.ensureWatch()

		if GluHold.Connection then
			pcall(function()
				GluHold.Connection:Disconnect()
			end)

			GluHold.Connection = nil
		end
	end

	GluHold.modules = function()
		if GluHold._mods then
			return GluHold._mods
		end
		local mods = {}

		pcall(function()
			mods.Utility = require(ReplicatedStorage.CAM.Global.Utility)
		end)

		GluHold._mods = mods
		return mods
	end

	GluHold.aimBody = function(arg)
		local humanoid = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid then
			return
		end

		if arg then
			if GluHold.SavedStand == nil then
				GluHold.SavedStand = humanoid.PlatformStand
				GluHold.SavedRotate = humanoid.AutoRotate
			end

			humanoid.PlatformStand = false
			humanoid.AutoRotate = false

			pcall(function()
				humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall, false)
				humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, false)
				humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, false)
			end)

			GluHold.antiFall(true)
			return
		end

		GluHold.antiFall(false)
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
		humanoid.AutoRotate = true

		pcall(function()
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Ragdoll, true)
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall, true)
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.FallingDown, true)
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp, true)
			humanoid:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running, true)
			humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp)
		end)

		GluHold.SavedStand = nil
		GluHold.SavedRotate = nil
	end

	GluHold.antiFall = function(arg)
		local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local fallBody = GluHold.FallBody

		if humanoidRootPart then
			for _, child in ipairs(humanoidRootPart:GetChildren()) do
				if
					child.Name == "GluAntiFall" and child ~= fallBody
					or child.Name == "GluAntiFallAttach" and child ~= GluHold.FallAttach
				then
					pcall(function()
						child:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end
		end

		if not arg then
			GluHold.FallBody = nil

			if fallBody then
				pcall(function()
					fallBody:Destroy()
				end)
			end

			if GluHold.FallAttach then
				pcall(function()
					GluHold.FallAttach:Destroy()
				end)

				GluHold.FallAttach = nil
			end

			return
		end

		if not humanoidRootPart then
			return
		end

		if
			fallBody
			and fallBody.Parent
			and fallBody.Attachment0
			and fallBody.Attachment0.Parent == humanoidRootPart
		then
			return
		end

		if fallBody then
			pcall(function()
				fallBody:Destroy()
			end)
		end

		if GluHold.FallAttach then
			pcall(function()
				GluHold.FallAttach:Destroy()
			end)
		end

		local gluAntiFallAttach = Instance.new("Attachment")
		gluAntiFallAttach.Name = "GluAntiFallAttach"
		gluAntiFallAttach.Parent = humanoidRootPart

		local gluAntiFall = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
		gluAntiFall.Name = "GluAntiFall"
		gluAntiFall.Attachment0 = gluAntiFallAttach
		gluAntiFall.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
		gluAntiFall.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
		gluAntiFall.MaxForce = math.huge
		gluAntiFall.Parent = humanoidRootPart
		GluHold.FallAttach = gluAntiFallAttach
		GluHold.FallBody = gluAntiFall
	end

	GluFloorParams = function(arg)
		local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
		raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		local filterDescendantsInstances = {}

		if arg then
			filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = arg
		end

		local humanoids = workspace:FindFirstChild("Humanoids")

		if humanoids then
			filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = humanoids
		end

		local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")

		if debree then
			filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = debree
		end

		raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
		raycastParams.IgnoreWater = true
		return raycastParams
	end

	GluFloorUnder = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		if typeof(arg) ~= "Vector3" then
			return nil
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return workspace:Raycast(arg, Vector3.new(0, -(arg3 or 400), 0), GluFloorParams(arg2))
		end)

		if ok and result then
			return result.Position
		end
		return nil
	end

	GluStealth = {
		Enabled = true,
		Relay = true,
		Horiz = 48,
		Vert = 48,
		Gap = 0.04,
		Count = 0,
		Active = false,
		Goal = nil,
		Status = "ready",
	}

	GluStealth.clamp = function(arg, arg2)
		local position = arg.Position
		local position2 = arg2.Position
		local n16 = position2.Y - position.Y

		if math.abs(n16) > GluStealth.Vert then
			n16 = (n16 < 0 and -1 or 1) * GluStealth.Vert
		end

		local x = position2.X
		local z = position2.Z

		if GluStealth.Relay then
			local vector = Vector3.new(position2.X - position.X, 0, position2.Z - position.Z)
			local magnitude = vector.Magnitude

			if GluStealth.Horiz < magnitude then
				vector *= GluStealth.Horiz / magnitude
			end

			x = position.X + vector.X
			z = position.Z + vector.Z
		end

		return CFrame.new(Vector3.new(x, position.Y + n16, z)) * (arg2 - arg2.Position)
	end

	GluStealth.within = function(arg, arg2)
		if math.abs(arg2.Position.Y - arg.Position.Y) > GluStealth.Vert then
			return false
		end

		if GluStealth.Relay then
			if
				GluStealth.Horiz
				< Vector3.new(arg2.Position.X - arg.Position.X, 0, arg2.Position.Z - arg.Position.Z).Magnitude
			then
				return false
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	GluStealth.hop = function(primaryPart, arg)
		local cFrame = GluStealth.clamp(primaryPart, arg)
		if GluHold and GluHold.commit then
			GluHold.commit(primaryPart, cFrame)
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			local parent = primaryPart.Parent

			if parent and parent:IsA("Model") then
				if parent.PrimaryPart ~= primaryPart then
					parent.PrimaryPart = primaryPart
				end

				parent:PivotTo(cFrame)
			else
				primaryPart.CFrame = cFrame
			end

			primaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			primaryPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	GluStealth.launch = function()
		if GluStealth.Active then
			return
		end
		GluStealth.Active = true

		SafeSpawn("glu-stealth", function()
			while not GluUnloaded and GluStealth.Goal do
				local character2 = localPlayer.Character
				local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				local goal = GluStealth.Goal

				if humanoidRootPart and goal then
					local n16 = math.abs(goal.Position.Y - humanoidRootPart.Position.Y)
					local vector = Vector3.new(
						goal.Position.X - humanoidRootPart.Position.X,
						0,
						goal.Position.Z - humanoidRootPart.Position.Z
					)

					if n16 <= 0.8 and (not GluStealth.Relay or vector.Magnitude <= 1.2) then
						GluHold.Home = humanoidRootPart.Position
						GluStealth.Goal = nil
						GluStealth.Status = "arrived"
						break
					else
						GluStealth.hop(humanoidRootPart, goal)
						task.wait(GluStealth.Gap)
						continue
					end
				end

				break
			end

			GluStealth.Active = false
		end)
	end

	GluStealth.route = function(arg, goal, arg2)
		if not GluStealth.Enabled then
			return false
		end

		if arg2 or not arg or not goal then
			return false
		end

		if GluStealth.within(arg, goal) then
			return false
		end
		local flag15 = GluStealth.Goal == nil or (GluStealth.Goal.Position - goal.Position).Magnitude > 2
		GluStealth.Goal = goal

		if flag15 then
			GluStealth.Count = (GluStealth.Count or 0) + 1
			GluStealth.Status =
				string.format("stepping %.0f studs of height", math.abs(goal.Position.Y - arg.Position.Y))
		end

		GluStealth.launch()
		return true
	end

	GluHold.commit = function(primaryPart, cFrame, arg)
		if not primaryPart or not primaryPart.Parent or not cFrame then
			return
		end
		local parent = primaryPart.Parent
		local y = 0

		if arg then
			pcall(function()
				y = primaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
			end)

			if y > 0 then
				y = 0
			end
		end

		pcall(function()
			if parent and parent:IsA("Model") then
				if parent.PrimaryPart ~= primaryPart then
					parent.PrimaryPart = primaryPart
				end

				parent:PivotTo(cFrame)
			else
				primaryPart.CFrame = cFrame
			end

			if arg then
				primaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, y, 0)
			else
				primaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			end

			primaryPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end)
	end

	GluHold.flatFrom = function(arg, arg2)
		local position = arg.Position - arg2.Position
		return Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z).Magnitude
	end

	GluHold.dropWrite = function(instance, arg)
		if not instance or not arg then
			return false
		end
		local position = instance.Position
		local position2 = arg.Position
		local stickFloor = GluHold.StickFloor

		if Vector3.new(position.X - position2.X, 0, position.Z - position2.Z).Magnitude <= 18 then
			if stickFloor == nil or position.Y < stickFloor then
				GluHold.StickFloor = position.Y
				stickFloor = position.Y
			end

			if position.Y <= stickFloor + 8 then
				return false
			end
			local n16 = arg - arg.Position
			local n17 = CFrame.new(position2.X, stickFloor, position2.Z) * n16
			GluHold.commit(instance, n17, true)
			GluHold.Home = n17.Position
			return true
		end

		local y = position2.Y
		local v10 = GluFloorUnder(
			Vector3.new(position2.X, math.max(position2.Y, position.Y) + 8, position2.Z),
			instance.Parent,
			90
		)

		if v10 and position2.Y - v10.Y > 4 then
			y = v10.Y + 3
		end

		if not (stickFloor and stickFloor < y) then
			stickFloor = y
		end

		local n16 = arg - arg.Position
		local anchor = CFrame.new(position2.X, stickFloor, position2.Z) * n16
		GluHold.commit(instance, anchor, true)
		GluHold.StickFloor = stickFloor
		GluHold.Home = anchor.Position
		GluHold.Anchor = anchor
		return true
	end

	GluHold.place = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		if GluHold.Instant then
			return GluHold.placeDirect(arg, arg2, false)
		end

		if GluGlide and GluGlide.Farm == true and GluGlide.wanted and GluGlide.wanted(arg3) then
			return GluGlide.move(arg, arg2, arg3)
		end
		return GluHold.placeDirect(arg, arg2, arg3)
	end

	GluHold.placeDirect = function(arg, cframe, arg2)
		if GluHold.Instant then
			GluHold.commit(arg, cframe)
			return
		end
		local flag15 = (arg.Position - cframe.Position).Magnitude < (arg2 and 0.45 or 0.75)
		local flag16 = arg.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(cframe.LookVector) > 0.99

		if arg2 then
			if flag15 and flag16 then
				return
			end
		elseif flag15 then
			return
		end

		if GluStealth and GluStealth.route and GluStealth.route(arg, cframe, arg2) then
			return
		end
		GluHold.commit(arg, cframe)
	end

	GluHold.frameCamera = function(arg)
		local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not currentCamera then
			return
		end

		if not (arg and GluHold.Pose and arg.CFrame.LookVector.Y < -0.35) then
			if GluHold.CamOwned then
				currentCamera.CameraType = GluHold.CamType or Enum.CameraType.Custom
				GluHold.CamOwned = false
			end

			return
		end

		if not GluHold.CamOwned then
			GluHold.CamType = currentCamera.CameraType
			GluHold.CamOwned = true
		end

		currentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
		currentCamera.CFrame =
			CFrame.lookAt(arg.Position + -arg.CFrame.LookVector * 18 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0), arg.Position)
	end

	GluHold.wantsMove = function()
		local UserInputService2 = game:GetService("UserInputService")
		if UserInputService2:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			return false
		end
		return UserInputService2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W)
			or UserInputService2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A)
			or UserInputService2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S)
			or UserInputService2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D)
			or UserInputService2:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space)
	end

	GluHold.pin = function(arg)
		local goal = GluHold.solve(arg)
		if not goal then
			return false
		end
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not character2 or not humanoidRootPart then
			return false
		end

		if GluHold.Lock then
			pcall(function()
				GluHold.Lock:Destroy()
			end)

			GluHold.Lock = nil
			GluHold.LockCharacter = nil
		end

		if GluHold.Pose and LootHold and LootHold.busy() then
			GluHold.Pose = false
			return false
		end
		GluHold.Goal = goal
		GluHold.Lease = os.clock()
		GluHold.Just = os.clock()
		GluHold.Home = goal.Position

		if GluHold.Pose then
			GluHold.aimBody(true)
		end

		GluHold.place(humanoidRootPart, goal, GluHold.Pose == true)
		GluHold.Seen = goal.Position
		GluHold.LastWrite = goal.Position
		GluHold.ensureWatch()
		GluHold.LastBlink = os.clock()
		GluHold.Status = "there"
		return true
	end

	GluHold.guarding = function()
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if now3 < (GluHold.HoldUntil or 0) then
			return true
		end

		if now3 - (GluHold.Lease or 0) < 0.5 then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	GluHold.stopWatch = function()
		if GluHold.Watch then
			pcall(function()
				GluHold.Watch:Disconnect()
			end)

			GluHold.Watch = nil
		end

		GluHold.antiFall(false)
	end

	GluHold.clearStick = function()
		GluHold.Stick = nil
		GluHold.StickChar = nil
		GluHold.StickQuietAt = nil
	end

	GluHold.holdStick = function()
		local stick = GluHold.Stick
		if typeof(stick) ~= "CFrame" then
			return false
		end
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if (GluHold.StickHard or 0) <= now3 then
			GluHold.clearStick()
			return false
		end
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local humanoid = character2 and character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if GluHold.StickChar and character2 ~= GluHold.StickChar then
			GluHold.clearStick()
			return false
		end

		if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return false
		end
		GluHold.dropWrite(humanoidRootPart, stick)
		GluHold.Goal = stick
		local v10 = GluHold.flatFrom(humanoidRootPart, stick)

		if v10 > 18 and now3 + 1.5 < (GluHold.StickHard or 0) then
			GluHold.StickUntil = math.max(GluHold.StickUntil or 0, now3 + 1.5)
			GluHold.StickQuietAt = nil
		elseif v10 <= 18 then
			if not GluHold.StickQuietAt then
				GluHold.StickQuietAt = now3
			end

			GluHold.Home = humanoidRootPart.Position
		end

		if (GluHold.StickUntil or 0) <= now3 then
			if (GluHold.StickQuietAt and now3 - GluHold.StickQuietAt or 0) >= 0.45 then
				GluHold.clearStick()
				return false
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	GluHold.bindStick = function()
		if GluHold.StickBeat then
			return
		end

		GluHold.StickBeat = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			if GluUnloaded then
				if GluHold.StickBeat then
					pcall(function()
						GluHold.StickBeat:Disconnect()
					end)

					GluHold.StickBeat = nil
				end

				GluHold.clearStick()
				return
			end

			GluHold.holdStick()
		end)
	end

	GluHold.armStick = function(stick)
		if typeof(stick) ~= "CFrame" then
			return
		end
		local now3 = os.clock()
		GluHold.Stick = stick
		GluHold.StickChar = localPlayer.Character
		GluHold.StickUntil = now3 + 4.2
		GluHold.StickHard = now3 + 10
		GluHold.StickQuietAt = nil
		GluHold.StickFloor = nil
		GluHold.Anchor = stick
		GluHold.AnchorUntil = now3 + 10
		GluHold.Home = stick.Position
		GluHold.Goal = stick
		GluHold.bindStick()
		GluHold.holdStick()
	end

	GluHold.ensureWatch = function()
		if GluHold.Watch then
			return
		end

		if GluUnloaded then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			local genv = getgenv()
			local gluWatchConns = genv.GluWatchConns

			if type(gluWatchConns) ~= "table" then
				gluWatchConns = {}
				genv.GluWatchConns = gluWatchConns
			end

			for i = #gluWatchConns, 1, -1 do
				pcall(function()
					gluWatchConns[i]:Disconnect()
				end)

				gluWatchConns[i] = nil
			end
		end)

		GluHold.Watch = (RunService.PreSimulation or RunService.Heartbeat):Connect(function(arg)
			if GluUnloaded then
				GluHold.stopWatch()
				return
			end
			local n16 = tonumber(arg) or 0.016
			local character2 = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local humanoid = character2 and character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if not humanoidRootPart or not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				GluHold.Home = nil

				if GluHold.CamOwned then
					GluHold.frameCamera(nil)
				end

				return
			end

			if GluHold.holdStick and GluHold.holdStick() then
				return
			end

			if GluHold.HomeChar ~= character2 then
				GluHold.HomeChar = character2
				GluHold.Home = humanoidRootPart.Position
				return
			end

			local now3 = os.clock()
			local anchor = GluHold.Anchor

			if typeof(anchor) == "CFrame" and now3 < (GluHold.AnchorUntil or 0) then
				local v10 = GluHold.flatFrom(humanoidRootPart, anchor)

				if GluHold.wantsMove and GluHold.wantsMove() and v10 < 12 then
					GluHold.Anchor = nil
				else
					if v10 > 18 then
						GluHold.dropWrite(humanoidRootPart, anchor)
						return
					end

					if humanoidRootPart.Position.Y < anchor.Position.Y - 1 then
						local n17 = anchor - anchor.Position
						GluHold.Anchor = CFrame.new(anchor.Position.X, humanoidRootPart.Position.Y, anchor.Position.Z)
							* n17
					end
				end
			elseif anchor and now3 >= (GluHold.AnchorUntil or 0) then
				GluHold.Anchor = nil
				GluHold.StickFloor = nil
			end

			local weak = GluPace and GluPace.Weak
			local flag15 = GluHold.Pose and now3 - (GluHold.Lease or 0) < 0.5 and not (LootHold and LootHold.busy())
			local goal = GluHold.Goal

			if flag15 and goal then
				if weak and now3 - (GluHold.WeakAt or 0) < 0.12 then
					return
				end

				if weak then
					GluHold.WeakAt = now3
				end

				GluHold.aimBody(true)
				GluHold.place(humanoidRootPart, goal, true)
				GluHold.frameCamera(humanoidRootPart)
				GluHold.Home = goal.Position
				GluHold.Seen = goal.Position
				return
			end

			GluHold.frameCamera(nil)

			if LootHold and LootHold.busy() and LootHold.Pos then
				local pos = LootHold.Pos

				if
					not (GluLoot.NoTp and GluHold.wantsMove and GluHold.wantsMove())
					and (
						math.abs(humanoidRootPart.Position.Y - pos.Y) > 14
						or (humanoidRootPart.Position - pos).Magnitude > 22
					)
				then
					GluHold.place(humanoidRootPart, CFrame.new(pos), false)
				end

				GluHold.Home = pos
				return
			end

			if now3 - (GluHold.Just or 0) < 0.12 then
				return
			end
			local home = GluHold.Home or humanoidRootPart.Position
			local magnitude = (humanoidRootPart.Position - home).Magnitude
			local n17 = math.abs(humanoidRootPart.Position.Y - home.Y)
			if GluLoot.NoTp and now3 > (GluHold.HoldUntil or 0) and not GluHold.guarding() then
				GluHold.Home = humanoidRootPart.Position
				return
			end
			local n18 = GluLoot.NoTp and 60 or 22

			if weak then
				n18 = math.max(90, 140 * n16)
			end

			if n17 > (GluLoot.NoTp and 22 or 12) or magnitude > n18 then
				if GluLoot.NoTp then
					GluHold.Home = humanoidRootPart.Position
					return
				end

				if weak and magnitude < 220 and n17 < 40 then
					GluHold.Home = humanoidRootPart.Position
					return
				end
				humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(home)
					* (humanoidRootPart.CFrame - humanoidRootPart.CFrame.Position)
				humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				return
			end

			GluHold.Home = humanoidRootPart.Position
		end)

		pcall(function()
			local gluWatchConns = getgenv().GluWatchConns

			if type(gluWatchConns) == "table" then
				gluWatchConns[#gluWatchConns + 1] = GluHold.Watch
			end
		end)
	end

	GluHold.ensure = function()
		if GluHold.Connection then
			return
		end
		GluHold.Character = localPlayer.Character

		GluHold.Connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
			local character2 = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not character2 or not humanoidRootPart then
				GluHold.release()
				return
			end

			if
				GluHold.Mode == "follow"
				and not GluHold.Sticky
				and (GluHold.Pulse or 0) > 0
				and os.clock() - GluHold.Pulse > 0.45
			then
				GluHold.release()
				return
			end

			if not GluHold.guarding() then
				GluHold.Goal = nil
				GluHold.Source = nil
				GluHold.Mode = "idle"
				GluHold.Sticky = false
				GluHold.Status = "idle"
				return
			end

			local goal = GluHold.solve(GluHold.Source)
			if not goal then
				return
			end
			local goal2 = GluHold.Goal

			if not goal2 or (goal2.Position - goal.Position).Magnitude > 1.25 or GluHold.Pose then
				GluHold.Goal = goal
				GluHold.place(humanoidRootPart, goal, GluHold.Pose == true)
				GluHold.LastWrite = goal.Position
			end
		end)
	end

	GluHold.watch = function(arg)
		return GluHold.pin(arg)
	end

	GluHold.go = function(arg, arg2)
		local v10 = GluHold.solve(arg)
		if not v10 then
			return false
		end

		if GluStealth then
			GluStealth.Goal = nil
		end

		if GluGlide and GluGlide.cancel then
			GluGlide.cancel()
		end

		GluHold.HoldUntil = math.max(GluHold.HoldUntil or 0, os.clock() + math.max(4.2, tonumber(arg2) or 4.2))
		GluHold.Pose = false
		GluHold.Source = nil
		GluHold.Mode = "go"
		GluHold.Sticky = false
		GluHold.Instant = true
		local v11 = GluHold.pin(v10)
		GluHold.Instant = false

		if v11 then
			GluHold.armStick(v10)
		end

		return v11
	end

	GluHold.follow = function(source, arg)
		if not GluHold.solve(source) then
			return false
		end
		GluHold.Source = source
		GluHold.Mode = "follow"
		GluHold.Until = 0
		GluHold.Sticky = arg and true or false
		GluHold.Pose = true

		if not GluHold.Sticky then
			GluHold.Pulse = os.clock()
		end

		GluHold.Status = "locked"
		GluHold.ensure()
		GluHold.pin(source)
		return true
	end

	GluHold.holding = function()
		return GluHold.Connection ~= nil
	end

	GluHold.set = function(arg, arg2)
		if arg2 == 0 then
			return GluHold.follow(arg, true)
		end
		return GluHold.go(arg)
	end

	GluHold.at = function(arg, arg2)
		if arg2 == 0 then
			return GluHold.follow(arg, true)
		end
		return GluHold.go(arg)
	end

	GluHold.onto = function(arg, arg2)
		if arg2 == nil or arg2 == 0 then
			return GluHold.follow(arg, true)
		end
		return GluHold.go(arg)
	end

		if type(genv) == "table" then
			genv.GluHold = GluHold
		end
	end)

	GluWebhook.trim = function(arg)
		return (tostring(arg or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
	end

	GluWebhook.Hosts = {
		["discord.com"] = true,
		["discordapp.com"] = true,
		["ptb.discord.com"] = true,
		["canary.discord.com"] = true,

	GluWebhook.RelayHost = "gluhub.gluhub.deno.net"

	GluWebhook.host = function(arg)
		local match = tostring(arg or ""):match("^%a[%w+%.%-]*://([^/?#]+)")
		if not match then
			return nil
		end

		if match:find("@", 1, true) then
			return nil
		end
		local match2 = string.lower(match:match("^([^:]+)") or match)
		if match2 == "" then
			return nil
		end
		return match2
	end

	GluWebhook.redact = function(arg)
		local v10 = GluWebhook.trim(arg)
		if v10 == "" then
			return "(not set)"
		end
		local match, v11 = v10:match("/webhooks/(%d+)/([%w_%-]+)")
		if match and v11 then
			return string.format("webhook %s...%s", match, #v11 >= 4 and v11:sub(-4) or "")
		end
		return "a url on " .. tostring(GluWebhook.host(v10) or "an unknown host")
	end

	GluWebhook.scrub = function(arg)
		return (
			tostring(arg or ""):gsub("https?://[%w%.%-]+/api/webhooks/%d+/[%w_%-]+", function(arg2)
				return GluWebhook.redact(arg2)
			end)
		)
	end

	GluWebhook.commas = function(arg)
		local n16 = math.floor(tonumber(arg) or 0)
		local str11 = ""
		local n17

		if n16 < 0 then
			n17 = -n16
			str11 = "-"
		else
			n17 = n16
		end

		return str11 .. tostring(n17):reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1,"):reverse():gsub("^,", "")
	end

	GluWebhook.valid = function(arg)
		local v10 = GluWebhook.trim(arg)
		if v10 == "" then
			return false, "no url set"
		end

		if v10:find("%s") or v10:find("[%z\1-\31]") then
			return false, "the url contains spaces or control characters"
		end
		local match = v10:match("^(%a[%w+%.%-]*)://")
		if not match then
			return false, "the url needs http:// or https://"
		end

		if string.lower(match) ~= "https" then
			return false, "only https is allowed - http would send the token in the clear"
		end

		if #v10 < 30 or #v10 > 400 then
			return false, "that does not look like a discord webhook url"
		end

		if v10:find("@", 1, true) then
			return false, "the url must not contain credentials"
		end
		local v11 = GluWebhook.host(v10)
		if not v11 then
			return false, "the url has credentials or no host"
		end

		if v11 == GluWebhook.RelayHost then
			return true, v10
		end

		if not GluWebhook.Hosts[v11] then
			return false, "only discord.com webhook urls are allowed, not " .. v11
		end
		local match2, v12 = v10:match("/api/webhooks/(%d+)/([%w_%-]+)")
		if not match2 then
			return false, "the url is missing the /api/webhooks/<id>/<token> path"
		end

		if #v12 < 50 then
			return false, "that webhook token is too short to be real"
		end
		return true, v10
	end

	GluWebhook.duration = function(arg)
		local n16 = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(arg) or 0))
		if n16 < 60 then
			return n16 .. "s"
		end
		local n17 = math.floor(n16 / 60)
		local n18 = n16 % 60
		if n17 < 60 then
			return string.format("%dm %02ds", n17, n18)
		end
		return string.format("%dh %02dm", math.floor(n17 / 60), n17 % 60)
	end

	GluWebhook.iso = function()
		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return DateTime.now():ToIsoDate()
		end)

		if ok and type(result) == "string" and result ~= "" then
			return result
		end

		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			return os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
		end)

		if ok2 and type(result2) == "string" then
			return result2
		end
		return nil
	end

	GluWebhook.slot = function()
		local child3 = nil

		pcall(function()
			local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
			local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
			if not data then
				return
			end
			local child = data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name) or data:FindFirstChild(tostring(localPlayer.UserId))
			if not child then
				return
			end
			local slots = child:FindFirstChild("slots") or child:FindFirstChild("Slots")
			if not slots then
				return
			end

			for _, child2 in ipairs(slots:GetChildren()) do
				if child2:FindFirstChild("Wen") or child2:FindFirstChild("Exp") then
					child3 = child2
					return
				end
			end

			child3 = slots:FindFirstChild("Slot1")
		end)

		return child3
	end

	GluWebhook.perLevel = function()
		if GluWebhook.LevelStep then
			return GluWebhook.LevelStep
		end
		local levelStep = 60

		pcall(function()
			local gameSettings = require(ReplicatedStorage.CAM.Global.gameSettings)

			if gameSettings and tonumber(gameSettings.expPerLevel) and tonumber(gameSettings.expPerLevel) > 0 then
				levelStep = tonumber(gameSettings.expPerLevel)
			end
		end)

		GluWebhook.LevelStep = levelStep
		return levelStep
	end

	GluWebhook.purse = function()
		local tbl14 = { Wen = 0, Exp = 0, Level = 0, Goal = 0, TotalWen = nil, TotalExp = nil, Ok = false }
		local instance = GluWebhook.slot()
		if not instance then
			return tbl14
		end
		local wen = instance:FindFirstChild("Wen")

		if wen and tonumber(wen.Value) then
			tbl14.Wen = tonumber(wen.Value)
		end

		local exp = instance:FindFirstChild("Exp")
		local current = exp and exp:FindFirstChild("Current")
		local goal = exp and exp:FindFirstChild("Goal")

		if current and tonumber(current.Value) then
			tbl14.Exp = tonumber(current.Value)
		end

		if goal and tonumber(goal.Value) then
			tbl14.Goal = tonumber(goal.Value)
			local v10 = GluWebhook.perLevel()

			if v10 > 0 then
				tbl14.Level = math.floor(tbl14.Goal / v10)
			end
		end

		pcall(function()
			local slotLevelStats = instance:FindFirstChild("SlotLevelStats")
			local totalWenEarned = slotLevelStats and slotLevelStats:FindFirstChild("TotalWenEarned")
			local totalExpEarned = slotLevelStats and slotLevelStats:FindFirstChild("TotalExpEarned")

			if totalWenEarned and tonumber(totalWenEarned.Value) then
				tbl14.TotalWen = tonumber(totalWenEarned.Value)
			end

			if totalExpEarned and tonumber(totalExpEarned.Value) then
				tbl14.TotalExp = tonumber(totalExpEarned.Value)
			end
		end)

		tbl14.Ok = true
		return tbl14
	end

	GluWebhook.clock = function()
		local v10 = GluWebhook.purse()
		local v11 = GluWebhook.perLevel()

		return {
			Wen = v10.TotalWen or v10.Wen,
			Exp = v10.TotalExp or (v10.Level or 0) * v11 + (v10.Exp or 0),
			Level = v10.Level or 0,
			At = os.clock(),
			Ok = v10.Ok,
		}
	end

	GluWebhook.gain = function(arg, arg2)
		arg = arg or { Wen = 0, Exp = 0 }
		arg2 = arg2 or { Wen = 0, Exp = 0 }
		local n16 = (arg2.Wen or 0) - (arg.Wen or 0)
		local n17 = (arg2.Exp or 0) - (arg.Exp or 0)

		if n16 < 0 then
			n16 = 0
		end

		if n17 < 0 then
			n17 = 0
		end

		return n16, n17
	end

	GluWebhook.record = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4)
		local now3 = os.clock()
		local tbl14 = GluWebhook.Rec[arg]

		if tbl14 then
			if tbl14.Mode ~= arg3 then
				tbl14 = nil
			elseif arg3 == "stream" and now3 - tbl14.At >= (tbl14.Life or 45) then
				tbl14 = nil
			elseif arg3 == "hold" and now3 - (tbl14.Last or tbl14.At) >= (tbl14.Life or 30) then
				tbl14 = nil
			end
		end

		if not tbl14 then
			tbl14 = {
				Kind = arg,
				Name = tostring(arg2 or arg),
				Mode = arg3,
				Life = arg4 or 30,
				MaxLife = GluWebhook.MaxLife or 150,
				At = now3,
				Last = now3,
				Before = GluWebhook.clock(),
				Drops = {},
				DropsN = 0,
				Kills = 0,
				Caches = 0,
				Names = {},
				BestRarity = 0,
				BestRarityName = "",
				BestDrop = "",
			}

			GluWebhook.Rec[arg] = tbl14
		end

		if arg2 then
			tbl14.Name = tostring(arg2)
			tbl14.Names[tostring(arg2)] = true
		end

		tbl14.Last = now3
		return tbl14
	end

	GluWebhook.bossKill = function(arg)
		GluWebhook.BossKills = (GluWebhook.BossKills or 0) + 1
		if not GluWebhook.Enabled or not GluWebhook.Boss then
			return false
		end
		local boss = GluWebhook.record("boss", arg, "hold", GluWebhook.Hold or 30)
		boss.Kills = (boss.Kills or 0) + 1
		GluWebhook.Status = "tracking " .. tostring(arg or "boss")
		return true
	end

	GluWebhook.dungeonKill = function()
		GluWebhook.DungeonKills = (GluWebhook.DungeonKills or 0) + 1
		local dungeon = GluWebhook.Rec.dungeon
		if dungeon and dungeon.Mode == "manual" then
			dungeon.Kills = (dungeon.Kills or 0) + 1
			return true
		end

		if not GluWebhook.Enabled or not GluWebhook.Dungeon then
			return false
		end
		local dungeon2 = GluWebhook.record("dungeon", "Dungeon run", "stream", GluWebhook.Digest or 45)
		dungeon2.Kills = (dungeon2.Kills or 0) + 1
		GluWebhook.Status = "tracking dungeon"
		return true
	end

	GluWebhook.dungeonRunStart = function()
		if not GluWebhook.Enabled or not GluWebhook.Dungeon then
			return false
		end
		local dungeon = GluWebhook.Rec.dungeon
		if dungeon and dungeon.Mode == "manual" and os.clock() - (dungeon.At or 0) < 1800 then
			return false
		end
		local dungeon2 = GluWebhook.record("dungeon", "Dungeon run", "manual", 0)
		dungeon2.At = os.clock()
		dungeon2.Last = dungeon2.At
		dungeon2.Before = GluWebhook.clock()
		dungeon2.Drops = {}
		dungeon2.DropsN = 0
		dungeon2.Kills = 0
		dungeon2.Caches = 0
		dungeon2.BestRarity = 0
		dungeon2.BestRarityName = ""
		dungeon2.BestDrop = ""
		GluWebhook.Status = "dungeon run started"
		return true
	end

	GluWebhook.dungeonCleared = function()
		local dungeon = GluWebhook.Rec.dungeon
		if not dungeon or dungeon.Mode ~= "manual" then
			return false
		end
		dungeon.Wave = GluWebhook.waveText()
		dungeon.ClearedAt = os.clock()
		dungeon.Kills = kills or dungeon.Kills or 0
		dungeon.Caches = tbl5.OpenedCaches or dungeon.Caches or 0
		GluWebhook.Status = "dungeon cleared - collecting"
		return true
	end

	GluWebhook.dungeonEnd = function(arg)
		local dungeon = GluWebhook.Rec.dungeon
		if not dungeon or dungeon.Mode ~= "manual" then
			return false
		end
		dungeon.EndedAt = os.clock()
		dungeon.Reason = arg and tostring(arg) or nil

		if (dungeon.Kills or 0) == 0 then
			dungeon.Kills = kills or 0
		end

		if (dungeon.Caches or 0) == 0 then
			dungeon.Caches = tbl5.OpenedCaches or 0
		end

		GluWebhook.Rec.dungeon = nil
		return GluWebhook.emit(dungeon)
	end

	GluWebhook.dropLabel = function(instance)
		if not instance then
			return "Unknown drop"
		end
		local dropLabel = GluWebhook.DropLabels[instance]
		if dropLabel then
			return dropLabel
		end
		local str11 = nil

		for _, attribute in ipairs({ "DropItemId", "CatchItem", "ItemId", "ItemName", "DropName" }) do
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return instance:GetAttribute(attribute)
			end)

			if ok and result ~= nil and tostring(result) ~= "" then
				str11 = tostring(result)
				break
			end
		end

		local flag15 = not str11

		if flag15 then
			pcall(function()
				local lootDropPrompt = instance:FindFirstChild("LootDropPrompt")
					or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
				local str12 = lootDropPrompt and tostring(lootDropPrompt.ObjectText or "") or ""

				if str12 ~= "" and str12 ~= " " and string.lower(str12) ~= "pick up" then
					str11 = str12
				end
			end)
		end

		if flag15 then
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return instance.Name
			end)

			if
				ok
				and type(result) == "string"
				and result ~= ""
				and not string.find(result, "FishingCatch", 1, true)
			then
				str11 = result
			end
		end

		str11 = str11 or "Unknown drop"
		GluWebhook.DropLabels[instance] = str11
		return str11
	end

	GluWebhook.noteDrop = function(arg, arg2)
		if type(arg) ~= "string" then
			arg = GluWebhook.dropLabel(arg)
		end

		local bestDrop = GluWebhook.trim(arg)

		if bestDrop == "" then
			bestDrop = "Unknown drop"
		end

		GluWebhook.DropCount = (GluWebhook.DropCount or 0) + 1
		if not GluWebhook.Enabled then
			return bestDrop
		end
		arg2 = arg2 or World and World.IsDungeon and "dungeon" or "boss"
		local v10 = GluWebhook.Rec[arg2]
			or GluWebhook.record(
				arg2,
				arg2 == "dungeon" and "Dungeon loot" or "Boss loot",
				arg2 == "dungeon" and "stream" or "hold",
				arg2 == "dungeon" and (GluWebhook.Digest or 45) or GluWebhook.Hold or 30
			)
		local v11 = GluWebhook.itemInfo(bestDrop)
		v10.DropsN = (v10.DropsN or 0) + 1
		local drop = v10.Drops[bestDrop]

		if drop then
			drop.n += 1
		else
			v10.Drops[bestDrop] = { n = 1, Rarity = v11.Rarity, RarityName = v11.RarityName }
		end

		if (v10.BestRarity or 0) < v11.Rarity then
			v10.BestRarity = v11.Rarity
			v10.BestRarityName = v11.RarityName
			v10.BestColor = v11.Color
			v10.BestDrop = bestDrop
		end

		v10.Last = os.clock()
		GluWebhook.Status = "tracking " .. bestDrop
		return bestDrop
	end

	GluWebhook.noteCatch = function(arg)
		local str11 = "Unknown catch"

		pcall(function()
			str11 = GluWebhook.dropLabel(arg)
		end)

		str11 = GluWebhook.trim(str11)

		if str11 == "" then
			str11 = "Unknown catch"
		end

		local v10 = GluWebhook.itemInfo(str11)
		GluWebhook.CatchTally[str11] = (GluWebhook.CatchTally[str11] or 0) + 1
		GluWebhook.CatchCount = (GluWebhook.CatchCount or 0) + 1
		GluWebhook.Catches = (GluWebhook.Catches or 0) + 1

		if v10.Rarity > (GluWebhook.CatchBest or 0) then
			GluWebhook.CatchBest = v10.Rarity
			GluWebhook.CatchBestName = v10.RarityName
			GluWebhook.CatchBestColor = v10.Color
		end

		if type(GluWebhook.CatchInfo) ~= "table" then
			GluWebhook.CatchInfo = {}
		end

		GluWebhook.CatchInfo[str11] = v10

		if (GluWebhook.CatchAt or 0) == 0 then
			GluWebhook.CatchAt = os.clock()
			GluWebhook.CatchBefore = GluWebhook.clock()
		end

		return str11
	end

	GluWebhook.fieldsFor = function(arg, arg2, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		local times = {}
		times[#times + 1] = GluWebhook.field("time", GluWebhook.duration(arg5), true)

		if arg.Wave and arg.Wave ~= "" then
			times[#times + 1] = GluWebhook.field("reached", arg.Wave, true)
		end

		if (arg.Kills or 0) > 0 then
			times[#times + 1] = GluWebhook.field("kills", tostring(arg.Kills), true)
		end

		if (arg.Caches or 0) > 0 then
			times[#times + 1] = GluWebhook.field("caches opened", tostring(arg.Caches), true)
		end

		if (arg.DropsN or 0) > 0 then
			times[#times + 1] = GluWebhook.field("drops", tostring(arg.DropsN), true)
		end

		if arg.BestDrop and arg.BestDrop ~= "" then
			local str11 = tostring(arg.BestDrop)

			if arg.BestRarityName and arg.BestRarityName ~= "" then
				str11 ..= " (" .. arg.BestRarityName .. ")"
			end

			times[#times + 1] = GluWebhook.field("best drop", str11, true)
		end

		if GluWebhook.Purse then
			times[#times + 1] = GluWebhook.field("exp gained", "+" .. GluWebhook.commas(arg4), true)
			times[#times + 1] = GluWebhook.field("wen gained", "+" .. GluWebhook.commas(arg3), true)
			times[#times + 1] = GluWebhook.field("wen total", GluWebhook.commas(arg2.Wen), true)

			if (arg2.Level or 0) > 0 then
				times[#times + 1] = GluWebhook.field("level", tostring(arg2.Level), true)
			end
		end

		return times
	end

	GluWebhook.nameList = function(arg, arg2)
		local n16 = arg2 or 4
		local tbl14 = {}
		local v10 = pairs
		arg = arg or {}

		for k in v10(arg) do
			tbl14[#tbl14 + 1] = k
		end

		if #tbl14 == 0 then
			return ""
		end
		table.sort(tbl14)

		if #tbl14 > n16 then
			local tbl15 = {}

			for i = 1, n16 do
				tbl15[i] = tbl14[i]
			end

			return table.concat(tbl15, ", ") .. string.format(" +%d", #tbl14 - n16)
		end

		return table.concat(tbl14, ", ")
	end

	GluWebhook.dropLines = function(arg, arg2)
		if not GluWebhook.Drops then
			return nil
		end
		arg2 = arg2 or 24
		local tbl14 = {}
		local v10 = pairs
		local tbl15 = arg or {}

		for k in v10(tbl15) do
			tbl14[#tbl14 + 1] = k
		end

		if #tbl14 == 0 then
			return nil
		end

		table.sort(tbl14, function(arg3, arg4)
			local rarity = arg[arg3] and arg[arg3].Rarity or 0
			local rarity2 = arg[arg4] and arg[arg4].Rarity or 0
			if rarity ~= rarity2 then
				return rarity > rarity2
			end
			return arg3 < arg4
		end)

		local tbl16 = {}

		for i = 1, #tbl14 do
			if i > arg2 then
				tbl16[#tbl16 + 1] = string.format("... and %d more kinds", #tbl14 - arg2)
				break
			end
			local v11 = tbl14[i]
			local v12 = arg[v11]
			local flag15 = v12.RarityName and v12.RarityName ~= ""
			local str11 = ""

			if flag15 then
				str11 = " [" .. v12.RarityName .. "]"
			end

			if v12.n and v12.n > 1 then
				tbl16[#tbl16 + 1] = string.format("%s x%d%s", v11, v12.n, str11)
			else
				tbl16[#tbl16 + 1] = v11 .. str11
			end
		end

		return table.concat(tbl16, "\n")
	end

	GluWebhook.embed = function(arg, arg2, description, arg3, arg4, arg5)
		local tbl14 = {
			title = arg2,
			color = arg5 or GluWebhook.color(arg),
			fields = arg3,
			footer = { text = arg4 or "Glu Hub" },
		}

		if description and description ~= "" then
			tbl14.description = description
		end

		local timestamp = GluWebhook.iso()

		if timestamp then
			tbl14.timestamp = timestamp
		end

		return tbl14
	end

	GluWebhook.emit = function(arg)
		if not GluWebhook.Enabled then
			return false
		end

		if arg.Kind == "boss" and not GluWebhook.Boss then
			return false
		end

		if arg.Kind == "dungeon" and not GluWebhook.Dungeon then
			return false
		end
		local v10 = GluWebhook.clock()
		local v11, v12 = GluWebhook.gain(arg.Before, v10)
		local n16 = (arg.EndedAt or os.clock()) - arg.At
		local v13 = GluWebhook.toHex(arg.BestColor) or GluWebhook.color(arg.Kind)
		local str11, v14

		if arg.Kind == "boss" then
			local name = arg.Name

			if (arg.Kills or 0) > 1 then
				local name2 = GluWebhook.nameList(arg.Names, 4)

				if name2 == "" then
					name2 = name
				end

				str11 = string.format("%d bosses slain - %s", arg.Kills, name2)
			else
				str11 = "Boss slain - " .. name
			end

			v14 = GluWebhook.dropLines(arg.Drops, 24)
		elseif arg.Kind == "dungeon" then
			if arg.Wave and arg.Wave ~= "" then
				str11 = "Dungeon cleared - " .. arg.Wave
			else
				str11 = "Dungeon run finished"
			end

			v14 = GluWebhook.dropLines(arg.Drops, 24)
		else
			str11 = "Loot collected - " .. arg.Name
			v14 = GluWebhook.dropLines(arg.Drops, 24)
		end

		GluWebhook.push({
			username = "Glu Hub",
			embeds = {
				GluWebhook.embed(
					arg.Kind,
					str11,
					v14,
					GluWebhook.fieldsFor(arg, v10, v11, v12, n16),
					string.format(
						"Glu Hub | %s | session: %d boss, %d dungeon, %d drops",
						GluWebhook.where(),
						GluWebhook.BossKills or 0,
						GluWebhook.DungeonKills or 0,
						GluWebhook.DropCount or 0
					),
					v13
				),
			},
		}, arg.Kind)

		GluWebhook.Status = "queued " .. arg.Kind .. " report"
		return true
	end

	GluWebhook.flushFish = function()
		local catchCount = GluWebhook.CatchCount or 0
		if catchCount == 0 then
			return false
		end
		local catchTally = GluWebhook.CatchTally or {}
		local catchBefore = GluWebhook.CatchBefore
		local catchInfo = GluWebhook.CatchInfo or {}
		local catchBestColor = GluWebhook.CatchBestColor
		local at = catchBefore and catchBefore.At or os.clock()

		GluWebhook.CatchTally = {}
		GluWebhook.CatchCount = 0
		GluWebhook.CatchAt = 0
		GluWebhook.CatchBefore = nil
		GluWebhook.CatchInfo = {}
		GluWebhook.CatchBest = 0
		GluWebhook.CatchBestName = ""
		GluWebhook.CatchBestColor = nil
		if not GluWebhook.Enabled or not GluWebhook.Fish then
			return false
		end
		local v10 = GluWebhook.clock()
		local v11, v12 = GluWebhook.gain(catchBefore, v10)
		local tbl14 = {}

		for k in pairs(catchTally) do
			tbl14[#tbl14 + 1] = k
		end

		table.sort(tbl14, function(arg, arg2)
			if catchTally[arg] ~= catchTally[arg2] then
				return catchTally[arg] > catchTally[arg2]
			end
			return arg < arg2
		end)

		local tbl15 = {}

		for i = 1, #tbl14 do
			if i > 24 then
				tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = string.format("... and %d more kinds", #tbl14 - 24)
				break
			end
			local v13 = tbl14[i]
			local v14 = catchInfo[v13]
			local flag15 = type(v14) == "table" and v14.RarityName and v14.RarityName ~= ""
			local str11 = ""

			if flag15 then
				str11 = " [" .. v14.RarityName .. "]"
			end

			tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = string.format("%s x%d%s", v13, catchTally[v13], str11)
		end

		local field = GluWebhook.field

		local tbl16 = {
			GluWebhook.field("time", GluWebhook.duration(os.clock() - at), true),
			field("catches", tostring(catchCount), true),
		}

		if GluWebhook.Purse then
			tbl16[#tbl16 + 1] = GluWebhook.field("exp gained", "+" .. GluWebhook.commas(v12), true)
			tbl16[#tbl16 + 1] = GluWebhook.field("wen gained", "+" .. GluWebhook.commas(v11), true)
			tbl16[#tbl16 + 1] = GluWebhook.field("wen total", GluWebhook.commas(v10.Wen), true)
		end

		local push = GluWebhook.push
		local tbl17 = { username = "Glu Hub" }
		local embeds = {}
		local embed = GluWebhook.embed
		local str11 = table.concat(tbl15, "\n")
		local format = string.format
		local catches = GluWebhook.Catches or catchCount

		do
			local values = table.pack(
				embed(
					"fish",
					"Fishing digest",
					str11,
					tbl16,
					format("Glu Hub | auto fish | %d catches this session", catches),
					GluWebhook.toHex(catchBestColor)
				)
			)
			table.move(values, 1, values.n, 1, embeds)
		end

		tbl17.embeds = embeds
		push(tbl17, "fish")
		GluWebhook.Status = "queued fishing digest"
		return true
	end

	GluWebhook.reap = function()
		local now3 = os.clock()

		for k, v10 in pairs(GluWebhook.Rec) do
			if not v10 then
				continue
			end
			local flag15

			if v10.Mode == "manual" then
				flag15 = now3 - v10.At >= 1800
			elseif v10.Mode == "stream" then
				flag15 = now3 - v10.At >= (v10.Life or 45)
			else
				flag15 = now3 - (v10.Last or v10.At) >= (v10.Life or 30) or now3 - v10.At >= (v10.MaxLife or 150)
			end

			if flag15 then
				GluWebhook.Rec[k] = nil
				pcall(GluWebhook.emit, v10)
			end
		end

		if
			(GluWebhook.CatchCount or 0) > 0
			and (GluWebhook.CatchAt or 0) ~= 0
			and now3 - GluWebhook.CatchAt >= (GluWebhook.Digest or 45)
		then
			pcall(GluWebhook.flushFish)
		end
	end

	GluWebhook.post = function(arg)
		local v10, v11 = GluWebhook.valid(GluWebhook.Url)
		if not v10 then
			return false, v11
		end
		local json = nil
		if not pcall(function()
			json = GluWebhook.Http:JSONEncode(arg)
		end) or type(json) ~= "string" then
			return false, "the report would not encode"
		end
		local tbl14 = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", ["X-Glu-Key"] = GluWebhook.Key }
		local tbl15 = {}

		if type(request) == "function" then
			tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = function()
				local v12 = request({ Url = v11, Method = "POST", Headers = tbl14, Body = json })
				return v12 == nil or v12.Success ~= false
			end
		end

		if type(http_request) == "function" then
			tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = function()
				local v12 = http_request({ Url = v11, Method = "POST", Headers = tbl14, Body = json })
				return v12 == nil or v12.Success ~= false
			end
		end

		if type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.request) == "function" then
			tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = function()
				local v12 = syn.request({ Url = v11, Method = "POST", Headers = tbl14, Body = json })
				return v12 == nil or v12.Success ~= false
			end
		end

		if type(http) == "table" and type(http.request) == "function" then
			tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = function()
				local v12 = http.request({ Url = v11, Method = "POST", Headers = tbl14, Body = json })
				return v12 == nil or v12.Success ~= false
			end
		end

		tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = function()
			local v12 = GluWebhook.Http:RequestAsync({ Url = v11, Method = "POST", Headers = tbl14, Body = json })
			return v12 ~= nil and v12.Success == true
		end

		local str11 = "no transport available"

		for i = 1, #tbl15 do
			local ok, result = pcall(tbl15[i])
			if ok and result then
				return true
			end

			if ok then
				str11 = "the endpoint refused the post"
			else
				str11 = tostring(result)
			end
		end

		return false, str11
	end

	GluWebhook.push = function(arg, arg2)
		GluWebhook.Queue[#GluWebhook.Queue + 1] = { Body = arg, Tag = tostring(arg2 or "event"), At = os.clock() }

		while (GluWebhook.MaxQueue or 80) < #GluWebhook.Queue do
			table.remove(GluWebhook.Queue, 1)
		end

		return true
	end

	GluWebhook.pump = function()
		local queue = GluWebhook.Queue
		if type(queue) ~= "table" or #queue == 0 then
			return false
		end

		if GluWebhook.Sending then
			return false
		end

		if not GluWebhook.valid(GluWebhook.Url) then
			if #queue > 20 then
				GluWebhook.Queue = {}
			end

			return false
		end

		local now3 = os.clock()
		if now3 - (GluWebhook.LastAt or 0) < (GluWebhook.MinGap or 1.4) then
			return false
		end

		if now3 - (GluWebhook.WindowAt or 0) >= 60 then
			GluWebhook.WindowAt = now3
			GluWebhook.WindowCount = 0
		end

		if (GluWebhook.WindowCount or 0) >= 22 then
			GluWebhook.Status = "rate limited - waiting a moment"
			return false
		end
		local v10 = table.remove(queue, 1)
		GluWebhook.LastAt = now3
		GluWebhook.WindowCount = (GluWebhook.WindowCount or 0) + 1
		GluWebhook.Sending = true
		local v11, v12 = GluWebhook.post(v10.Body)
		GluWebhook.Sending = false

		if v11 then
			GluWebhook.Sent = (GluWebhook.Sent or 0) + 1
			GluWebhook.LastErr = ""
			GluWebhook.Status = string.format("sent %d", GluWebhook.Sent)
		else
			GluWebhook.Fails = (GluWebhook.Fails or 0) + 1
			GluWebhook.LastErr = GluWebhook.scrub(v12 or "failed")
			GluWebhook.Status = "failed - " .. GluWebhook.LastErr

			if GluWebhook.Fails == 1 or GluWebhook.Fails % 6 == 0 then
				warn(string.format("[Glu] webhook failed (%d): %s", GluWebhook.Fails, GluWebhook.LastErr))
			end
		end

		return v11
	end

	GluWebhook.status = function()
		if not GluWebhook.Enabled then
			return "off"
		end

		if not select(1, GluWebhook.valid(GluWebhook.Url)) then
			return "waiting for a url"
		end
		local str11 = string.format(
			"on | %s | sent %d | queue %d | %d boss / %d dungeon kills | %d drops | %d fish",
			GluWebhook.redact(GluWebhook.Url),
			GluWebhook.Sent or 0,
			#(GluWebhook.Queue or {}),
			GluWebhook.BossKills or 0,
			GluWebhook.DungeonKills or 0,
			GluWebhook.DropCount or 0,
			GluWebhook.Catches or 0
		)

		if (GluWebhook.Fails or 0) > 0 and GluWebhook.LastErr ~= "" then
			str11 ..= " | last error: " .. tostring(GluWebhook.LastErr)
		end

		return str11
	end

	GluWebhook.test = function()
		local v10, v11 = GluWebhook.valid(GluWebhook.Url)
		if not v10 then
			v:Warn("Webhook", tostring(v11), 4)
			return false
		end
		local v12 = GluWebhook.clock()
		local field = GluWebhook.field

		GluWebhook.push({
			username = "Glu Hub",
			embeds = {
				GluWebhook.embed(
					"boss",
					"Glu Hub webhook test",
					"If you can read this, this channel is wired up correctly.",
					{
						GluWebhook.field("where", GluWebhook.where(), true),
						GluWebhook.field("executor", GluWebhook.executorName(), true),
						GluWebhook.field("build", GluWebhook.Build, true),
						field("wen total", GluWebhook.commas(v12.Wen), true),
					},
					"Glu Hub test"
				),
			},
		}, "test")

		v:Success("Webhook", "Test queued - it posts within a second or two", 4)
		return true
	end

	GluWebhook.summary = function()
		if not GluWebhook.Enabled then
			v:Warn("Webhook", "Turn the webhook on first", 4)
			return false
		end
		local v10, v11 = GluWebhook.valid(GluWebhook.Url)
		if not v10 then
			v:Warn("Webhook", tostring(v11), 4)
			return false
		end
		local v12 = GluWebhook.clock()
		local v13, v14 = GluWebhook.gain(GluWebhook.SessionBefore or v12, v12)
		local levels = {}
		local session =
			GluWebhook.field("session", GluWebhook.duration(os.clock() - (GluWebhook.SessionAt or os.clock())), true)
		local v15 = GluWebhook.field("boss kills", tostring(GluWebhook.BossKills or 0), true)
		local v16 = GluWebhook.field("dungeon kills", tostring(GluWebhook.DungeonKills or 0), true)
		local drops = GluWebhook.field("drops", tostring(GluWebhook.DropCount or 0), true)
		local v17 = GluWebhook.field("fish caught", tostring(GluWebhook.Catches or 0), true)
		local v18 = GluWebhook.field("exp gained", "+" .. GluWebhook.commas(v14), true)
		local v19 = GluWebhook.field("wen gained", "+" .. GluWebhook.commas(v13), true)
		local v20 = table.pack(GluWebhook.field("wen total", GluWebhook.commas(v12.Wen), true))

		levels[1] = session
		levels[2] = v15
		levels[3] = v16
		levels[4] = drops
		levels[5] = v17
		levels[6] = v18
		levels[7] = v19

		do
			local values = table.pack(table.unpack(v20, 1, v20.n))
			table.move(values, 1, values.n, 8, levels)
		end

		if (v12.Level or 0) > 0 then
			levels[#levels + 1] = GluWebhook.field("level", tostring(v12.Level), true)
		end

		GluWebhook.push({
			username = "Glu Hub",
			embeds = {
				GluWebhook.embed(
					"boss",
					"Glu Hub session summary",
					GluWebhook.describe(
						string.format("%s | place %s", GluWebhook.where(), tostring(game.PlaceId)),
						GluWebhook.where()
					),
					levels,
					"Glu Hub summary"
				),
			},
		}, "summary")

		v:Success("Webhook", "Summary queued", 4)
		return true
	end

	GluWebhook.applyFlags = function()
		local flags = v and v.Flags
		if type(flags) ~= "table" then
			return false
		end
		local gluWebhookUrl = flags.glu_webhook_url

		if type(gluWebhookUrl) == "string" and GluWebhook.trim(gluWebhookUrl) ~= "" then
			GluWebhook.Url = GluWebhook.trim(gluWebhookUrl)
		end

		if flags.glu_webhook_enabled ~= nil then
			GluWebhook.Enabled = flags.glu_webhook_enabled == true
		end

		if flags.glu_webhook_boss ~= nil then
			GluWebhook.Boss = flags.glu_webhook_boss == true
		end

		if flags.glu_webhook_dungeon ~= nil then
			GluWebhook.Dungeon = flags.glu_webhook_dungeon == true
		end

		if flags.glu_webhook_fish ~= nil then
			GluWebhook.Fish = flags.glu_webhook_fish == true
		end

		if flags.glu_webhook_purse ~= nil then
			GluWebhook.Purse = flags.glu_webhook_purse == true
		end

		if flags.glu_webhook_drops ~= nil then
			GluWebhook.Drops = flags.glu_webhook_drops == true
		end

		if flags.glu_webhook_privacy ~= nil then
			GluWebhook.Privacy = flags.glu_webhook_privacy == true
		end

		if tonumber(flags.glu_webhook_hold) then
			GluWebhook.Hold = math.clamp(tonumber(flags.glu_webhook_hold), 5, 90)
		end

		if tonumber(flags.glu_webhook_digest) then
			GluWebhook.Digest = math.clamp(tonumber(flags.glu_webhook_digest), 15, 300)
		end

		if GluWebhook.Enabled and not GluWebhook.SessionBefore then
			GluWebhook.SessionBefore = GluWebhook.clock()
		end

		return true
	end

	GluWebhook.tick = function()
		local statusLabel = GluWebhook.StatusLabel
		if not statusLabel then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			statusLabel:Set("webhook: " .. GluWebhook.status())
		end)
	end

		while not GluUnloaded do
			task.wait(0.5)
			pcall(GluWebhook.reap)
			pcall(GluWebhook.pump)
			pcall(GluWebhook.tick)
		end
	end)

	SafeSpawn("glu-recover", function()
		while not GluUnloaded do
			task.wait(1)
			local character2 = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character2 and character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			if not (humanoid and humanoidRootPart and humanoid.Health > 0) then
				continue
			end
			local flag15 = os.clock() - (GluHold.Lease or 0) > 3
				and os.clock() > (GluHold.HoldUntil or 0)
				and not (LootHold and LootHold.busy())

			if flag15 and GluHold.Pose then
				GluHold.Pose = false
			end

			if flag15 and (GluHold.FallBody or humanoid.AutoRotate == false) and GluHold.SavedStand ~= nil then
				GluHold.aimBody(false)
			end

			if currentCamera then
				if GluHold.CamOwned and not GluHold.Pose then
					GluHold.frameCamera(nil)
				end

				local savedEnabled2 = flag2 or savedEnabled or flag3

				if
					not GluHold.CamOwned
					and savedEnabled2
					and currentCamera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
				then
					GluCamStuckSince = GluCamStuckSince or os.clock()

					if os.clock() - GluCamStuckSince > 20 then
						GluCamStuckSince = nil
						currentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
						currentCamera.CameraSubject = humanoid
					end
				else
					GluCamStuckSince = nil
				end

				if not GluHold.CamOwned and savedEnabled2 and currentCamera.CameraSubject == nil then
					currentCamera.CameraSubject = humanoid
				end
			end

			if humanoidRootPart.Anchored and not GluHold.Lock and (flag2 or savedEnabled) then
				humanoidRootPart.Anchored = false
			end

			if GluHold.Watch == nil then
				GluHold.ensureWatch()
			end

			if currentCamera and (not currentCamera.CameraSubject or currentCamera.CameraSubject.Parent == nil) then
				currentCamera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
				currentCamera.CameraSubject = humanoid
			end
		end
	end)

	GluSnap = function(arg)
		if not GluHold.solve(arg) then

	GluGlide = {
		Active = false,
		Speed = 58,
		Max = 1.4,
		Arrive = 2.5,
		Retarget = 2.5,
		Farm = false,
		Until = nil,
		Tween = nil,
		Done = true,
		Goal = nil,
		Moves = 0,
		Steps = 0,
		Status = "idle",
	}

	GluGlide.cancel = function()
		if GluGlide.Tween then
			pcall(function()
				GluGlide.Tween:Cancel()
			end)

			GluGlide.Tween = nil
		end

		GluGlide.Done = true
	end

	GluGlide.stop = function()
		GluGlide.Active = false
		GluGlide.Until = nil
		GluGlide.Goal = nil
		GluGlide.Status = "idle"
		GluGlide.cancel()
	end

	GluGlide.live = function()
		if GluGlide.Until and os.clock() < GluGlide.Until then
			return true
		end
		return GluGlide.Farm == true
	end

	GluGlide.wanted = function(arg)
		if not GluGlide.live() then
			return false
		end

		if GluGlide.Until and os.clock() < GluGlide.Until then
			return true
		end
		return arg == true
	end

	GluGlide.move = function(part, goal, arg)
		if not part or not goal or not part.Parent then
			return false
		end
		local magnitude = (goal.Position - part.Position).Magnitude
		GluGlide.Active = true
		if magnitude <= (tonumber(GluGlide.Arrive) or 2.5) then
			GluGlide.Goal = goal
			return true
		end
		local magnitude2 = 999

		if GluGlide.Goal then
			magnitude2 = (GluGlide.Goal.Position - goal.Position).Magnitude
		end

		if GluGlide.Tween and GluGlide.Done ~= true and magnitude2 < (tonumber(GluGlide.Retarget) or 2.5) then
			return true
		end
		local n16 = math.max(10, tonumber(GluGlide.Speed) or 58)
		local n17 = math.max(0.15, tonumber(GluGlide.Max) or 1.4)
		local n18 = n16 * n17
		local goal2 = goal

		if n18 < magnitude then
			local position = goal.Position - part.Position

			if position.Magnitude < 0.05 then
				position = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end

			local position2 = part.Position + position.Unit * n18
			goal2 = CFrame.lookAt(position2, position2 + goal.LookVector)
		end

		GluGlide.cancel()

		pcall(function()
			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end)

		GluGlide.Goal = goal
		GluGlide.Moves = (GluGlide.Moves or 0) + 1
		local duration = math.clamp((goal2.Position - part.Position).Magnitude / n16, 0.05, n17)

		local ok, tween = pcall(function()
			return TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), { CFrame = goal2 })
		end)

		if ok and tween then
			GluGlide.Tween = tween
			GluGlide.Done = false
			GluGlide.Status = string.format("gliding %.0f studs", magnitude)

			pcall(function()
				tween.Completed:Connect(function()
					if GluGlide.Tween == tween then
						GluGlide.Tween = nil
						GluGlide.Done = true
					end
				end)
			end)

			pcall(function()
				tween:Play()
			end)

			return true
		end

		GluGlide.Steps = (GluGlide.Steps or 0) + 1
		GluGlide.Status = "gliding without tweenservice"
		return GluHold.placeDirect(part, goal2, arg == true)
	end

	GluGlide.to = function(arg, arg2)
		local v10 = GluHold.solve(arg)
		if not v10 then
			return false
		end
		arg2 = arg2 or {}

		if tonumber(arg2.speed) then
			GluGlide.Speed = tonumber(arg2.speed)
		end

		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		return GluGlide.move(character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart"), v10, arg2.aim == true)
	end

	GluNpcSafe = {
		Enabled = true,
		Jump = 140,
		SpeedCap = 260,
		Window = 6,
		Count = 0,
		Last = 0,
		LastGap = 0,
		Status = "watching for npcs that snap back",
		Seen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		Drop = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	}

	GluNpcSafe.held = function(arg)
		if not arg then
			return false
		end
		local v10 = GluNpcSafe.Drop[arg]
		if not v10 then
			return false
		end

		if v10 < os.clock() then
			GluNpcSafe.Drop[arg] = nil
			return false
		end
		return true
	end

	GluNpcSafe.forget = function(arg)
		GluNpcSafe.Seen[arg] = nil
		GluNpcSafe.Drop[arg] = nil
	end

	GluNpcSafe.flag = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		if not arg then
			return false
		end
		local now3 = os.clock()
		local n16 = math.max(1, tonumber(GluNpcSafe.Window) or 6)
		GluNpcSafe.Count = (GluNpcSafe.Count or 0) + 1
		GluNpcSafe.Last = now3
		GluNpcSafe.LastGap = tonumber(arg3) or 0
		GluNpcSafe.Status = string.format(
			"%s snapped back to spawn (%.0f studs) - letting go and gliding",
			tostring(arg2 or "npc"),
			GluNpcSafe.LastGap
		)
		GluNpcSafe.Drop[arg] = now3 + n16
		GluNpcSafe.Seen[arg] = nil

		GluGlide.Until = math.max(GluGlide.Until or 0, now3 + n16)
		GluGlide.Active = true
		GluGlide.Goal = nil
		GluGlide.Status = "gliding after a snap-back"

		pcall(function()
			GluHold.Pose = false
			GluHold.release()
		end)

		return true
	end

	GluNpcSafe.tick = function(instance, arg, arg2)
		if not (GluNpcSafe.Enabled and instance and instance.Parent) then
			return false
		end
		local instance2 = fn15(instance)
		if not instance2 or not instance2.Parent then
			return false
		end
		local position = instance2.Position
		local v10 = GluNpcSafe.Seen[instance]
		GluNpcSafe.Seen[instance] = { Pos = position, At = os.clock() }
		if not v10 then
			return false
		end
		local magnitude = (position - v10.Pos).Magnitude
		local n16 = magnitude / math.max(tonumber(arg2) or 0.016, 0.001)
		if magnitude < (tonumber(GluNpcSafe.Jump) or 140) then
			return false
		end

		if n16 < (tonumber(GluNpcSafe.SpeedCap) or 260) then
			return false
		end
		return GluNpcSafe.flag(instance, arg or tostring(instance.Name or "npc"), magnitude)
	end

	TeleportFix = { Target = nil, HoldUntil = 0, Status = "idle" }

	TeleportFix.hold = function(arg)
		TeleportFix.HoldUntil = math.max(TeleportFix.HoldUntil or 0, os.clock() + (arg or 0))
	end

	TeleportFix.holding = function()
		if os.clock() >= (TeleportFix.HoldUntil or 0) then
			return false
		end
		local target_ = TeleportFix.Target
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

		if
			typeof(target_) == "Vector3"
			and humanoidRootPart
			and (humanoidRootPart.Position - target_).Magnitude > 90
		then
			TeleportFix.HoldUntil = 0
			TeleportFix.Status = "released"
			return false
		end

		return true
	end

	TeleportFix.arm = function(target_)
		if typeof(target_) ~= "Vector3" then
			return
		end
		TeleportFix.Target = target_
		TeleportFix.Status = "holding"
	end

	LootHold = { Target = nil, Until = 0, Pos = nil, Holds = 0 }

	LootHold.busy = function()
		return os.clock() < (LootHold.Until or 0)
	end

	LootHold.grab = function(target_, arg)
		LootHold.Target = target_
		LootHold.Until = math.max(LootHold.Until or 0, os.clock() + (arg or 0))
		LootHold.Holds = (LootHold.Holds or 0) + 1
		LootHold.Pos = nil
		return true
	end

	LootHold.mark = function()
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			return false
		end
		LootHold.Pos = humanoidRootPart.Position
		return true
	end

	LootHold.pin = function()
		local pos = LootHold.Pos
		if not pos then
			return false
		end
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			return false
		end

		if GluLoot.NoTp and GluHold.wantsMove and GluHold.wantsMove() then
			return true
		end

		if math.abs(humanoidRootPart.Position.Y - pos.Y) > 10 or (humanoidRootPart.Position - pos).Magnitude > 1.5 then
			GluHold.Pose = false
			GluHold.place(humanoidRootPart, CFrame.new(pos), false)
		end

		return true
	end

	LootHold.release = function()
		LootHold.Target = nil
		LootHold.Pos = nil
		LootHold.Until = 0
	end

	GluParkLoot = function(arg)
		if typeof(arg) ~= "Vector3" then
			return false
		end

		if LootHold.busy() then
			return false
		end
		GluHold.Pose = false

		if GluHold.aimBody then
			GluHold.aimBody(false)
		end

		local vector = GluLootStand(arg, localPlayer.Character) or arg + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		local humanoidRootPart = localPlayer.Character and localPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if
			humanoidRootPart
			and math.abs(humanoidRootPart.Position.Y - vector.Y) < 6
			and (humanoidRootPart.Position - vector).Magnitude < 6
		then
			return true
		end

		if GluHold.go then
			return GluHold.go(CFrame.new(vector), 0.45)
		end
		return GluHold.pin(CFrame.new(vector))
	end
