		local function getMatches(blacklist)
			local matches = {}
			local gmatch = string.gmatch
			local v10 = tostring
			blacklist = blacklist or ""

			for k in gmatch(v10(blacklist), "[^,]+") do
				local match = string.lower(k:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))

				if match ~= "" then
					table.insert(matches, match)
				end
			end

			return matches
		end

		local obj = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

		local function fn30(instance)
			if not instance then
				return nil
			end
			local instance2 = obj[instance]

			if instance2 and instance2.Parent and instance2:IsDescendantOf(instance) then
				if instance2.Enabled then
					return instance2
				end
			end

			local chestPrompt = instance:FindFirstChild("ChestPrompt", true)

			if chestPrompt and chestPrompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
				obj[instance] = chestPrompt
				if chestPrompt.Enabled then
					return chestPrompt
				end
				return nil
			end

			local descendant = nil

			for _, descendant2 in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant2:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and descendant2.Enabled then
					local actionText = string.lower(descendant2.ActionText or "")
					if
						actionText:find("open", 1, true)
						or actionText:find("loot", 1, true)
						or actionText:find("claim", 1, true)
						or actionText:find("take", 1, true)
					then
						return descendant2
					end
					descendant = descendant or descendant2
				end
			end

			return descendant
		end

		local function getPosition(instance)
			if not instance or not instance.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
				return instance.Position
			end

			if instance:IsA("Model") then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return instance:GetPivot()
				end)

				if ok and result then
					return result.Position
				end
				local v10 = fn15(instance)
				return v10 and v10.Position or nil
			end

			local basePart = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			return basePart and basePart.Position or nil
		end

		local children2 = nil
		local now4 = 0

		local function getChildren()
			local now3 = os.clock()
			if children2 and now3 - now4 < 0.3 then
				return children2
			end
			local children = {}
			local tbl15 = {}
			children2 = children
			now4 = now3

			local function fn31(instance)
				if not instance then
					return
				end

				for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Model") and child.Parent and not tbl15[child] then
						tbl15[child] = true
						table.insert(children, child)
					end
				end
			end

			local tagged = CollectionService:GetTagged("Chest")

			if type(tagged) == "table" then
				for _, instance in ipairs(tagged) do
					if instance and instance.Parent and instance:IsA("Model") and not tbl15[instance] then
						tbl15[instance] = true
						table.insert(children, instance)
					end
				end
			end

			fn31(workspace:FindFirstChild("Chests"))
			local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")
			fn31(debree and debree:FindFirstChild("Chests"))
			return children
		end

		local function fn31(instance)
			if not instance then
				return true
			end
			local matches = getMatches(tbl14.Blacklist)
			if #matches == 0 then
				return false
			end
			local v10 = string.lower(
				instance.Name
					.. " "
					.. tostring(instance:GetAttribute("ChestId") or "")
					.. " "
					.. tostring(instance:GetAttribute("ChestModel") or "")
			)

			for _, match in ipairs(matches) do
				if v10:find(match, 1, true) then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function fn32(instance)
			if not instance or not instance.Parent or not instance:IsA("Model") then
				return false
			end

			if fn31(instance) then
				return false
			end

			if instance:GetAttribute("IsOpen") == true or instance:GetAttribute("Opened") == true then
				return false
			end
			local v10 =
				string.lower(tostring(instance:GetAttribute("ChestState") or instance:GetAttribute("State") or ""))
			if v10 == "opened" or v10 == "open" or v10 == "claimed" or v10 == "empty" then
				return false
			end

			if (v10 == "locked" or v10 == "sealed") and not tbl14.IncludeLocked then
				return false
			end
			local v11 = fn30(instance)
			if not v11 or not v11.Enabled then
				return false
			end
			local attempt = tbl14.Attempts[instance]
			if attempt and os.clock() - attempt < tbl14.RETRY_DELAY then
				return false
			end
			local position = getPosition(instance)
			if not position then
				return false
			end
			local v12 = fn16(position)
			if tbl14.MaxDistance > 0 and v12 > tbl14.MaxDistance then
				return false
			end
			return true, v11, position, v12
		end

		local function fn33()
			local v10 = nil
			local child2 = nil
			local v11 = nil
			local v12 = nil

			for _, child in ipairs(getChildren()) do
				local v13, v14, v15, v16 = fn32(child)

				if v13 and (not v10 or v16 < v10) then
					v10 = v16
					child2 = child
					v11 = v14
					v12 = v15
				end
			end

			return child2, v11, v12, v10
		end

		local function fn34(instance)
			if not instance then
				return "Loot"
			end
			local dropLabel = GluWebhook.DropLabels[instance]
			if dropLabel then
				return dropLabel
			end

			for _, attribute in ipairs({ "DropItemId", "ItemId", "ItemName", "DropName", "LootId", "LootName" }) do
				local attribute2 = instance:GetAttribute(attribute)
				if attribute2 ~= nil and tostring(attribute2) ~= "" then
					GluWebhook.DropLabels[instance] = tostring(attribute2)
					return tostring(attribute2)
				end
			end

			local str11 = tostring(instance.Name or "Loot")
			GluWebhook.DropLabels[instance] = str11
			return str11
		end

		local function getInstances3()
			local instances = {}
			local tbl15 = {}
			local tagged = {}

			pcall(function()
				tagged = CollectionService:GetTagged("LootDrop")
			end)

			for _, instance in ipairs(tagged) do
				if instance and instance.Parent and not tbl15[instance] then
					tbl15[instance] = true
					table.insert(instances, instance)
				end
			end

			local lootDrops = workspace:FindFirstChild("LootDrops")

			if lootDrops then
				for _, child in ipairs(lootDrops:GetChildren()) do
					if child and child.Parent and not tbl15[child] then
						tbl15[child] = true
						table.insert(instances, child)
					end
				end
			end

			return instances
		end

		local function fn35(instance)
			if not instance or not instance.Parent then
				return nil
			end
			local lootDropPrompt = instance:FindFirstChild("LootDropPrompt")
			if lootDropPrompt and lootDropPrompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and lootDropPrompt.Enabled then
				return lootDropPrompt
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and descendant.Enabled then
					return descendant
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function fn36(instance)
			if not instance or not instance.Parent then
				return false
			end

			if (DropTries[instance] or 0) >= 3 or not DropOwner.isOurs(instance) then
				return false
			end
			local v10 = fn35(instance)
			if not v10 then
				return false
			end
			local lootAttempt = tbl14.LootAttempts[instance]
			if lootAttempt and os.clock() - lootAttempt < tbl14.LOOT_RETRY_DELAY then
				return false
			end
			return true, v10, getPosition(instance)
		end

		local function fn37(arg, arg2)
			if not tbl14.InterruptFarm and not tbl14.PriorityMode then
				return
			end
			local n16 = tbl14.PriorityMode and 0.4 or 1
			tbl14.RouteUntil = math.max(tbl14.RouteUntil or 0, os.clock() + (arg or 0.75) * n16)
			tbl14.RoutePhase = arg2 or tbl14.RoutePhase or "Loot"
		end

		local function fn38()
			if Souls and Souls.held and Souls.held() then
				return true
			end

			if LootHold.busy() then
				return true
			end

			if not tbl14.InterruptFarm and not tbl14.PriorityMode then
				return false
			end

			if not tbl14.AutoChestLoot and not tbl14.AutoLootDrops then
				return false
			end

			if tbl14.PriorityLock and tbl14.PriorityMode then
				return os.clock() - (tbl14.PrioritySince or 0) < 20
			end
			return os.clock() < (tbl14.RouteUntil or 0)
		end

		local function fn39()
			if LootHold.busy() then
				LootHold.pin()
			end

			local v10, v11, instance = fn13()
			if not instance then
				return false
			end
			local instances = getInstances3()
			local now3 = os.clock()
			local tbl15 = {}
			local tbl16 = {}

			for k, v12 in pairs(tbl14.LootFiredAt) do
				if not (k and v12) then
					continue
				end

				if k.Parent then
					if now3 - v12 >= 2.6 then
						table.insert(tbl15, k)
					end
				else
					table.insert(tbl16, k)
				end
			end

			for _, v12 in ipairs(tbl15) do
				tbl14.LootFiredAt[v12] = nil
				tbl14.LootAttempts[v12] = nil
				DropGiveUp(v12)
			end

			for _, v12 in ipairs(tbl16) do
				if not tbl14.LootCounted[v12] then
					tbl14.LootCounted[v12] = true
					tbl14.LootCollected += 1

					pcall(function()
						GluWebhook.noteDrop(v12)
					end)
				end

				tbl14.LootFiredAt[v12] = nil
			end

			if #instances == 0 then
				for _, v12 in ipairs(tbl16) do
					if not tbl14.LootCounted[v12] then
						tbl14.LootCounted[v12] = true
						tbl14.LootCollected += 1

						pcall(function()
							GluWebhook.noteDrop(v12)
						end)
					end

					tbl14.LootFiredAt[v12] = nil
				end

				return false
			end

			local magnitude2 = nil
			local instance3 = nil
			local position5 = nil

			for _, instance2 in ipairs(instances) do
				if not (fn35(instance2) and (DropTries[instance2] or 0) < 6 and DropOwner.isOurs(instance2)) then
					continue
				end
				local lootAttempt = tbl14.LootAttempts[instance2]
				if not (not lootAttempt or os.clock() - lootAttempt >= tbl14.LOOT_RETRY_DELAY) then
					continue
				end
				local position = getPosition(instance2)

				if position then
					local magnitude = (instance.Position - position).Magnitude

					if not magnitude2 or magnitude < magnitude2 then
						magnitude2 = magnitude
						instance3 = instance2
						position5 = position
					end
				end
			end

			if not instance3 then
				return false
			end

			if
				not (tbl14.InterruptFarm or tbl14.PriorityMode)
				and (flag2 or savedEnabled and #matches4 > 0 or flag3)
				and magnitude2 > tbl14.NearbyLootRadius
			then
				return false
			end
			local n16 = tbl14.PriorityMode and 0 or 0.05
			if os.clock() - tbl14.LastLootAction < n16 then
				return true
			end
			tbl14.LastLootAction = os.clock()
			tbl14.LootAttempts[instance3] = os.clock()
			fn37(0.3, "Loot claim")

			if not instance3.Parent then
				tbl14.LootAttempts[instance3] = nil
				tbl14.Status = "Drop vanished - skipping"
				return false
			end

			local v12 = fn35(instance3)
			local position = getPosition(instance3) or position5
			if not v12 or not position then
				tbl14.LootAttempts[instance3] = nil
				return false
			end

			local function fn40(position2)
				local position3 = GluLootStand(position2, localPlayer.Character) or position2 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
				local cframe = CFrame.new(position3)
				LootHold.Pos = position3
				GluHold.Pose = false

				if GluHold.go then
					GluHold.go(cframe, 1.6)
				end
			end

			LootHold.grab(instance3, 2)
			fn40(position)
			task.wait(0.08)

			if not instance3.Parent then
				tbl14.LootAttempts[instance3] = nil
				tbl14.Status = "Drop despawned - skipping"
				return false
			end

			local instance2 = fn35(instance3)
			if not instance2 then
				tbl14.LootAttempts[instance3] = nil
				return false
			end
			position = getPosition(instance3) or position

			if instance and instance.Parent then
				if (instance.Position - position).Magnitude > 6 then
					fn40(position)
					task.wait(0.05)
				end
			end

			if not instance3.Parent or not instance2.Parent then
				tbl14.LootAttempts[instance3] = nil
				tbl14.Status = "Drop vanished mid-pickup"
				return false
			end

			local v13 = fn29(instance2, instance3, position)
			tbl14.LootFiredAt[instance3] = tbl14.LootFiredAt[instance3] or os.clock()

			if instance3.Parent then
				DropGiveUp(instance3)
			end

			if v13 then
				tbl14.Status = "Looting: " .. fn34(instance3)
				return true
			end
			tbl14.LootAttempts[instance3] = nil
			return false
		end

		tbl14.tick = function()
			if (Crow and Crow.Enabled or Muzan and Muzan.Enabled) and not tbl14.BossBusy then
				local reward = Crow and Crow.Enabled and (Crow.Reward or Crow.Rewarding or Crow.Leftover)
					or Muzan and Muzan.Enabled and (Muzan.Reward or Muzan.Rewarding or Muzan.Leftover)

				if not reward then
					tbl14.PriorityLock = false
					tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
					tbl14.RouteUntil = 0
					tbl14.RoutePhase = "Idle"

					if LootHold.busy() then
						LootHold.release()
					end
				end

				tbl14.Status = reward and "Hunt is picking up the kill" or "Hunt is running - map loot is waiting"
				return false
			end

			if tbl14.BossBusy then
				tbl14.PriorityLock = false
				tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
				tbl14.Current = nil
				tbl14.RouteUntil = 0
				tbl14.RoutePhase = "Idle"
				if Souls and Souls.held and Souls.held() then
					tbl14.Status = "Holding for a soul"
					return false
				end
				local autoLootDrops = tbl14.AutoLootDrops or tbl14.AutoChestLoot
				local autoLootDrops2 = autoLootDrops and fn39() or false
				tbl14.Status = not autoLootDrops and "Boss fight in progress - auto loot off"
					or autoLootDrops2 and "Boss fight - grabbing boss loot"
					or "Boss fight in progress - chests on hold"
				return false
			end

			if not tbl14.PriorityMode and tbl14.PriorityLock then
				tbl14.PriorityLock = false
				tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
			end

			if not tbl14.AutoChestLoot and not tbl14.AutoLootDrops then
				tbl14.RoutePhase = "Idle"
				tbl14.PriorityLock = false
				tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
				LootHold.release()
				return false
			end

			if Souls and Souls.held and Souls.held() then
				tbl14.Status = "Holding for a soul"
				return false
			end

			if tbl14.PriorityMode and tbl14.AutoChestLoot then
				local now3 = os.clock()
				local priorityState = tbl14.PriorityState or "Idle"

				if priorityState == "Idle" then
					if now3 - tbl14.LastScan < 0.05 then
						return false
					end
					tbl14.LastScan = now3
					if tbl14.AutoLootDrops and fn39() then
						return true
					end
					local priorityChest, priorityPrompt, priorityPos = fn33()
					if not priorityChest then
						tbl14.Status = "Priority: watching for chest..."
						return false
					end
					tbl14.PriorityLock = true
					tbl14.PriorityChest = priorityChest
					tbl14.PriorityPrompt = priorityPrompt
					tbl14.PriorityPos = priorityPos
					tbl14.PriorityState = "Travel"
					tbl14.PrioritySince = now3
					tbl14.Status = "Priority: chest spotted - pausing farm"
					return true
				end

				if priorityState == "Travel" then
					if now3 - tbl14.PrioritySince > 6 then
						tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
						tbl14.PriorityLock = false
						tbl14.Status = "Priority: travel timeout"
						return false
					end

					local priorityChest = tbl14.PriorityChest

					if not priorityChest or not priorityChest.Parent then
						tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
						tbl14.PriorityLock = false
						return false
					end

					local priorityPos = tbl14.PriorityPos or getPosition(priorityChest)

					if priorityPos and not LootHold.busy() then
						fn22(priorityPos, 3)
						LootHold.grab(priorityChest, 1.4)
						LootHold.mark()
					end

					tbl14.PriorityState = "Fire"
					tbl14.PrioritySince = now3
					tbl14.Status = "Priority: at chest - firing prompt"
					return true
				end

				if priorityState == "Fire" then
					if now3 - tbl14.PrioritySince < 0.05 then
						return true
					end
					local priorityChest = tbl14.PriorityChest
					local priorityPrompt = tbl14.PriorityPrompt

					if not priorityChest or not priorityChest.Parent then
						tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
						tbl14.PriorityLock = false
						return false
					end

					if not priorityPrompt or not priorityPrompt.Parent or not priorityPrompt.Enabled then
						local priorityPrompt2 = fn30(priorityChest)
						tbl14.PriorityPrompt = priorityPrompt2
						priorityPrompt = priorityPrompt2
					end

					if priorityPrompt and priorityPrompt.Enabled then
						tbl14.Attempts[priorityChest] = now3

						if fn28(priorityPrompt) then
							tbl14.PriorityTries = (tbl14.PriorityTries or 0) + 1
							tbl14.Status = "Priority: prompt fired - waiting to confirm"
						else
							tbl14.Status = "Priority: prompt failed"
						end
					end

					tbl14.PriorityState = "WaitLoot"
					tbl14.PrioritySince = now3
					tbl14.PriorityLootSawAt = now3
					tbl14.PriorityLastCount = -1
					return true
				end

				if priorityState == "WaitLoot" then
					local tagged = {}

					pcall(function()
						tagged = CollectionService:GetTagged("LootDrop")
					end)

					if #tagged > 0 then
						tbl14.PriorityState = "Looting"
						tbl14.PrioritySince = now3
						tbl14.PriorityLootSawAt = now3
						tbl14.PriorityLastCount = #tagged
						tbl14.Status = "Priority: looting " .. #tagged .. " drop(s)"
						return true
					end

					if tbl14.verifyOpen(tbl14.PriorityChest) then
						if not tbl14.Counted[tbl14.PriorityChest] then
							tbl14.Counted[tbl14.PriorityChest] = true
							tbl14.Opened += 1
						end

						tbl14.Status = "Priority: chest confirmed open - watching loot"
					end

					if now3 - tbl14.PrioritySince > 3 then
						if tbl14.retryChest(tbl14.PriorityChest, now3) then
							tbl14.PriorityState = "Fire"
							tbl14.PrioritySince = now3
							tbl14.Status = "Priority: chest unconfirmed - re-opening"
							return true
						end

						tbl14.release("Priority: chest unclaimed - released")
						return false
					end

					tbl14.Status = "Priority: waiting for loot to drop..."
					return true
				end

				if priorityState == "Looting" then
					local tagged = {}

					pcall(function()
						tagged = CollectionService:GetTagged("LootDrop")
					end)

					if #tagged == 0 then
						tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
						tbl14.PriorityLock = false
						tbl14.Status = "Priority: done - resuming farm"
						return false
					end

					if tbl14.PriorityLastCount ~= #tagged then
						tbl14.PriorityLastCount = #tagged
						tbl14.PriorityLootSawAt = now3
					end

					if now3 - (tbl14.PriorityLootSawAt or now3) > 3 then
						tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
						tbl14.PriorityLock = false
						tbl14.Status = "Priority: loot stuck - resuming farm"
						return false
					end

					if now3 - tbl14.PrioritySince > 15 then
						tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
						tbl14.PriorityLock = false
						tbl14.Status = "Priority: loot timeout"
						return false
					end

					fn39()
					return true
				end

				tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
				tbl14.PriorityLock = false
				return false
			end

			local now3 = os.clock()
			if now3 - tbl14.LastScan < tbl14.SCAN_DELAY then
				return false
			end
			tbl14.LastScan = now3
			if (tbl14.AutoLootDrops or tbl14.AutoChestLoot) and fn39() then
				return true
			end

			if not tbl14.AutoChestLoot then
				tbl14.Current = nil
				tbl14.Status = "Watching loot drops"
				return false
			end

			local interruptFarm = tbl14.InterruptFarm or not (flag2 or savedEnabled and #matches4 > 0 or flag3)
			local current, v10, v11, v12 = fn33()

			if not current then
				tbl14.Current = nil

				if not fn38() then
					tbl14.RoutePhase = "Idle"
				end

				tbl14.Status = "No usable chest nearby"
				return false
			end

			tbl14.Current = current
			if not interruptFarm and v12 > tbl14.INTERACT_DIST then
				tbl14.Status = string.format("Chest %.0f studs away (farm protected)", v12)
				return false
			end

			if v12 > tbl14.INTERACT_DIST then
				if LootHold.busy() then
					tbl14.Status = "Holding while a prompt is pressed"
					return true
				end

				if tbl14.MoveTarget ~= current then
					tbl14.MoveTarget = current
					tbl14.MoveTries = 0
				end

				tbl14.MoveTries = (tbl14.MoveTries or 0) + 1

				if tbl14.MoveTries > 6 then
					tbl14.Attempts[current] = os.clock() + 45
					tbl14.MoveTarget = nil
					tbl14.MoveTries = 0
					tbl14.Status = "Chest out of reach - skipping it for now"
					return false
				end

				fn37(1, "Chest travel")
				fn22(v11, 3)
				LootHold.grab(current, 1.4)
				LootHold.mark()
				tbl14.Status = "Going to chest: " .. tostring(current:GetAttribute("ChestId") or current.Name)
				return true
			end

			if now3 - tbl14.LastAction < tbl14.OPEN_WAIT then
				fn37(0.5, "Chest wait")
				return true
			end
			tbl14.LastAction = now3
			tbl14.Attempts[current] = now3
			tbl14.MoveTarget = nil
			tbl14.MoveTries = 0
			fn37(tbl14.ROUTE_HOLD, "Chest open")

			if fn28(v10) then
				tbl14.Status = "Opening chest: " .. tostring(current:GetAttribute("ChestId") or current.Name)

				task.delay(math.max(0.25, tbl14.OPEN_WAIT), function()
					if not current then
						return
					end
					local parent = current.Parent
							and string.lower(
								tostring(current:GetAttribute("ChestState") or current:GetAttribute("State") or "")
							)
						or "gone"
					local flag15 = not current.Parent
						or current:GetAttribute("IsOpen") == true
						or current:GetAttribute("Opened") == true
						or parent == "opened"
						or parent == "open"
						or parent == "claimed"
						or parent == "empty"

					if flag15 and not tbl14.Counted[current] then
						tbl14.Counted[current] = true
						tbl14.Opened += 1
						tbl14.Status = "Chest opened - collecting drops"
						fn37(tbl14.ROUTE_HOLD, "Chest loot")
					elseif not flag15 then
						tbl14.retryChest(current, os.clock())
					end
				end)

				return true
			end

			tbl14.Status = "Chest prompt failed"
			return false
		end

		tbl14.routeBusy = function()
			return fn38()
		end

		tbl14.forceRouteRelease = function(status)
			tbl14.PriorityLock = false
			tbl14.PriorityState = "Idle"
			tbl14.PriorityChest = nil
			tbl14.PriorityPrompt = nil
			tbl14.PriorityTries = 0
			tbl14.RouteUntil = 0
			tbl14.RoutePhase = "Idle"

			if LootHold then
				LootHold.release()
			end

			if status then
				tbl14.Status = status
			end

			return true
		end

		tbl14.chestNear = function(arg, distance)
			if not arg then
				return false
			end
			distance = distance or 60

			for _, child in ipairs(getChildren()) do

		tbl14.claimNearBoss = function(arg, distance)
			if not arg then
				return false
			end
			distance = distance or 60
			local v10, v11, v12 = fn13()

			if v12 then
				local magnitude2 = nil
				local instance2 = nil
				local v13 = nil
				local position2 = nil

				for _, instance in ipairs(getInstances3()) do
					if
						not (
							instance
							and instance.Parent
							and (DropTries[instance] or 0) < 6
							and DropOwner.isOurs(instance)

					then
						continue
					end
					local v14 = fn35(instance)
					local position = v14 and getPosition(instance)
					if not (v14 and position and (position - arg).Magnitude <= distance) then
						continue
					end
					local lootAttempt = tbl14.LootAttempts[instance]
					if not (not lootAttempt or os.clock() - lootAttempt >= tbl14.LOOT_RETRY_DELAY) then
						continue
					end
					local magnitude = (position - v12.Position).Magnitude

					if not magnitude2 or magnitude < magnitude2 then
						magnitude2 = magnitude
						instance2 = instance
						v13 = v14
						position2 = position
					end
				end

				if instance2 then
					tbl14.LootAttempts[instance2] = os.clock()
					tbl14.Status = "Picking up boss loot: " .. fn34(instance2)
					fn29(v13, instance2, position2)
					tbl14.LootFiredAt[instance2] = tbl14.LootFiredAt[instance2] or os.clock()

					if instance2.Parent then
						DropGiveUp(instance2)
					end

					return true
				end
			end

			local now3 = os.clock()

			for _, child in ipairs(getChildren()) do
				if not child or not child.Parent then
					continue
				end
				local position = getPosition(child)
				if not position or (position - arg).Magnitude > distance then
					continue
				end

				if fn31(child) then
					continue
				end

				if child:GetAttribute("IsOpen") == true or child:GetAttribute("Opened") == true then
					continue
				end
				local v13 =
					string.lower(tostring(child:GetAttribute("ChestState") or child:GetAttribute("State") or ""))
				if v13 == "opened" or v13 == "open" or v13 == "claimed" or v13 == "empty" then
					continue
				end

				if (v13 == "locked" or v13 == "sealed") and not tbl14.IncludeLocked then
					continue
				end
				local attempt = tbl14.Attempts[child]
				if attempt and now3 - attempt < tbl14.RETRY_DELAY then
					continue
				end
				local v14 = fn30(child)

				if not v14 or not v14.Enabled then
					v14 = nil
				end

					continue

					GluHold.go(CFrame.new(LootHold.Pos), 1.8)
				end

					task.delay(0.45, function()
						if not child or not child.Parent then
							if child and not tbl14.Counted[child] then
								tbl14.Counted[child] = true
								tbl14.Opened += 1
							end

							return
						end

						if tbl14.verifyOpen(child) then
							if not tbl14.Counted[child] then
								tbl14.Counted[child] = true
								tbl14.Opened += 1
							end
						else
							tbl14.retryChest(child, os.clock())
						end
					end)

					tbl14.Status = "Boss reward: " .. tostring(child:GetAttribute("ChestId") or child.Name)
				end

			end

		end

				tbl14.Attempts[arg] = arg2 + 30
				tbl14.Status = string.format("Chest did not confirm after %d tries - parked", openTry)
				tbl14.release("chest parked after failed claims")

			tbl14.LastAction = 0

	local function fn28()
		local tbl14 = {

			return GluPrompt.fire(descendant, { pin = true, duration = 1 })
		end

		local function fn30(name)
			local str11 = string.lower(tostring(name or "")):gsub("[^%w]", "")
			if str11 == "spiderlily" or str11 == "lily" then
				return true
			end

			if str11:find("spider") and str11:find("lil") then
				return true
			end
			return false
		end

		local function fn31(instance)
			if not instance or not instance.Parent then
				return false
			end

			if fn30(instance.Name) then
				return true
			end
			return (
				instance:GetAttribute("IsSpiderLily")
				or instance:GetAttribute("SpiderLily")
				or instance:GetAttribute("IsLily")
				or instance:GetAttribute("Lily")
			) == true
		end

		local descendants3 = nil
		local now4 = 0

		local function getDescendants()
			local now3 = os.clock()
			if descendants3 and now3 - now4 < 1.5 then
				return descendants3
			end
			local descendants = {}
			local descendants2 = {}

			for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				if not descendants2[descendant] and fn31(descendant) then
					descendants2[descendant] = true
					table.insert(descendants, descendant)
				end
			end

			descendants3 = descendants
			now4 = now3
			return descendants
		end

		local function getPosition(instance)
			if not instance or not instance.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
				return instance.Position
			end

			if instance:IsA("Model") then
				local v10 = fn15(instance)
				if v10 then
					return v10.Position
				end

				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return instance:GetPivot()
				end)

				if ok and result and result.Position.Magnitude > 1 then
					return result.Position
				end
			end

			local basePart = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			if basePart then
				return basePart.Position
			end
			local position = nil

			for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("CFrameValue") and typeof(descendant.Value) == "CFrame" then
					local position2 = descendant.Value.Position
					if not (position2.Magnitude > 1) then
						continue
					end
					position = position or position2
					local name = string.lower(descendant.Name)
					if name:find("flower") or name:find("original") then
						return position2
					end
				end
			end

			return position
		end

		local function fn32(instance)
			if not instance then
				return nil
			end

			if instance:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and instance.Enabled then

			end
			return instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
		end

		tbl14.tick = function()
			if not tbl14.Enabled then
				tbl14.Status = "Idle"
				return false
			end
			local now3 = os.clock()
			if now3 - tbl14.LastScan < tbl14.ScanDelay then
				return false
			end
			tbl14.LastScan = now3
			local v10, v11, v12 = fn13()
			if not v12 or not v11 or v11.Health <= 0 then
				tbl14.Status = "Waiting for character"
				return false
			end
			local descendants = getDescendants()

			if #descendants == 0 then
				tbl14.Current = nil
				tbl14.Status = "No Spider Lily found"
				return false
			end

			local magnitude2 = nil
			local descendant2 = nil
			local position2 = nil

			for _, descendant in ipairs(descendants) do
				local v13 = tbl14.Attempted[descendant]
				if not (not v13 or now3 - v13 >= tbl14.AttemptCooldown) then
					continue
				end
				local position = getPosition(descendant)
				if not position then
					continue
				end
				local magnitude = (v12.Position - position).Magnitude

				if tbl14.MaxDistance == 0 or magnitude <= tbl14.MaxDistance then
					if not magnitude2 or magnitude < magnitude2 then
						magnitude2 = magnitude
						descendant2 = descendant
						position2 = position
					end
				end
			end

			if not position2 then
				tbl14.Current = nil
				tbl14.Status = string.format("All %d lilies on cooldown", #descendants)
				return false
			end

			tbl14.Current = descendant2

			if tbl14.InteractDist < magnitude2 then
				if now3 - tbl14.LastAction < 0.15 then
					return true
				end
				tbl14.LastAction = now3
				fn22(position2, tbl14.TeleportYOff)
				tbl14.Status = string.format("Going to lily (%.0f studs)", magnitude2)
				return true
			end

			if now3 - tbl14.LastAction < tbl14.PromptWait then
				return true
			end
			tbl14.LastAction = now3
			tbl14.Attempted[descendant2] = now3
			local descendant3 = fn32(descendant2)

			if not descendant3 then
				local magnitude3 = nil

				for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					if not (descendant:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and descendant.Enabled) then
						continue
					end
					local parent = descendant.Parent
					local parent2 = parent
						and (parent:IsA("BasePart") and parent or parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true))

					if parent2 then
						local magnitude = (parent2.Position - position2).Magnitude

						if magnitude <= 12 and (not magnitude3 or magnitude < magnitude3) then
							magnitude3 = magnitude
							descendant3 = descendant
						end
					end
				end
			end

			if descendant3 and fn29(descendant3) then
				if not tbl14.Counted[descendant2] then
					tbl14.Counted[descendant2] = true
					tbl14.Harvested += 1
				end

				tbl14.Status = string.format("Harvested lily #%d", tbl14.Harvested)
				return true
			end

			if not descendant3 then
				tbl14.LastScan = 0
				tbl14.Status = "At lily - waiting for bloom..."
				return true
			end

			if not descendant3.Enabled then
				tbl14.LastScan = 0
				tbl14.Status = "At lily - prompt not ready yet..."
				return true
			end

			tbl14.Status = "Lily prompt failed"
			return false
		end

		tbl14.reset = function()
			tbl14.Harvested = 0
			tbl14.Attempted = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
			tbl14.Counted = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		end

		return tbl14
	end

	local function fn29()
		local v10 = nil
		local v11 = nil
		local v12 = nil
		local v13 = nil
		local v14 = nil
		local v15 = nil

		local function getMatch(arg)
			return tostring(arg or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""
		end

		local function getMatch2(arg)
			return string.lower(getMatch(arg))
		end

		local function fn30()
			pcall(function()
				local communication = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Communication")
				local serverAndClient = communication and communication:FindFirstChild("ServerAndClient")
				local signals = serverAndClient and serverAndClient:FindFirstChild("Signals")
				local signalEvent = signals and signals:FindFirstChild("SignalEvent")

				if signalEvent and signalEvent:IsA("ModuleScript") then
					local ok, result = pcall(require, signalEvent)

					if ok then
						v10 = result
					end
				end

				local signalFunction = signals and signals:FindFirstChild("SignalFunction")

				if signalFunction and signalFunction:IsA("ModuleScript") then
					local ok, result = pcall(require, signalFunction)

					if ok then
						v11 = result
					end
				end

				local cam = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CAM")
				local global = cam and cam:FindFirstChild("Global")

				if global then
					local utility = global:FindFirstChild("Utility")

					if utility and utility:IsA("ModuleScript") then
						local ok, result = pcall(require, utility)

						if ok then
							v12 = result
						end
					end

					local spinBalance = global:FindFirstChild("SpinBalance")

					if spinBalance and spinBalance:IsA("ModuleScript") then
						local ok, result = pcall(require, spinBalance)

						if ok then
							v14 = result
						end
					end

					local spinners = global:FindFirstChild("Spinners")

					if spinners and spinners:IsA("ModuleScript") then
						local ok, result = pcall(require, spinners)

						if ok then
							v15 = result
						end
					end
				end

				if cam then
					local clans = cam:FindFirstChild("Clans")

					if clans and clans:IsA("ModuleScript") then
						local ok, result = pcall(require, clans)

						if ok then
							v13 = result
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		local function fn31()

		local function getMatches(targetClans)
			local matches = {}
			local gmatch = string.gmatch
			local v16 = tostring
			targetClans = targetClans or ""

			for k in gmatch(v16(targetClans), "[^,]+") do
				local match = getMatch2(k)

				if match ~= "" then
					table.insert(matches, match)
				end
			end

			return matches
		end

		local tbl14

		tbl14 = {
			Enabled = false,
			TargetClans = "",
			StopRarity = "Legendary",
			Status = "Idle",
			SessionCount = 0,
			LastAction = 0,
			LastResult = "",
			BalanceSource = "unknown",
			Delay = 0.15,
			Driver = nil,
			currentClan = function()
				local instance = fn31()
				local clan = instance and instance:FindFirstChild("Clan")

				if clan and clan:IsA("ValueBase") then
					local match = getMatch(clan.Value)
					if match ~= "" then
						return match
					end
				end

				local character2 = localPlayer.Character

				if character2 then
					local ok, result = pcall(character2.GetAttribute, character2, "Clan")
					if ok and type(result) == "string" and getMatch(result) ~= "" then
						return getMatch(result)
					end
				end

				return "None"
			end,
			currentClanRarity = function(arg)
				local match = getMatch(arg or tbl14.currentClan())
				if match == "" or match == "None" then
					return "None"
				end

				if v13 and type(v13.TierOf) == "function" then
					local ok, result = pcall(v13.TierOf, match)

					if ok and result ~= nil then
						if type(result) == "table" then
							return tostring(result.name or result.Name or result.tier or result.Tier or "Unknown")
						end
						return tostring(result)
					end
				end

				return "Unknown"
			end,
			spinBalance = function()
				local instance = fn31()
				if not instance then
					tbl14.BalanceSource = "data unavailable"
					return nil
				end

				if v14 and type(v14.Total) == "function" then
					local ok, result = pcall(v14.Total, instance, true)
					if ok and tonumber(result) then
						tbl14.BalanceSource = "SpinBalance.Total"
						return math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(result)))
					end
				end

				local spinning = instance:FindFirstChild("Spinning")
				local flag15 = false
				local n16 = 0

				if spinning then
					for _, name in ipairs({ "FreeClanSpins", "Spins" }) do
						local child = spinning:FindFirstChild(name)

						if child and child:IsA("ValueBase") then
							n16 += tonumber(child.Value) or 0
							flag15 = true
						end
					end
				end

				for _, instance2 in ipairs({ instance, instance.Parent }) do
					if instance2 then
						local accountSpins = instance2:FindFirstChild("AccountSpins", true)

						if accountSpins and accountSpins:IsA("ValueBase") then
							n16 += tonumber(accountSpins.Value) or 0
							flag15 = true
							break
						end
					end
				end

				if flag15 then
					tbl14.BalanceSource = "replicated Spinning values"
					return math.max(0, math.floor(n16))
				end
				tbl14.BalanceSource = "unavailable"
				return nil
			end,
			clanSpinCost = function()
				if v15 and type(v15) == "table" and type(v15.Clan) == "table" then
					return math.max(1, tonumber(v15.Clan.Cost) or 1)
				end
				return 1
			end,
			spinTargetClanReached = function(arg)
				local match = getMatch2(arg)
				if match == "" or match == "none" then
					return false
				end

				for _, match2 in ipairs(getMatches(tbl14.TargetClans)) do
					if match == match2 then
						return true
					end
				end

				return false
			end,
			spinLegendaryOrBetter = function(arg)
				local tbl15 = { common = 1, uncommon = 2, rare = 3, legendary = 4, mythic = 5, supreme = 6 }
				local v16 = tbl15[getMatch2(arg)]
				return v16 ~= nil and v16 >= tbl15.legendary
			end,
			spinTargetRarityReached = function(arg)
				local match = getMatch2(tbl14.StopRarity)
				local match2 = getMatch2(arg)
				if match == "" or match2 == "" or match2 == "unknown" then
					return false
				end
				local matches = { common = 1, uncommon = 2, rare = 3, legendary = 4, mythic = 5, supreme = 6 }
				local match3 = matches[match2]
				local match4 = matches[match]
				if match3 and match4 then
					return match3 >= match4
				end
				return match2 == match
			end,
		}

		local function fn32(arg, lastResult)
			task.spawn(function()
				local deadline = os.clock() + 1

				while os.clock() < deadline and localPlayer:GetAttribute("PendingClanSpin") == nil do
					task.wait(0.02)
				end

				task.wait(0.03)

				if v10 and type(v10.ToServer) == "function" then
					if not pcall(v10.ToServer, "ClanSpinComplete") then
						tbl14.Status = "ClanSpin returned " .. tostring(lastResult) .. " | completion signal failed"
						return
					end
					local deadline2 = os.clock() + 1.5

					while os.clock() < deadline2 do
						if tbl14.currentClan() ~= arg or localPlayer:GetAttribute("PendingClanSpin") == nil then
							break
						end
						task.wait(0.02)
					end

					local v16 = tbl14.currentClan()
					local v17 = tbl14.currentClanRarity(v16)
					tbl14.LastResult = tostring(lastResult)

					if tbl14.spinLegendaryOrBetter(v17) then
						tbl14.Enabled = false
						tbl14.Status = "STOP | " .. tostring(v17) .. " clan: " .. tostring(v16)
					elseif
						tbl14.Enabled ~= true and tbl14.spinLegendaryOrBetter(tbl14.currentClanRarity(lastResult))
					then
						tbl14.Status = "STOP | Legendary+ result: " .. tostring(lastResult)
					else
						tbl14.Status = "Result: " .. tostring(lastResult) .. " | Clan: " .. tostring(v16)
					end

					return
				end

				tbl14.Status = "ClanSpin returned " .. tostring(lastResult) .. " | SignalEvent unavailable"
			end)
		end

		tbl14.spinClanOnce = function()
			if not v11 or not v10 then
				fn30()
			end

			if localPlayer:GetAttribute("PendingClanSpin") ~= nil then
				tbl14.Status = "Clan spin already pending"
				return false
			end

			if not v11 or type(v11.ToServer) ~= "function" then
				tbl14.Status = "SignalFunction unavailable"
				return false
			end
			local v16 = tbl14.spinBalance()
			local v17 = tbl14.clanSpinCost()
			if v16 ~= nil and v16 < v17 then
				tbl14.Status = string.format("Not enough spins: %d/%d", v16, v17)
				return false
			end
			local v18 = tbl14.currentClan()
			tbl14.LastAction = os.clock()
			tbl14.Status = "Requesting ClanSpin..."
			local ok, lastResult = pcall(v11.ToServer, "ClanSpin")
			if not ok then
				tbl14.Status = "ClanSpin server error: " .. tostring(lastResult)
				return false
			end

			if typeof(lastResult) ~= "string" or lastResult == "" then
				tbl14.Status = "ClanSpin refused / invalid server result"
				return false
			end
			tbl14.SessionCount = (tbl14.SessionCount or 0) + 1
			tbl14.LastResult = lastResult
			local v19 = tbl14.currentClanRarity(lastResult)

			if tbl14.spinLegendaryOrBetter(v19) then
				tbl14.Enabled = false
				tbl14.Status = "STOP | " .. tostring(v19) .. " clan rolled: " .. tostring(lastResult)
			else
				tbl14.Status = "Server rolled: " .. tostring(lastResult)
			end

			fn32(v18, lastResult)
			return true, lastResult
		end

		tbl14.tick = function()
			if tbl14.Enabled ~= true then
				return
			end

			if os.clock() - (tbl14.LastAction or 0) < (tbl14.Delay or 0.15) then
				return
			end

			if localPlayer:GetAttribute("PendingClanSpin") ~= nil then
				return
			end
			local v16 = tbl14.currentClan()
			local v17 = tbl14.currentClanRarity(v16)

			if tbl14.spinLegendaryOrBetter(v17) then
				tbl14.Enabled = false
				tbl14.Status = "STOP | Legendary+ clan: " .. v16 .. " (" .. tostring(v17) .. ")"
				return
			end

			if tbl14.spinTargetClanReached(v16) then
				tbl14.Enabled = false
				tbl14.Status = "STOP | target clan: " .. v16
				return
			end

			if tbl14.spinTargetRarityReached(v17) then
				tbl14.Enabled = false
				tbl14.Status = "STOP | " .. tostring(v17) .. ": " .. v16
				return
			end

			local v18 = tbl14.spinBalance()
			local v19 = tbl14.clanSpinCost()

			if v18 ~= nil and v18 < v19 then
				tbl14.Enabled = false
				tbl14.Status = "STOP | not enough spins"
				return
			end

			tbl14.spinClanOnce()
		end

		tbl14.setEnabled = function(arg)
			tbl14.Enabled = arg == true
			tbl14.LastAction = 0

			if tbl14.Enabled and not tbl14.Driver then
				tbl14.Driver = task.spawn(function()
					while tbl14.Enabled do
						local ok, result = pcall(tbl14.tick)

						if not ok and result then
							tbl14.Status = "tick error: " .. tostring(result)
						end

						RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
					end

					tbl14.Driver = nil
				end)
			end

			return tbl14.Enabled
		end

		tbl14.refreshModules = function()
			fn30()
		end

		return tbl14
	end

	local function fn30()

		local function getPosition(instance)
			if not instance or not instance.Parent then
				return nil
			end

			if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
				return instance.Position
			end

			if instance:IsA("Model") then
				local v10 = fn15(instance)
				if v10 then
					return v10.Position
				end

				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return instance:GetPivot()
				end)

				if ok and result then
					return result.Position
				end
			end

			local basePart = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
			return basePart and basePart.Position or nil
		end

		local function fn32(name)
			if not name or name == "" then
				return nil
			end
			local child = workspace:FindFirstChild(name, true)

			if child then
				if child:IsA("Model") then
					return child
				end
				local model = child:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
				if model then
					return model
				end
			end

			local name2 = string.lower(name)

			for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("Model") and string.lower(descendant.Name) == name2 then
					return descendant
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function getDescendant(instance, arg)
			if not instance then
				return nil
			end
			arg = arg or 30
			local v10 = nil
			local descendant2 = nil

			for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
				if not (descendant:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and descendant.Enabled) then
					continue
				end
				local parent = descendant.Parent
				parent = parent and (parent:IsA("BasePart") and parent or parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))

				if parent then
					local v11 = fn16(parent)

					if v11 <= arg and (not v10 or v11 < v10) then
						v10 = v11
						descendant2 = descendant
					end
				end
			end

			return descendant2
		end

		local function createBodyPosition(parent)
			if tbl14.SlideBody and tbl14.SlideBody.Parent == parent then
				return tbl14.SlideBody
			end

			if tbl14.SlideBody then
				pcall(function()
					tbl14.SlideBody:Destroy()
				end)
			end

			local gluSlideBody = Instance.new("BodyPosition")
			gluSlideBody.Name = "Glu_SlideBody"
			gluSlideBody.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
			gluSlideBody.P = 50000
			gluSlideBody.D = 1000
			gluSlideBody.Position = parent.Position
			gluSlideBody.Parent = parent
			tbl14.SlideBody = gluSlideBody
			return gluSlideBody
		end

		local function fn33(arg)
			if not tbl14.SlideEnabled then
				return
			end
			local v10, humanoid, part = fn13()
			if not humanoid or not part or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local bodyPosition = createBodyPosition(part)
			if not bodyPosition or not bodyPosition.Parent then
				return
			end
			local moveDirection

			if humanoid.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0.05 then
				moveDirection = humanoid.MoveDirection
			else
				local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
				local flag15 = currentCamera and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
				moveDirection = Vector3.zero

				if flag15 then
					moveDirection = Vector3.zero

					if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
						moveDirection = Vector3.zero + currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
					end

					if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
						moveDirection -= currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
					end

					if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
						moveDirection += currentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
					end

					if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
						moveDirection -= currentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
					end
				end
			end

			local vector = Vector3.new(moveDirection.X, 0, moveDirection.Z)

			if vector.Magnitude > 0.05 then
				local position = part.Position + vector.Unit * (tbl14.SlideSpeed * arg * 5)
				bodyPosition.Position = position
				part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * (part.CFrame - part.CFrame.Position)
			else
				bodyPosition.Position = part.Position
			end

			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		end

		local function fn35(arg)
			if not tbl14.FlyEnabled then
				return
			end
			local v10, v11, part = fn13()
			if not v11 or not part or v11.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end

			if tbl14.FlyBody and tbl14.FlyBody.Parent ~= part then
				tbl14.markDetected("the game removed the fly body")
			end

			if tbl14.FlyDetected and os.clock() - (tbl14.FlyDetectAt or 0) > 4 then
				tbl14.FlyDetected = false
			end

			local v12, v13 = fn34(part)
			if not v12 or not v13 then
				return
			end
			local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
			local flag15 = currentCamera and not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()
			local vector = Vector3.zero

			if flag15 then
				vector = Vector3.zero

				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
					vector = Vector3.zero + currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
				end

				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
					vector -= currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector
				end

				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
					vector += currentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
				end

				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
					vector -= currentCamera.CFrame.RightVector
				end

				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
					vector += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
				end

				if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then
					vector -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
				end
			end

			if vector.Magnitude > 0.05 then
				vector = vector.Unit
			end

			local vector2 = vector.Magnitude > 0.05 and vector * (tbl14.FlySpeed * arg) or Vector3.zero
			local position = part.Position + vector2
			v12.Position = position

			if vector2.Magnitude > 0 then
				part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * (part.CFrame - part.CFrame.Position)
			end

			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

			if currentCamera then
				v13.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(part.Position, part.Position + currentCamera.CFrame.LookVector)
			end

			local n16 = vector.Magnitude > 0.05 and tbl14.FlySpeed * arg or 0

			if tbl14.FlyPrevPos and part.Position then
				local magnitude = (part.Position - tbl14.FlyPrevPos).Magnitude

				if n16 + 40 < magnitude then
					tbl14.markDetected(string.format("the server snapped you back %.0f studs", magnitude))
				end
			end

			tbl14.FlyPrevPos = part.Position

			if not tbl14.FlyDetected then
				tbl14.FlyStatus = string.format("flying (%.0f studs/s)", tbl14.FlySpeed)
			end
		end

		tbl14.getRegionList = function()
			local names3 = {}
			local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")
			local regions = debree and debree:FindFirstChild("Regions")

			if regions then
				for _, child in ipairs(regions:GetChildren()) do
					if child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("Model") then

					end
				end
			end

			table.sort(names3)
			return names3
		end

		tbl14.teleportRegion = function(name)
			if not name or name == "" then
				return false, "Pick a region first"
			end
			local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")
			local regions = debree and debree:FindFirstChild("Regions")
			local child = regions and regions:FindFirstChild(name)
			if not child then
				return false, "Region '" .. tostring(name) .. "' not streamed"
			end
			local child3 = nil

			for _, child2 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
				if string.find(string.lower(child2.Name), "crystal", 1, true) then
					child3 = child2
					break
				end
			end

			local cframe = nil

			if child3 then
				if child3:IsA("BasePart") then
					cframe = child3.CFrame
				else
					local basePart = child3:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					local cframe2 = nil

					if basePart then
						cframe2 = basePart.CFrame
					end

					if not cframe2 then
						local ok

						ok, cframe = pcall(function()
							return child3:GetPivot()
						end)

						if not (ok and cframe and cframe.Position.Magnitude > 5) then
							cframe = cframe2
						end
					else
						cframe = cframe2
					end
				end
			end

			if not cframe then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return child:GetPivot()
				end)

				if ok and result and result.Position.Magnitude > 5 then
					cframe = result
				end
			end

			if not cframe then
				local stationaryNpcs = child:FindFirstChild("StationaryNpcs")
				local model = stationaryNpcs and stationaryNpcs:FindFirstChildOfClass("Model")

				if model then
					local ok, result = pcall(function()
						return model:GetPivot()
					end)

					if ok and result and result.Position.Magnitude > 5 then
						cframe = result
					end
				end
			end

			if not cframe then
				local basePart = child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

				if basePart then
					cframe = basePart.CFrame
				end
			end

			if not cframe then
				local v10 = ({
					["Verdant Cliffs"] = { 1774.963, -425.009 },
					["Forgotten Ruins"] = { -953.97, 945.479 },
					["Stone Sanctuary"] = { 2564.096, -590.007 },
				})[name]

				if v10 then
					local function getPosition2(x, z)
						local character2 = localPlayer.Character
						local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
						raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
						raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = character2 and { character2 } or {}
						local hit = workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(x, 5000, z), Vector3.new(0, -10000, 0), raycastParams)
						return hit and hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0) or nil
					end

					local position = getPosition2(v10[1], v10[2])

					if not position then
						pcall(function()
							localPlayer:RequestStreamAroundAsync(Vector3.new(v10[1], 900, v10[2]), 12)
						end)

						position = getPosition2(v10[1], v10[2])
					end

					if not position then
						local character2 = localPlayer.Character

						if character2 then
							character2:PivotTo(CFrame.new(v10[1], 2500, v10[2]))
							task.wait(2)
							position = getPosition2(v10[1], v10[2])
						end
					end

					if position then
						cframe = CFrame.new(position)
					else
						cframe = CFrame.new(v10[1], 2500, v10[2])
					end
				end
			end

			if not cframe then
				return false, "No teleport point in " .. tostring(name)
			end

			if not localPlayer.Character then
				return false, "Character not ready"
			end
			TeleportFix.hold(20)
			fn25()
			fn26()
			TeleportFix.arm(cframe.Position)
			if not TPMethod6.start(cframe) then
				return false, "Could not reach " .. tostring(name)
			end
			return true, "Teleported to " .. tostring(name)
		end

		tbl14.nextRegion = function()

			if #regionList == 0 then

			local selectedRegion = tbl14.SelectedRegion or ""

			tbl14.SelectedRegion = selectedRegion2

			return v10, v11, selectedRegion2
		end

		local function fn36()
			local v10, v11, v12 = fn13()
			if not v12 then
				return nil
			end
			local magnitude2 = nil
			local descendant2 = nil

			for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

				local v13 = fn15(descendant)

		tbl14.horseAction = function(arg)
			local v10 = fn36()

			if not v10 then
				local tbl15 = {
					Vector3.new(-1740.47, 311.5, 881.24),
					Vector3.new(128.307, 827.359, 987.86),
					Vector3.new(607.25, 1017.5, -224.46),

	local function fn32()
		local HttpService2 = game:GetService("HttpService")
		local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
		local request_ = nil

		local function getRequest()
			if request_ ~= nil then
				return request_
			end
			request_ = false
			local v10 = _G

			if type(v10) == "table" then
				for _, v11 in ipairs({ "request", "http_request", "syn_request", "httprequest" }) do
					if type(v10[v11]) == "function" then
						request_ = v10[v11]
						return request_
					end
				end

				local syn_ = v10.syn
				if type(syn_) == "table" and type(syn_.request) == "function" then
					request_ = syn_.request
					return request_
				end
			end

			return request_
		end

		local function fn33(arg)
			local request_2 = getRequest()

			if request_2 then
				local ok, result = pcall(request_2, { Url = arg, Method = "GET" })

				if ok and type(result) == "table" and type(result.Body) == "string" and #result.Body > 0 then
					local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
						return HttpService2:JSONDecode(result.Body)
					end)

					if ok2 and type(result2) == "table" then
						return result2
					end
				end
			end

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return game:HttpGet(arg)
			end)

			if ok and type(result) == "string" and #result > 0 then
				local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
					return HttpService2:JSONDecode(result)
				end)

				if ok2 and type(result2) == "table" then
					return result2
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function fn34(player, groupId)

				end

		end

		end

						end)
					end
				end
			end

			tbl14.Saved = {}
			tbl14.SavedAttr = {}
			tbl14.Refills = 0
			tbl14.Frames = 0
			tbl14.Status = "Idle"
		end

		local function fn35()

		local v11 = nil
		local now5 = 0

		local function fn36()
			local tbl18 = {}
			local count4 = 0

			pcall(function()
				local items = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Items")
				if not items then
					return
				end

		end

		local function weapons()
			if not v11 or os.clock() - (now5 or 0) > 5 then
				return fn36()
			end
			return v11
		end

		local function isWeapon(arg)
			if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
				return false
			end

			if weapons()[arg] then
				return true
			end
			local v12 = fn35()
			local flag16 = type(v12) == "table" and v12[arg] or nil

			if type(flag16) == "table" then
				if flag16.HasCombat == true then
					return true
				end
				local combatPreset = flag16.CombatPreset
				if typeof(combatPreset) == "string" and combatPreset ~= "" then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		tbl15.isWeapon = isWeapon
		tbl15.weapons = weapons

		tbl15.styleOf = function(arg)

			if type(flag16) == "table" then
				local skillCategory = flag16.SkillCategory or flag16.CombatPreset
				if typeof(skillCategory) == "string" and skillCategory ~= "" then
					return skillCategory
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function getNames2()
			local names3 = {}
			local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
			local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
			local child = data and data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name)
			local slots = child and child:FindFirstChild("slots")
			local slot1 = slots and slots:FindFirstChild("Slot1")
			local inventory = slot1 and slot1:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
			local inventory2 = inventory and inventory:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
			if not inventory2 then
				return names3
			end
			local tbl18 = {}

			for _, child2 in ipairs(inventory2:GetChildren()) do
				if isWeapon(child2.Name) and not tbl18[child2.Name] then
					tbl18[child2.Name] = true
					table.insert(names3, child2.Name)
				end
			end

			if #names3 == 0 then
				table.insert(names3, "Combat")
			end

			table.sort(names3)
			return names3
		end

		local function fn37(name)
			local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
			local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
			local child = data and data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name)
			local slots = child and child:FindFirstChild("slots")
			local slot1 = slots and slots:FindFirstChild("Slot1")
			local inventory = slot1 and slot1:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
			local inventory2 = inventory and inventory:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
			local child2 = inventory2 and inventory2:FindFirstChild(name)
			local id = child2 and child2:FindFirstChild("Id")
			return id and tonumber(id.Value)
		end

		local function equip(arg)
			local tbl18 = { "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five" }
			local v12 = fn37(arg)
			if not v12 then
				return false, "weapon not in inventory"
			end
			local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
			local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
			local child = data and data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name)
			local slots = child and child:FindFirstChild("slots")
			local slot1 = slots and slots:FindFirstChild("Slot1")
			local toolbar = slot1 and slot1:FindFirstChild("Inventory") and slot1.Inventory:FindFirstChild("Toolbar")
			if not toolbar then
				return false, "toolbar not found"
			end
			local currentSlot = nil

			for i = 1, 5 do
				local child2 = toolbar:FindFirstChild(tbl18[i])
				if child2 and tonumber(child2.Value) == v12 then
					currentSlot = i
					break
				end
			end

			if currentSlot and fn24() == currentSlot then
				tbl15.CurrentSlot = currentSlot
				return true, "already equipped (slot " .. currentSlot .. ")"
			end

			if not currentSlot then
				for i = 1, 5 do
					local child2 = toolbar:FindFirstChild(tbl18[i])
					if not child2 or tonumber(child2.Value) == 0 or tostring(child2.Value) == "" then
						currentSlot = i
						break
					end
				end
			end

			currentSlot = currentSlot or 1
			tbl15.CurrentSlot = currentSlot
			local child2 = toolbar:FindFirstChild(tbl18[currentSlot])

			if not child2 or tonumber(child2.Value) ~= v12 then
				local remote = fn6()

				if remote then
					pcall(function()
						remote:FireServer("Toolbar_Equip", tbl18[currentSlot], v12)
					end)

					task.wait(0.15)
				end
			end

			if fn24() ~= currentSlot then
				getOk(currentSlot)
				task.wait(0.15)
			end

			return true, "slot " .. currentSlot
		end

		tbl15.owned = getNames2
		tbl15.equip = equip
		return tbl15
	end
