	local function fn35()
		local tbl15 = {
			Enabled = false,
			Status = "Idle",
			MinRarity = 1,
			LastCheck = 0,
			Cooldown = 4,
			SlotNames = { "One", "Two", "Three", "Four", "Five" },
		}

		local v10 = nil

		local function fn36()
			if v10 then
				return v10
			end

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return require(ReplicatedStorage.CAM.Global.Collectibles.Items)
			end)

			if ok and result then
				v10 = result
			end

			return v10
		end

		local function getStats()
			local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
			local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
			local child = data and data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name)
			local slots = child and child:FindFirstChild("slots")
			local slot1 = slots and slots:FindFirstChild("Slot1")
			local inventory = slot1 and slot1:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
			if not inventory then
				return nil
			end
			local accessories = inventory:FindFirstChild("Accessories")
			return accessories and accessories:FindFirstChild("Stats")
		end

		local function getInventory()
			local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
			local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
			local child = data and data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name)
			local slots = child and child:FindFirstChild("slots")
			local slot1 = slots and slots:FindFirstChild("Slot1")
			local inventory = slot1 and slot1:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
			return inventory and inventory:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
		end

		local function fn37(arg)
			if not arg then
				return 0
			end
			local n16 = (tonumber(arg.Rarity) or 1) * 100
			local stats = arg.Stats

			if type(stats) == "table" then
				for _, stat in pairs(stats) do
					if type(stat) == "number" then
						n16 += stat
					end
				end
			end

			return n16
		end

		local function fn38()
			local v11 = fn36()
			local tbl16 = {}
			local tbl17 = {}
			local inventory = getInventory()
			if not inventory then
				return tbl16
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(inventory:GetChildren()) do
				local id = child:FindFirstChild("Id")
				local num = id and id:IsA("ValueBase") and tonumber(id.Value)

				if num then
					local v12 = v11 and v11[child.Name]

					if v12 and tonumber(v12.EquipType) == 3 and not tbl17[num] then
						tbl17[num] = true

						table.insert(tbl16, {
							name = child.Name,
							id = num,
							cat = tostring(v12.Category or ""),
							score = fn37(v12),
							rarity = tonumber(v12.Rarity) or 1,
						})
					end
				end
			end

			table.sort(tbl16, function(arg, arg2)
				return arg.score > arg2.score
			end)

			return tbl16
		end

		local function getSlotNames()
			local slotNames = {}
			local stats = getStats()
			if not stats then
				return slotNames
			end

			for _, slotName in ipairs(tbl15.SlotNames) do
				local slot = stats:FindFirstChild(slotName)
				slotNames[slotName] = slot and slot:IsA("ValueBase") and tonumber(slot.Value) or 0
			end

			return slotNames
		end

		local function fn39(slotName, id)
			local remote = fn6()
			if not remote then
				return false
			end

			if pcall(function()
				remote:FireServer("AccessoryEquip", slotName, id, "Stats")
			end) then
				return true
			end
			return false
		end

		tbl15.tick = function()
			if not tbl15.Enabled then
				return
			end
			local now3 = os.clock()
			if now3 - tbl15.LastCheck < tbl15.Cooldown then
				return
			end
			tbl15.LastCheck = now3
			local v11 = fn38()
			if #v11 == 0 then
				tbl15.Status = "no accessories owned"
				return
			end
			local slotNames = getSlotNames()
			local slotNames2 = {}

			for _, slotName in pairs(slotNames) do
				if slotName and slotName > 0 then
					slotNames2[slotName] = true
				end
			end

			local count4 = 0

			for _, slotName in ipairs(tbl15.SlotNames) do
				local slotName2 = slotNames[slotName] or 0
				local str11 = nil
				local n16 = 0

				if slotName2 > 0 then
					local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
					local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
					local child = data and data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name)
					local slots = child and child:FindFirstChild("slots")
					local slot1 = slots and slots:FindFirstChild("Slot1")
					local inventory = slot1 and slot1:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
					inventory = inventory and inventory:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
					str11 = nil

					if inventory then
						str11 = nil

						for _, child2 in ipairs(inventory:GetChildren()) do
							local id = child2:FindFirstChild("Id")

							if id and id:IsA("ValueBase") and tonumber(id.Value) == slotName2 then
								local v12 = fn36()
								v12 = v12 and v12[child2.Name]
								str11 = nil

								if v12 then
									str11 = tostring(v12.Category or "")
									n16 = fn37(v12)
								end

								break
							end

							str11 = nil
						end
					end
				end

				local v12

				if str11 and str11 ~= "" then
					v12 = nil

					for _, v13 in ipairs(v11) do
						if
							v13.cat == str11
							and v13.rarity >= tbl15.MinRarity
							and not slotNames2[v13.id]
							and v13.score > n16
						then
							v12 = v13
							break
						end
						v12 = nil
					end
				else
					v12 = nil

					for _, v13 in ipairs(v11) do
						if v13.rarity >= tbl15.MinRarity and not slotNames2[v13.id] then
							v12 = v13
							break
						end
						v12 = nil
					end
				end

				if v12 then
					if fn39(slotName, v12.id) then
						slotNames2[v12.id] = true
						slotNames[slotName] = v12.id
						count4 += 1
						tbl15.Status = string.format("equipped %s -> %s", v12.name, slotName)
						task.wait(0.15)
					end
				end
			end

			if count4 == 0 then
				tbl15.Status = "best accessories already equipped"
			end
		end

		return tbl15
	end

	v9 = fn35()

	AutoBlockSkills = {
		Enabled = false,
		BlockKey = Enum.KeyCode.F,
		DisappearLimit = 5,
		Timeout = 1.5,
		Status = "Idle",
		Holding = false,
		HeldUntil = 0,
		Blocks = 0,
		Vanished = 0,
		Tracked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		TrackedCount = 0,
		DeepConns = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		DebreeConn = nil,
		LoopConn = nil,
		Armed = false,
		BossLabel = nil,
	}

	AutoBlockSkills.press = function()
		pcall(function()
			VirtualInputManager_:SendKeyEvent(true, AutoBlockSkills.BlockKey, false, game)
		end)
	end

	AutoBlockSkills.release = function()
		pcall(function()
			VirtualInputManager_:SendKeyEvent(false, AutoBlockSkills.BlockKey, false, game)
		end)
	end

	AutoBlockSkills.trigger = function()
		if not AutoBlockSkills.Enabled then
			return
		end

		if not AutoBlockSkills.Holding then
			AutoBlockSkills.Vanished = 0
			AutoBlockSkills.press()
			AutoBlockSkills.Holding = true
			AutoBlockSkills.Blocks = AutoBlockSkills.Blocks + 1
		end

		AutoBlockSkills.HeldUntil = os.clock() + AutoBlockSkills.Timeout
		AutoBlockSkills.Status = "Active"
	end

	AutoBlockSkills.track = function(instance)
		if AutoBlockSkills.Tracked[instance] then
			return
		end
		AutoBlockSkills.TrackedCount = AutoBlockSkills.TrackedCount + 1
		local connection = nil

		AutoBlockSkills.Tracked[instance] = instance.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
			if parent == nil then
				if connection then
					connection:Disconnect()
				end

				AutoBlockSkills.Tracked[instance] = nil
				AutoBlockSkills.TrackedCount = math.max(0, AutoBlockSkills.TrackedCount - 1)
				AutoBlockSkills.Vanished = AutoBlockSkills.Vanished + 1

				if AutoBlockSkills.DisappearLimit <= AutoBlockSkills.Vanished then
					if AutoBlockSkills.Holding then
						AutoBlockSkills.release()
						AutoBlockSkills.Holding = false
					end

					AutoBlockSkills.Status = string.format("Released (%d gone)", AutoBlockSkills.Vanished)
					AutoBlockSkills.Vanished = 0
				else
					AutoBlockSkills.Status = string.format(
						"Holding (%d gone / %d)",
						AutoBlockSkills.Vanished,
						AutoBlockSkills.DisappearLimit
					)
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	AutoBlockSkills.onChildAdded = function(instance)
		if not instance then
			return
		end

		if instance:IsA("BasePart") or instance:IsA("Model") then
			AutoBlockSkills.trigger(instance.Name)
			AutoBlockSkills.track(instance)
		end

		if instance:IsA("Folder") or instance:IsA("Model") then
			AutoBlockSkills.hookContainer(instance)
		end
	end

	AutoBlockSkills.hookContainer = function(instance)
		if not instance or AutoBlockSkills.DeepConns[instance] then
			return
		end
		AutoBlockSkills.DeepConns[instance] = instance.ChildAdded:Connect(AutoBlockSkills.onChildAdded)

		for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			if child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("Model") then
				AutoBlockSkills.hookContainer(child)
			end
		end

		local connection = nil

		connection = instance.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(child, parent)
			if parent == nil then
				local deepConn = AutoBlockSkills.DeepConns[instance]

				if deepConn then
					pcall(function()
						deepConn:Disconnect()
					end)
				end

				AutoBlockSkills.DeepConns[instance] = nil

				if connection then
					connection:Disconnect()
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	AutoBlockSkills.arm = function()
		if AutoBlockSkills.Armed then
			return
		end
		AutoBlockSkills.Armed = true

		local function fn36(instance)
			if AutoBlockSkills.DebreeConn then
				pcall(function()
					AutoBlockSkills.DebreeConn:Disconnect()
				end)
			end

			AutoBlockSkills.DebreeConn = instance.ChildAdded:Connect(AutoBlockSkills.onChildAdded)

			for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Folder") or child:IsA("Model") then
					AutoBlockSkills.hookContainer(child)
				end
			end
		end

		task.spawn(function()
			local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")

			if debree then
				fn36(debree)
			else
				local connection = nil

				connection = workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
					if child.Name == "Debree" then
						if connection then
							connection:Disconnect()
						end

						fn36(child)
					end
				end)
			end
		end)

		if not AutoBlockSkills.LoopConn then
			AutoBlockSkills.LoopConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if not AutoBlockSkills.Holding then
					return
				end

				if AutoBlockSkills.HeldUntil <= os.clock() then
					AutoBlockSkills.release()
					AutoBlockSkills.Holding = false
					AutoBlockSkills.Status = "Released (timeout)"
					AutoBlockSkills.Vanished = 0
				end
			end)
		end
	end

	AutoBlockSkills.disarm = function()
		AutoBlockSkills.Armed = false

		if AutoBlockSkills.Holding then
			AutoBlockSkills.release()
			AutoBlockSkills.Holding = false
		end

		if AutoBlockSkills.DebreeConn then
			pcall(function()
				AutoBlockSkills.DebreeConn:Disconnect()
			end)

			AutoBlockSkills.DebreeConn = nil
		end

		for _, deepConn in pairs(AutoBlockSkills.DeepConns) do
			pcall(function()
				deepConn:Disconnect()
			end)
		end

		AutoBlockSkills.DeepConns = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

		for _, connection in pairs(AutoBlockSkills.Tracked) do
			pcall(function()
				connection:Disconnect()
			end)
		end

		AutoBlockSkills.Tracked = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		AutoBlockSkills.TrackedCount = 0
		AutoBlockSkills.Vanished = 0
		AutoBlockSkills.Status = "Idle"
	end

	local function fn36()
		local tbl15

		tbl15 = {
			Cycle = 7200,
			ActiveFor = 1800,
			Seed = 7331,
			SpawnCount = 11,
			Spawns = {
				CFrame.new(-132.676, 804, 101.24, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, -1, 0, 0),
				CFrame.new(2161.963, 823.459, -900.676, 0, 0, -1, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, 0),
				CFrame.new(1795.511, 659.399, -523.103, -0.959, 0, 0.285, 0, 1, 0, -0.285, 0, -0.959),
				CFrame.new(-464.862, 1356.974, -3497.761, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1),
				CFrame.new(-2089.845, 62.241, -408.465, -1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, -1),
				CFrame.new(-864.695, 1389, -1639.538, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1),
				CFrame.new(-118.712, 1379.275, -1861.278, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, -1, 0, 0),
				CFrame.new(-1045.371, 1282, -1312.49, -1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, -1),
				CFrame.new(-1775.234, 141.75, 1297.076, -1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, -1),
				CFrame.new(-2736.262, 143.75, 833.486, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1, 0, -1, 0, 0),
				CFrame.new(-1946.007, 311.5, -282.891, -1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, -1),
			},
			AutoTP = false,
			getSpotIndex = function(arg)
				local spawnCount = tbl15.SpawnCount

				if #tbl15.Spawns > 0 and spawnCount > #tbl15.Spawns then
					spawnCount = #tbl15.Spawns
				end

				if spawnCount <= 1 then
					return 1
				end
				local n16 = math.floor(arg / spawnCount)
				local v10 = table.create(spawnCount)

				for i = 1, spawnCount do
					v10[i] = i
				end

				local v11 = Random.new(n16 * 6151 + tbl15.Seed)

				for i = 1, spawnCount - 1 do
					local v12 = v11:NextInteger(i, spawnCount)
					local v13 = v10[i]
					v10[i] = v10[v12]
					v10[v12] = v13
				end

				return v10[arg - n16 * spawnCount + 1]
			end,
			getState = function()
				local serverTimeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				local n16 = math.floor(serverTimeNow / tbl15.Cycle)
				local n17 = serverTimeNow - n16 * tbl15.Cycle
				local flag15 = n17 < tbl15.ActiveFor
				local n18 = flag15 and tbl15.ActiveFor - n17 or tbl15.Cycle - n17
				local spotIndex = tbl15.getSpotIndex(n16)

				return {
					Active = flag15,
					NextEdgeIn = n18,
					Cycle = n16,
					TimeIntoCycle = n17,
					SpotIndex = spotIndex,
					SpotCFrame = tbl15.Spawns[spotIndex],
				}
			end,
			teleport = function()
				local state = tbl15.getState()
				if not state.Active then
					return false, "vendor not spawned"
				end
				local character2 = localPlayer.Character
				if not character2 then
					return false, "no character"
				end

				if not character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					return false, "no root"
				end
				local spotCFrame = state.SpotCFrame or tbl15.Spawns[1]
				if not spotCFrame then
					return false, "no vendor spawn known"
				end
				local n16 = spotCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, -6)
				TeleportFix.hold(20)
				fn25()
				fn26()
				TeleportFix.arm(n16.Position)
				if not TPMethod6.start(n16) then
					return false, "could not reach the vendor"
				end
				return true, string.format("teleported to spawn #%d", state.SpotIndex)
			end,
			ensureConfig = function()
				if tbl15.Configured then
					return true
				end
				tbl15.Configured = true

				pcall(function()
					tbl15.TimedVendor = require(ReplicatedStorage.CAM.Global.Subsets.Gameplay.TimedVendor)
				end)

				pcall(function()
					tbl15.TimedEvents = require(ReplicatedStorage.CAM.Global.Subsets.Gameplay.TimedEvents)
				end)

				pcall(function()
					local npcs = ReplicatedStorage.Ouwland.Content.Misc.Npcs

					for _, name in ipairs({ "Black_Marketer", "Black Marketer", "BlackMarketer" }) do
						local child = npcs and npcs:FindFirstChild(name)

						if child then
							tbl15.VendorConfig = require(child)
							tbl15.VendorName = name
							break
						end
					end
				end)

				local timedVendor = type(tbl15.VendorConfig) == "table" and tbl15.VendorConfig.TimedVendor or nil

				if type(timedVendor) == "table" then
					if tonumber(timedVendor.ActiveFor) and tonumber(timedVendor.ActiveFor) > 0 then
						tbl15.ActiveFor = tonumber(timedVendor.ActiveFor)
					end

					if tonumber(timedVendor.Seed) then
						tbl15.Seed = tonumber(timedVendor.Seed)
					end
				end

				local blackMarketArrival = type(tbl15.TimedEvents) == "table" and tbl15.TimedEvents.BlackMarketArrival
					or nil

				if
					type(blackMarketArrival) == "table"
					and tonumber(blackMarketArrival.Every)
					and tonumber(blackMarketArrival.Every) > 0
				then
					tbl15.Cycle = tonumber(blackMarketArrival.Every)
				end

				return true
			end,
			patchedConfig = function()
				local vendorConfig = tbl15.VendorConfig
				if type(vendorConfig) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end
				local timedVendor = vendorConfig.TimedVendor
				if type(timedVendor) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end
				local timedEvent = type(tbl15.TimedEvents) == "table"
						and tbl15.TimedEvents[tostring(timedVendor.TimedEvent)]
					or nil
				local tbl16 = {}

				for k, v10 in pairs(vendorConfig) do
					tbl16[k] = v10
				end

				local timedVendor2 = {}

				for k, v10 in pairs(timedVendor) do
					timedVendor2[k] = v10
				end

				local cycle = type(timedEvent) == "table" and tonumber(timedEvent.Every) or nil

				if cycle == nil or cycle <= 0 then
					cycle = tbl15.Cycle
				end

				if timedVendor2.SpawnCount == nil then
					timedVendor2.SpawnCount = #(timedVendor2.Spawns or {})
				end

				if timedVendor2.SlotCount == nil then
					timedVendor2.SlotCount = 1
				end

				if timedVendor2.Seed == nil then
					timedVendor2.Seed = tonumber(tbl15.Seed) or 7331
				end

				if timedVendor2.ActiveFor == nil then
					timedVendor2.ActiveFor = tonumber(tbl15.ActiveFor) or 1800
				end

				if timedVendor2.Cycle == nil then
					timedVendor2.Cycle = cycle
				end

				if timedVendor2.Every == nil then
					timedVendor2.Every = cycle
				end

				if timedVendor2.Name == nil then
					timedVendor2.Name = tostring(timedVendor.TimedEvent or "BlackMarketArrival")
				end

				if timedVendor2.Spawns == nil and type(tbl15.Spawns) == "table" then
					timedVendor2.Spawns = tbl15.Spawns
				end

				tbl16.TimedVendor = timedVendor2
				return tbl16
			end,
			stockCatalogue = function()
				local timedVendor = type(tbl15.VendorConfig) == "table" and tbl15.VendorConfig.TimedVendor or nil
				local stock = type(timedVendor) == "table" and timedVendor.Stock or nil
				if type(stock) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end
				local tbl16 = {}

				for k, v10 in pairs(stock) do
					if type(k) == "string" and k ~= "" then
						local rarity = nil
						local price = nil

						if type(v10) == "table" then
							rarity = v10.Rarity or v10.rarity
							price = v10.Price or v10.price
						end

						tbl16[#tbl16 + 1] = { Name = k, Price = price, Rarity = rarity, Catalogue = true }
					end
				end

				if #tbl16 == 0 then
					return nil
				end

				table.sort(tbl16, function(arg, arg2)
					local str11 = tostring(arg.Rarity or "~")
					local str12 = tostring(arg2.Rarity or "~")
					if str11 == str12 then
						return arg.Name < arg2.Name
					end
					return str11 < str12
				end)

				return tbl16
			end,
			itemRarity = function(arg)
				if tbl15._items == nil then
					local Items = nil

					pcall(function()
						Items = require(ReplicatedStorage.CAM.Global.Collectibles.Items)
					end)

					tbl15._items = type(Items) == "table" and Items or false
				end

				if tbl15._items == false then
					return nil
				end
				local item = tbl15._items[arg]
				if type(item) ~= "table" then
					return nil
				end
				local rarity = item.Rarity
				if type(rarity) == "string" and rarity ~= "" then
					return rarity
				end

				if tbl15._rarityNames == nil then
					local order = nil

					pcall(function()
						local Rarities = require(ReplicatedStorage.CAM.Global.Rarities)
						order = type(Rarities) == "table" and Rarities.Order or nil
					end)

					tbl15._rarityNames = type(order) == "table" and order or false
				end

				if tbl15._rarityNames ~= false and tbl15._rarityNames[rarity] then
					return tbl15._rarityNames[rarity]
				end
				return nil
			end,
			rollStock = function(arg)
				local timedVendor = tbl15.TimedVendor
				local vendorConfig = tbl15.VendorConfig
				local timedVendor2 = type(vendorConfig) == "table" and vendorConfig.TimedVendor or nil
				if
					type(timedVendor) ~= "table"
					or type(timedVendor.GetStock) ~= "function"
					or type(timedVendor2) ~= "table"
				then
					return nil
				end
				local ok, result = pcall(timedVendor.GetStock, timedVendor2, arg)
				if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
					return nil, ok and "empty" or tostring(result)
				end
				local tbl16 = {}

				for _, v10 in ipairs(result) do
					local str11 = tostring(type(v10) == "table" and v10.Name or v10 or "")

					if str11 ~= "" then
						tbl16[#tbl16 + 1] = {
							Name = str11,
							Rarity = tbl15.itemRarity(str11),
							Price = type(v10) == "table" and v10.Price or nil,
						}
					end
				end

				if #tbl16 == 0 then
					return nil, "empty"
				end
				return tbl16
			end,
			getStock = function(arg)
				tbl15.ensureConfig()
				local state = tbl15.getState()
				if
					not arg
					and tbl15.StockCache
					and tbl15.StockCacheCycle == state.Cycle
					and not tbl15.StockIsCatalogue
				then
					return tbl15.StockCache
				end
				tbl15.StockError = nil
				local stockCache, stockError = tbl15.rollStock(state.Cycle)

				if stockCache and #stockCache > 0 then
					tbl15.StockCache = stockCache
					tbl15.StockCacheCycle = state.Cycle
					tbl15.StockIsCatalogue = false
					return stockCache
				end

				if not tbl15.TimedVendor then
					tbl15.StockError = "the TimedVendor module did not load"
				elseif type(tbl15.VendorConfig) ~= "table" or type(tbl15.VendorConfig.TimedVendor) ~= "table" then
					tbl15.StockError = "the Black Marketer config did not load"
				else
					tbl15.StockError = stockError or "the vendor rolled an empty stock"
				end

				return nil
			end,
			split = function(arg)
				local n16 = math.max(0, math.floor(arg + 0.5))
				return math.floor(n16 / 3600), math.floor(n16 % 3600 / 60), n16 % 60
			end,
			TimerHex = "#FF3C3C",
			PulseHex = "#7A0F0F",
		}

		return tbl15
	end

	BlackMarketer = fn36()
end

GluClickGui = function(button)
	if not button or not button.Parent then
		return false
	end
	local ok = false

	if firesignal then
		pcall(function()
			firesignal(button.MouseButton1Down)
		end)

		pcall(function()
			firesignal(button.MouseButton1Up)
		end)

		ok = pcall(function()
			firesignal(button.MouseButton1Click)
		end) or false
	end

	pcall(function()
		button:Activate()
	end)

	if not ok and VirtualInputManager_ then
		local ok2, result = pcall(function()
			return button.AbsolutePosition + button.AbsoluteSize / 2
		end)

		if ok2 and result then
			pcall(function()
				VirtualInputManager_:SendMouseMoveEvent(result.X, result.Y, false)
				VirtualInputManager_:SendMouseButtonEvent(result.X, result.Y, 0, true, game, 1)
				VirtualInputManager_:SendMouseButtonEvent(result.X, result.Y, 0, false, game, 1)
			end)

			ok = true
		end
	end

	return ok
end

GluFindButtons = function(instances, arg)
	local descendants = {}

	local function fn25(instance)
		local str11 = ""

		if instance:IsA("TextButton") then
			str11 = tostring(instance.Text or "")
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return instance:GetDescendants()
		end)

		if not ok then
			return str11
		end

		for _, instance2 in ipairs(result) do
			if instance2:IsA("TextLabel") then
				local str12 = tostring(instance2.Text or "")

				if str12 ~= "" then
					str11 ..= " " .. str12
				end
			end
		end

		return str11
	end

	for _, instance in ipairs(instances) do
		if not instance then
			continue
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("GuiButton") and descendant.Visible and descendant.Active ~= false then
				local name = string.lower(descendant.Name)
				local lower = string.lower
				local v10 = fn25(descendant)

				if arg(name, lower(v10), descendant) then
					descendants[#descendants + 1] = descendant
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return descendants
end

	return playerGui:FindFirstChild("ComponentsHolder")
end

GluDialogueCache = { at = 0, roots = {} }

GluDialogueRoots = function()
	local now3 = os.clock()
	if now3 - GluDialogueCache.at < 0.35 then
		return GluDialogueCache.roots
	end
	local children = {}
	local instance = GluComps()
	if not instance then
		GluDialogueCache = { at = now3, roots = children }
		return children
	end

	for _, name in ipairs({ "DialogueFrame", "DialogueHolder", "DialogueContent" }) do
		local child = instance:FindFirstChild(name)

		if child then
			children[#children + 1] = child
		end
	end

	for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("GuiObject") then
			if string.find(string.lower(descendant.Name), "dialogue", 1, true) then
				children[#children + 1] = descendant
			end
		end
	end

	GluDialogueCache = { at = now3, roots = children }
	return children
end

GluDialogueOpen = function()
	for _, gluDialogueRoot in ipairs(GluDialogueRoots()) do
		if gluDialogueRoot.Visible then
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return gluDialogueRoot:GetDescendants()
			end)

			if ok and #result > 0 then
				return true
			end
		end
	end

	return false
end

GluCardId = function(instance)
	if not instance then
		return nil
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return instance:GetAttributes()
	end)

	if ok and type(result) == "table" then
		for k, v10 in pairs(result) do
			if string.lower(tostring(k)) == "id" or string.lower(tostring(k)) == "huntid" then
				local match = tostring(v10):match("%d+")
				if match then
					return match
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
		if string.lower(child.Name) == "id" and child:IsA("ValueBase") then
			local match = tostring(child.Value):match("%d+")
			if match then
				return match
			end
		end
	end

	return instance.Name:match("^Hunt(%d+)$")
end

GluCardButton = function(instance)
	if not instance then
		return nil
	end

	if instance:IsA("GuiButton") then
		return instance
	end

	for _, name in ipairs({ "Plate", "Claim", "Click", "Button" }) do
		local child = instance:FindFirstChild(name)
		if child and child:IsA("GuiButton") then
			return child
		end
	end

	for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
		if descendant:IsA("GuiButton") then
			return descendant
		end
	end

	return nil
end

GluHuntQuestSet = function(arg)

GluBossForQuest = function(arg, activeTargetName)
	local v10 = string.lower(tostring(activeTargetName or ""))
	local v11 = fn11(activeTargetName)
	if v10 == "" and v11 == "" then
		return nil
	end

	for _, gluHuntOffer in ipairs(GluHuntOffers(arg)) do
		local v12 = string.lower(tostring(gluHuntOffer:GetAttribute("Quest") or ""))
		local str11 = tostring(gluHuntOffer:GetAttribute("Boss") or "")
		local v13 = fn11(str11)
		if v12 ~= "" and v12 == v10 then
			return str11
		end

		if v13 ~= "" and v11 ~= "" then
			if v13 == v11 then
				return str11
			end

			if #v13 >= 4 and #v11 >= 4 and (string.find(v13, v11, 1, true) or string.find(v11, v13, 1, true)) then
				return str11
			end
		end
	end

	return nil
end

GluKnownBossNames = {}
GluKnownBossAt = 0

GluRefreshKnownBosses = function()
	local tbl14 = {}

	for k in pairs(GluBossCenters) do
		local v10 = fn11(k)

		if v10 ~= "" then
			tbl14[v10] = true
		end
	end

	for _, v10 in ipairs(GluBossCatalog) do
		local v11 = fn11(v10)

		if v11 ~= "" then
			tbl14[v11] = true
		end
	end

	for _, allBossFolder in ipairs(getAllBossFolders()) do
		for _, child in ipairs(allBossFolder:GetChildren()) do
			local v10 = fn11(child.Name)

			if v10 ~= "" then
				tbl14[v10] = true
			end

			local bossInfo = child:FindFirstChild("BossInfo")
			if not bossInfo then
				continue
			end
			local v11 = fn11(tostring(bossInfo:GetAttribute("NpcCode") or ""))

			if v11 ~= "" then
				tbl14[v11] = true
			end

			local v12 = fn11(tostring(bossInfo:GetAttribute("Title") or ""))

			if v12 ~= "" then
				tbl14[v12] = true
			end
		end
	end

	GluKnownBossNames = tbl14
	GluKnownBossAt = os.clock()
	return tbl14
end

GluBossCenterCache = {}
GluBossCenterAt = 0

GluBossCenter = function(arg)
	local v10 = fn11(arg)
	if v10 == "" then
		return nil
	end

	if os.clock() - GluBossCenterAt > 60 or next(GluBossCenterCache) == nil then
		local tbl14 = {}

		for k, gluBossCenter in pairs(GluBossCenters) do
			local v11 = fn11(k)

			if v11 ~= "" then
				tbl14[v11] = gluBossCenter
			end
		end

		GluBossCenterCache = tbl14
		GluBossCenterAt = os.clock()
	end

	local v11 = GluBossCenterCache[v10]
	if v11 then
		return v11
	end

	for k, v12 in pairs(GluBossCenterCache) do
		if #k >= 4 and #v10 >= 4 and (string.find(k, v10, 1, true) or string.find(v10, k, 1, true)) then
			return v12
		end
	end

	return nil
end

GluKnownBoss = function(arg)
	local v10 = fn11(arg)
	if v10 == "" then
		return false
	end

	if os.clock() - GluKnownBossAt > 20 or next(GluKnownBossNames) == nil then
		GluRefreshKnownBosses()
	end

	local names3 = GluKnownBossNames
	if names3[v10] then
		return true
	end

	for k in pairs(names3) do
		if #k >= 4 and #v10 >= 4 and (string.find(k, v10, 1, true) or string.find(v10, k, 1, true)) then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

GluHuntTarget = function(arg, huntCache)
	local holder = getHolder()
	if not holder then
		return nil
	end
	local now3 = os.clock()

	if not huntCache.set or now3 - (huntCache.at or 0) > 5 then
		huntCache.set = GluHuntQuestSet(arg)
		huntCache.at = now3
	end

	local set = huntCache.set
	local flag15 = nil
	local v10 = nil
	local v11 = nil

	for _, child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
		local v12 = string.lower(tostring(child.Name))
		local questString = child:FindFirstChild("QuestString")
		local isValueBase = questString and questString:IsA("ValueBase")
		local str11 = ""

		if isValueBase then
			str11 = string.lower(tostring(questString.Value))
		end

		local flag16 = set[v12] or str11 ~= "" and set[str11] or string.find(v12, "eliminate", 1, true) ~= nil

		if flag16 then
			flag15 = true
		end

		local tasks = child:FindFirstChild("Tasks")
		if not tasks then
			continue
		end

		for _, child2 in ipairs(tasks:GetChildren()) do
			local value = child2:FindFirstChild("Value")
			local max = child2:FindFirstChild("Max")
			if not (value and max and value.Value < max.Value) then
				continue
			end
			local code = child2:FindFirstChild("Code")
			local name

			if code and code:IsA("ValueBase") and tostring(code.Value) ~= "" then
				name = tostring(code.Value)
			else
				name = child2.Name
			end

			local str12 = name:gsub("%-AddedByAreaLocator$", "")

			if flag16 or set["#" .. fn11(str12)] then
				v10 = v10 or str12
			elseif not v11 and GluKnownBoss(str12) then
				v11 = str12
			end
		end
	end

	if v10 then
		return v10
	end

	if flag15 then
		return nil
	end
	return v11
end

GluHuntCardClick = function(arg, cardState, rarityAllowed)
	local now3 = os.clock()
	if now3 - (cardState.at or 0) < 1.2 then
		return false
	end

	if now3 - (cardState.scan or 0) < 0.5 then
		return false
	end
	cardState.scan = now3

	if not cardState.ids or now3 - (cardState.idsAt or 0) > 5 then
		local ids = {}

		for _, gluHuntOffer in ipairs(GluHuntOffers(arg)) do
			ids[gluHuntOffer.Name] = true
		end

		cardState.ids = ids
		cardState.idsAt = now3
	end

	local gluHuntCard3 = nil
	local gluHuntCard = nil

	for _, gluHuntCard2 in ipairs(GluHuntCards()) do
		if gluHuntCard2:FindFirstChild("LevelCover") then
			continue
		end
		local v10 = HuntRarity.get(gluHuntCard2)

		if rarityAllowed(v10) then
			local v11 = GluCardId(gluHuntCard2)

			if v11 and cardState.ids[tostring(v11)] then
				gluHuntCard3 = gluHuntCard2
			else
				gluHuntCard = gluHuntCard or gluHuntCard2
			end
		end
	end

	gluHuntCard3 = gluHuntCard3 or gluHuntCard
	if not gluHuntCard3 then
		return false
	end
	local v10 = GluCardButton(gluHuntCard3)
	if not v10 then
		return false
	end
	cardState.at = now3
	return GluClickGui(v10)
end

do
	local function fn25()
		local tbl14 = { Supreme = { 161, 0, 0 }, Mythic = { 217, 77, 217 }, Legendary = { 255, 202, 44 } }
		local n16 = 30

		local function fn26(guiObject)
			if not guiObject then
				return nil
			end

			if guiObject:IsA("ImageLabel") or guiObject:IsA("ImageButton") then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return guiObject.ImageColor3
				end)

				if ok and typeof(result) == "Color3" then
					return result
				end
			end

			if guiObject:IsA("TextLabel") or guiObject:IsA("TextButton") then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return guiObject.TextColor3
				end)

				if ok and typeof(result) == "Color3" then
					return result
				end
			end

			if guiObject:IsA("UIStroke") then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return guiObject.Color
				end)

				if ok and typeof(result) == "Color3" then
					return result
				end
			end

			if guiObject:IsA("GuiObject") then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return guiObject.BackgroundColor3
				end)

				if ok and typeof(result) == "Color3" then
					return result
				end
			end

			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return guiObject:GetAttribute("Color")
			end)

			if ok and typeof(result) == "Color3" then
				return result
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function fn27(arg)
			if not arg then
				return nil
			end
			return math.floor(arg.R * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(arg.G * 255 + 0.5), math.floor(arg.B * 255 + 0.5)
		end

		return {
			get = function(instance)
				if not instance then
					return "Unknown"
				end
				local glow = instance:FindFirstChild("Glow")
				if not glow then
					return "Unknown"
				end
				local v10 = fn26(glow)
				local v11

				if not v10 then
					for _, descendant in ipairs(glow:GetDescendants()) do
						v10 = fn26(descendant)
						if v10 then
							break
						end
					end

					v11 = v10
				else
					v11 = v10
				end

				if not v11 then
					return "Unknown"
				end
				local v12, v13, v14 = fn27(v11)

				for k, v15 in pairs(tbl14) do
					if
						math.abs(v12 - v15[1]) <= n16
						and math.abs(v13 - v15[2]) <= n16
						and math.abs(v14 - v15[3]) <= n16

	tbl14.tick = function()
		if not tbl14.Enabled then
			tbl14.Status = "Idle"
			tbl14.CurrentTarget = nil
			tbl14.StartAnnounced = false
			return
		end

		local now3 = os.clock()

		if now3 - tbl14.LastHeartCheck > 0.5 then
			tbl14.LastHeartCheck = now3
			tbl14.HasHeart = fn26()
		end

		if not tbl14.HasHeart then
			tbl14.StartAnnounced = false

			if now3 - tbl14.LastNotify >= 1 then
				tbl14.LastNotify = now3

				pcall(function()
					v:Warn("Yeti", "Frozen Heart required in inventory", 1.2)
				end)
			end

			tbl14.Status = "No Frozen Heart in inventory"
			tbl14.CurrentTarget = nil
			return
		end

		if not tbl14.StartAnnounced then
			tbl14.StartAnnounced = true
			tbl14.Status = "Starting Yeti farm..."

			pcall(function()
				v:Success("Yeti", "Frozen Heart found - starting farm", 3)
			end)
		end

		character = localPlayer.Character
		if not character then
			tbl14.Status = "Waiting for character"
			return
		end
		local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			tbl14.Status = "Waiting for root"
			return
		end
		local currentTarget = tbl14.CurrentTarget

		if currentTarget and (not currentTarget.Parent or not fn14(currentTarget)) then
			tbl14.CurrentTarget = nil
			tbl14.LastSummonAt = 0
			currentTarget = nil
		end

		local v11 = fn29()

		if #v11 > 0 then
			local currentTarget2 = nil

			if currentTarget then
				currentTarget2 = nil

				for _, v12 in ipairs(v11) do
					if v12 == currentTarget then
						currentTarget2 = currentTarget
						break
					end
					currentTarget2 = nil
				end
			end

			if not currentTarget2 then
				local v12, v13, v14 = fn13()
				local v15, v16, v17 = ipairs(v11)
				local magnitude2 = nil
				currentTarget2 = nil

				for _, v18 in v15, v16, v17 do
					local v19 = fn15(v18)

					if v19 and v14 then
						local magnitude = (v19.Position - v14.Position).Magnitude

						if not magnitude2 or magnitude < magnitude2 then
							magnitude2 = magnitude
							currentTarget2 = v18
						end
					else
						currentTarget2 = currentTarget2 or v18
					end
				end
			end

			if currentTarget2 then
				tbl14.CurrentTarget = currentTarget2
				local humanoid = currentTarget2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				tbl14.Status = string.format(
					"Small Yeti priority | %d left | HP %d/%d",
					#v11,
					humanoid and math.floor(humanoid.Health) or 0,
					humanoid and math.floor(humanoid.MaxHealth) or 0
				)
				return
			end
		end

		if currentTarget then
			local humanoid = currentTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			tbl14.Status = string.format(
				"Farming Yeti Demon | HP %d/%d",
				humanoid and math.floor(humanoid.Health) or 0,
				humanoid and math.floor(humanoid.MaxHealth) or 0
			)
			return
		end

		local currentTarget2 = fn28()

		if currentTarget2 then
			tbl14.CurrentTarget = currentTarget2
			tbl14.Status = "Yeti Demon engaged"
			return
		end

		local spawnPos = tbl14.SpawnPos

		if (humanoidRootPart.Position - spawnPos).Magnitude > 25 then
			fn20(spawnPos, "yeti")
			fn22(spawnPos, 3)
			tbl14.Status = "TP to Frozen Yeti spawn"
			return
		end

		if now3 - tbl14.LastSummonAt < tbl14.SummonCd then
			return
		end
		local v12 = fn27()
		if not v12 then
			tbl14.Status = "Waiting for Frozen Yeti prompt..."
			return
		end

		if not v12.Enabled then
			tbl14.Status = "Frozen Yeti prompt not enabled - waiting"
			return
		end
		tbl14.LastSummonAt = now3

		if fn30(v12) then
			tbl14.Status = "Summon prompt fired - waiting for Yeti Demon"
		else
			tbl14.Status = "Summon prompt failed"
		end
	end

	return tbl14

	local function readHuntId(instance)
		if not instance then
			return nil
		end
		local attribute = instance:GetAttribute("Id") or instance:GetAttribute("ID") or instance:GetAttribute("HuntId")

		if attribute ~= nil then
			local num = tonumber(tostring(attribute):match("%d+"))
			if num then
				return tostring(num)
			end
		end

		for k, attribute2 in pairs(instance:GetAttributes()) do
			local v11 = string.lower(k)

			if v11 == "id" or v11 == "huntid" then
				local num = tonumber(tostring(attribute2):match("%d+"))
				if num then
					return tostring(num)
				end
			end
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			if string.lower(child.Name) == "id" and child:IsA("ValueBase") then
				local num = tonumber(tostring(child.Value):match("%d+"))
				if num then
					return tostring(num)
				end
			end
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("ValueBase") and string.lower(descendant.Name) == "id" then
				local num = tonumber(tostring(descendant.Value):match("%d+"))
				if num then
					return tostring(num)
				end
			end
		end

		local num = tonumber(instance.Name:match("^Hunt(%d+)$"))
		if num then
			return tostring(num)
		end
		return nil
	end

	tbl15.readHuntId = readHuntId

	tbl15.getHuntRarity = function(arg)
		return HuntRarity.get(arg)
	end

	tbl15.rarityAllowed = function(arg)
		return HuntRarity.allowed(tbl15.RarityFilter, arg)
	end

	tbl15.claimById = function(arg)
		local tbl16 = { action = "Claim", id = tostring(arg) }

		if QuestAx and type(QuestAx.fire) == "function" then
			if QuestAx.fire("BossHuntsRequest", tbl16) then
				return true
			end
		end

		local remote = fn6()
		if not remote then
			tbl15.Status = "SignalEvent missing"
			return false
		end

		if not pcall(function()
			remote:FireServer("BossHuntsRequest", tbl16)
		end) then
			tbl15.Status = "Claim remote failed"
			return false
		end

		return true
	end

	tbl15.claimAny = function()
		local descendants = getDescendants()
		if #descendants == 0 then
			return false
		end
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if now3 - tbl15.LastClaim < tbl15.ClaimCooldown then
			return false
		end
		local tbl16 = { Supreme = {}, Mythic = {}, Legendary = {}, Other = {} }

		for _, descendant in ipairs(descendants) do
			if descendant:FindFirstChild("LevelCover") then
				continue
			end
			local huntRarity = tbl15.getHuntRarity(descendant)

			if tbl15.rarityAllowed(huntRarity) then
				local huntId = readHuntId(descendant)

				if huntId then
					table.insert(
						tbl16[huntRarity] or tbl16.Other,
						{ hunt = descendant, id = huntId, rarity = huntRarity }
					)
				end
			end
		end

		local v11 = nil

		for _, v12 in ipairs({ "Supreme", "Mythic", "Legendary", "Other" }) do
			if #tbl16[v12] > 0 then
				v11 = tbl16[v12][1]
				break
			end
			v11 = nil
		end

		if not v11 then
			return false
		end
		tbl15.LastClaim = now3

		if tbl15.claimById(v11.id) then
			tbl15.Claimed += 1
			tbl15.LastRarity = v11.rarity
			tbl15.Status = string.format("Claimed id=%s [%s]", v11.id, v11.rarity)
			task.wait(0.3)
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	tbl15.allLocked = function()
		local descendants = getDescendants()
		if #descendants == 0 then
			return false
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(descendants) do
			if not descendant:FindFirstChild("LevelCover") then
				return false
			end
		end

		return true
	end

	tbl15.getActiveTargetName = function()
		if not tbl15._huntCache then
			tbl15._huntCache = {}
		end

		return GluHuntTarget("Muzan", tbl15._huntCache)
	end

	tbl15.findTarget = function(arg)
		if not arg or arg == "" then
			return nil, nil
		end
		local v11 = fn19(arg)
		if v11 then
			return fn21(arg, v11), v11
		end
		local activeNpcs = getActiveNpcs()

		if activeNpcs then
			local v12 = fn11(arg)

			for _, child in ipairs(activeNpcs:GetChildren()) do
				local v13 = fn11(child.Name)

				if
					v13 == v12
					or #v13 >= 4
						and #v12 >= 4
						and (string.find(v13, v12, 1, true) or string.find(v12, v13, 1, true))
				then
					local v14 = fn19(child.Name)
					if v14 then
						return fn21(child.Name, v14), v14
					end
				end
			end
		end

		local instances = getInstances({ arg })
		if #instances > 0 then
			return instances[1], nil
		end
		return nil, nil
	end

	return tbl15
end

local v11 = fn26()
local HttpService2 = game:GetService("HttpService")

local function fn27()
	local function getFunction()
		local communication = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Communication")
		local serverAndClient = communication and communication:FindFirstChild("ServerAndClient")
		local signals = serverAndClient and serverAndClient:FindFirstChild("Signals")
		local signalFunction = signals and signals:FindFirstChild("SignalFunction")
		return signalFunction and signalFunction:FindFirstChild("Function")
	end

	local function fn28(arg)
		if syn and syn.request then
			local ok, result = pcall(syn.request, { Url = arg, Method = "GET" })
			if ok and result and result.Body then
				return result.Body
			end
		end

		if request then
			local ok, result = pcall(request, { Url = arg, Method = "GET" })
			if ok and result and result.Body then
				return result.Body
			end
		end

		if http_request then
			local ok, result = pcall(http_request, { Url = arg, Method = "GET" })
			if ok and result and result.Body then
				return result.Body
			end
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return game:HttpGet(arg)
		end)

		if ok then
			return result
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function fn29(arg)
		local str11 = string.format(
			"https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=%s&limit=100",
			game.PlaceId,
			arg or "Asc"
		)
		local v12 = fn28(str11)
		if not v12 then
			return nil, "HTTP failed"
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(HttpService2.JSONDecode, HttpService2, v12)
		if not ok or not result or not result.data then
			return nil, "Bad JSON"
		end
		return result.data
	end

	local tbl14 = {
		Status = "Idle",
		LastHop = 0,
		Cooldown = 10,
		Hops = 0,
		Region = "any",
		Regions = {},
		Cache = {},
		LastList = {},
		PickModes = { "Best Ping", "Random", "Lowest Pop", "Highest Pop" },
	}

	local function fn30(arg)
		for _, v12 in ipairs({ "request", "http_request", "http" }) do
			local v13 = _G[v12]
			if type(v13) ~= "function" then
				continue
			end
			local ok, result = pcall(v13, arg)

			if ok and type(result) == "table" then
				local body = result.Body or result.body
				if body then
					return body
				end
			end
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			if type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.request) == "function" then
				return syn.request(arg)
			end
		end)

		if ok and type(result) == "table" then
			local body = result.Body or result.body
			if body then
				return body
			end
		end

		if arg.Method == "GET" then
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
				return game:HttpGet(arg.Url)
			end)

			if ok2 then
				return result2
			end
		elseif game.HttpPost then
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
				return game:HttpPost(arg.Url, arg.Body, "application/json")
			end)

			if ok2 then
				return result2
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function getMachineAddress(arg)
		local v12 = fn30({
			Url = "https://gamejoin.roblox.com/v1/join-game-instance",
			Method = "POST",
			Body = HttpService2:JSONEncode({ placeId = game.PlaceId, gameInstanceId = arg }),
		})

		if not v12 then
			tbl14.RegionErr = "join API refused (no HTTP response)"
			return nil
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(HttpService2.JSONDecode, HttpService2, v12)
		if not ok or type(result) ~= "table" then
			tbl14.RegionErr = "join API returned something unreadable"
			return nil
		end
		local joinScript = result.joinScript or result
		if type(joinScript) ~= "table" then
			tbl14.RegionErr = "join API returned no join script"
			return nil
		end
		local machineAddress = joinScript.MachineAddress
			or joinScript.machineAddress
			or joinScript.DataCenterId
			or joinScript.dataCenterId
			or joinScript.DatacenterId

		if machineAddress == nil then
			tbl14.RegionErr = "join script carried no address"
		end

		return machineAddress
	end

	local function fn31(arg)
		return {
			"https://ipwho.is/" .. arg,
			"https://ipapi.co/" .. arg .. "/json/",
			"http://ip-api.com/json/" .. arg .. "?fields=countryCode,city,status",
		}
	end

	local function fn32(arg)
		if type(arg) ~= "table" then
			return nil
		end
		local countryCode = arg.countryCode or arg.country_code
		local city = arg.city or arg.region
		if type(countryCode) ~= "string" or countryCode == "" then
			return nil
		end

		if type(city) == "string" and city ~= "" then
			return tostring(countryCode) .. " " .. tostring(city)
		end
		return tostring(countryCode)
	end

	local function fn33(machineAddress)
		for _, v12 in ipairs(fn31(tostring(machineAddress))) do
			local v13 = fn30({ Url = v12, Method = "GET" })
			if not v13 then
				continue
			end
			local ok, result = pcall(HttpService2.JSONDecode, HttpService2, v13)

			if ok then
				local v14 = fn32(result)
				if v14 then
					return v14
				end
			end
		end

		tbl14.RegionErr = "address found but no geolocation provider answered"
		return nil
	end

	tbl14.regionOf = function(arg)
		if not arg then
			return nil
		end
		local v12 = tbl14.Cache[arg]
		if v12 then
			return v12
		end
		local machineAddress = getMachineAddress(arg)
		local str11

		if type(machineAddress) == "string" then
			if machineAddress:find("%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+") then
				str11 = fn33(machineAddress)
			else
				tbl14.RegionErr = tbl14.RegionErr or "join script had a hostname, not an address"
				str11 = nil
			end
		else
			str11 = nil

			if type(machineAddress) == "number" then
				str11 = "DC" .. tostring(machineAddress)
			end
		end

		tbl14.Cache[arg] = str11 or "unknown"
		return tbl14.Cache[arg]
	end

	tbl14.STATIC_REGIONS = {
		"US East",
		"US West",
		"US Central",
		"EU West",
		"EU Central",
		"Singapore",
		"Japan",
		"Australia",
		"Brazil",
		"India",
	}

	tbl14.resolveRegions = function(arg)
		local resolveTried = 0

		for _, v12 in ipairs(tbl14.LastList) do
			if (arg or 8) <= resolveTried then
				break
			end

			if not tbl14.Cache[v12.id] then
				tbl14.regionOf(v12.id)
				resolveTried += 1
			end
		end

		local tbl15 = {}
		local resolved = 0

		for _, v12 in ipairs(tbl14.LastList) do
			local v13 = tbl14.Cache[v12.id]

			if v13 then
				tbl15[v13] = (tbl15[v13] or 0) + 1

				if v13 ~= "unknown" then
					resolved += 1
				end
			end
		end

		local staticRegions = { "any" }
		local tbl16 = { any = true }

		for k in pairs(tbl15) do
			if k ~= "unknown" and not tbl16[k] then
				tbl16[k] = true
				table.insert(staticRegions, k)
			end
		end

		for _, staticRegion in ipairs(tbl14.STATIC_REGIONS) do
			if not tbl16[staticRegion] then
				tbl16[staticRegion] = true
				table.insert(staticRegions, staticRegion)
			end
		end

		if tbl15.unknown then
			table.insert(staticRegions, "unknown")
		end

		table.sort(staticRegions, function(arg2, arg3)
			if arg2 == "any" then
				return true
			end

			if arg3 == "any" then
				return false
			end
			return arg2 < arg3
		end)

		tbl14.Resolved = resolved
		tbl14.ResolveTried = resolveTried

		if resolved > 0 then
			tbl14.ResolveNote = string.format("%d of %d server(s) resolved to a region", resolved, resolveTried)
		else
			tbl14.ResolveNote = "no region could be read of "
				.. resolveTried
				.. " tried - "
				.. tostring(tbl14.RegionErr or "the join API was refused")
				.. " (regions cannot be read on this executor)"
		end

		return staticRegions, tbl14.ResolveNote
	end

	tbl14.refresh = function()
		local Asc, v12 = fn29("Asc")
		if not Asc then
			tbl14.Status = "Fetch error: " .. tostring(v12)
			return false, tbl14.Status
		end
		tbl14.LastList = Asc
		tbl14.Status = string.format("%d servers listed", #Asc)
		return true, tbl14.Status
	end

	tbl14.Auto = false
	tbl14.AutoEvery = 360
	tbl14.AutoAt = 0

	tbl14.autoTick = function()
		if not tbl14.Auto then
			return
		end

		if os.clock() < tbl14.AutoAt then
			return
		end
		tbl14.AutoAt = os.clock() + math.max(360, tonumber(tbl14.AutoEvery) or 360)
		local v12, v13 = tbl14.hop("Best Ping", tbl14.Region)
		tbl14.AutoStatus = tostring(v13)
		tbl14.Status = v12 and "auto: " .. tostring(v13) or tostring(v13)
	end

	tbl14.hop = function(arg, arg2)
		if os.clock() - tbl14.LastHop < tbl14.Cooldown then
			local v12 = math.ceil(tbl14.Cooldown - (os.clock() - tbl14.LastHop))
			tbl14.Status = string.format("Cooldown %ds", v12)
			return false, tbl14.Status
		end

		local str11 = arg == "Lowest Pop" and "Asc" or arg == "Highest Pop" and "Desc" or "Asc"
		tbl14.Status = "Fetching server list..."
		local lastList, v12 = fn29(str11)
		if not lastList then
			tbl14.Status = "Fetch error: " .. tostring(v12)
			return false, tbl14.Status
		end
		tbl14.LastList = lastList
		local tbl15 = {}

		for _, v13 in ipairs(lastList) do
			local n16 = tonumber(v13.playing) or 0
			local n17 = tonumber(v13.maxPlayers) or 0
			local id = v13.id

			if id and id ~= game.JobId and n17 > 0 and n16 < n17 then
				table.insert(tbl15, v13)
			end
		end

		local str12 = arg2 and arg2 ~= "" and arg2 ~= "any" and tostring(arg2) or nil

		if str12 then
			local tbl16 = {}
			local count4 = 0

			for _, v13 in ipairs(tbl15) do
				if count4 >= 8 then
					break
				end

				if not tbl14.Cache[v13.id] then
					count4 += 1
				end

				local ok, result = pcall(tbl14.regionOf, v13.id)

				if ok and result == str12 then
					table.insert(tbl16, v13)
				end
			end

			if #tbl16 > 0 then
				tbl15 = tbl16
			else
				tbl14.Status = "No server found in " .. str12 .. " - using any region"
			end
		end

		if #tbl15 == 0 then
			tbl14.Status = "No suitable servers"
			return false, tbl14.Status
		end

		local function fn34(arg3)
			return tonumber(arg3.ping) or 999
		end

		local v13

		if arg == "Lowest Pop" then
			table.sort(tbl15, function(arg3, arg4)
				return (tonumber(arg3.playing) or 0) < (tonumber(arg4.playing) or 0)
			end)

			v13 = tbl15[1]
		elseif arg == "Highest Pop" then
			table.sort(tbl15, function(arg3, arg4)
				return (tonumber(arg3.playing) or 0) > (tonumber(arg4.playing) or 0)
			end)

			v13 = tbl15[1]
		elseif arg == "Best Ping" then
			table.sort(tbl15, function(arg3, arg4)
				return fn34(arg3) < fn34(arg4)
			end)

			v13 = tbl15[1]
		else
			v13 = tbl15[math.random(1, #tbl15)]
		end

		local remote = getFunction()

		if not remote then
			tbl14.Status = "TeleportServer remote missing - using TeleportService"
			local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

			if
				pcall(function()
					TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, v13.id, localPlayer)
				end)
			then
				tbl14.LastHop = os.clock()
				tbl14.Hops += 1
				return true, "Hopping via TeleportService → " .. tostring(v13.id):sub(1, 8)
			end

			tbl14.Status = "No teleport path available"
			return false, tbl14.Status
		end

		tbl14.Status = string.format(
			"Hopping → %s (%d/%d)",
			tostring(v13.id):sub(1, 8),
			tonumber(v13.playing) or 0,
			tonumber(v13.maxPlayers) or 0
		)

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return remote:InvokeServer(
				"TeleportServer",
				{ jobId = v13.id, allowFallback = false, placeId = game.PlaceId }
			)
		end)

		if not ok then
			tbl14.Status = "Remote error: " .. tostring(result) .. " - trying TeleportService"
			local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
			if
				not pcall(function()
					TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, v13.id, localPlayer)
				end)
			then
				return false, tbl14.Status
			end
		end

		tbl14.LastHop = os.clock()
		tbl14.Hops += 1
		return true, tbl14.Status
	end

	return tbl14
end

local v12 = fn27()

local function fn28()
	local tbl14 = { Status = "idle", Last = 0, Saved = nil, SavedAt = 0 }

	local function getPosition(model)
		if not model or not model.Parent then
			return nil
		end

		if model:IsA("BasePart") then
			return model.Position
		end
		local humanoidRootPart = model:IsA("Model") and (model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart)
		if humanoidRootPart then
			return humanoidRootPart.Position
		end
		local basePart = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		if basePart then
			return basePart.Position
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return model:GetPivot()
		end)

		if ok and result and result.Position.Magnitude > 5 then
			return result.Position
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function fn29(position)
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not position or not humanoidRootPart then
			return 0
		end
		return (position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude
	end

	local function fn30(arg, arg2, arg3)
		if not localPlayer.Character or not arg then
			tbl14.Status = "no character"
			return false
		end
		local position = typeof(arg) == "CFrame" and arg.Position or arg
		local cframe = CFrame.new(position + Vector3.new(0, arg3 or 3, 0))

		if typeof(arg) == "CFrame" then
			cframe = CFrame.new(cframe.Position) * (arg - arg.Position)
		end

		if GluHold and GluHold.go then
			GluHold.go(cframe)
		else
			fn22(position, arg3 or 3, true, true)
		end

		tbl14.Last = os.clock()
		tbl14.Status = "teleported to " .. tostring(arg2 or "position")
		return true
	end

	local function fn31(arg)
		local v13, v14 = string.match(tostring(arg or ""), "^(.*) | ([^|]+)$")
		if v13 and v13 ~= "" then
			return v13, v14
		end
		return tostring(arg or ""), nil
	end

	tbl14.ensureCatalog = function()
		if tbl14.ByLabel and tbl14.CatalogAt and os.clock() - tbl14.CatalogAt < 45 then
			return
		end
		tbl14.ByLabel = {}
		tbl14.NpcLabels = {}
		tbl14.RegionLabels = {}
		local ouwland = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Ouwland")
		local content = ouwland and ouwland:FindFirstChild("Content")
		if not content then
			return
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do
			tbl14.RegionLabels[#tbl14.RegionLabels + 1] = child.Name
			local npcs = child:FindFirstChild("Npcs")

			if npcs then
				for _, child2 in ipairs(npcs:GetChildren()) do
					if not child2:IsA("ModuleScript") then
						continue
					end
					local ok, result = pcall(require, child2)
					local spawn_ = ok
						and type(result) == "table"
						and type(result.Spawns) == "table"
						and result.Spawns[1]

					if typeof(spawn_) == "CFrame" and spawn_.Position.Magnitude > 5 then
						local str11 = child2.Name .. " | " .. child.Name
						tbl14.ByLabel[str11] = spawn_
						tbl14.NpcLabels[#tbl14.NpcLabels + 1] = str11
					end
				end
			end

			local activeNpcs = child:FindFirstChild("ActiveNpcs")
			if not activeNpcs then
				continue
			end

			for _, child2 in ipairs(activeNpcs:GetChildren()) do
				if not child2:IsA("ModuleScript") then
					continue
				end
				local ok, result = pcall(require, child2)
				local spawning = ok and type(result) == "table" and result.SendOver and result.SendOver.Spawning

				if spawning then
					spawning = spawning.Center or type(spawning.Locations) == "table" and spawning.Locations[1]
				end

				if typeof(spawning) == "Vector3" and spawning.Magnitude > 5 then
					local str11 = child2.Name .. " | " .. child.Name

					if not tbl14.ByLabel[str11] then
						tbl14.ByLabel[str11] = CFrame.new(spawning)
						tbl14.NpcLabels[#tbl14.NpcLabels + 1] = str11
					end
				end
			end
		end

		table.sort(tbl14.NpcLabels)
		table.sort(tbl14.RegionLabels)
		tbl14.CatalogAt = os.clock()
	end

	tbl14.crystalList = function()
		local tbl15 = {}

		pcall(function()
			local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")
			local regions = debree and debree:FindFirstChild("Regions")
			if not regions then
				return
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(regions:GetChildren()) do
				for _, child2 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
					if string.find(child2.Name, "SpawnCrystal") then
						tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = { region = child.Name, inst = child2 }

	tbl14.crystalNames = function()

			if not instance or not instance:IsA("Model") then

	tbl14.findByName = function(arg)
		if not arg or arg == "" then
			return nil
		end
		local v13 = string.lower(arg)
		local instance2 = nil
		local v14 = nil

		local function fn33(instance)
			if not getIsModel(instance) then
				return
			end

			if
				not (
					instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
					or instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				)
			then
				return
			end
			local name = string.lower(instance.Name)
			if name ~= v13 and not string.find(name, v13, 1, true) then
				return
			end
			local position = getPosition(instance)
			if not position then
				return
			end
			local v15 = fn29(position)

			if not v14 or v15 < v14 then
				instance2 = instance
				v14 = v15
			end
		end

		local humanoids = workspace:FindFirstChild("Humanoids")
		local v15 = ipairs
		local children = humanoids and humanoids:GetChildren() or {}

		for _, child in v15(children) do
			fn33(child)
		end

		if not instance2 then
			pcall(function()
				for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					if not instance2 then
						fn33(descendant)
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		return instance2
	end

	tbl14.tpEntity = function(arg, arg2)
		tbl14.ensureCatalog()
		local v13 = fn31(arg)
		local byLabel = tbl14.ByLabel and tbl14.ByLabel[arg]
		local byName = tbl14.findByName(v13)

		if byName then
			local position = getPosition(byName)

			if position and (not byLabel or (position - byLabel.Position).Magnitude < 120) then
				byLabel = CFrame.new(position)
			end
		end

		if not byLabel then
			return false, "'" .. tostring(arg) .. "' not found"
		end

		if not fn30(byLabel, v13, 3) then
			return false, tbl14.Status
		end

		if arg2 then
			local v14 = v13

			task.spawn(function()
				task.wait(0.35)
				local byName2 = tbl14.findByName(v14)
				local proximityPrompt = byName2 and byName2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)

				if proximityPrompt and proximityPrompt.Enabled then
					if type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
						pcall(fireproximityprompt, proximityPrompt, 1)
					end

					pcall(function()
						proximityPrompt:InputHoldBegin()
					end)

					task.wait(math.min(tonumber(proximityPrompt.HoldDuration) or 0.2, 0.4))

					pcall(function()
						proximityPrompt:InputHoldEnd()
					end)

					tbl14.Status = "interacted with " .. byName2.Name
				end
			end)
		end

		return true, "Teleported to " .. v13
	end

		end

			return false, tbl14.Status

		return true, "Teleported to " .. player2.Name
	end

	tbl14.tpSpot = function(arg)
		for _, v13 in ipairs(tbl15) do
			if v13.label ~= arg then
				continue
			end

			if v13.pos then
				if not fn30(v13.pos, v13.label, 3) then
					return false, tbl14.Status
				end
				return true, "Teleported to " .. v13.label
			end

			local v14 = ipairs
			local names3 = v13.names or {}

			for _, name in v14(names3) do
				local byName = tbl14.findByName(name)
				if not byName then
					continue
				end
				local position = getPosition(byName)

				if position then
					if not fn30(position, v13.label, 4) then
						return false, tbl14.Status
					end
					return true, "Teleported to " .. v13.label
				end
			end

			return false, v13.label .. " is not streamed/not found"
		end

		return false, "unknown spot '" .. tostring(arg) .. "'"
	end

	tbl14.tpCoords = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		local num = tonumber(arg)
		local num2 = tonumber(arg2)
		local num3 = tonumber(arg3)
		if not (num and num2 and num3) then
			return false, "enter X, Y and Z"
		end

		if math.abs(num) < 5 and math.abs(num2) < 5 and math.abs(num3) < 5 then
			return false, "those boxes look empty - set real coordinates"
		end

		if not fn30(Vector3.new(num, num2, num3), "coordinates", 0) then
			return false, tbl14.Status
		end
		return true, string.format("Teleported to %.0f, %.0f, %.0f", num, num2, num3)
	end

	tbl14.tpCurrent = function()
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			return "0, 0, 0"
		end
		local position = humanoidRootPart.Position
		return string.format("%.0f, %.0f, %.0f", position.X, position.Y, position.Z)
	end

	tbl14.savePos = function()
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			return false, "no character"
		end
		tbl14.Saved = humanoidRootPart.Position
		tbl14.SavedAt = os.clock()
		return true, "Saved " .. tbl14.tpCurrent()
	end

	tbl14.back = function()
		if not tbl14.Saved then
			return false, "nothing saved yet"
		end

		if not fn30(tbl14.Saved, "saved position", 3) then
			return false, tbl14.Status
		end
		return true, "Went back to the saved position"
	end

	return tbl14
end

	local function fn30(name)
		if not name then
			return false
		end
		local match = tostring(name):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
		if tbl14.Whitelist[match] then
			return true
		end
		local match2 = match:lower()

		for k in pairs(tbl14.Whitelist) do
			if k:lower() == match2 then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function fn31(instance)
		if not instance or not instance.Parent or not instance:IsA("Model") then
			return false
		end

		if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(instance) then
			return false
		end

		if not instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			return false
		end
		return fn30(instance.Name) or tbl14.KillAll == true
	end

	local function fn32(instance)
		if not fn31(instance) then
			return false
		end
		return instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health > 0
	end

	end

			return

		end
		humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position.X, position.Y + (arg or 3), position.Z)
		humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	end

	local function getOk2(instance)

			return false

			ok = pcall(fireproximityprompt, instance, 1) or ok
		end

		if tbl14.HoldWait and not tbl14.HoldWait[instance] then
			tbl14.HoldWait[instance] = true
			GluPrompt.fire(instance, { fast = true, min = 0.05, max = 3 })

			task.delay(3, function()
				if tbl14.HoldWait then
					tbl14.HoldWait[instance] = nil
				end
			end)

			ok = true
		end

	end

	local n16 = 2.2

	local function fn36(instance)
		if not instance or not instance.Parent then

		end

			VirtualInputManager_:SendKeyEvent(true, keyboardKeyCode, false, game)

		while os.clock() - now4 < n16 do

			VirtualInputManager_:SendKeyEvent(false, keyboardKeyCode, false, game)

	end

			then

			end
			local position2 = getPosition(child)

			if position2 and (not position or (position2 - position).Magnitude <= distance) then
				local v13 = fn37(child)

				if v13 and v13.Enabled then
					table.insert(tbl15, { model = child, pos = position2, prompt = v13 })
				end
			end
		end

		return tbl15
	end
