	end

	local function getChild3()
		local chests = workspace:FindFirstChild("Chests")
		if not chests then
			return nil
		end
		local n17 = 0
		local child2 = nil

		for _, child in ipairs(chests:GetChildren()) do
			if
				not (
					child:IsA("Model")
					and fn38(child.Name)
					and not tbl14.FiredChests[child]
					and not child:GetAttribute("IsOpen")
					and not child:GetAttribute("Opened")
				)
			then
				continue
			end
			local position = getPosition(child)

			if position then
				local n18 = #getChildren2(position, tbl14.GuardRadius * 2)

				if n17 < n18 then
					n17 = n18
					child2 = child
				end
			end
		end

		return child2
	end

	local function getLootDrops()
		return workspace:FindFirstChild("LootDrops")
	end

	local function getPosition2(instance)
		if not instance then
			return nil
		end

		if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
			return instance.Position
		end

		if instance:IsA("Model") then
			local v13 = fn15(instance)
			if v13 then
				return v13.Position
			end
		end

		local basePart = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		return basePart and basePart.Position
	end

	local function fn40(instance)
		if not instance then
			return nil
		end
		local lootDropPrompt = instance:FindFirstChild("LootDropPrompt")
		if lootDropPrompt and lootDropPrompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			return lootDropPrompt
		end
		return instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
	end

	local function fn41(position, arg)
		local tbl15 = {}
		local models = {}

		pcall(function()
			local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
			overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
			overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { localPlayer.Character }

			local partBoundsInRadius = workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, arg, overlapParams)
			local count4 = 0
			local flag15

			for _, instance in ipairs(partBoundsInRadius) do
				count4 += 1
				if count4 > 120 then
					break
				end
				local model = instance:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model") or instance
				if not (not models[model] and (DropTries[model] or 0) < 3) then
					continue
				end
				local model2 = model

				while true do
					local flag16 = model2 and model2 ~= workspace
					flag15 = false
					if not flag16 then
						break
					end
					local name = model2.Name

					if name == "Chests" or name == "Humanoids" or name == "Debree" or name == "Map" then
						flag15 = true
						break
					else
						model2 = model2.Parent
					end
				end

				if not flag15 then
					local v13 = fn40(model) or fn40(instance)
					local str11 = v13 and string.lower(tostring(v13.ActionText or "")) or ""

					if
						v13
						and (v13.Name == "LootDropPrompt" or str11:find("loot", 1, true) or str11:find("take", 1, true) or str11:find(
							"pick",
							1,
							true
						) or str11:find("grab", 1, true))
						and v13.Enabled
						and DropOwner.isOurs(model)
					then
						models[model] = true
						table.insert(tbl15, { drop = model, pos = instance.Position, prompt = v13 })
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		return tbl15
	end

	tbl14.tick = function()
		if not tbl14.Enabled then
			tbl14.Status = "Idle"
			tbl14.CurrentChest = nil
			tbl14.GuardTarget = nil
			tbl14.LootingDrops = false
			tbl14.WaitingForDrops = false
			tbl14.StandByAt = 0
			return
		end

		local v13, v14, v15 = fn13()
		if not v13 or not v14 or v14.Health <= 0 or not v15 then
			tbl14.Status = "Waiting for character..."
			return
		end
		local now4 = os.clock()
		local lootDrops = getLootDrops()
		local children = lootDrops and lootDrops:GetChildren() or {}

		for k, v16 in pairs(tbl14.FireWait) do
			if not (k and v16) then
				continue
			end
			local parent = k.Parent and fn37(k) or nil

			if
				not k.Parent
				or k:GetAttribute("IsOpen")
				or k:GetAttribute("Opened")
				or parent and not parent.Enabled
			then
				tbl14.FireWait[k] = nil
			else
				if not (parent and now4 - v16.at >= 1.2) then
					continue
				end

				if v16.tries >= 4 then
					tbl14.FireWait[k] = nil
					tbl14.Status = "Chest would not open - moving on"
				else
					v16.tries += 1
					v16.at = now4
					getOk2(parent)
				end
			end
		end

		for k, v16 in pairs(tbl14.LootFired) do
			if not (k and v16) then
				continue
			end

			if not k.Parent then
				tbl14.LootFired[k] = nil
			elseif now4 - v16 >= 0.8 then
				tbl14.LootFired[k] = nil
				DropGiveUp(k)
			end
		end

		if lootDrops then
			local children2 = {}

			for _, child in ipairs(lootDrops:GetChildren()) do
				if child and child.Parent and (DropTries[child] or 0) < 3 and DropOwner.isOurs(child) then
					table.insert(children2, child)
				end
			end

			if #children2 > 0 then
				local child = children2[1]

				local function fn42(instance)
					if not instance or not instance.Parent then
						return nil
					end

					local ok, result = pcall(function()
						return instance:GetPivot()
					end)

					if ok and result then
						return result
					end

					if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
						return instance.CFrame
					end
					local basePart = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
					return basePart and basePart.CFrame or nil
				end

				local v16 = fn42(child)

				if v16 then
					local humanoidRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()

					if humanoidRootPart then
						LootHold.grab(child, 2.8)
						humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(v16.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0))
						LootHold.mark()
						humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end
				end

				tbl14.LootingDrops = true
				tbl14.LastDropSeenAt = now4
				tbl14.Status = string.format("Stuck to %s (%d left)", child.Name, #children2)
				local instance = fn40(child)

				if instance and instance.Parent and instance.Enabled and not tbl14.HoldWait[instance] then
					tbl14.HoldWait[instance] = true
					tbl14.LootFired[child] = os.clock()

					task.spawn(function()
						fn36(instance)
						tbl14.HoldWait[instance] = nil
					end)
				end

				return
			end
		end

		local tbl15 = {}

		if lootDrops then
			for _, child in ipairs(children) do
				if not (child and child.Parent and (DropTries[child] or 0) < 3) then
					continue
				end
				local position = getPosition2(child)

				if position then
					local v16 = fn40(child)

					if v16 and DropOwner.isOurs(child) then
						table.insert(tbl15, { drop = child, pos = position, prompt = v16 })
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if tbl14.WaitingForDrops and tbl14.LastChest then
			if now4 - (tbl14.SweepAt or 0) >= 0.4 then
				tbl14.SweepAt = now4
				local position = getPosition(tbl14.LastChest) or v15.Position

				for _, v16 in ipairs(fn41(position, 120)) do
					table.insert(tbl15, v16)
				end
			end
		end

		local flag15 = false

		if tbl14.CurrentChest then
			local position = getPosition(tbl14.CurrentChest)
			flag15 = position ~= nil and #getChildren2(position, tbl14.GuardRadius) > 0
		end

		if #tbl15 > 0 and not flag15 and next(tbl14.HoldWait) == nil then
			tbl14.LootingDrops = true
			tbl14.LastDropSeenAt = now4
			local humanoidRootPart = getHumanoidRootPart()

			if humanoidRootPart then
				local v16 = tbl15[1]
				LootHold.grab(v16.drop, 2.8)
				humanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(v16.pos.X, v16.pos.Y + 2, v16.pos.Z)
				LootHold.mark()
				humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
				humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

				if v16.prompt.Enabled and fn36(v16.prompt) then
					tbl14.LootFired[v16.drop] = os.clock()

					if not tbl14.CountedDrops[v16.drop] then
						tbl14.CountedDrops[v16.drop] = true
						tbl14.DropsLooted += 1
					end
				else
					tbl14.LootFired[v16.drop] = tbl14.LootFired[v16.drop] or os.clock()
				end
			end

			tbl14.Status = string.format("Looting ours (%d near, %d on the floor)", #tbl15, #children)
			return
		end

		if tbl14.WaitingForDrops then
			if tbl14.LootingDrops then
				tbl14.LootingDrops = false
				tbl14.LastDropSeenAt = now4
			end

			if now4 - tbl14.WaitingSince < tbl14.DropTimeout then
				tbl14.Status = "Collecting drops..."
				return
			end
			tbl14.WaitingForDrops = false
			tbl14.LootingDrops = false
			tbl14.Status = string.format("Chest #%d finished", tbl14.ChestsOpened)
		end

		if tbl14.CurrentChest then
			local currentChest = tbl14.CurrentChest
			local position = getPosition(currentChest)

			if not position then
				tbl14.CurrentChest = nil
				tbl14.GuardTarget = nil
				return
			end

			local v16 = fn37(currentChest)
			local children2 = getChildren2(position, tbl14.GuardRadius)
			local flag16 = tbl14.LastGuardHP ~= nil and now4 - (tbl14.LastGuardDrop or 0) > 8

			if #children2 > 0 and not (flag16 and v16 and v16.Enabled) then
				if tbl14.EngageStart == 0 then
					tbl14.EngageStart = now4
					tbl14.LastGuardDrop = now4
					tbl14.LastGuardHP = nil
				end

				local guardTarget = tbl14.GuardTarget

				if
					not guardTarget
					or not fn32(guardTarget)
					or not fn15(guardTarget)
					or (fn15(guardTarget).Position - position).Magnitude > tbl14.GuardRadius
				then
					guardTarget = children2[1]
					tbl14.GuardTarget = guardTarget
					tbl14.GuardStart = now4
				end

				local v17 = SafePivot(guardTarget, v15.Position)
				fn34(Aim.at(guardTarget, tbl11[str6] or tbl11.Under, n4, v17))
				local humanoid = guardTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				local flag17 = humanoid and humanoid.MaxHealth and humanoid.MaxHealth > 0
				local n17 = 0

				if flag17 then
					n17 = math.floor(humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth * 100)
				end

				if tbl14.LastGuardHP and humanoid and humanoid.Health < tbl14.LastGuardHP - 0.01 then
					tbl14.LastGuardDrop = now4
				end

				if humanoid then
					tbl14.LastGuardHP = humanoid.Health
				end

				if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and n17 <= (#children2 > 1 and 98 or 65) then
					fn35(guardTarget)
				end

				if tbl14.GuardStuckTime < now4 - (tbl14.GuardStart or now4) then
					tbl14.GuardTarget = nil
					tbl14.GuardStart = now4
					tbl14.Switched = (tbl14.Switched or 0) + 1
				end

				if tbl14.EngageMax < now4 - tbl14.EngageStart then
					tbl14.FiredChests[currentChest] = true
					tbl14.CurrentChest = nil
					tbl14.GuardTarget = nil
					tbl14.EngageStart = 0
					tbl14.Status = string.format("Guards would not die - moving on (switched %d)", tbl14.Switched or 0)
					return
				end

				tbl14.Status =
					string.format("Clearing %d raid mob(s) for chest - %s (%d%%)", #children2, guardTarget.Name, n17)
				return
			end

			tbl14.GuardTarget = nil
			tbl14.EngageStart = 0
			tbl14.LastGuardHP = nil
			tbl14.LastGuardDrop = now4

			if v16 and v16.Enabled then
				fn33(position, 3)
				local tbl16 = fn39(position, 40)
				tbl16 = #tbl16 > 0 and tbl16 or { { model = currentChest, pos = position, prompt = v16 } }
				local n17 = math.min(tbl14.GuardRadius, 30)
				local count4 = 0

				for _, v17 in ipairs(tbl16) do
					if flag16 or #getChildren2(v17.pos, n17) == 0 then
						if getOk2(v17.prompt) then
							tbl14.FiredChests[v17.model] = true
							tbl14.FireWait[v17.model] = { at = now4, tries = 1 }
							tbl14.LastChest = v17.model
							count4 += 1
						end
					end
				end

				if count4 == 0 then
					if tbl14.EngageStart > 0 and now4 - tbl14.EngageStart > tbl14.EngageMax then
						tbl14.FiredChests[currentChest] = true
						tbl14.CurrentChest = nil
						tbl14.GuardTarget = nil
						tbl14.EngageStart = 0
						tbl14.Status = "Chest would not open - moving to the next spot"
						return
					end

					tbl14.Status = "Chest is still guarded - clearing it first"
					return
				end

				tbl14.ChestsOpened += count4
				tbl14.ChestLootedThisServer = true
				tbl14.CurrentChest = nil
				tbl14.GuardTarget = nil
				tbl14.WaitingForDrops = true
				tbl14.WaitingSince = now4
				tbl14.LastDropSeenAt = 0
				tbl14.Status = string.format("Fired %d chest(s) - collecting drops...", count4)
				return
			end

			if v16 and not v16.Enabled then
				if tbl14.StandByAt == 0 then
					tbl14.StandByAt = now4
				end

				if now4 - tbl14.StandByAt > 20 then
					tbl14.CurrentChest = nil
					tbl14.StandByAt = 0
					return
				end

				fn33(position, 3)
				tbl14.Status = "Guards cleared - waiting for chest to unlock..."
				return
			end

			tbl14.StandByAt = 0
			tbl14.CurrentChest = nil
			return
		end

		if next(tbl14.FireWait) ~= nil then
			tbl14.Status = "Confirming the chest opened..."
			return
		end

		if tbl14.ScanDelay <= now4 - tbl14.LastTP then
			tbl14.LastTP = now4
			local count4 = 0

			if lootDrops then
				for _, child in ipairs(lootDrops:GetChildren()) do
					if child and child.Parent and (DropTries[child] or 0) < 3 then
						count4 += 1
					end
				end
			end

			if count4 > 0 then
				tbl14.Status = string.format("Looting drops (%d left)...", count4)
				return
			end
			local child = getChild2()

			if child then
				local position = getPosition(child)

				if position then
					tbl14.CurrentChest = child
					tbl14.GuardTarget = nil
					fn33(position, 3)
					tbl14.CFramesVisited = 0
					tbl14.Status = string.format("Active chest found - %s", child.Name)
					return
				end
			end

			if #getChildren() > 0 then
				local child2 = getChild3()

				if child2 then
					local position = getPosition(child2)

					if position then
						tbl14.CurrentChest = child2
						tbl14.GuardTarget = nil
						fn33(position, 3)
						tbl14.CFramesVisited = 0
						tbl14.Status = string.format("Raid active - clearing guards at %s", child2.Name)
						return
					end
				end

				tbl14.CFramesVisited = 0
			end

			if tbl14.Mode == "Server Hop Farm" and not tbl14.Hopping then
				tbl14.CFramesVisited += 1

				if #tbl14.CFrames <= tbl14.CFramesVisited then
					tbl14.CFramesVisited = 0
					tbl14.Hopping = true
					tbl14.Status =
						string.format("No raid found (%d/%d spots) - hopping server...", #tbl14.CFrames, #tbl14.CFrames)
					local hopType = tbl14.HopType == "Best Server" and "Highest Pop" or tbl14.HopType

					task.spawn(function()
						local v16, v17 = v12.hop(hopType)

						if v16 then
							tbl14.ChestLootedThisServer = false
							tbl14.CFramesVisited = 0
							tbl14.Idx = 1
							tbl14.FiredChests = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
							tbl14.CountedDrops = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
							tbl14.Status = "Hopped - " .. tostring(v17)
						else
							tbl14.Status = "Hop failed: " .. tostring(v17)
						end

						task.wait(3)
						tbl14.Hopping = false
					end)

					return
				end
			end

			if tbl14.Idx < 1 or tbl14.Idx > #tbl14.CFrames then
				tbl14.Idx = 1
			end

			fn33(tbl14.CFrames[tbl14.Idx].Position, 3)
			tbl14.Idx = tbl14.Idx % #tbl14.CFrames + 1
		end

		local child = getChild2()

		if not child and #getChildren() > 0 then
			child = getChild3()
		end

		if child then
			local position = getPosition(child)

			if position then
				tbl14.CurrentChest = child
				tbl14.GuardTarget = nil
				fn33(position, 3)
				tbl14.CFramesVisited = 0
				tbl14.Status = string.format("Raid spot - engaging %s", child.Name)
				return
			end
		end

		if not tbl14.Hopping then
			tbl14.Status =
				string.format("Scanning spot #%d / %d | chests: %d", tbl14.Idx, #tbl14.CFrames, tbl14.ChestsOpened or 0)
		end
	end

	tbl14.reset = function()
		tbl14.ChestsOpened = 0
		tbl14.DropsLooted = 0
		tbl14.Idx = 1
		tbl14.CurrentChest = nil
		tbl14.GuardTarget = nil
		tbl14.GuardStart = 0
		tbl14.EngageStart = 0
		tbl14.Switched = 0
		tbl14.LootingDrops = false
		tbl14.WaitingForDrops = false
		tbl14.WaitingSince = 0
		tbl14.LastDropSeenAt = 0
		tbl14.CountedDrops = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		tbl14.FiredChests = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		tbl14.LootFired = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		tbl14.FireWait = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		tbl14.HoldWait = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		tbl14.LastChest = nil
		tbl14.SweepAt = 0
		tbl14.LastGuardHP = nil
		tbl14.LastGuardDrop = 0
		tbl14.StandByAt = 0
	end

	return tbl14
end

SealedChest = fn29()

local function fn30()
	local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

	local tbl14 = {
		Enabled = false,
		Status = "Idle",
		Casts = 0,
		DefaultHold = 0.15,
		AimOffsetY = 1.5,
		ReadyAt = {},
		Cooldowns = {},
		HoldTimes = {},
		LastCast = "",
		CastGap = 0.02,
		MaxActiveWait = 0.9,
		FallbackCooldown = 1.5,
		FailCooldown = 0.3,
		LastGapAt = 0,
		AimEnabled = false,
		Weapon = nil,
		LastWeapon = nil,
		WeaponAt = 0,
		Keys = nil,
		KeySet = nil,
		KeySource = nil,
		WeaponKeys = nil,
		Allowed = nil,
		AllowedPicked = false,
		FamilyOn = false,
		FamilyName = "",
		FamilyAt = 0,
		SkillInfo = nil,
		LastReload = 0,
		PendingUI = false,
	}

	local v13 = nil
	local v14 = nil
	local mousemoveabs = nil
	local iswindowactive = nil
	local flag15 = false

	local function fn31(arg)
		for _, v15 in ipairs({ 0, 1 }) do
			local ok, result = pcall(getfenv, v15)
			if ok and type(result) == "table" and result[arg] ~= nil then
				return result[arg]
			end
		end

		if type(_G) == "table" and _G[arg] ~= nil then
			return _G[arg]
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function fn32()
		if World.IsMenu then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			local cam = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CAM")
			local client = cam and cam:FindFirstChild("Client")
			local controllers = client and client:FindFirstChild("Controllers")
			if not controllers then
				return
			end
			local skillsProvider = controllers:FindFirstChild("Skills_Provider")

			if skillsProvider and skillsProvider:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				local ok, result = pcall(require, skillsProvider)

				if ok then
					v13 = result
				end
			end

			local skillController = controllers:FindFirstChild("Skill_Controller")

			if skillController and skillController:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				local ok, result = pcall(require, skillController)

				if ok then
					v14 = result
				end
			end
		end)

		if not mousemoveabs then
			mousemoveabs = fn31("mousemoveabs")
		end

		if not iswindowactive then
			iswindowactive = fn31("iswindowactive")
		end

		flag15 = v13 ~= nil and v14 ~= nil
	end

	fn32()

	pcall(function()
		if World.IsMenu then
			return
		end
		local cam = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CAM")
		local global = cam and cam:FindFirstChild("Global")
		local powers = global and global:FindFirstChild("Powers")
		if not powers then
			return
		end

		local function fn33(skill)
			if type(skill) ~= "table" then
				return
			end

			if type(skill.Name) == "string" and type(skill.CoolDown) == "number" then
				tbl14.Cooldowns[skill.Name] = skill.CoolDown
			end

			for _, v15 in pairs(skill) do
				if type(v15) == "table" and type(v15.Name) == "string" and type(v15.CoolDown) == "number" then
					tbl14.Cooldowns[v15.Name] = v15.CoolDown
				end
			end
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(powers:GetChildren()) do
			if not child:IsA("Folder") then
				continue
			end

			for _, child2 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
				if not child2:IsA("ModuleScript") then
					continue
				end
				local ok, result = pcall(require, child2)

				if ok and type(result) == "table" and type(result.Skills) == "table" then
					for _, skill in ipairs(result.Skills) do
						fn33(skill)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	local function fn33()
		if not v13 then
			fn32()
			if not v13 then
				return {}
			end
		end

		if type(v13.get_current_keys) ~= "function" then
			return {}
		end
		local ok, result = pcall(v13.get_current_keys)
		if not ok or not result then
			return {}
		end
		local tbl15 = {}

		for _, v15 in ipairs(result) do
			v15 = type(v15) == "table" and v15.Name or v15

			if type(v15) == "string" and v15 ~= "" and v15 ~= "Blocking" then
				table.insert(tbl15, v15)
			end
		end

		return tbl15
	end

	local function getSkillInfo()
		if tbl14.SkillInfo ~= nil then
			return tbl14.SkillInfo
		end

		pcall(function()
			local cam = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CAM")
			local global = cam and cam:FindFirstChild("Global")
			local playerProfile = global and global:FindFirstChild("PlayerProfile")
			local skillInfo = playerProfile and playerProfile:FindFirstChild("Skill_Info")

			if skillInfo and skillInfo:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				local ok, skillInfo2 = pcall(require, skillInfo)

				if ok and type(skillInfo2) == "table" then
					tbl14.SkillInfo = skillInfo2
				end
			end
		end)

		return tbl14.SkillInfo
	end

	tbl14.categoryOf = function(arg)
		local skillInfo = getSkillInfo()
		skillInfo = skillInfo and skillInfo[arg]
		if type(skillInfo) ~= "table" then
			return ""
		end
		return tostring(skillInfo.Category or skillInfo.Type or "")
	end

	tbl14.familyOf = function(arg)

		skillInfo = skillInfo and skillInfo[arg]
		if type(skillInfo) ~= "table" then

		return tostring(skillInfo.Family or skillInfo.Clan or skillInfo.FamilyName or "")

	tbl14.currentFamily = function()
		local str11 = ""

		pcall(function()
			local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
			local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
			local child = data and data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name)
			if not child then
				return
			end

			for _, name in ipairs({ "Clan", "clan", "Family", "family" }) do
				local child2 = child:FindFirstChild(name)
				if child2 and child2:IsA("ValueBase") and tostring(child2.Value) ~= "" then
					str11 = tostring(child2.Value)
					break
				end
			end
		end)

		if str11 == "" then
			local character2 = localPlayer.Character

			if character2 then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return character2:GetAttribute("Clan")
				end)

				if ok and type(result) == "string" then
					str11 = result
				end
			end
		end

		return str11
	end

	tbl14.isFamily = function(arg)
		local v15 = string.lower(tbl14.categoryOf(arg))
		if v15:find("family", 1, true) or v15:find("clan", 1, true) then
			return true
		end
		local v16 = string.lower(tostring(tbl14.FamilyName or ""))
		if v16 ~= "" and v15 ~= "" and v15:find(v16, 1, true) then
			return true
		end
		local v17 = string.lower(tbl14.familyOf(arg))
		if v17 ~= "" and (v16 == "" or v17 == v16) then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	tbl14.listAllSkills = function()

		if skillInfo then

				if type(k) == "string" and type(v15) == "table" and not tbl16[k] then
					tbl16[k] = true
					table.insert(tbl15, k)
				end
			end
		end

		local v15 = ipairs
		local keys = tbl14.Keys or {}

		for _, key in v15(keys) do
			if not tbl16[key] then
				tbl16[key] = true
				table.insert(tbl15, key)
			end
		end

		table.sort(tbl15)
		return tbl15
	end

	local function fn34()
		local tbl15 = {}

		pcall(function()
			local localPlayer2 = Players.LocalPlayer
			local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
			local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")

			end

			for i = 1, 5 do
				local child2 = toolbar:FindFirstChild(tbl13[i])
				child2 = child2 and tonumber(child2.Value)
				if not (child2 and child2 > 0) then
					continue
				end

				for _, child3 in ipairs(inventory2:GetChildren()) do
					local id = child3:FindFirstChild("Id")

					if id and id:IsA("ValueBase") and tonumber(id.Value) == child2 then
						local v15 = fn11(child3.Name)

						if v15 ~= "" then
							tbl15[v15] = true
						end

						break
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		return tbl15
	end

	local function fn35(name)
		if not v13 then
			return nil, nil, nil
		end

		for _, v15 in ipairs({ "get_keys_for", "get_skill_keys" }) do
			local v16 = v13[v15]
			if type(v16) ~= "function" then
				continue
			end
			local ok, result = pcall(v16, name)
			if ok and type(result) == "table" and #result > 0 then
				return result, v15, nil
			end
		end

		local v15 = fn33()
		if #v15 == 0 then
			return v15, "get_current_keys", nil
		end
		local v16 = fn11(name or "")
		if v16 == "" then
			return v15, "get_current_keys", nil
		end
		local v17 = fn34()
		local tbl15 = {}
		local tbl16 = {}

		for _, v18 in ipairs(v15) do
			local v19 = fn11(tbl14.categoryOf(v18))

			if
				not (
					v19 == ""
					or v19 == v16
					or string.find(v19, v16, 1, true) ~= nil
					or string.find(v16, v19, 1, true) ~= nil
				) and v17[v19]
			then
				table.insert(tbl16, v18)
			else
				table.insert(tbl15, v18)
			end
		end

		if #tbl15 == 0 then
			return v15, "get_current_keys (kept all)", nil
		end
		return tbl15, "get_current_keys (weapon filtered)", tbl16
	end

	tbl14.refreshWeapon = function(arg)
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if not arg and now3 - (tbl14.WeaponAt or 0) < 0.4 then
			return false
		end
		tbl14.WeaponAt = now3
		local name = getName()
		local flag16 = name ~= nil and name ~= ""

		if not flag16 then
			name = ""
		end

		local flag17 = name ~= tbl14.Weapon
		local flag18 = not flag17
		if flag18 and not arg and tbl14.Keys and #tbl14.Keys > 0 then
			return false
		end

		if flag18 and tbl14.Keys and #tbl14.Keys > 0 and os.clock() - (tbl14.LastForced or 0) < 0.2 then
			return false
		end

		if arg then
			tbl14.LastForced = os.clock()
		end

		local v15, keySource, v16

		if flag16 then
			v15, keySource, v16 = fn35(name)
		else
			v15 = fn33()
			v16 = nil
			keySource = "get_current_keys (weapon unknown)"
		end

		if type(v15) ~= "table" then
			return false
		end
		local weaponKey = {}
		local tbl15 = {}

		for _, v17 in ipairs(v15) do
			v17 = type(v17) == "table" and v17.Name or v17

			if type(v17) == "string" and v17 ~= "" and v17 ~= "Blocking" and not tbl15[v17] then
				tbl15[v17] = true
				table.insert(weaponKey, v17)
			end
		end

		if not tbl14.WeaponKeys then
			tbl14.WeaponKeys = {}
		end

		if #weaponKey == 0 then
			weaponKey = tbl14.WeaponKeys[name] or weaponKey
		else
			tbl14.WeaponKeys[name] = weaponKey
		end

		tbl14.Weapon = name
		tbl14.Keys = weaponKey
		tbl14.KeySource = keySource
		tbl14.KeySet = {}

		for _, v17 in ipairs(weaponKey) do
			tbl14.KeySet[v17] = true
		end

		local tbl16 = {}

		if tbl14.Allowed and next(tbl14.Allowed) ~= nil then
			for k in pairs(tbl14.Allowed) do
				if not tbl14.KeySet[k] then
					tbl14.Allowed[k] = nil
					table.insert(tbl16, k)
				end
			end

			tbl14.AllowedPicked = next(tbl14.Allowed) ~= nil
		end

		local logKey =
			string.format("%s|%d|%s|%s", name, #weaponKey, tostring(keySource), tostring(tbl14.LastWeapon or ""))

		if (flag17 or arg) and tbl14.LogKey ~= logKey then
			tbl14.LogKey = logKey

			if flag17 then
				DEV(
					string.format(
						"[Glu] Weapon changed: %s -> %s (slot %s)",
						tostring(tbl14.LastWeapon or "none"),
						name,
						tostring(fn24())
					)
				)
			end

			DEV(
				string.format(
					"[Glu] Skills refreshed: %d skill(s) for %s [%s]",
					#weaponKey,
					name ~= "" and name or "unknown weapon",
					tostring(keySource)
				)
			)

			for _, v17 in ipairs(tbl16) do
				DEV("[Glu] Ignored skill: " .. v17 .. " (wrong weapon)")
			end

			if type(v16) == "table" then
				for _, v17 in ipairs(v16) do
					DEV("[Glu] Ignored skill: " .. v17 .. " (belongs to another weapon)")
				end
			end
		end

		tbl14.LastWeapon = name
		tbl14.PendingUI = true
		return true
	end

	local function getKeys()
		if tbl14.Keys and #tbl14.Keys > 0 then
			return tbl14.Keys
		end
		tbl14.refreshWeapon(true)
		return tbl14.Keys or {}
	end

	tbl14.allowed = function(arg)
		if tbl14.KeySet and tbl14.Keys and #tbl14.Keys > 0 and not tbl14.KeySet[arg] then
			return false
		end

		if tbl14.Allowed and next(tbl14.Allowed) ~= nil then
			if tbl14.Allowed[arg] == true then
				return true
			end

			if tbl14.FamilyOn and tbl14.KeySet and tbl14.KeySet[arg] and tbl14.isFamily(arg) then
				return true
			end
			return false
		end

		return true
	end

	tbl14.describe = function()
		local tbl15 = {}
		table.insert(
			tbl15,
			string.format(
				"equipped weapon: %s | %d skill(s) [%s]",
				tostring(tbl14.Weapon or "?"),
				#(tbl14.Keys or {}),
				tostring(tbl14.KeySource or "?")
			)
		)

		for _, key in ipairs(getKeys()) do
			table.insert(
				tbl15,
				string.format(
					"%s | cat=%s | family=%s | cd=%s | allowed=%s",
					key,
					tbl14.categoryOf(key),
					tostring(tbl14.isFamily(key)),
					tostring(tbl14.getCooldown(key)),
					tostring(tbl14.allowed(key))
				)
			)
		end

		return tbl15
	end

	local function getInstance()
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		if not character2 then
			return nil
		end
		local humanoidRootPart = character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			return nil
		end
		local magnitude2 = nil
		local instance2 = nil

		for _, instance in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Humanoids")) do
			if
				not (
					instance:IsA("Model")
					and instance ~= character2
					and Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(instance) == nil
				)
			then
				continue
			end

			if instance:GetAttribute("IsMob") ~= true then
				continue
			end
			local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local humanoidRootPart2 = instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

			if humanoid and humanoidRootPart2 and humanoid.Health > 0 then
				local magnitude = (humanoidRootPart2.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude

				if not magnitude2 or magnitude < magnitude2 then
					magnitude2 = magnitude
					instance2 = instance
				end
			end
		end

		return instance2
	end

	local function getInstance2()
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		if not character2 then
			return nil
		end

		if not character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			return nil
		end
		local instances = {}
		local currentTarget = v10 and v10.CurrentTarget
		local savedEnabled2 = savedEnabled3
		local instance2 = instance5
		local instance3 = instance4

		instances[1] = currentTarget
		instances[2] = savedEnabled2
		instances[3] = instance2
		instances[4] = instance3

		for _, instance in ipairs(instances) do
			if instance and fn14(instance) then
				if instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					return instance
				end
			end
		end

		return getInstance()
	end

	local function fn36()
		if not mousemoveabs then
			return false
		end

		if type(iswindowactive) == "function" and not iswindowactive() then
			return false
		end
		local instance = getInstance2()
		if not instance then
			return false
		end
		local humanoidRootPart = instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			return false
		end
		local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not currentCamera then
			return false
		end
		local screenPos =
			currentCamera:WorldToScreenPoint(humanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, tbl14.AimOffsetY, 0))
		if screenPos.Z <= 0 then
			return false
		end
		local viewportSize = currentCamera.ViewportSize
		if screenPos.X < 0 or screenPos.Y < 0 or screenPos.X > viewportSize.X or screenPos.Y > viewportSize.Y then
			return false
		end
		pcall(mousemoveabs, math.floor(screenPos.X), math.floor(screenPos.Y))
		return true
	end

	local function fn37(arg)

		if not character2 then
			return false
		end
		local shc = character2:FindFirstChild("SHC")
		local shcs = character2:FindFirstChild("SHCS")
		return shc and shc.Value == arg or shcs and shcs.Value == arg
	end

	tbl14.getEquippedSkills = function()

	end

	tbl14.getCooldown = function(arg)
		local cooldown = tbl14.Cooldowns[arg]

		if not cooldown or cooldown <= 0 then
			cooldown = tbl14.FallbackCooldown or 1.5
		end

		local cooldownCap = tbl14.CooldownCap or 6

		if not (cooldown > cooldownCap) then
			cooldownCap = cooldown
		end

		return cooldownCap
	end

	tbl14.getHold = function(arg)
		return tbl14.HoldTimes[arg] or tbl14.DefaultHold
	end

	tbl14.isReady = function(arg)
		return (tbl14.ReadyAt[arg] or 0) <= os.clock()
	end

	tbl14.reload = function()
		fn32()
	end

	tbl14.isLoaded = function()
		return flag15
	end

	local function fn38(arg)
		if not v14 or type(v14.Attempt_Hold) ~= "function" then
			return false
		end

		if tbl14.AimEnabled then
			fn36()
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(v14.Attempt_Hold, arg)
		if not ok or result ~= true then
			return false
		end
		local hold = tbl14.getHold(arg)

		if hold > 0 then
			task.wait(hold)
		end

		pcall(v14.StopHold, arg)
		local n16 = math.min(tbl14.MaxActiveWait or 0.9, 0.9)
		local n17 = 0

		while fn37(arg) and n17 < n16 do
			task.wait(0.03)
			n17 += 0.03
		end

		return true
	end

	local function fn39(arg)
		local remote = fn6()
		if not remote then
			return false
		end
		local instance = getInstance2()
		if not instance then
			return false
		end
		local humanoidRootPart = instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			return false
		end
		local position = humanoidRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, tbl14.AimOffsetY, 0)
		if
			not pcall(function()
				remote:FireServer("server_skill_controller_signaler", arg, "Hold", position)
			end)
		then
			return false
		end
		task.wait(tbl14.getHold(arg))

		pcall(function()
			remote:FireServer("server_skill_controller_signaler", arg, "UnHold", position)
		end)

		task.wait(0.05)
		return true
	end

	tbl14.CombatOk = false
	tbl14.CombatAt = 0

	local function fn40(model, humanoidRootPart, distance)
		if not model or not model.Parent then
			return false
		end
		local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if humanoid and humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return false
		end
		local humanoidRootPart2 = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
		if not humanoidRootPart2 or not humanoidRootPart2.Position then
			return false
		end
		return (humanoidRootPart2.Position - humanoidRootPart.Position).Magnitude <= distance
	end

	tbl14.farmRunning = function()
		if flag2 then
			return true
		end

		if savedEnabled and #matches4 > 0 then
			return true
		end

		if flag3 then
			return true
		end
		local flags = v.Flags or {}
		return flags.glu_yeti_enabled == true or flags.glu_crow_enabled == true
	end

	tbl14.combatActive = function()
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if now3 - (tbl14.CombatAt or 0) < 0.2 then
			return tbl14.CombatOk == true
		end
		tbl14.CombatAt = now3
		tbl14.CombatOk = false
		if not tbl14.farmRunning() then
			return false
		end
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			return false
		end
		local combatOk = fn40(getInstance(), humanoidRootPart, 140)
			or fn40(instance4, humanoidRootPart, 180)
			or fn40(savedEnabled3, humanoidRootPart, 220)
			or fn40(v11 and v11.CurrentTarget, humanoidRootPart, 220)
			or fn40(v10 and v10.CurrentTarget, humanoidRootPart, 220)
			or fn40(Yeti and Yeti.CurrentTarget, humanoidRootPart, 220)
		tbl14.CombatOk = combatOk
		return combatOk
	end

	tbl14.tick = function()
		if World.IsMenu then
			tbl14.Status = "Idle (main menu)"
			return
		end
		local flags = v.Flags

		if type(flags) == "table" then
			if World.IsMain then
				local num = tonumber(flags.glu_skill_hold)

				if num then
					tbl14.DefaultHold = math.clamp(num, 0.05, 3)
				end

				local num2 = tonumber(flags.glu_skill_cast_gap)

				if num2 then
					tbl14.CastGap = math.clamp(num2, 0, 5)
				end
			else
				local num = tonumber(flags.glu_dungeon_skill_hold)

				if num then
					tbl14.DefaultHold = math.clamp(num, 0.05, 3)
				end

				local num2 = tonumber(flags.glu_dungeon_skill_gap)

				if num2 then
					tbl14.CastGap = math.clamp(num2, 0, 5)
				end
			end
		end

		tbl14.refreshWeapon(false)
		if not tbl14.Enabled then
			tbl14.Status = "Idle"
			return
		end

		if not tbl14.combatActive() then
			tbl14.Status = "Idle (nothing to fight)"
			return
		end

		if not tbl14.FamilyAt or os.clock() - tbl14.FamilyAt > 5 then
			tbl14.FamilyAt = os.clock()
			tbl14.FamilyName = tbl14.currentFamily()
		end

		if not v13 or not v14 then
			fn32()
		end

		local keys = tbl14.Keys or {}
		local keys2

		if #keys == 0 then
			if os.clock() - (tbl14.LastReload or 0) > 3 then
				tbl14.LastReload = os.clock()
				fn32()
				tbl14.refreshWeapon(true)
				keys2 = tbl14.Keys or {}
			else
				keys2 = keys
			end
		else
			keys2 = keys
		end

		if #keys2 == 0 then
			local weapon = tbl14.Weapon or ""
			tbl14.Status = weapon ~= "" and "No skills for equipped weapon (" .. weapon .. ")"
				or v13 and "No skills equipped"
				or "Skills_Provider missing"
			return
		end

		local tbl15 = {}

		for _, key in ipairs(keys2) do
			if tbl14.allowed(key) and tbl14.isReady(key) then
				table.insert(tbl15, key)
			end
		end

		if #tbl15 == 0 then
			if (tbl14.StuckAfter or 4) <= os.clock() - (tbl14.LastAnyCast or 0) then
				local v15 = nil
				local v16 = nil

				for _, key in ipairs(keys2) do
					local n16 = tbl14.ReadyAt[key] or 0

					if not v15 or n16 < v15 then
						v15 = n16
						v16 = key
					end
				end

				if v16 then
					tbl14.ReadyAt[v16] = 0
					tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = v16
				end
			end

			if #tbl15 == 0 then
				tbl14.Status = tbl14.AllowedPicked and "All selected skills on cooldown"
					or "All equipped skills on cooldown"
				return
			end
		end

		local tbl16 = {}

		for _, v15 in ipairs(tbl15) do
			if not tbl14.FamilyOn or tbl14.isFamily(v15) then
				table.insert(tbl16, v15)
			end
		end

		for _, v15 in ipairs(tbl15) do
			if tbl14.FamilyOn and not tbl14.isFamily(v15) then
				table.insert(tbl16, v15)
			end
		end

		if #tbl16 > 1 then
			tbl14.Rotate = (tbl14.Rotate or 0) % #tbl16 + 1
			local v15 = table.remove(tbl16, tbl14.Rotate)
			table.insert(tbl16, 1, v15)
		end

		local delay = tonumber(tbl14.CastGap) or 0
		if delay > 0 and os.clock() - (tbl14.LastCastEnd or 0) < delay then
			tbl14.Status = string.format("Skill delay %.2fs", delay - (os.clock() - (tbl14.LastCastEnd or 0)))
			return
		end
		local n16 = math.max(1, math.floor(tonumber(tbl14.PerTick) or 1))
		local count4 = 0
		local lastCast2 = nil
		local lastCast3 = nil

		for i = 1, math.min(#tbl16, 3) do
			local lastCast = tbl16[i]

			if lastCast and tbl14.allowed(lastCast) then
				if tbl14.KeySet and next(tbl14.KeySet) ~= nil and not tbl14.KeySet[lastCast] then
					tbl14.refreshWeapon(true)
					lastCast = nil
				end
			end

			if not lastCast then
				continue
			end

			if count4 > 0 and delay > 0 then
				task.wait(delay)
			end

			tbl14.Casting = os.clock()
			local ok, result = pcall(fn38, lastCast)
			local ok2 = ok and result

			if not ok2 then
				local result2
				ok2, result2 = pcall(fn39, lastCast)
				ok2 = ok2 and result2
			end

			tbl14.Casting = nil

			if ok2 then
				tbl14.LastCastEnd = os.clock()
				tbl14.ReadyAt[lastCast] = os.clock() + tbl14.getCooldown(lastCast)
				tbl14.Casts += 1
				tbl14.LastCast = lastCast
				tbl14.LastAnyCast = os.clock()
				count4 += 1

				if count4 >= n16 then
					lastCast2 = lastCast
					lastCast3 = lastCast
					break
				end

				lastCast2 = lastCast
				lastCast3 = lastCast
			else
				tbl14.ReadyAt[lastCast] = os.clock() + (tbl14.FailCooldown or 0.3)
			end
		end

		if not lastCast2 then
			tbl14.Status = "No skill would hold - retrying"
			return
		end
		tbl14.Status = count4 > 1 and string.format("Cast %d skills (#%d)", count4, tbl14.Casts)
			or string.format("Cast %s (#%d)", tostring(lastCast3), tbl14.Casts)
	end

	tbl14.reset = function()
		tbl14.Casts = 0
		tbl14.ReadyAt = {}
		tbl14.Rotate = 0
		tbl14.LastAnyCast = os.clock()
	end

	return tbl14
end

	end

Knock = {
	MaxSpeed = 220,
	MaxSpin = 45,
	FallSpeed = -60,
	BelowDrop = 200,
	AnchorHold = 5,
	TeleportGrace = 1.5,
	Clamps = 0,
	Rescues = 0,
	Status = "idle",
	guard = function(part, arg, instance)
		if not part or not part.Parent then
			return
		end
		local assemblyLinearVelocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity
		local magnitude = part.AssemblyAngularVelocity.Magnitude
		local magnitude2 = assemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
		local flag15 = assemblyLinearVelocity.Y < Knock.FallSpeed
		local lastPos = Aim.LastPos
		local flag16 = lastPos ~= nil and os.clock() - (Aim.LastAt or 0) < Knock.AnchorHold
		local flag17 = os.clock() - (Aim.TeleportedAt or 0) < Knock.TeleportGrace

		if flag16 and not flag17 and flag15 and part.Position.Y < lastPos.Y - Knock.BelowDrop then
			if
				pcall(function()
					if GluHold and GluHold.go then
						GluHold.go(CFrame.new(lastPos))
					elseif instance and instance.Parent then
						instance:PivotTo(CFrame.new(lastPos))
					else
						part.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastPos)
					end

					part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end)
			then
				Knock.Rescues = Knock.Rescues + 1
				Knock.Status = string.format("pulled back out of the void (%d)", Knock.Rescues)
				return
			end
		end

		if magnitude2 > Knock.MaxSpeed or magnitude > Knock.MaxSpin then
			part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			Knock.Clamps = Knock.Clamps + 1
			Knock.Status = string.format("cancelled a launch (speed %.0f, %d total)", magnitude2, Knock.Clamps)
		end
	end,
}

Void = { Anchor = nil, Rescues = 0, Samples = 0, NextAt = 0, Status = "idle" }

Void.tick = function()
	local now3 = os.clock()
	if now3 < (Void.NextAt or 0) then
		return
	end
	Void.NextAt = now3 + 0.15
	local v14, v15, part = fn13()
	if not v14 or not v15 or not part or v15.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	if flag9 then
		return
	end
	local flag15 = false

	pcall(function()
		flag15 = v6 and v6.FlyEnabled == true
	end)

	if flag15 then
		return
	end
	local position = part.Position
	local y = 0

	pcall(function()
		local assemblyLinearVelocity = part.AssemblyLinearVelocity

		if typeof(assemblyLinearVelocity) == "Vector3" then
			y = assemblyLinearVelocity.Y
		end
	end)

	local flag16 = y < -45
	local fallenPartsDestroyHeight = (workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight or -500) + 250
	local v16 = GluGroundUnder(position - Vector3.new(0, 2, 0), v14, 14)

	if v16 and not flag16 and position.Y > fallenPartsDestroyHeight then
		Void.Anchor = v16 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
		Void.Samples = (Void.Samples or 0) + 1

		if (Void.Rescues or 0) == 0 then
			Void.Status = "watching"
		end

		return
	end

	local anchor = Void.Anchor
	if not anchor then
		return
	end
	local flag17 = position.Y < anchor.Y - 150 or position.Y < fallenPartsDestroyHeight
	local flag18 = y < -20 and position.Y < anchor.Y - 60 and GluGroundUnder(position, v14, 600) == nil

	if flag16 and flag17 or flag18 then
		if GluGroundUnder(anchor - Vector3.new(0, 40, 0), v14, 90) == nil then
			Void.Anchor = nil
			Void.Status = "anchor had no floor left - dropped it"
			return
		end

		if
			pcall(function()
				if GluHold and GluHold.go then
					GluHold.go(CFrame.new(anchor))
				else
					v14:PivotTo(CFrame.new(anchor))
					part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end
			end)
		then
			Void.Rescues = (Void.Rescues or 0) + 1
			Void.Status = string.format("pulled back out of the void (%d)", Void.Rescues)
		end
	end
end

GluTrack(RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not (flag2 or savedEnabled or flag3) then
		Void.Anchor = nil
		return
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(Void.tick)

	if not ok then
		Void.Status = "error: " .. tostring(result)
	end
end))

end

end

			n21 = n19
		end

		local num = tonumber(n3) or n21
		if num < n21 then
			return n21
		end

		if num > 0.35 then
			return 0.35
		end
		return num
	end

	local function fn34(instance)

	end

	end

	local function getPosition(instance)
		if LootHold and LootHold.busy() then
			return nil
		end

		if GluNpcSafe and GluNpcSafe.held and GluNpcSafe.held(instance) then
			return nil
		end

		if v10 and (v10.Reward or v10.Rewarding) then
			return nil
		end

		if v11 and (v11.Reward or v11.Rewarding) then
			return nil
		end

		if BossLoot and BossLoot.Phase and BossLoot.Phase ~= "idle" then
			return nil
		end

		if not instance or not instance.Parent then
			return nil
		end
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoidRootPart then
			return nil
		end
		local v15 = SafePivot(instance, humanoidRootPart.Position)
		if not v15 then
			return nil
		end
		local under, farmDistance

		if flag3 and tbl5 then
			under = tbl11[tbl5.FarmType] or tbl11[str6] or tbl11.Under
			farmDistance = tbl5.FarmDistance or n4
		else
			under = tbl11[str6] or tbl11.Under
			farmDistance = n4
		end

		local cframe = under(v15, fn32(farmDistance))
		if typeof(cframe) ~= "CFrame" then
			return v15.Position
		end
		local flag16 = humanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(cframe.LookVector) > 0.95

		if (humanoidRootPart.Position - cframe.Position).Magnitude > 3 or not flag16 then
			GluHold.Pose = true
			GluHold.pin(cframe)
		end

		return v15.Position
	end

		while true do
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				M1.refreshNative()

				if GluFarm and GluFarm.weaponCheck then
					GluFarm.weaponCheck()
				end

				local enabled = fn14(savedEnabled3)
					or fn14(instance5)
					or v10 and v10.Enabled and fn14(v10.CurrentTarget)
					or v11 and v11.Enabled and fn14(v11.CurrentTarget)
					or Yeti and Yeti.Enabled and fn14(Yeti.CurrentTarget)
				if v3.routeBusy() and not enabled then
					task.wait(0.1)
					return
				end

				if
					flag3
					and DungeonM1 ~= false
					and not flag9
					and not fn14(instance5)
					and tbl5
					and tbl5.scan
					and os.clock() - (M1.DungeonLook or 0) > 0.4
				then
					M1.DungeonLook = os.clock()
					local ok, result = pcall(tbl5.scan)

					if ok and type(result) == "table" and #result > 0 and tbl5.nearest then
						local ok2, result2 = pcall(tbl5.nearest, result)

						if ok2 and result2 then
							instance5 = result2
						end
					end
				end

				local savedEnabled2 = savedEnabled and fn34(savedEnabled3)

				if savedEnabled and not savedEnabled2 and type(matches4) == "table" and #matches4 > 0 then
					if os.clock() - (M1.BossLook or 0) > 0.35 then
						M1.BossLook = os.clock()
						local match = matches4[BossRotationIdx] or matches4[1]
						local ok, result = pcall(fn21, match, position4 or BossCenterCache and BossCenterCache[match])

						if ok then
							savedEnabled2 = fn34(result)

							if savedEnabled2 then
								savedEnabled3 = savedEnabled2
							end
						end
					end
				end

				local flag16 = flag3 and not flag9 and fn34(instance5)
				local enabled2 = v10 and v10.Enabled and fn34(v10.CurrentTarget)
				local enabled3 = v11 and v11.Enabled and fn34(v11.CurrentTarget)
				local enabled4 = Yeti and Yeti.Enabled and fn34(Yeti.CurrentTarget)
				local v15 = flag2 and fn34(instance4)
				local enabled5 = SealedChest and SealedChest.Enabled
				local target_

				if Aura and Aura.Enabled then
					local v16, v17, v18 = fn13()
					local magnitude2 = tonumber(Aura.Range) or 18
					target_ = nil

					if v18 then
						target_ = nil

						for _, instance in ipairs(getInstances2()) do
							local v19 = fn34(instance)
							if not v19 then
								continue
							end

							if string.find(string.lower(tostring(v19.Name)), "civilian", 1, true) then
								continue
							end
							local v20 = fn15(v19)

							if v20 then
								local magnitude = (v20.Position - v18.Position).Magnitude

								if magnitude <= magnitude2 then
									magnitude2 = magnitude
									target_ = v19
								end
							end
						end
					end

					Aura.Target = target_
					Aura.Status = target_ and target_.Name or "no target in range"
				else
					target_ = nil

					if Aura then
						Aura.Target = nil
						Aura.Status = "off"
						target_ = nil
					end
				end

				local target_2 = target_ or savedEnabled2 or flag16 or v15 or enabled2 or enabled3 or enabled4

				if not (target_2 ~= nil or enabled5) then
					M1.NoDamage = 0
					M1.Status = "idle"
					task.wait((flag2 or savedEnabled or v10 and v10.Enabled or v11 and v11.Enabled) and 0.05 or 0.2)
					return
				end

				if not target_2 then
					M1.Status = "waiting for the npc"
					task.wait(0.06)
					return
				end

				if v13.Casting and os.clock() - v13.Casting < 0.12 then
					M1.Status = "skill gap"
					task.wait(0.03)
					return
				end

				local humanoid = target_2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					or target_2:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Humanoid", true)
				local health = humanoid and humanoid.Parent and humanoid.Health or nil
				getPosition(target_2)
				local n17 = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(M1.Burst) or 2), 1, 4)

				for i = 1, n17 do
					v14(target_2)

					if i < n17 then
						task.wait(0.012)
					end
				end

				local targetMoving = Aim.running(target_2)
				M1.TargetMoving = targetMoving

				if humanoid and health and humanoid.Parent then
					if humanoid.Health < health - 0.01 then
						M1.NoDamage = 0
					elseif targetMoving then
						M1.NoDamage = math.max(0, M1.NoDamage - 2)
					else
						M1.NoDamage = M1.NoDamage + 1
					end
				end

				local v16 = M1.interval()
				M1.Status = string.format(
					"%.3fs swing | %s via %s (native %.3fs)%s",
					v16,
					tostring(M1.Preset or "Combat"),
					tostring(M1.Trigger or "remote"),
					M1.Native,
					targetMoving and " - lerping a running target" or ""
				)
				local now3 = os.clock()

				if M1.NextAt < now3 - 0.5 then
					M1.NextAt = now3
				end

				M1.NextAt = M1.NextAt + v16
				local delay = M1.NextAt - os.clock()

				if delay > 0 then
					task.wait(delay)
				else
					task.wait(0)
				end
			end)

			if not ok then
				M1.Errors = (M1.Errors or 0) + 1
				M1.LastError = tostring(result)
				M1.NextAt = os.clock()
				M1.Status = string.format("recovered from a swing error (%d) - still swinging", M1.Errors)
				task.wait(0.2)
			end
		end
	end)
end

local function fn33()
	local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

	local tbl14 = {
		Enabled = false,
		Status = "Idle",
		Collected = 0,
		Room = nil,
		Miss = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
	}

	local rooms = {
		["Nightfall Katana Schematic"] = Vector3.new(-570.2, 815.2, 111.9),
		["Nightfall Mask Schematic"] = Vector3.new(-1628.8, 1229.1, 1143.4),
		["Nightfall Axe and Mace Schematic"] = Vector3.new(1083.4, 1583.9, -810.9),
		["Firstlight Mask Schematic"] = Vector3.new(2232.1, 603.5, -509),
		["Nightfall Scythe Schematic"] = Vector3.new(-1205, 969, -3187),
		["Firstlight Spear Schematic"] = Vector3.new(-890, 983, -3962),
	}

	local n16 = 4

	local function getInventory()
		pcall(function()
			local cam = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CAM")
			local global = cam and cam:FindFirstChild("Global")
			local utility = global and global:FindFirstChild("Utility")
			if not utility then
				return
			end
			local ok, result = pcall(require, utility)

			if ok and type(result) == "table" and type(result.GetData) == "function" then
				local ok2, result2 = pcall(result.GetData, localPlayer, true)

				if ok2 and result2 then
					local inventory = result2:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
					inventory = inventory and inventory:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
					if inventory then
						return inventory
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
		local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
		local child = data
			and (data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name) or data:FindFirstChild(tostring(localPlayer.UserId)))
		if not child then
			return nil
		end
		local slots = child:FindFirstChild("slots") or child:FindFirstChild("Slots")

		if slots then
			for _, child2 in ipairs(slots:GetChildren()) do
				local inventory = child2:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
				inventory = inventory and inventory:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
				if inventory then
					return inventory
				end
			end
		end

		return (child:FindFirstChild("Inventory", true))
	end

	local function fn34(name)
		if type(name) ~= "string" or name == "" then
			return false
		end
		local inventory = getInventory()
		if not inventory then
			return false
		end

		if inventory:FindFirstChild(name) then
			return true
		end

		if inventory:FindFirstChild(name .. " Schematic") then
			return true
		end
		local name2 = string.lower(name)

		for _, child in ipairs(inventory:GetChildren()) do
			local name3 = string.lower(child.Name)

			if name3 == name2 or name3 == name2 .. " schematic" or string.find(name3, name2, 1, true) then
				if string.find(name3, "schematic", 1, true) or name3 == name2 then
					return true
				end
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function getProximityPrompt(instance)
		local proximityPrompt = nil

		pcall(function()
			proximityPrompt = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
		end)

		return proximityPrompt
	end

	local function fn35(model)
		if model:IsA("BasePart") then
			return model
		end
		return model:IsA("Model") and model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end

	local function fn36()
		local tbl15 = {}
		local instances = {}

		local function fn37(instance)
			if instances[instance] or not instance or not instance.Parent then
				return
			end
			instances[instance] = true
			local attribute = nil

			pcall(function()
				attribute = instance:GetAttribute("Item")
			end)

			if type(attribute) ~= "string" or attribute == "" then
				attribute = instance.Name
			end

			if
				not string.find(string.lower(tostring(attribute)), "schematic", 1, true)
				and instance:GetAttribute("Item") == nil
			then
				return
			end
			local proximityPrompt = getProximityPrompt(instance)
			if not proximityPrompt then
				return
			end
			tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = { prop = instance, item = attribute, prompt = proximityPrompt }
		end

		pcall(function()
			for _, v14 in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("StudyProp")) do
				fn37(v14)
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
			local puzzles = map and map:FindFirstChild("Puzzles")

			if puzzles then
				for _, descendant in ipairs(puzzles:GetDescendants()) do
					if descendant:IsA("Model") or descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
						fn37(descendant)
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			for _, tag in ipairs({ "Schematic", "Schematics", "StudyBoard" }) do
				for _, v14 in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(tag)) do
					fn37(v14)
				end
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			local count4 = 0

			for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
				count4 += 1
				if count4 > 8000 then
					break
				end

				if
					(descendant:IsA("Model") or descendant:IsA("BasePart"))
					and string.find(string.lower(descendant.Name), "schematic", 1, true)
				then
					fn37(descendant)
				end
			end
		end)

		return tbl15
	end

	local function fn37(arg)
		if not arg then
			return
		end
		GluParkLoot(arg)
	end

	local function fn38(arg)
		local prop = arg.prop
		local proximityPrompt = getProximityPrompt(arg.prop)
		if not prop or not prop.Parent then
			return true
		end

		if not proximityPrompt or not proximityPrompt.Parent then
			return false
		end
		local parent = proximityPrompt.Parent
		local basePart

		if parent and not parent:IsA("BasePart") then
			basePart = parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		else
			basePart = parent
		end

		local isBasePart = basePart and basePart:IsA("BasePart")
		local position = nil

		if isBasePart then
			position = basePart.Position
		end

		fn37(position or fn35(prop) and fn35(prop).Position)
		task.wait(0.12)

		pcall(function()
			proximityPrompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false

			if (tonumber(proximityPrompt.MaxActivationDistance) or 0) < 16 then
				proximityPrompt.MaxActivationDistance = 16
			end
		end)

		if GluPrompt and GluPrompt.fire then
			GluPrompt.fire(
				proximityPrompt,
				{ holdOnly = true, inst = prop, extra = 0.25, min = 0.15, max = 4, pin = false }
			)
		end

		if type(fireproximityprompt) == "function" then
			pcall(fireproximityprompt, proximityPrompt, 1)
		end

		for i = 1, 15 do
			if fn34(arg.item) then
				return true
			end

			if not proximityPrompt.Parent or proximityPrompt.Enabled == false then
				return true
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		pcall(function()
			proximityPrompt:InputHoldBegin()
			task.wait(0.12)
			proximityPrompt:InputHoldEnd()
		end)

		local keyboardKeyCode = nil

		pcall(function()
			keyboardKeyCode = proximityPrompt.KeyboardKeyCode
		end)

		if
			VirtualInputManager_
			and keyboardKeyCode
			and typeof(keyboardKeyCode) == "EnumItem"
			and keyboardKeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown
		then
			pcall(function()
				VirtualInputManager_:SendKeyEvent(true, keyboardKeyCode, false, game)
			end)

			task.wait(0.12)

			pcall(function()
				VirtualInputManager_:SendKeyEvent(false, keyboardKeyCode, false, game)
			end)
		end

		for i = 1, 20 do
			if fn34(arg.item) then
				return true
			end

			if not proximityPrompt.Parent or proximityPrompt.Enabled == false then
				return true
			end
			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		return false
	end

	tbl14.sweep = function()
		local count4 = 0

		for _, v14 in ipairs(fn36()) do
			if not tbl14.Enabled then
				break
			end

			if fn34(v14.item) then
				tbl14.Status = "Already own " .. v14.item
				continue
			end
			local v15 = tbl14.Miss[v14.prop]
			local flag16 = false

			pcall(function()
				flag16 = v14.prop:GetAttribute("Locked") == true
			end)

			if flag16 then
				tbl14.Status = v14.item .. " is locked (puzzle not solved)"
			elseif not (v15 and os.clock() - v15 < n16) then
				tbl14.Status = "Taking " .. v14.item

				if fn38(v14) then
					count4 += 1
					tbl14.Collected += 1
					tbl14.Miss[v14.prop] = nil
					tbl14.Status = "Collected " .. v14.item
				else
					tbl14.Miss[v14.prop] = os.clock()
					tbl14.Status = "Could not take " .. v14.item
				end
			end
		end

		return count4
	end

	tbl14.gotoRoom = function(room, arg)
		local room2 = rooms[room]
		if not room2 then
			return false, "no known room for " .. tostring(room)
		end
		tbl14.Room = room
		tbl14.Status = "Travelling to " .. room
		fn37(room2)
		fn20(room2, "room:" .. tostring(room))
		local deadline = os.clock() + 8

		while os.clock() < deadline do
			task.wait(0.25)
			if arg == false then
				return true, room
			end

			if not (tbl14.sweep() > 0) then
				continue
			end
			return true, room
		end

		return false, "nothing to take at " .. room
	end

	tbl14.gotoNextRoom = function(arg)
		local tbl15 = {}

		for k in pairs(rooms) do
			table.insert(tbl15, k)
		end

		table.sort(tbl15)

		for _, v14 in ipairs(tbl15) do
			if not fn34(string.gsub(v14, " Schematic$", "")) then
				if tbl14.gotoRoom(v14, arg) then
					return true, v14
				end
			end
		end

		tbl14.Status = "Nothing left to collect here"
		return false, tbl14.Status
	end

	tbl14.tick = function()
		if not tbl14.Enabled then
			return
		end

		if tbl14.Busy then
			return
		end
		tbl14.Busy = true

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			if tbl14.sweep() > 0 then
				return
			end
			tbl14.gotoNextRoom(true)
		end)

		tbl14.Busy = false

		if not ok then
			tbl14.Status = "error: " .. tostring(result)
		end
	end

	tbl14.reset = function()
		tbl14.Collected = 0
		tbl14.Miss = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	end

	tbl14.Rooms = rooms
	return tbl14
end

AutoSchem = fn33()

	while true do
		task.wait(AutoSchem.Enabled and 0.5 or 1.5)

		if AutoSchem.Enabled then
			local ok, result = pcall(AutoSchem.tick)

			if not ok and result then
				warn("[Glu] schematic tick:", result)
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function fn34()
	local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

	local tbl14 = {
		Enabled = false,
		Status = "Idle",
		Taken = 0,
		Miss = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		Block = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		Dead = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		Seen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" }),
		Cache = nil,
		CacheAt = 0,
		Claiming = false,
		Busy = false,
	}

	local n16 = 1
	local n17 = 40
	local n18 = 10
	local n19 = 3
	local n20 = 1.4

	local function fn35(model, arg)
		local n21 = (tbl14.Miss[model] or 0) + 1
		tbl14.Miss[model] = n21

		if n18 <= n21 then
			tbl14.Dead[model] = true
			tbl14.Status = string.format("%s was not taken after %d tries - leaving it", tostring(arg), n21)
			return
		end

		local n22 = math.min(0.4 * 2 ^ (n21 - 1), 6)
		tbl14.Block[model] = os.clock() + n22
		tbl14.Status = string.format("%s did not vanish (%d) - retrying in %.0fs", tostring(arg), n21, n22)
	end

	local function fn36(instance)
		if tbl14.Dead[instance] then
			return true
		end
		return (tbl14.Block[instance] or 0) > os.clock()
	end

	local function fn37(model)
		if not model then
			return nil
		end

		if model:IsA("BasePart") then
			return model
		end
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("Root")
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			return root
		end

		if not model:IsA("Model") then
			return model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
		end
		return model.PrimaryPart or model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
	end

	local function fn38(instance)
		if not instance or not instance.Parent then
			return false
		end

		if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
			return string.find(string.lower(instance.Name), "soul", 1, true) ~= nil
		end

		if not instance:IsA("Model") then
			return false
		end

		if string.find(string.lower(instance.Name), "soul", 1, true) then
			return true
		end
		return instance:FindFirstChild("Root") ~= nil
	end

	local function fn39(instance)
		if not fn38(instance) then
			return false
		end

		if string.find(string.lower(instance.Name), "soul", 1, true) then
			return true
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			if instance:FindFirstChild("SoulGroundHost", true) then
				return true
			end

			for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:GetAttribute("SoulTransparency") ~= nil then
					return true
				end

				if descendant:IsA("Sound") and descendant.Name == "PS2soulLOOP" then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end)

		return ok and result == true
	end

	local function fn40(position)
		if not position then
			return
		end

		if TeleportFix.holding() then

		end
	end

	local function fn42(descendant, instance)

	local getDescendants = nil

	local function getDescendants2(instance)
		local descendants = {}
		local descendants2 = {}
		local descendants3 = {}

		for _, descendant in ipairs(getDescendants(instance, fn37(instance))) do
			local str11 = ""

			pcall(function()
				str11 = string.lower(
					tostring(descendant.ActionText or "")
						.. " "
						.. tostring(descendant.ObjectText or "")
						.. " "
						.. tostring(descendant.Name or "")
				)
			end)

			local parent = descendant.Parent

			if not (parent ~= nil and (parent == instance or parent:IsDescendantOf(instance))) then
				descendants3[#descendants3 + 1] = descendant
			elseif string.find(str11, "claim", 1, true) or string.find(str11, "soul", 1, true) then
				descendants[#descendants + 1] = descendant
			else
				descendants2[#descendants2 + 1] = descendant
			end
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(descendants2) do
			descendants[#descendants + 1] = descendant
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(descendants3) do
			descendants[#descendants + 1] = descendant
		end

		return descendants
	end

	getDescendants = function(instance, arg)
		local descendants = {}

		pcall(function()
			for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and descendant.Parent then
					descendants[#descendants + 1] = descendant
				end
			end
		end)

		if #descendants > 0 or not arg then
			return descendants
		end
		local position = arg.Position
		local parent = instance.Parent

		if parent then
			pcall(function()
				for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
					if child == instance then
						continue
					end

					for _, descendant in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
						if descendant:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and descendant.Parent then
							local parent2 = descendant.Parent:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Parent
								or descendant.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

							if parent2 and (parent2.Position - position).Magnitude <= 16 then
								descendants[#descendants + 1] = descendant
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		if #descendants == 0 then
			pcall(function()
				local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
				overlapParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
				overlapParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { localPlayer.Character }

				for _, instance2 in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(position, 14, overlapParams)) do
					for _, child in ipairs(instance2:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and child.Parent then
							descendants[#descendants + 1] = child
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		end

		return descendants
	end

	local function fn43(instance, position, arg)
		if not position then
			return 999
		end

		if TeleportFix.holding() then
			return 999
		end
		arg = arg or 4
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		if not character2 then
			return 999
		end
		local humanoid = character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local humanoidRootPart = character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not humanoid or not humanoidRootPart then
			return 999
		end
		local vector =
			Vector3.new(humanoidRootPart.Position.X - position.X, 0, humanoidRootPart.Position.Z - position.Z)

		if vector.Magnitude > 70 then
			if vector.Magnitude < 0.5 then
				vector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
			end

			local position2 = position + vector.Unit * arg

			pcall(function()
				if GluHold and GluHold.go then
					GluHold.go(CFrame.new(position2 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
				else
					character2:PivotTo(CFrame.new(position2 + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)))
					humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end
			end)

			task.wait(0.12)
		end

		local deadline = os.clock() + 2.5
		local magnitude = 999
		local deadline2 = 0

		while true do
			if not (os.clock() < deadline) then
				pcall(function()
					local character3 = localPlayer.Character
					local humanoid2 = character3 and character3:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

					if humanoid2 and humanoid2.RootPart then
						humanoid2:MoveTo(humanoid2.RootPart.Position)
					end
				end)

				return magnitude
			end

			if not instance.Parent then
				break
			end
			local character3 = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid2 = character3 and character3:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local rootPart = humanoid2 and humanoid2.RootPart

			if not rootPart then
				pcall(function()
					local character4 = localPlayer.Character
					local humanoid3 = character4 and character4:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

					if humanoid3 and humanoid3.RootPart then
						humanoid3:MoveTo(humanoid3.RootPart.Position)
					end
				end)

				return magnitude
			end

			magnitude = (rootPart.Position - position).Magnitude

			if magnitude <= arg + 1 then
				pcall(function()
					local character4 = localPlayer.Character
					local humanoid3 = character4 and character4:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

					if humanoid3 and humanoid3.RootPart then
						humanoid3:MoveTo(humanoid3.RootPart.Position)
					end
				end)

				return magnitude
			end

			if deadline2 <= os.clock() then
				deadline2 = os.clock() + 0.5

				pcall(function()
					humanoid2:MoveTo(Vector3.new(position.X, rootPart.Position.Y, position.Z))
				end)
			end

			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		return 0
	end

	local function fn44(instance, instance2)
		if not instance2 or not instance2.Parent then
			return false
		end

		local ok, result = pcall(function()
			return instance2:FindFirstChild("Idle") ~= nil
		end)

		if ok and result then
			return true
		end
		local flag16 = false

		pcall(function()
			local attribute = instance2:GetAttribute("SoulTransparency")

			if type(attribute) == "number" and attribute < 0.97 then
				flag16 = true
			end

			local transparency = instance2.Transparency

			if type(transparency) == "number" and transparency < 0.97 then
				flag16 = true
			end
		end)

		if flag16 then
			return true
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
			if descendant:IsA("Sound") and descendant.Name == "PS2soulLOOP" then
				return true
			end

			if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Name ~= "SoulGroundHost" and descendant.Transparency < 0.9 then
				return true
			end
		end

		local v14 = tbl14.Seen[instance]
		return v14 ~= nil and os.clock() - v14 >= n20
	end

	local function fn45(instance, instance2)
		if not instance2 or not instance2.Parent then
			return
		end
		local flag16 = type(firetouchinterest) == "function"
		local flag17 = type(firetouch) == "function"
		if not flag16 and not flag17 then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
				if descendant:IsA("BasePart") and descendant.Parent then
					if not descendant.CanTouch then
						descendant.CanTouch = true
					end

					if flag16 then
						firetouchinterest(descendant, instance2, 0)
						firetouchinterest(descendant, instance2, 1)
						firetouchinterest(instance2, descendant, 0)
						firetouchinterest(instance2, descendant, 1)
					else
						firetouch(descendant, instance2)
						firetouch(instance2, descendant)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	local function fn46(instance, instance2, arg)
		local position = instance2.Position
		local position2 = GluLootStand(position, localPlayer.Character) or position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
		arg = arg or 2.5
		local now3 = os.clock()
		local deadline = now3 + arg
		local deadline2 = now3 + arg * 0.5
		local count4 = 0

		while os.clock() < deadline do
			if not instance.Parent then
				return true
			end
			local character2 = localPlayer.Character
			local humanoid = character2 and character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local rootPart = humanoid and humanoid.RootPart

			if rootPart then
				if not TeleportFix.holding() then
					pcall(function()
						rootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(position2)
						rootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						rootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end

				local now4 = os.clock()

				if deadline2 <= now4 then
					deadline2 = now4 + 0.25
					count4 += 1
					fn45(instance, rootPart)
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.05)
		end

		if count4 > 0 then
			tbl14.Status = "Stood on "
				.. tostring(instance.Name)
				.. " for "
				.. tostring(math.floor(arg))
				.. "s - still there"
		end

		return not instance.Parent
	end

	local function fn47(instance)
		if type(fireclickdetector) ~= "function" then

		local descendants = {}

		return false
	end

	local function fn48(instance, instance2)
		local str11 = tostring(instance.Name)
		tbl14.Claiming = true
		local descendants = getDescendants2(instance)

		for i = 1, 4 do
			if not instance.Parent then
				tbl14.Claiming = false
				return true
			end
			local instance3 = fn37(instance) or instance2
			GluHold.Pose = false

			if GluHold.aimBody then
				GluHold.aimBody(false)
			end

			if instance3 and instance3.Parent then
				GluParkLoot(instance3.Position)
				task.wait(0.12)
			end

			if i ~= 1 then
				instance2 = instance3
			else
				if not fn44(instance, instance3) then
					tbl14.Status = "Waiting for " .. str11 .. " to settle..."
					local deadline = os.clock() + n19
					local exitTo = nil

					while true do
						if not (os.clock() < deadline) then
							exitTo = 1
							break
						end

						if instance.Parent then
							if fn44(instance, instance3) then
								exitTo = 1
								break
							else
								task.wait(0.08)
								continue
							end
						end

						break
					end

					if exitTo ~= 1 then
						tbl14.Claiming = false
						return true
					end
				end

				if not instance.Parent then
					tbl14.Claiming = false
					return true
				end
				tbl14.Status = "Walking to " .. str11
				fn43(instance, instance3.Position, 4)
				instance2 = fn37(instance) or instance3
				if fn41(instance, 0.2) then
					tbl14.Claiming = false
					return true
				end
			end

			if #descendants > 0 then
				for i2, descendant in ipairs(descendants) do
					if not descendant.Parent then
						continue
					end

					pcall(function()
						descendant.RequiresLineOfSight = false

						if (tonumber(descendant.MaxActivationDistance) or 10) < 22 then
							descendant.MaxActivationDistance = 22
						end
					end)

					if instance2 and instance2.Parent then
						GluParkLoot(instance2.Position)
					end

					tbl14.Status = string.format("Holding the %s prompt (%d/%d)", str11, i2, #descendants)
					fn42(descendant, instance)
					if fn41(instance, 1.1) then
						tbl14.Claiming = false
						return true
					end
				end

				if i >= 2 and instance2 and instance2.Parent then
					tbl14.Status = "Standing on " .. str11
					if fn46(instance, instance2, 1.6) or not instance.Parent then
						tbl14.Claiming = false
						return true
					end
				end
			elseif i == 1 then
				tbl14.Status = "Standing on " .. str11
				fn40(instance2.Position)
				if fn46(instance, instance2, 2.5) or not instance.Parent then
					tbl14.Claiming = false
					return true
				end

				if fn47(instance) then
					tbl14.Claiming = false
					return true
				end
				tbl14.Claiming = false
				return fn41(instance, 0.9)
			end

			if i >= 2 then
			end

			task.wait(0.25)

			if instance2 and instance2.Parent and instance.Parent then
				fn43(instance, instance2.Position, 4)
			end
		end

		tbl14.Claiming = false
		return fn41(instance, 0.9)
	end

	local function fn49(instance)
		if not instance or not instance.Parent then
			return false
		end

		if tbl14.Busy then
			return false, "busy"
		end
		local instance2 = fn37(instance)
		if not instance2 or not instance2.Parent then

		tbl14.Busy = true
		local ok, result = pcall(fn48, instance, instance2)
		tbl14.Busy = false
		tbl14.Claiming = false
		if not ok then
			return false, "error"
