		return result == true
	end

	local function fn50()
		local tbl15 = {}
		local instances = {}
		local count4 = 0
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local position = humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart.Position or nil

		local function fn51(instance)
			if instances[instance] then
				return
			end
			instances[instance] = true
			if not instance or not instance.Parent then
				return
			end

			if tbl14.Seen[instance] == nil then
				tbl14.Seen[instance] = os.clock()
			end

			if fn36(instance) then
				return
			end

			if not fn38(instance) then
				return
			end

			if n17 <= count4 then
				return
			end
			count4 += 1
			if not fn39(instance) then
				return
			end
			local v14 = fn37(instance)
			if not v14 then
				return
			end
			local magnitude = 0

			if position then
				magnitude = (v14.Position - position).Magnitude
			end

			tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = { model = instance, root = v14, dist = magnitude }
		end

		pcall(function()
			for _, tag in ipairs({ "Soul", "Souls", "SoulOrb", "Collectible" }) do
				for _, v14 in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(tag)) do
					fn51(v14)
				end
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")

			if debree then
				for _, child in ipairs(debree:GetChildren()) do
					fn51(child)
				end
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
				fn51(child)
			end
		end)

		table.sort(tbl15, function(arg, arg2)
			return arg.dist < arg2.dist
		end)

		return tbl15
	end

	tbl14.sweep = function(arg)
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if not arg and tbl14.Cache and now3 - tbl14.CacheAt < n16 then
			return tbl14.Cache
		end
		tbl14.CacheAt = now3
		tbl14.Cache = fn50()
		return tbl14.Cache
	end

	local function fn51(arg)
		local str11 = tostring(arg.model.Name)
		local v14, v15 = fn49(arg.model)

		if v14 then
			tbl14.Taken += 1
			tbl14.Cache = nil
			tbl14.Miss[arg.model] = nil
			tbl14.Dead[arg.model] = nil
			tbl14.Status = string.format("Consumed a soul (%d total)", tbl14.Taken)
			return true, str11
		end

		if v15 ~= "busy" and arg.model.Parent then
			fn35(arg.model, str11)
		end

		tbl14.Cache = nil
		return false, str11
	end

	tbl14.takeNearest = function()
		local v14 = tbl14.sweep(true)
		if #v14 == 0 then
			tbl14.Status = "No soul nearby"
			return false, "no soul nearby"
		end
		return fn51(v14[1]), tbl14.Status
	end

	tbl14.claimNear = function(arg, distance)
		if not arg then
			return 0
		end
		distance = distance or 80
		local count4 = 0

		for _, v14 in ipairs(tbl14.sweep()) do
			if count4 >= 3 then
				break
			end

			if v14.model.Parent then
				if (v14.root.Position - arg).Magnitude <= distance then
					if fn51(v14) then
						count4 += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if count4 > 0 then
			tbl14.Status = string.format("Consumed %d soul(s) at the kill spot", count4)
		end

		return count4
	end

	tbl14.tick = function()
		if not tbl14.Enabled then
			return
		end

		if v10 and v10.Enabled or v11 and v11.Enabled then
			if
				not (
					v10 and v10.Enabled and (v10.Reward or v10.Leftover)
					or v11 and v11.Enabled and (v11.Reward or v11.Leftover)
				)
			then
				return
			end
		end

		if os.clock() < (tbl14.NextAt or 0) then
			return
		end
		tbl14.NextAt = os.clock() + 0.5
		if #tbl14.sweep() == 0 then
			tbl14.Status = "Watching for souls"
			return
		end
		tbl14.takeNearest()
	end

	tbl14.isDead = function(arg)
		return arg ~= nil and tbl14.Dead[arg] == true
	end

	tbl14.held = function()
		return tbl14.Claiming == true
	end

	tbl14.holding = function(arg, distance)
		if not arg or not tbl14.Enabled then
			return false
		end
		distance = distance or 80

		for _, v14 in ipairs(tbl14.sweep()) do
			if
				v14.model
				and v14.model.Parent
				and v14.root
				and v14.root.Parent
				and not tbl14.Dead[v14.model]
				and (v14.root.Position - arg).Magnitude <= distance
			then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	tbl14.reset = function()
		tbl14.Taken = 0
		tbl14.Miss = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		tbl14.Block = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		tbl14.Dead = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		tbl14.Seen = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		tbl14.Cache = nil
		tbl14.NextAt = 0
		tbl14.Claiming = false
		tbl14.Busy = false
	end

	return tbl14
end

local function fn35()
	local tbl14 = { Supreme = 1, Mythic = 2, Legendary = 3, Epic = 4, Rare = 5, Common = 6 }

	local function fn36(attribute)
		local v14 = string.lower(tostring(attribute or ""))
		if string.find(v14, "myth", 1, true) then
			return "Mythic"
		end

		if string.find(v14, "legend", 1, true) then
			return "Legendary"
		end

		if string.find(v14, "supreme", 1, true) then
			return "Supreme"
		end
		return "Other"
	end

	local function fn37(arg)
		local bossHunts = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BossHunts")
		if not bossHunts then
			return {}
		end
		local children = {}

		for _, child in ipairs(bossHunts:GetChildren()) do
			if child:GetAttribute("Side") == arg then
				table.insert(children, child)
			end
		end

		return children
	end

	local function fn38(arg, arg2)
		if type(arg) ~= "table" then
			return true
		end
		local v14, v15, v16 = pairs(arg)
		local flag16 = false
		local v17 = table.pack(f_1())

		if v17[1] then
			flag16 = true
		end

		if not flag16 then
			return true
		end

		if arg2 == "Other" or arg2 == "Unknown" then
			return arg.Other == true
		end
		return arg[arg2] == true
	end

	local tbl15 = {}

	local function fn39(arg, arg2)
		local bossHunts = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("BossHunts")
		local child = bossHunts and bossHunts:FindFirstChild(tostring(arg2))
		if not child then
			return false
		end
		return child:GetAttribute("Side") == arg or arg == ""
	end

	local function fn40(arg)
		for k in pairs(tbl15) do
			if not fn39(arg, k) then
				tbl15[k] = nil
			end
		end
	end

	local function fn41(name)
		local tbl16 = { action = "Claim", id = tostring(name) }

		if QuestAx and type(QuestAx.fire) == "function" then
			if QuestAx.fire("BossHuntsRequest", tbl16) then
				return true
			end
		end

		local remote = fn6()
		if not remote then
			return false
		end

		return pcall(function()
			remote:FireServer("BossHuntsRequest", tbl16)
		end)
	end

	return {
		claimFromOffers = function(arg, arg2)
			if not fn6() then
				return false, nil, nil
			end
			local now3 = os.clock()
			local instances = fn37(arg)
			local instance2 = nil
			local v14 = nil
			local v15 = nil

			for _, instance in ipairs(instances) do
				local v16 = tbl15[instance.Name]
				if v16 and (v16.at or 0) > now3 then
					continue
				end
				local v17 = fn36(instance:GetAttribute("Tier"))

				if fn38(arg2, v17) then
					local n16 = tbl14[v17] or 99

					if not instance2 or n16 < v14 then
						instance2 = instance
						v14 = n16
						v15 = v17
					end
				end
			end

			if not instance2 then
				return false, nil, nil
			end
			local tbl16 = tbl15[instance2.Name] or { tries = 0 }
			tbl16.tries = (tbl16.tries or 0) + 1
			local n16 = math.min(3 * 2 ^ math.min(tbl16.tries - 1, 4), 45)
			tbl16.at = now3 + n16
			tbl15[instance2.Name] = tbl16
			if not fn41(instance2.Name) then
				return false, nil, nil
			end
			return true,
				instance2.Name,
				v15,
				instance2:GetAttribute("Quest") or instance2:GetAttribute("Boss") or "",
				n16
		end,
		pruneTried = fn40,
	}
end

SafeSpawn("hunt", function()
	local flag16 = true

	while true do
		task.wait(0.1)

		if not v10.Enabled then
			v10.Status = "Idle"
			v10.CurrentTarget = nil
			v10.CurrentTargetName = ""
			v10.LastTpName = ""
			v10.Reward = nil
			v10.PendingKill = nil
			v10.Rewarding = false
			v10.Leftover = nil
			v10.LeftoverAt = 0
			v10.LastSeen = nil
			tbl12.Suppressed = false
			flag16 = true
			continue
		end

		if GluBossFloor() then
			if v10.CurrentTarget or v10.Reward or v10.Rewarding or v10.PendingKill or v10.Leftover then
				v10.CurrentTarget = nil
				v10.CurrentTargetName = ""
				v10.LastSeen = nil
				v10.Reward = nil
				v10.Rewarding = false
				v10.PendingKill = nil
				v10.Leftover = nil
				v10.LeftoverAt = 0
			end

			v10.Status = "Waiting - auto boss has the floor"
			tbl12.Suppressed = false
			continue
		end

		if v10.CurrentTarget and v10.CurrentTarget.Parent or v10.Reward or v10.Rewarding then
			tbl12.Suppressed = false
		else
			tbl12.Suppressed = true
		end

		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		local humanoid = character2 and character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local flag17 = humanoid ~= nil and humanoid.Health > 0 and humanoidRootPart ~= nil
		flag16 = flag16 and not flag17

		if flag16 then
			v10.Status = "Died - waiting to respawn..."
		end

		local flag18 = not flag17

		if flag18 then
			GluTryRespawn(os.clock())
		end

		if v10.Reward then
			local reward = v10.Reward
			local now3 = os.clock()

			if not flag17 then
				v10.Status = "Died during a reward pass - waiting to respawn"
				flag16 = flag17
				continue
			end

			v10.CurrentTarget = nil
			GluHold.Pose = false

			if reward.Pos then
				GluParkLoot(reward.Pos)
			end

			local at2 = false
			local flag19 = false

			if reward.Pos then
				pcall(function()
					local at, v15 = Rewards.collectAt(reward.Pos, reward.Radius)
					at2 = at
					flag19 = v15
				end)
			end

			if at2 or flag19 then
				reward.QuietAt = now3
			end

			local flag20 = false

			if reward.Pos then
				pcall(function()
					flag20 = Rewards.hasLeft(reward.Pos, reward.Radius)
				end)
			end

			if flag20 then
				at2 = true
				reward.QuietAt = now3
			end

			local elapsed = now3 - (reward.QuietAt or reward.Since)
			local flag21 = now3 >= reward.Deadline

			if not (flag21 or now3 - reward.Since >= 3.2 and not at2 and elapsed >= 1.4) then
				v10.Status = "Collecting kill rewards (chest/loot/souls)"
				flag16 = flag17
				continue
			end

			if flag21 and at2 then
				v10.Leftover = { Pos = reward.Pos, Radius = reward.Radius, At = now3 }
			else
				v10.Leftover = nil
			end

			v10.Reward = nil
			v10.Rewarding = false
			v10.Status = "Kill rewards collected - moving to the next task"
		end

		v10.Rewarding = false
		local now3 = os.clock()

		if v10.Leftover and now3 >= (v10.LeftoverAt or 0) then
			v10.LeftoverAt = now3 + 2
			local leftover = v10.Leftover

			if now3 - (leftover.At or now3) > 75 or not leftover.Pos then
				v10.Leftover = nil
			else
				local flag19 = false

				pcall(function()
					flag19 = Rewards.hasLeft(leftover.Pos, leftover.Radius)
				end)

				if flag19 then
					pcall(function()
						Rewards.collectAt(leftover.Pos, leftover.Radius)
					end)

					v10.Status = "Collecting rewards left at the last kill spot"
					flag16 = flag17
					continue
				end

				v10.Leftover = nil
			end
		end

		if v10.PendingKill and not v10.Reward then
			local pendingKill = v10.PendingKill
			v10.PendingKill = nil

			v10.Reward = {
				Pos = pendingKill or humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart.Position or nil,
				Radius = 110,
				Since = os.clock(),
				QuietAt = os.clock(),
				Grace = 3.2,
				Deadline = os.clock() + 28,
				Parked = false,
			}

			pcall(function()
				Rewards.resume()
			end)

			v10.Rewards = (v10.Rewards or 0) + 1
			v10.Kills = (v10.Kills or 0) + 1
			v10.Rewarding = true
			v10.Status = "Crow down - collecting chest, loot and souls"
			flag16 = flag17
			continue
		end

		local activeTargetName = v10.getActiveTargetName()

		if activeTargetName then
			v10.CurrentTargetName = activeTargetName
			v10.ActiveQuest = activeTargetName

			if v10.CurrentTarget and fn14(v10.CurrentTarget) then
				local humanoid2 = v10.CurrentTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				v10.Status = string.format(
					"Farming %s | HP %d/%d",
					v10.CurrentTarget.Name,
					humanoid2 and math.floor(humanoid2.Health) or 0,
					humanoid2 and math.floor(humanoid2.MaxHealth) or 0
				)
				flag16 = flag17
				continue
			end

			if v10.CurrentTarget then
				local currentTarget = v10.CurrentTarget
				local flag19 = currentTarget.Parent ~= nil
				local humanoid2 = flag19 and currentTarget:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") or nil

				if not flag19 or humanoid2 ~= nil and humanoid2.Health <= 0 then
					local lastSeen = v10.LastSeen

					if flag19 then
						pcall(function()
							lastSeen = currentTarget:GetPivot().Position or lastSeen
						end)
					end

					v10.PendingKill = v10.PendingKill or lastSeen
					v10.CurrentTarget = nil
					v10.LastSeen = nil
					v10.Status = "Crow down - collecting chest, loot and souls"
					flag16 = flag17
					continue
				end
			end

			if not flag17 then
				v10.Status = "Waiting for respawn..."
				flag16 = flag17
				continue
			end

			local target_, v15 = v10.findTarget(activeTargetName)

			if not target_ then
				local Crow_ = GluBossForQuest("Crow", activeTargetName)

				if Crow_ then
					local v16 = fn19(Crow_)

					if v16 then
						target_ = fn21(Crow_, v16)
						v15 = v16
					end
				end
			end

			if target_ then
				v10.CurrentTarget = target_
				v10.Status = "Farming " .. target_.Name
				flag16 = flag17
				continue
			end

			v10.CurrentTarget = nil

			if v15 then
				if (humanoidRootPart.Position - v15).Magnitude > 20 then
					fn22(v15, 5)
					v10.LastTpName = os.clock()
					v10.Status = "TP to " .. activeTargetName .. " spawn area"
					flag16 = flag17
					continue
				end

				v10.Status = "Camping " .. activeTargetName .. " spawn - waiting for spawn..."
				if not (os.clock() - (v10.LastTpName or 0) > 2) then
					flag16 = flag17
					continue
				end
				v10.LastTpName = os.clock()
				fn22(v15, 5)
				flag16 = flag17
				continue
			end

			v10.Status = "Waiting for " .. activeTargetName .. " to spawn..."
			flag16 = flag17
			continue
		end

		v10.CurrentTarget = nil

		if flag18 then
			v10.Status = "Waiting for respawn..."
			flag16 = flag17
			continue
		end

		v14.pruneTried("Crow")
		local Crow_, v15, lastRarity, v16 = v14.claimFromOffers("Crow", v10.RarityFilter)

		if Crow_ and v15 then
			v10.Claimed += 1
			v10.LastRarity = lastRarity
			v10.ActiveQuest = v16 ~= "" and v16 or tostring(v15)
			v10.Status = string.format("Claim sent: %s [%s]", v10.ActiveQuest, tostring(lastRarity))
			task.wait(0.2)
			flag16 = flag17
			continue
		end

		if not v10.isCrowOpen() then
			if v10.clickHuntCard() then
				v10.Status = "Clicked a hunt card"
				task.wait(0.3)
				flag16 = flag17
				continue
			end

			v10.equipCrow()
			v10.Status = v10.isCrowOpen() and "Opening Crow..." or "Opening Crow (retrying)"
			task.wait(0.2)
			flag16 = flag17
			continue
		end

		task.wait(0.1)

		if v10.claimAny() then
			local remote = fn6()

			if remote then
				pcall(function()
					remote:FireServer("NpcTalking", "Ended")
				end)
			end

			task.wait(0.1)

			if remote then
				pcall(function()
					remote:FireServer("NpcTalking", "Ended")
				end)
			end

			v10.Status = "Claimed - starting next quest..."
			task.wait(0.2)
			flag16 = flag17
			continue
		end

		if v10.allLocked() then
			v10.Status = "Waiting for a claimable hunt (offers are retried)"
		else
			v10.Status = "No claimable hunt in the Crow board"
		end

		task.wait(0.2)
		flag16 = flag17
	end
end)

				end
			elseif state <= 186 then
				if state == 186 then
					currentTarget3 = v11.Rewarding
					state = 187
				end
			elseif state <= 187 then
				if state == 187 then
					if currentTarget3 then
						state = 189
					else
						state = 188
					end
				end
			elseif state == 188 then
				currentTarget3 = v11.PendingKill
				state = 189
			end
		elseif state <= 191 then
			if state <= 189 then
				if state == 189 then
					if currentTarget3 then
						state = 191
					else
						state = 190
					end
				end
			elseif state <= 190 then
				if state == 190 then
					currentTarget3 = v11.Leftover
					state = 191
				end
			elseif state == 191 then
				if currentTarget3 then
					state = 192
				else
					state = 193
				end
			end
		elseif state <= 193 then
			if state <= 192 then
				if state == 192 then
					v11.CurrentTarget = nil
					v11.Reward = nil
					v11.Rewarding = false
					v11.PendingKill = nil
					v11.Leftover = nil
					v11.LeftoverAt = 0
					state = 193
				end
			elseif state == 193 then
				v11.Status = "Waiting - auto boss has the floor"
				state = 2
			end
		elseif state <= 194 then
			if state ~= 194 then
				continue
			end
			v11.Status = "Idle"
			v11.CurrentTarget = nil
			v11.CurrentTargetName = ""
			v11.Reward = nil
			v11.Rewarding = false
			v11.PendingKill = nil
			v11.LastSeen = nil
			v11.Leftover = nil
			v11.LeftoverAt = 0
			v11.Progress = os.clock()
			flag16 = true
			state = 2
		elseif state == 195 then
			return
		end
	end
end

QuestAx = { Index = nil, At = 0, _gate = nil, _sig = nil, _npc = {} }

QuestAx.pos = function(instance)
	if instance == nil then
		return nil
	end

	if typeof(instance) == "Vector3" then
		return instance
	end

	if typeof(instance) == "CFrame" then
		return instance.Position
	end

	if typeof(instance) == "Instance" then
		if instance:IsA("Vector3Value") then
			return instance.Value
		end

		if instance:IsA("CFrameValue") then
			return instance.Value.Position
		end

		if instance:IsA("StringValue") then
			return QuestAx.pos(instance.Value)
		end
		return nil
	end

	if type(instance) == "table" and type(instance[1]) == "number" then
		return Vector3.new(instance[1], instance[2], instance[3])
	end

	if type(instance) == "string" then
		local match, v15, v16 = instance:match("([%-%d%.]+)%s*,%s*([%-%d%.]+)%s*,%s*([%-%d%.]+)")
		if match then
			return Vector3.new(tonumber(match), tonumber(v15), tonumber(v16))
		end
	end

	return nil
end

QuestAx.build = function(arg)
	if QuestAx.Index and not arg and os.clock() - (QuestAx.At or 0) < 180 then
		return QuestAx.Index
	end
	local index = { byName = {}, byCode = {}, byNpc = {}, list = {}, regions = {} }

	pcall(function()
		local ouwland = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Ouwland")
		local content = ouwland and ouwland:FindFirstChild("Content")
		if not content then
			return
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(content:GetChildren()) do
			if not child:IsA("ModuleScript") then
				continue
			end
			local ok, result = pcall(require, child)
			if not (ok and type(result) == "table") then
				continue
			end
			local name = result.Name or child.Name
			index.regions[#index.regions + 1] = name
			local tbl14 = {}

			if type(result.Npcs) == "table" then
				for _, npc in ipairs(result.Npcs) do
					if not (type(npc) == "table" and npc.Name) then
						continue
					end
					local sendOver = npc.SendOver or {}
					local settings_ = sendOver.Settings or {}
					local spawning = sendOver.Spawning or {}

					local tbl15 = {
						name = npc.Name,
						region = name,
						kind = npc.Type,
						code = sendOver.Code,
						npc = settings_.NpcCode,
						at = QuestAx.pos(type(npc.Spawns) == "table" and npc.Spawns[1] or nil),
						locs = {},
						center = QuestAx.pos(spawning.Center),
					}

					if type(spawning.Locations) == "table" then
						for _, location in ipairs(spawning.Locations) do
							local v15 = QuestAx.pos(location)

							if v15 then
								tbl15.locs[#tbl15.locs + 1] = v15
							end
						end
					end

					if not tbl15.center and tbl15.locs[1] then
						local vector = Vector3.zero

						for _, loc in ipairs(tbl15.locs) do
							vector += loc
						end

						tbl15.center = vector / #tbl15.locs
					end

					tbl14[npc.Name] = tbl15

					if type(tbl15.npc) == "string" then
						tbl14[tbl15.npc] = tbl15
					end

					if type(tbl15.code) == "string" then
						tbl14[tbl15.code] = tbl15
					end

					index.byNpc[tbl15.name] = tbl15
				end
			end

			if type(result.Quests) ~= "table" then
				continue
			end

			for k, quest in pairs(result.Quests) do
				if type(quest) ~= "table" then
					continue
				end
				local v15 = tbl14[quest.OfferNpc]

				local tbl15 = {
					name = k,
					region = name,
					cat = quest.Category,
					level = quest.Requirements and quest.Requirements.Level or 0,
					giver = quest.OfferNpc,
					giverAt = v15 and v15.at or nil,
					combatAt = QuestAx.pos(quest.Position),
					hasPower = type(quest.Rewards) == "table" and quest.Rewards.Power ~= nil or false,
					noSave = quest.NoSave == true,
					mobs = {},
					codes = {},
				}

				local questInstance = quest.QuestInstance

				if typeof(questInstance) == "Instance" then
					tbl15.instance = questInstance.Name
					local tasks = questInstance:FindFirstChild("Tasks")

					if tasks then
						for _, child2 in ipairs(tasks:GetChildren()) do
							local code = child2:FindFirstChild("Code")
							local value = code and code.Value or nil

							if type(value) == "string" then
								tbl15.codes[#tbl15.codes + 1] = value
							end

							local flag16 = type(value) == "string" and tbl14[value] or nil

							if flag16 and flag16.kind == 2 then
								tbl15.mobs[#tbl15.mobs + 1] = flag16
								index.byCode[value] = flag16
							end
						end
					end
				end

				index.byName[k] = tbl15
				index.list[#index.list + 1] = tbl15
			end
		end
	end)

	QuestAx.Index = index
	QuestAx.At = os.clock()
	return index
end

QuestAx.actsFor = function(name)
	if not name then
		return nil
	end

	for _, name2 in ipairs({ "Humanoids", "Debree" }) do
		local child = workspace:FindFirstChild(name2)
		local regions = child and child:FindFirstChild("Regions")
		local child2 = regions and regions:FindFirstChild(name)
		local activeNpcs = child2 and child2:FindFirstChild("ActiveNpcs")
		if activeNpcs then
			return activeNpcs
		end
	end

	return nil
end

QuestAx.targets = function(arg)
	local v15 = QuestAx.build()
	local v16 = v15.byName[arg]
	local tbl14 = {}
	local child = getChild(arg)

	if child then
		local tasks = child:FindFirstChild("Tasks")

		if tasks then
			for _, child2 in ipairs(tasks:GetChildren()) do
				local value = child2:FindFirstChild("Value")
				local max = child2:FindFirstChild("Max")

				if value and max and tonumber(value.Value) and tonumber(max.Value) and value.Value < max.Value then
					local code = child2:FindFirstChild("Code")
					local str11 = (code and tostring(code.Value) ~= "" and tostring(code.Value) or child2.Name):gsub(
						"%-AddedByAreaLocator$",
						""
					)

					if str11 ~= "" then
						tbl14[#tbl14 + 1] = str11
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local tbl15 = {}
	local tbl16 = {}

	local function fn36(arg2)
		if arg2 and not tbl16[arg2] then
			tbl16[arg2] = true
			tbl15[#tbl15 + 1] = arg2
		end
	end

	for _, v17 in ipairs(tbl14) do
		local v18 = v15.byCode[v17] or v15.byNpc[v17]

		if v18 and v18.kind ~= 1 then
			fn36(v18)
		end
	end

	if #tbl15 == 0 and v16 then
		for _, mob in ipairs(v16.mobs) do
			fn36(mob)
		end
	end

	return tbl15, v16, tbl14
end

QuestAx.spotFor = function(arg, arg2)
	for _, v15 in ipairs(arg) do
		if v15.center then
			return v15.center
		end
	end

	for _, v15 in ipairs(arg) do
		if v15.locs and v15.locs[1] then
			return v15.locs[1]
		end
	end

	return arg2 and arg2.combatAt or nil
end

QuestAx.liveMobs = function(arg, arg2)
	local tbl14 = {}

	for _, v15 in ipairs(arg) do
		local v16 = fn11(v15.name)

		if v16 ~= "" then
			tbl14[v16] = true
		end
	end

	local instances = {}
	local instances2 = {}

	local function fn36(instance)
		if not instance or instances2[instance] or not instance:IsA("Model") then
			return
		end
		local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
			return
		end
		local v15 = fn11(instance.Name)
		local v16 = fn11(instance:GetAttribute("NpcCode"))
		local flag16 = tbl14[v15] or v16 ~= "" and tbl14[v16]
		local v17

		if not flag16 then
			for k in pairs(tbl14) do
				if #v15 >= 4 and #k >= 4 and (string.find(v15, k, 1, true) or string.find(k, v15, 1, true)) then
					flag16 = true
					break
				end
			end

			v17 = flag16
		else
			v17 = flag16
		end

		if v17 then
			instances2[instance] = true
			instances[#instances + 1] = instance
		end
	end

	local instance = arg2 and QuestAx.actsFor(arg2.region)

	if instance then
		for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			fn36(child)

			for _, child2 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
				fn36(child2)
			end
		end
	end

	if #instances ~= 0 then
		return instances
	end

	for _, instance2 in ipairs(fn18()) do
		for _, child in ipairs(instance2:GetChildren()) do
			fn36(child)

			for _, child2 in ipairs(child:GetChildren()) do
				fn36(child2)
			end
		end
	end

	return instances
end

QuestAx.giverFor = function(arg)
	local v15 = QuestAx.build().byName[arg]
	local giver = v15 and v15.giver or tbl8[arg]
	if v15 and v15.giverAt then
		return v15.giverAt, giver
	end

	if giver and giver ~= "" then
		local v16 = fn4(giver)
		if v16 then
			return v16, giver
		end
		local npc = QuestAx.findNpc(giver)
		if npc then
			return npc, giver
		end
	end

	if v15 and v15.combatAt then
		return v15.combatAt, giver
	end
	return nil, giver
end

QuestAx.findNpc = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
		return nil
	end
	local v15 = fn11(arg)
	local v16 = QuestAx._npc[v15]
	if v16 then
		return v16
	end

	for _, name in ipairs({ "Debree", "Humanoids" }) do
		local child = workspace:FindFirstChild(name)
		local regions = child and child:FindFirstChild("Regions")
		if not regions then
			continue
		end

		for _, child2 in ipairs(regions:GetChildren()) do
			local stationaryNpcs = child2:FindFirstChild("StationaryNpcs")
			if not stationaryNpcs then
				continue
			end

			for _, child3 in ipairs(stationaryNpcs:GetChildren()) do

					local v17 = fn15(child3)

QuestAx.signal = function()
	if QuestAx._sig ~= nil and GluSignal.callable(QuestAx._sig) then
		return QuestAx._sig
	end
	local v15 = GluSignal.resolve()
	QuestAx._sig = v15 ~= nil and v15 or nil
	return QuestAx._sig
end

QuestAx.fire = function(arg, arg2)
	if GluSignal and GluSignal.send then
		local v15

		if arg2 == nil then
			v15 = GluSignal.send(arg)
		else
			v15 = GluSignal.send(arg, arg2)
		end

		if v15 then
			return true
		end
	end

	local v15 = QuestAx.signal()

	if v15 and type(v15.ToServer) == "function" then
		local ok

		if arg2 == nil then
			ok = pcall(v15.ToServer, arg)
		else
			ok = pcall(v15.ToServer, arg, arg2)
		end

		if ok then
			return true
		end
	end

	local remote = fn6()

	if remote then
		local ok

		if arg2 == nil then
			ok = pcall(function()
				remote:FireServer(arg)
			end)
		else
			ok = pcall(function()
				remote:FireServer(arg, arg2)
			end)
		end

		if ok then
			return true
		end
	end

	return false
end

QuestAx.huntCards = function()
	local tbl14 = {}
	local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
	local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local child = data and data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name)
	if not child then
		return tbl14
	end

	local function fn36(instance, arg)
		if arg > 6 then
			return
		end

		for _, child2 in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
			if child2:IsA("Folder") or child2:IsA("Configuration") then
				local id = child2:FindFirstChild("Id")
				local quest = child2:FindFirstChild("Quest")

				if id and id:IsA("ValueBase") and quest and quest:IsA("ValueBase") then
					tbl14[#tbl14 + 1] = { id = id.Value, quest = quest.Value, folder = child2 }
				end

				fn36(child2, arg + 1)
			end
		end
	end

	fn36(child, 0)
	return tbl14
end

QuestAx.Refused = {}

QuestAx.cooldownLeft = function(arg)
	local n16 = 0

	pcall(function()
		local Utility = require(ReplicatedStorage.CAM.Global.Utility)
		local data = Utility.GetData(localPlayer)
		local v15 = QuestAx.gate()
		local questInfo = v15 and type(v15.GetQuestInfo) == "function" and arg and v15.GetQuestInfo(arg) or nil
		n16 = math.max(tonumber(v15 and v15.QuestCD) or 30, tonumber(questInfo and questInfo.AcceptCooldown) or 0)
			- (Utility.Tick() - data.Quests.LastTime.Value)
	end)

	return math.max(0, n16)
end

QuestAx.blocked = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
		return true
	end
	return os.clock() < (QuestAx.Refused[arg] or 0)
end

local function fn36(arg)
	if typeof(arg) ~= "Vector3" then
		return false
	end

	if TeleportFix then
		TeleportFix.HoldUntil = 0
	end

	local v15 = fn22(arg, 3, true, true)

	if TeleportFix then
		TeleportFix.HoldUntil = 0
		TeleportFix.Status = "released"
	end

	return v15
end

QuestAx.accept = function(arg)
	if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
		return false
	end

	if getChild(arg) then
		return true
	end

	if QuestAx.blocked(arg) then
		return false
	end

	if QuestAx.cooldownLeft(arg) > 0.5 then
		return false
	end
	local v15 = QuestAx.gate()

	if v15 and type(v15.CanAddQuest) == "function" then
		local ok, result, result2 = pcall(v15.CanAddQuest, arg)
		if ok and not result and result2 == 2 then
			QuestAx.Refused[arg] = os.clock() + 120
			return false
		end
	end

	local v16 = QuestAx.giverFor(arg)

	if not v16 then
		for _, huntCard in ipairs(QuestAx.huntCards()) do
			if huntCard.quest ~= arg then
				continue
			end
			QuestAx.fire("BossHuntsRequest", { action = "Claim", id = huntCard.id })
			local now3 = os.clock()

			while os.clock() - now3 < 3 do
				if getChild(arg) then
					return true
				end
				task.wait(0.2)
			end
		end

		QuestAx.fire("AddQuest", arg)
		local now3 = os.clock()

		while os.clock() - now3 < 1.6 do
			if getChild(arg) then
				return true
			end
			task.wait(0.2)
		end

		QuestAx.Refused[arg] = os.clock() + 12
		return false
	end

	for i = 1, 3 do
		local v17, v18, v19 = fn13()
		if not v19 then
			return false
		end

		if (v19.Position - v16).Magnitude > 14 then
			fn36(v16)
			task.wait(i == 1 and 0.2 or 0.35)
			fn13()
		end

		QuestAx.fire("AddQuest", arg)
		local now3 = os.clock()

		while os.clock() - now3 < 1.6 do
			if getChild(arg) then
				QuestAx.LastDone = nil
				return true
			end
			task.wait(0.15)
		end
	end

	QuestAx.Refused[arg] = os.clock() + 18
	return false
end

QuestAx.gate = function()
	if QuestAx._gate ~= nil then
		return QuestAx._gate
	end
	local gate = nil

	pcall(function()
		local cam = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CAM")
		local global = cam and cam:FindFirstChild("Global")
		local subsets = global and global:FindFirstChild("Subsets")
		local gameplay = subsets and subsets:FindFirstChild("Gameplay")
		local quests = gameplay and gameplay:FindFirstChild("Quests")

		if quests then
			local ok, result = pcall(require, quests)

			if ok and type(result) == "table" then
				gate = result
			end
		end
	end)

	QuestAx._gate = gate or false
	return QuestAx._gate
end

QuestAx.canAdd = function(arg)
	local v15 = QuestAx.gate()
	if not v15 or type(v15.CanAddQuest) ~= "function" then
		return true
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(v15.CanAddQuest, arg)
	if not ok then
		return true
	end
	return result and true or false
end

QuestAx.next = function()
	if not QuestAx.gate() then
		return nil
	end
	local v15 = QuestAx.build()
	local v16, v17, v18 = fn13()
	local position = v18 and v18.Position or nil
	local lastDone2 = QuestAx.LastDone
	local v19, v20, v21 = ipairs(v15.list)
	local v22 = nil
	local v23 = nil
	local magnitude2 = nil
	local v24 = nil

	for _, v25 in v19, v20, v21 do
		local n16 = tonumber(v25.level) or 0
		local cat = v25.cat
		if
			not (
				n16 >= 0
				and (cat == nil or cat == "Combat")
				and v25.giver
				and not v25.hasPower
				and not v25.noSave
				and not QuestAx.blocked(v25.name)
			)
		then
			continue
		end

		if not QuestAx.canAdd(v25.name) then
			continue
		end
		local giverAt = position and v25.giverAt
		local magnitude = math.huge

		if giverAt then
			magnitude = (v25.giverAt - position).Magnitude
		end

		if v25.name == lastDone2 then
			v22 = v22 or v25
		elseif not v23 or n16 > v23 or n16 == v23 and magnitude < (magnitude2 or math.huge) then
			v23 = n16
			magnitude2 = magnitude
			v24 = v25
		end
	end

	return v24 or v22
end

	local function fn37(instance)
		if not instance then
			return nil
		end

		if instance:IsA("ValueBase") and type(instance.Value) == "number" then
			return instance.Value
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function fn38(match)
		if not match or match == "" then
			return nil
		end

		if matches[match] then
			return matches[match]
		end
		local bossFolderAnywhere = findBossFolderAnywhere(match)
		if not bossFolderAnywhere then
			return nil
		end
		local bossInfo = bossFolderAnywhere:FindFirstChild("BossInfo")
		if not bossInfo then
			return nil
		end
		local attribute = bossInfo:GetAttribute("SpawnTime")
		if type(attribute) == "number" and attribute > 0 then
			matches[match] = attribute
			return attribute
		end

		for k, attribute2 in pairs(bossInfo:GetAttributes()) do
			if string.lower(k) == "spawntime" and type(attribute2) == "number" and attribute2 > 0 then
				matches[match] = attribute2
				return attribute2
			end
		end

		for _, child in ipairs(bossInfo:GetChildren()) do
			if string.lower(child.Name) ~= "spawntime" then
				continue
			end
			local v15 = fn37(child)
			if v15 and v15 > 0 then
				matches[match] = v15
				return v15
			end
		end

		for _, descendant in ipairs(bossInfo:GetDescendants()) do
			if string.lower(descendant.Name) ~= "spawntime" then
				continue
			end
			local v15 = fn37(descendant)
			if v15 and v15 > 0 then
				matches[match] = v15
				return v15
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	local function fn39(match, now3)
		local v15 = fn38(match)
		if not v15 then
			return nil
		end
		local v16 = tbl14[match]
		if not v16 then
			return nil
		end
		return math.max(0, v16 + v15 - now3)
	end

	local function fn40(arg, distance)
		if not arg then
			return 0
		end
		local count4 = 0
		local instances = {}

		local function fn41(instance)
			if not instance or not instance.Parent or instances[instance] then
				return
			end
			instances[instance] = true
			if not DropOwner.isOurs(instance) then
				return
			end
			local position

			if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
				position = instance.Position
			elseif instance:IsA("Model") then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return instance:GetPivot()
				end)

				position = nil

				if ok then
					position = result.Position
				end
			else
				position = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
				position = position and position.Position or nil
			end

			if position and (position - arg).Magnitude <= distance then
				count4 += 1
			end
		end

		local lootDrops = workspace:FindFirstChild("LootDrops")

		if lootDrops then
			for _, child in ipairs(lootDrops:GetChildren()) do
				fn41(child)
			end
		end

		pcall(function()
			for _, v15 in ipairs(game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("LootDrop")) do
				fn41(v15)
			end
		end)

		return count4
	end

				BossRestarts = (BossRestarts or 0) + 1
				BossLoopGen = (BossLoopGen or 0) + 1

local scan

do
	local function getActiveNpcs2()
		local humanoids = workspace:FindFirstChild("Humanoids")
		local regions = humanoids and humanoids:FindFirstChild("Regions")
		local temporary = regions and regions:FindFirstChild("Temporary")
		return temporary and temporary:FindFirstChild("ActiveNpcs")
	end

	local tbl19 = { at = 0, list = {} }

	local function fn37(instance)
		local parent = instance.Parent

		while parent and parent ~= workspace do
			if string.find(string.lower(parent.Name), "stationary", 1, true) then
				return true
			end
			parent = parent.Parent
		end

		return false
	end

	local function getList()
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if now3 - tbl19.at < 1.5 then

					end

			end

	end

	local function fn39()

	local function fn40()
		if not flag8 or not flag3 then
			if flag9 then
				fn37()
			end

			tbl5.SafeLastHP = 0
			return false
		end

		local v15
		v15, v15 = fn13()
		if not v15 or v15.MaxHealth <= 0 then
			return flag9
		end
		local safeLastHP = v15.Health / v15.MaxHealth * 100

		local function fn41()
			local v16
			v16, v16 = fn13()
			if not v16 or v16.MaxHealth <= 0 then
				return safeLastHP
			end
			return v16.Health / v16.MaxHealth * 100
		end

		if flag9 then
			if n6 <= safeLastHP then
				local safeHoldAt = tbl5.SafeHoldAt or 0

				if safeHoldAt == 0 then
					tbl5.SafeHoldAt = os.clock()
					str7 = string.format("Recovering - holding at %.0f%%", safeLastHP)
				elseif (tbl5.SafeHold or 1.2) <= os.clock() - safeHoldAt then
					fn37()
					str7 = "Safe mode cleared - resuming farm"
					return false
				end
			else
				tbl5.SafeHoldAt = 0
			end

			if tbl5.PotionOn and safeLastHP < n6 then
				tbl5.tryDrinkPotion(true)
			end

			local v16, v17, part = fn13()

			if part and tbl4 then
				local pos = tbl4.Pos

				if (part.Position - pos).Magnitude > 12 then
					pcall(function()
						part.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						part.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

						if v16 and GluHold and GluHold.go then
							GluHold.go(CFrame.new(pos))
						elseif v16 then
							v16:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos))
						else
							part.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos)
						end
					end)
				end
			end

			tbl5.SafeLastHP = safeLastHP
			return true
		end

		if os.clock() < (tbl5.SafeResumeAt or 0) then
			tbl5.SafeHoldAt = 0
			tbl5.SafeLastHP = safeLastHP
			return false
		end

		if
			tbl5.SafeLastHP > 0
			and tbl5.SafeLastHP - safeLastHP >= tbl5.SafePanic
			and safeLastHP <= tbl5.SafePanicMax
		then
			tbl5.SafeLastHP = safeLastHP

			if tbl5.PotionOn then
				tbl5.tryDrinkPotion(true)
				if fn41() > n5 then
					return false
				end
			end

			fn39()
			str7 = string.format("SAFE MODE (panic): HP %.0f%%", safeLastHP)
			return true
		end

		if safeLastHP <= n5 then
			tbl5.SafeLastHP = safeLastHP

			if tbl5.PotionOn then
				tbl5.tryDrinkPotion(true)
				if n5 < fn41() then
					return false
				end
			end

			fn39()
			return true
		end

		tbl5.SafeLastHP = safeLastHP
		return false
	end

	tbl5.startFarm = function()
