	tbl5.findOuwigaharaCaches = function()
		local instances = {}
		local instances2 = {}

		local function getOk2(tag)
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return game:GetService("CollectionService"):HasTag(tag, "Chest")
			end)

			return ok and result
		end

		local function getOk3(instance)
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true) ~= nil
					or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ClickDetector", true) ~= nil
			end)

			return ok and result
		end

		local function fn41(instance)
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				return string.lower(tostring(instance.Name))
			end)

			if not ok or not result then
				return true
			end
			return string.find(result, "partcache", 1, true) ~= nil
		end

		local function fn42(instance, arg)
			if not instance or instances2[instance] or not instance.Parent then
				return
			end

			if not (instance:IsA("Model") or instance:IsA("BasePart")) then
				return
			end

			if fn41(instance) then
				return
			end

			if not arg then
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return string.lower(tostring(instance.Name))
				end)

				if not ok or not result then
					return
				end
				local flag16 = string.find(result, "chest", 1, true) ~= nil
					or string.find(result, "ouwigahara", 1, true) ~= nil
					or string.find(result, "cache", 1, true) ~= nil
				if not (getOk2(instance) or getOk3(instance) or flag16) then
					return
				end
			end

			instances2[instance] = true
			instances[#instances + 1] = instance
		end

		local function fn43(instance, arg)
			if not instance then
				return
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("Model") or child:IsA("BasePart") then
					fn42(child, arg)
				end
			end
		end

		fn43(workspace:FindFirstChild("Chests"), true)
		local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")
		fn43(debree and debree:FindFirstChild("Chests"), true)

		for _, instance in ipairs({ workspace, debree }) do
			if not instance then
				continue
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
				local v15 = string.lower(tostring(child.Name))

				if not string.find(v15, "partcache", 1, true) then
					if
						string.find(v15, "chest", 1, true)
						or string.find(v15, "cache", 1, true)
						or string.find(v15, "loot", 1, true)
						or string.find(v15, "ouwigahara", 1, true)
					then
						fn43(child)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		pcall(function()
			for _, v15 in ipairs(game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("Chest")) do
				fn42(v15, true)
			end
		end)

		table.sort(instances, function(arg, arg2)
			local v15 = string.lower(tostring(arg.Name))
			local v16 = string.lower(tostring(arg2.Name))
			local n16 = string.find(v15, "ouwigahara", 1, true) and 1 or 0
			local n17 = string.find(v16, "ouwigahara", 1, true) and 1 or 0
			if n16 ~= n17 then
				return n16 > n17
			end
			return v15 < v16
		end)

		return instances
	end

	tbl5.getCachePrompt = function(instance)
		if not instance or not instance.Parent then
			return nil
		end
		local rootPart = instance:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
		local chestPromptAnchor = rootPart and rootPart:FindFirstChild("ChestPromptAnchor")
		local chestPrompt = chestPromptAnchor and chestPromptAnchor:FindFirstChild("ChestPrompt")
		if chestPrompt and chestPrompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			return chestPrompt
		end
		local chestPrompt2 = instance:FindFirstChild("ChestPrompt", true)
		if chestPrompt2 and chestPrompt2:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
			return chestPrompt2
		end
		return instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
	end

	tbl5.lootReach = function(arg, arg2)
		if typeof(arg) ~= "Vector3" then
			return false
		end
		return GluLoot.moveTo(GluLootStand(arg, localPlayer.Character) or arg + Vector3.new(0, arg2 or 3, 0), 1.2)
	end

	tbl5.firePromptBoth = function(instance, arg)
		if not instance or not instance.Parent then
			return false
		end

		if GluPrompt.Instant then
			return GluPrompt.fire(instance, { pin = true, min = 0.05, max = 3, duration = 1 })
		end
		return GluPrompt.fire(instance, { pin = true, hold = tonumber(arg), min = 0.05, max = 3, duration = 1 })
	end

	tbl5.runChestPass = function()
		if not flag3 then
			return 0, 0
		end
		local v15, v16, v17 = fn13()
		if not v17 then
			return 0, 0
		end
		local count4 = 0

		for _, ouwigaharaCach in ipairs(tbl5.findOuwigaharaCaches()) do
			if not flag3 then
				break
			end

			if not ouwigaharaCach.Parent then
				continue
			end
			local attemptedCach = tbl5.AttemptedCaches[ouwigaharaCach]

			if type(attemptedCach) ~= "table" then
				attemptedCach = { Done = false, Tries = 0, NextAt = 0 }
				tbl5.AttemptedCaches[ouwigaharaCach] = attemptedCach
			end

			if attemptedCach.Done or os.clock() < (attemptedCach.NextAt or 0) then
				continue
			end
			local rootPart = ouwigaharaCach:FindFirstChild("RootPart")
			local position

			if rootPart and rootPart:IsA("BasePart") then
				position = rootPart.Position
			else
				position = fn15(ouwigaharaCach)
				position = position and position.Position
			end

			if not position then
				continue
			end
			tbl5.lootReach(position, 3)
			task.wait(0.04)
			local cachePrompt = tbl5.getCachePrompt(ouwigaharaCach)

			if not cachePrompt or not cachePrompt.Parent then
				tbl5.lootReach(position, 3)
				task.wait(0.04)

				if OpenAnyContainer(ouwigaharaCach) then
					task.wait(0.25)

					if not ouwigaharaCach.Parent then
						attemptedCach.Done = true
						attemptedCach.NextAt = 0
						tbl5.OpenedCaches = (tbl5.OpenedCaches or 0) + 1
						count4 += 1
					end
				end

				if not attemptedCach.Done then
					attemptedCach.Tries = (attemptedCach.Tries or 0) + 1
					attemptedCach.NextAt = os.clock() + 0.8
				end
			else
				if not (cachePrompt and cachePrompt.Parent) then
					continue
				end
				tbl5.firePromptBoth(cachePrompt)
				task.wait(0.15)

				if not ouwigaharaCach.Parent or not cachePrompt.Parent or cachePrompt.Enabled == false then
					attemptedCach.Done = true
					attemptedCach.NextAt = 0
					tbl5.OpenedCaches = (tbl5.OpenedCaches or 0) + 1
					count4 += 1
				else
					attemptedCach.Tries = (attemptedCach.Tries or 0) + 1

					if attemptedCach.Tries >= 4 then
						attemptedCach.Done = true
						tbl5.ChestStatus = string.format(
							"%s would not open after %d tries",
							tostring(ouwigaharaCach.Name),
							attemptedCach.Tries
						)
					else
						attemptedCach.NextAt = os.clock() + 0.8
					end
				end

				task.wait(0.15)
			end
		end

		local childrens = {}
		local lootDrops = workspace:FindFirstChild("LootDrops")

		if lootDrops then
			childrens[#childrens + 1] = lootDrops:GetChildren()
		end

		pcall(function()
			local tagged = game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("LootDrop")

			if #tagged > 0 then
				childrens[#childrens + 1] = tagged
			end
		end)

		local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")

		if debree then
			local children = {}

			for _, child in ipairs(debree:GetChildren()) do
				local v18 = string.lower(tostring(child.Name))

				if not string.find(v18, "partcache", 1, true) then
					if
						string.find(v18, "drop", 1, true)
						or string.find(v18, "loot", 1, true)
						or string.find(v18, "cache", 1, true)
					then
						children[#children + 1] = child
					end
				end
			end

			if #children > 0 then
				childrens[#childrens + 1] = children
			end
		end

		local count5 = 0

		for _, children in ipairs(childrens) do
			for _, child in ipairs(children) do
				if not flag3 then
					break
				end

				if not child.Parent then
					continue
				end
				local tbl19 = tbl5.LootedDropSet[child]

				if type(tbl19) ~= "table" then
					tbl19 = { Done = false, Tries = 0, NextAt = 0 }
					tbl5.LootedDropSet[child] = tbl19
				end

				if tbl19.Done or os.clock() < (tbl19.NextAt or 0) then
					continue
				end

				if not DropOwner.isOurs(child) then
					continue
				end
				local position

				if child:IsA("BasePart") then
					position = child.Position
				else
					local v18 = fn15(child)
					position = v18 and v18.Position
				end

				if not position then
					continue
				end
				local lootDropPrompt = child:FindFirstChild("LootDropPrompt")

				if not (lootDropPrompt and lootDropPrompt:IsA("ProximityPrompt")) then
					lootDropPrompt = child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
				end

				if not (lootDropPrompt and lootDropPrompt.Parent) then
					tbl5.lootReach(position, 2)
					task.wait(0.04)

					if OpenAnyContainer(child) then
						task.wait(0.25)

						if not child.Parent then
							tbl19.Done = true
							tbl19.NextAt = 0
							tbl5.LootedDrops = (tbl5.LootedDrops or 0) + 1

							pcall(function()
								GluWebhook.noteDrop(child, "dungeon")
							end)

							count5 += 1
						end
					end

					if not tbl19.Done then
						tbl19.Tries = (tbl19.Tries or 0) + 1

						if tbl19.Tries >= 4 then
							tbl19.Done = true
						else
							tbl19.NextAt = os.clock() + 0.8
						end
					end
				else
					tbl5.lootReach(position, 2)
					task.wait(0.04)
					tbl5.firePromptBoth(lootDropPrompt)
					task.wait(0.12)

					if not child.Parent or not lootDropPrompt.Parent or lootDropPrompt.Enabled == false then
						tbl19.Done = true
						tbl19.NextAt = 0
						tbl5.LootedDrops = (tbl5.LootedDrops or 0) + 1

						pcall(function()
							GluWebhook.noteDrop(child, "dungeon")
						end)

						count5 += 1
					else
						tbl19.Tries = (tbl19.Tries or 0) + 1

						if tbl19.Tries >= 4 then
							tbl19.Done = true
						else
							tbl19.NextAt = os.clock() + 0.6
						end
					end

					task.wait(0.05)
				end
			end
		end

		return count4, count5
	end

	tbl5.findReturnButton = function()
		local mainNotificationFrames = {}
		local componentsHolder = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ComponentsHolder")
		local mainNotificationFrame = componentsHolder and componentsHolder:FindFirstChild("MainNotificationFrame")

		if mainNotificationFrame then
			mainNotificationFrames[#mainNotificationFrames + 1] = mainNotificationFrame
		end

		local dungeonBar = tbl5.getDungeonBar()

		if dungeonBar then
			mainNotificationFrames[#mainNotificationFrames + 1] = dungeonBar
		end

		for _, mainNotificationFrame2 in ipairs(mainNotificationFrames) do
			for _, descendant in ipairs(mainNotificationFrame2:GetDescendants()) do
				if not descendant:IsA("GuiButton") then
					continue
				end
				local visible = true

				pcall(function()
					visible = descendant.Visible
				end)

				if visible then
					local str11 = ""

					pcall(function()
						str11 = tostring(descendant.Text or "")
					end)

					local v15 = string.lower(descendant.Name .. " " .. str11)
					if
						string.find(v15, "return", 1, true)
						or string.find(v15, "leave", 1, true)
						or string.find(v15, "exit", 1, true)
						or string.find(v15, "back to", 1, true)
						or string.find(v15, "lobby", 1, true)
					then
						return descendant
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	tbl5.teleportToMainMenu = function()
		if tbl5.TeleportFired then
			return true
		end
		local returnButton = tbl5.findReturnButton()

		if returnButton then
			if os.clock() - (tbl5.ReturnPressedAt or 0) >= 5 then
				tbl5.ReturnPressedAt = os.clock()
				local ok = false

				if type(firesignal) == "function" then
					ok = pcall(function()
						firesignal(returnButton.MouseButton1Click)
					end)
				end

				if not ok then
					pcall(function()
						returnButton:Activate()
					end)
				end
			end

			tbl5.ChestStatus = "Press the game's own return control - waiting for it"
			return false
		end

		if not World.MenuId or World.MenuId == 0 then
			tbl5.ChestStatus = "No lobby place id - waiting for the game to return"
			return false
		end
		local communication = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Communication")
		local serverAndClient = communication and communication:FindFirstChild("ServerAndClient")
		local signals = serverAndClient and serverAndClient:FindFirstChild("Signals")
		local signalFunction = signals and signals:FindFirstChild("SignalFunction")
		local function_ = signalFunction and signalFunction:FindFirstChild("Function")
		if not function_ then
			tbl5.ChestStatus = "TeleportServer remote missing"
			return false
		end

		if
			pcall(function()
				function_:InvokeServer("TeleportServer", { placeId = World.MenuId, allowFallback = true })
			end)
		then
			tbl5.TeleportFired = true
			tbl5.ChestStatus = "Return requested - waiting for the lobby"
			return true
		end

		tbl5.ChestStatus = "TeleportServer failed"
		return false
	end

	tbl5.resetLootPhase = function(chestStatus)
		if tbl5.ChestPhase == "looting" then
			pcall(function()
				GluWebhook.dungeonEnd(chestStatus)
			end)
		end

		tbl5.ChestPhase = "idle"
		tbl5.ChestPhaseAt = 0
		tbl5.NoCacheSince = 0
		tbl5.NoDropSince = 0
		tbl5.TeleportFired = false
		tbl5.TeleportTryAt = 0
		tbl5.TeleportTries = 0
		tbl5.NoBarSince = 0
		tbl5.AttemptedCaches = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		tbl5.LootedDropSet = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

		if chestStatus then
			tbl5.ChestStatus = chestStatus
		end
	end

	tbl5.returnAttempt = function(teleportTryAt)
		if teleportTryAt - (tbl5.TeleportTryAt or 0) < 3 then
			return
		end
		tbl5.TeleportTryAt = teleportTryAt
		tbl5.TeleportTries = (tbl5.TeleportTries or 0) + 1
		tbl5.teleportToMainMenu()

		if tbl5.TeleportTries >= 40 and not tbl5.TeleportFired then
			tbl5.resetLootPhase("Return not confirmed after 2 minutes - resuming the farm")
		end
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while task.wait(0.15) do
			if not flag3 then
				tbl5.resetLootPhase("idle")
				continue
			end
			local now3 = os.clock()
			local dungeonBar = tbl5.getDungeonBar()
			local v15 = tbl5.isDungeonDone()
			local isDungeon = World.IsDungeon or tbl5.inDungeon()

			if dungeonBar then
				tbl5.NoBarSince = 0
			elseif tbl5.NoBarSince == 0 then
				tbl5.NoBarSince = now3
			end

			if not (v15 or tbl5.SawRun and not dungeonBar and isDungeon and now3 - (tbl5.NoBarSince or now3) >= 2) then
				if tbl5.ChestPhase ~= "idle" then
					tbl5.resetLootPhase()
				end

				continue
			end

			if tbl5.ChestPhase == "idle" then
				tbl5.ChestPhase = "looting"

				pcall(function()
					GluWebhook.dungeonCleared()
				end)

				tbl5.ChestPhaseAt = now3
				tbl5.NoCacheSince = 0
				tbl5.NoDropSince = 0
				tbl5.ChestStatus = "Dungeon complete - scanning caches..."
			end

			if not tbl5.AutoChestDungeon then
				tbl5.ChestStatus = "Dungeon complete - returning to menu"

				if not tbl5.TeleportFired and now3 - tbl5.ChestPhaseAt > 2 then
					tbl5.returnAttempt(now3)
				end

				continue
			end

			local v16
			v16, v16 = fn13()

			if not (v16 ~= nil and v16.Health > 0) then
				if now3 - tbl5.ChestPhaseAt < (tbl5.LootMax or 120) then
					tbl5.ChestStatus = "Waiting to respawn before looting the caches"
				else
					tbl5.returnAttempt(now3)
				end

				continue
			end

			local v17, v18 = tbl5.runChestPass()
			local count4 = 0

			for _, ouwigaharaCach in ipairs(tbl5.findOuwigaharaCaches()) do
				local attemptedCach = tbl5.AttemptedCaches[ouwigaharaCach]

				if not (type(attemptedCach) == "table" and (attemptedCach.Done or (attemptedCach.Tries or 0) >= 4)) then
					count4 += 1
				end
			end

			local lootDrops = workspace:FindFirstChild("LootDrops")
			local count5 = 0

			if lootDrops then
				count5 = 0

				for _, child in ipairs(lootDrops:GetChildren()) do
					local v19 = tbl5.LootedDropSet[child]

					if not (type(v19) == "table" and v19.Done) then
						count5 += 1
					end
				end
			end

			tbl5.ChestStatus = string.format(
				"caches left: %d | drops left: %d | opened: %d | looted: %d",
				count4,
				count5,
				tbl5.OpenedCaches or 0,
				tbl5.LootedDrops or 0
			)

			if v17 > 0 or v18 > 0 then
				tbl5.NoCacheSince = 0
				tbl5.NoDropSince = 0
			else
				if count4 ~= 0 or count5 ~= 0 then
					tbl5.NoCacheSince = 0
					tbl5.NoDropSince = 0
					continue
				end

				if tbl5.NoCacheSince == 0 then
					tbl5.NoCacheSince = now3
				end

				local elapsed = now3 - tbl5.NoCacheSince
				local elapsed2 = now3 - tbl5.ChestPhaseAt

				if elapsed >= 8 and elapsed2 >= (tbl5.LootMin or 25) or elapsed2 >= (tbl5.LootMax or 120) then
					tbl5.returnAttempt(now3)

					pcall(function()
						GluWebhook.dungeonEnd("looted")
					end)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	tbl5.farmTick = function()
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if tbl5.ChestPhase ~= "idle" then
			str7 = "Looting caches..."
			return
		end

		if not tbl5.getDungeonBar() then
			if tbl5.activeNpcsStarted() then
				str7 = "Dungeon already started - no queue needed"
				return
			end
			local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
			local minigameMap = map and map:FindFirstChild("Minigame Map")
			local startPad = minigameMap and minigameMap:FindFirstChild("StartPad")
			if not startPad then
				str7 = "Waiting for Minigame Map.StartPad..."
				return
			end
			character = localPlayer.Character
			if not character then
				str7 = "Waiting for character"
				return
			end
			local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not humanoidRootPart then
				str7 = "Waiting for root"
				return
			end
			local cframe = nil

			if startPad:IsA("BasePart") then
				cframe = startPad.CFrame
			else
				local ok, result = pcall(function()
					return startPad:GetPivot()
				end)

				if ok and result then
					cframe = result
				end

				if not cframe then
					local v15 = fn15(startPad)

					if v15 then
						cframe = v15.CFrame
					end
				end
			end

			if not cframe then
				str7 = "StartPad has no pivot"
				return
			end

			if (humanoidRootPart.Position - cframe.Position).Magnitude > 8 then
				Aim.TeleportedAt = os.clock()

				if GluHold and GluHold.go then
					GluHold.go(cframe + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
				else
					pcall(function()
						character:PivotTo(cframe + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
						humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
						humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					end)
				end

				str7 = "Teleported to StartPad"
				return
			end

			task.wait(0.12)
			local readyUp = startPad:FindFirstChild("ReadyUp")

			if not (readyUp and readyUp:IsA("ProximityPrompt")) then
				readyUp = startPad:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
			end

			if readyUp and readyUp.Enabled then
				tbl5.firePromptBoth(readyUp, 0.2)
				str7 = "On StartPad - fired ReadyUp"
			else
				str7 = "On StartPad - ReadyUp not enabled yet"
			end

			return
		end

		if fn40() then
			tbl5.SafeSince = tbl5.SafeSince ~= 0 and tbl5.SafeSince or now3
			local elapsed = now3 - tbl5.SafeSince
			local v15
			v15, v15 = fn13()
			local n16 = v15 and v15.MaxHealth > 0 and v15.Health / v15.MaxHealth * 100 or 0

			if (tbl5.SafeMax or 25) < elapsed then
				local potionSlot, v16, v17 = tbl5.findPotionSlot()

				if n16 >= n5 or not (tbl5.PotionOn and (v17 or 0) > 0) then
					tbl5.SafeForced = (tbl5.SafeForced or 0) + 1
					tbl5.SafeSince = 0
					fn37()
					str7 = "Safe mode held too long - farming anyway"
					return
				end

				tbl5.SafeSince = now3
				elapsed = 0
			end

			str7 = string.format(
				"SAFE MODE: HP %.0f%% - healing up (farming again in %.0fs)",
				n16,
				math.max(0, (tbl5.SafeMax or 25) - elapsed)
			)
			return
		end

		tbl5.SafeSince = 0

		if v3.routeBusy() then
			if (tbl5.RouteSince or 0) == 0 then
				tbl5.RouteSince = now3
				str7 = "Paused for loot..."
				return
			end

			if (tbl5.RouteMax or 15) < now3 - tbl5.RouteSince then
				tbl5.RouteBreaks = (tbl5.RouteBreaks or 0) + 1
				tbl5.RouteSince = 0
				tbl5.RouteIgnore = now3 + 5
				str7 = "Loot route held too long - farming anyway"
				return
			end

			str7 = string.format("Paused for loot (%.0fs)", now3 - tbl5.RouteSince)
			return
		end

		if now3 < (tbl5.RouteIgnore or 0) then
			return
		end
		tbl5.RouteSince = 0
		character = localPlayer.Character
		if not character then
			str7 = "Waiting for character"
			return
		end

		if not character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
			str7 = "Waiting for root"
			return
		end
		local instance = instance5
		local instance2 = instance5

		if instance then
			instance2 = not tbl5.alive(instance)
		end

		if instance2 then
			kills += 1

			pcall(function()
				GluWebhook.dungeonKill()
			end)

			tbl5.LastKillAt = now3
			tbl5.LastDamageAt = now3
			instance5 = nil
			instance = nil
		end

		if instance then
			if (tbl5.TargetSince or 0) == 0 then
				tbl5.TargetSince = now3
			end

			local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local health = humanoid and humanoid.Health or nil

			if health and (tbl5.TargetHP == nil or health < tbl5.TargetHP - 0.01) then
				if tbl5.TargetHP ~= nil then
					tbl5.LastDamageAt = now3
				end

				tbl5.TargetHP = health
				tbl5.TargetSince = now3
			elseif (tbl5.TargetMax or 20) < now3 - tbl5.TargetSince then
				tbl5.SkipUntil[instance] = now3 + 45
				tbl5.Retired = (tbl5.Retired or 0) + 1
				str7 = string.format("%s took no damage - moving to the next mob (%d)", instance.Name, tbl5.Retired)
				instance5 = nil
				instance = nil
			end
		end

		if not instance then
			local v15 = scan()

			if #v15 == 0 then
				tbl5.TargetSince = 0
				tbl5.TargetHP = nil
				str7 = string.format("Waiting for dungeon NPCs... (kills: %d)", kills or 0)
				return
			end

			instance = nearest(v15)
			if not instance then
				str7 = "Every mob here is on a cooldown - retrying"
				return
			end
			instance5 = instance
			tbl5.TargetSince = now3
			tbl5.TargetHP = nil
			local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

			if humanoid then
				tbl5.TargetHP = humanoid.Health
			end
		end

		if not instance or not instance.Parent then
			str7 = "No target"
			return
		end

		if (tbl5.LastDamageAt or 0) == 0 then
			tbl5.LastDamageAt = now3
		end

		if now3 - tbl5.LastDamageAt > 12 then
			if (tbl5.DryAt or 0) == 0 then
				tbl5.DryAt = now3
				tbl5.Dry = (tbl5.Dry or 0) + 1
				tbl5.EquipAt = 0

				pcall(function()
					v:Warn("Dungeon", "No damage landing for 12s - re-asserting the weapon", 3)
				end)
			end
		else
			tbl5.DryAt = 0
		end

		if Souls and Souls.held and Souls.held() then
			str7 = "Standing on a soul..."
			return
		end
		local v15 = SafePivot(instance)

		if not v15 then
			instance5 = nil
			str7 = "Target streamed out - re-scanning"
			return
		end

		GluSnap((tbl11[tbl5.FarmType] or tbl11[str6] or tbl11.Under)(v15, fn32(tbl5.FarmDistance or n4)))
		local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local n16 = (tbl5.Errors or 0) + (M1.Errors or 0) + (tbl5.IkErrors or 0)
		local recoveries = tbl5.Recoveries or 0
		str7 = string.format("Attacking %s | HP %s", instance.Name, humanoid and math.floor(humanoid.Health) or "?")
	end
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(2) do
		if flag3 then
			if not tbl5.Running or os.clock() - (tbl5.Beat or 0) > 10 then
				tbl5.Recoveries = (tbl5.Recoveries or 0) + 1
				tbl5.startFarm()
				str7 = string.format("Farm restarted (%d)", tbl5.Recoveries)
			end
		end
	end
end)

tbl5.startFarm()

tbl5.getDungeonBar = function()
	local componentsHolder = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ComponentsHolder")
	if not componentsHolder then
		return nil
	end
	local mainNotificationFrame = componentsHolder:FindFirstChild("MainNotificationFrame")
	if not mainNotificationFrame then
		return nil
	end
	return mainNotificationFrame:FindFirstChild("OuwigaharaTopBar")
end

tbl5.getQueueRemote = function()
	local communication = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Communication")
	local serverAndClient = communication and communication:FindFirstChild("ServerAndClient")
	local signals = serverAndClient and serverAndClient:FindFirstChild("Signals")
	local queueSignal = signals and signals:FindFirstChild("QueueSignal")
	if not queueSignal then
		return nil
	end

	if tbl5.QueueSignal == nil then
		local module = nil

		tbl5.QueueSignal = pcall(function()
			module = require(queueSignal)
		end) and module or false
	end

	local queueSignal2 = tbl5.QueueSignal
	if queueSignal2 and type(queueSignal2.ToServer) == "function" then
		return queueSignal2, "module"
	end
	local function_ = queueSignal:FindFirstChild("Function")
	if function_ and (function_:IsA("RemoteFunction") or function_:IsA("UnreliableRemoteEvent")) then
		return function_, "remote"
	end
	return nil
end

tbl5.queueDungeon = function()
	if os.clock() - tbl5.QueueLast < tbl5.QueueCd then
		return false
	end
	local queueRemote, v15 = tbl5.getQueueRemote()
	if not queueRemote then
		tbl5.QueueState = "no queue remote"
		return false
	end
	tbl5.QueueLast = os.clock()

	if v15 == "module" then
		if not pcall(queueRemote.ToServer, "Queue", "Normal", false, false) then
			tbl5.QueueState = "queue call failed"
			return false
		end
	elseif not pcall(function()
		queueRemote:InvokeServer(queueRemote, "Queue", "Normal", false, false)
	end) then
		tbl5.QueueState = "queue call failed"
		return false
	end

	tbl5.QueueQueued = true
	tbl5.QueueState = "queued"
	return true
end

tbl5.getReadyPrompt = function()
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	local minigameMap = map and map:FindFirstChild("Minigame Map")
	local startPad = minigameMap and minigameMap:FindFirstChild("StartPad")
	if not startPad then
		return nil
	end
	local readyUp = startPad:FindFirstChild("ReadyUp")
	if readyUp and readyUp:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
		return readyUp
	end
	return startPad:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
end

tbl5.readyUp = function()
	local readyPrompt = tbl5.getReadyPrompt()
	if not readyPrompt or not readyPrompt.Enabled then
		return false
	end

	if os.clock() - tbl5.ReadyLast < tbl5.ReadyCd then
		return false
	end
	tbl5.ReadyLast = os.clock()
	local ok = false

	if fireproximityprompt then
		ok = pcall(fireproximityprompt, readyPrompt)
	end

	ok = ok
		or pcall(function()
			readyPrompt.HoldDuration = 0

			if readyPrompt.InputHoldBegin then
				firesignal(readyPrompt.InputHoldBegin)
			end

			firesignal(readyPrompt.Triggered, localPlayer)
		end)

	if ok then
		tbl5.QueueState = "readied"
	end

	return ok
end

tbl5.tryQueue = function(arg)
	if tbl5.getDungeonBar() then
		tbl5.QueueQueued = false
		tbl5.QueueState = "in dungeon"
		return false
	end

	if arg then
		tbl5.QueueLast = 0
		tbl5.ReadyLast = 0
		tbl5.QueueQueued = false
	end

	if tbl5.readyUp() then
		tbl5.QueueQueued = false
		return true
	end

	if not tbl5.QueueQueued then
		return tbl5.queueDungeon()
	end
	return false
end

tbl5.farmWanted = function()
	if flag3 then
		return false
	end

	if not World.IsDungeon then
		return false
	end

	if (tbl5.AdoptUntil or 0) < os.clock() then
		return false
	end
	local gluDungeon = Toggles and Toggles.glu_dungeon
	if not gluDungeon then
		return false
	end
	local toggled = gluDungeon.Value

	if toggled == nil then
		toggled = gluDungeon.Toggled
	end

	return toggled == true
end

tbl5.activeNpcsStarted = function()
	local humanoids = workspace:FindFirstChild("Humanoids")
	local regions = humanoids and humanoids:FindFirstChild("Regions")
	local temporary = regions and regions:FindFirstChild("Temporary")
	local activeNpcs = temporary and temporary:FindFirstChild("ActiveNpcs")
	if not activeNpcs then
		return false
	end

	local ok, result = pcall(function()
		return #activeNpcs:GetChildren()
	end)

	return ok and result > 0
end

tbl5.inDungeon = function()
	if tbl5.getDungeonBar() then
		return true
	end
	local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
	return (map and map:FindFirstChild("Minigame Map")) ~= nil
end

tbl5.onFarmEnabled = function()
	tbl5.SawRun = false
	tbl5.QueueQueued = false
	instance5 = nil

	if World.IsDungeon or tbl5.inDungeon() then
		tbl5.SawRun = true
		tbl5.QueueState = "in dungeon"
		tbl5.EquipAt = 0
		str7 = "In a dungeon - farming now"
		v:Success("Dungeon", "Already in a dungeon - farming", 3)
		return false
	end

	tbl5.AutoQueue = true

	if Toggles and Toggles.glu_dungeon_autoqueue then
		pcall(function()
			Toggles.glu_dungeon_autoqueue:SetValue(true)
		end)
	end

	if tbl5.tryQueue(true) then
		v:Success("Dungeon", "Not in a dungeon - queued, readies up at the pad", 3)
		return true
	end
	v:Warn("Dungeon", "Not in a dungeon, but the queue was not sent: " .. tostring(tbl5.QueueState), 3)
	return false
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(0.5) do
		if not flag3 and tbl5.farmWanted() then
			tbl5.AdoptUntil = 0

			if Toggles and Toggles.glu_dungeon then
				Toggles.glu_dungeon:SetValue(true)
			end

			if not flag3 then
				flag3 = true
			end

			tbl5.SawRun = false
			instance5 = nil
			str7 = "Scanning dungeon..."
		end

		if not flag3 then
			continue
		end

		if tbl5.getDungeonBar() then
			tbl5.SawRun = true
			tbl5.QueueQueued = false

			pcall(function()
				GluWebhook.dungeonRunStart()
			end)
		elseif tbl5.ChestPhase ~= "idle" then
			tbl5.QueueState = "looting caches - queueing after"
		elseif tbl5.SawRun and not tbl5.AutoQueue then
			tbl5.QueueState = "run finished - chaining is off"
		else
			tbl5.tryQueue(false)
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(0.5) do
		if not tbl5.AutoStart then
			continue
		end

		if flag3 then
			continue
		end

		if tbl5.AutoStartFired then
			continue
		end

		if tbl5.getDungeonBar() then
			tbl5.AutoStartFired = true
			local gluDungeon = Toggles and Toggles.glu_dungeon

			if gluDungeon then
				pcall(function()
					gluDungeon:SetValue(true)
				end)
			end

			if not flag3 then
				str7 = "Idle (auto-start blocked - main toggle off)"
				v:Warn("Dungeon", "Auto-start could not flip 'enable auto dungeon' - turn it on manually", 4)
			else
				instance5 = nil
				kills = 0
				str7 = "Auto-started: Ouwigahara"
				v:Success("Dungeon", "Auto-started the dungeon farm (Ouwigahara)", 3)
			end
		end
	end
end)

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(0.5) do
		if not flag3 then
			tbl5.EquipStatus = "idle"
			tbl5.CombatFallback = false
			tbl5.EquipMisses = 0
		elseif not flag5 and not tbl5.AutoCombat then
			tbl5.EquipStatus = "idle"
		elseif flag9 then
			tbl5.EquipStatus = "paused (safe mode)"
		elseif tbl12.Suppressed then
			tbl5.EquipStatus = "paused (drinking)"
		else
			if os.clock() - (tbl5.EquipAt or 0) < 3 then
				continue
			end
			tbl5.EquipAt = os.clock()
			local lastSelected = lastSelected2 or "Combat"

			if not tbl5.AutoCombat then
				tbl5.CombatFallback = false
				local v15, v16 = v8.equip(lastSelected)

				if v15 then
					tbl12.Slot = v8.CurrentSlot or tbl12.Slot or 1
					now8 = 0
					tbl5.EquipStatus = string.format("holding %s (slot %d)", tostring(lastSelected), tbl12.Slot)
				else
					tbl5.EquipStatus = "equip failed: " .. tostring(v16)
				end

				continue
			end

			local name = getName()

			if name == lastSelected then
				tbl5.CombatFallback = false
				tbl5.EquipMisses = 0
				tbl12.Slot = fn24() or tbl12.Slot or 1
				now8 = 0
				tbl5.EquipStatus = string.format("holding %s (slot %s)", tostring(name), tostring(tbl12.Slot))
				continue
			end

			local v15, v16 = v8.equip(lastSelected)

			if not v15 then
				tbl5.CombatFallback = true
				tbl5.EquipMisses = 0
				tbl5.EquipStatus = "combat fallback (" .. tostring(v16) .. ")"
			else
				tbl5.EquipMisses = (tbl5.EquipMisses or 0) + 1

				if tbl5.EquipMisses >= 2 then
					tbl5.CombatFallback = true
					tbl5.EquipStatus = "combat fallback (weapon disabled)"
				else
					tbl5.EquipStatus = "trying " .. tostring(lastSelected) .. "..."
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

local function getSkip()
	local componentsHolder = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ComponentsHolder")
	if not componentsHolder then
		return nil
	end
	local mainNotificationFrame = componentsHolder:FindFirstChild("MainNotificationFrame")
	if not mainNotificationFrame then
		return nil
	end
	local ouwigaharaTopBar = mainNotificationFrame:FindFirstChild("OuwigaharaTopBar")
	if not ouwigaharaTopBar then
		return nil
	end
	return ouwigaharaTopBar:FindFirstChild("Skip")
end

task.spawn(function()
	while task.wait(0.35) do
		if not flag6 or not flag3 then
			str8 = flag3 and "Disabled" or "Idle (dungeon off)"
			continue
		end
		local skip = getSkip()

		if not skip then
			str8 = "Waiting for Skip button..."
		else
			if skip:IsA("GuiObject") and not skip.Visible then
				str8 = "Skip button hidden"
				continue
			end
			local remote = fn6()

			if not remote then
				str8 = "SignalEvent missing"
			elseif pcall(function()
				remote:FireServer("OuwigaharaRequest", { action = "Skip" })
			end) then
				count += 1
				str8 = string.format("Skip fired (%d)", count)
			else
				str8 = "FireServer failed"
			end
		end
	end
end)

tbl5.cardKey = function(arg)
	if arg.stat and tostring(arg.stat) ~= "" then
		return "Stat: " .. tostring(arg.stat)
	end

	if string.lower(tostring(arg.rtype or "")) == "points" then
		return "Points"
	end
	return tostring(arg.title or "Card " .. tostring(arg.id or "?"))
end

tbl5.refreshCardOptions = function()
	local tbl19 = {}

	for i, v15 in ipairs(tbl5.CardCatalog) do
		tbl19[i] = v15
	end

	table.sort(tbl19, function(arg, arg2)
		return arg:lower() < arg2:lower()
	end)

	tbl5.CardDDBusy = true

	for _, v15 in ipairs({ tbl5.CardDD, tbl5.CardWDD }) do
		if v15 and v15.SetOptions then
			pcall(function()
				v15:SetOptions(tbl19)
			end)
		end
	end

	tbl5.CardDDBusy = false
end

tbl5.learnCard = function(arg)
	if arg == nil or arg == "" or tbl5.CardSeen[arg] then
		return false
	end
	tbl5.CardSeen[arg] = true
	table.insert(tbl5.CardCatalog, arg)
	return true
end

do
	local tbl19

	tbl19 = {
		Damage = { "damage", "attack", "crit", "strength" },
		Points = { "point", "multiplier", "score", "trophy", "trophies", "reward" },
		NotPriority = {
			"health",
			"stamina",
			"regen",
			"guard",
			"shield",
			"block",
			"immunity",
			"resist",
			"speed",
			"range",
			"combo",
		},
		textHasAny = function(arg, arg2)
			local v15 = string.lower(tostring(arg or ""))

			for i = 1, #arg2 do
				if string.find(v15, arg2[i], 1, true) then
					return true
				end
			end

			return false
		end,
		normKey = function(arg)
			return (string.lower(tostring(arg or "")):gsub("[^%w]", ""))
		end,
		rebuildNorm = function(arg)
			local tbl20 = {}
			local v15 = pairs
			local tbl21 = arg or {}

			for k in v15(tbl21) do
				local v16 = tbl19.normKey(k)

				if v16 ~= "" then
					tbl20[v16] = true
				end
			end

			return tbl20
		end,
	}

	tbl5.applyCardBlacklist = function(arg)
		local cardBlacklist = {}
		local v15 = ipairs
		arg = arg or {}
		local blackCount = 0
		local flag16 = false

		for _, v16 in v15(arg) do
			if type(v16) == "string" and v16 ~= "" then
				cardBlacklist[v16] = true
				blackCount += 1

				if tbl5.learnCard(v16) then
					flag16 = true
				end
			end
		end

		tbl5.CardBlacklist = cardBlacklist
		tbl5.CardBlackNorm = tbl19.rebuildNorm(cardBlacklist)
		tbl5.BlackCount = blackCount

		if flag16 and not tbl5.CardDDBusy then
			tbl5.refreshCardOptions()
		end

		return cardBlacklist
	end

	tbl5.applyCardWhitelist = function(arg)
		local cardWhitelist = {}
		local v15 = ipairs
		arg = arg or {}
		local whiteCount = 0
		local flag16 = false

		for _, v16 in v15(arg) do
			if type(v16) == "string" and v16 ~= "" then
				cardWhitelist[v16] = true
				whiteCount += 1

				if tbl5.learnCard(v16) then
					flag16 = true
				end
			end
		end

		tbl5.CardWhitelist = cardWhitelist
		tbl5.CardWhiteNorm = tbl19.rebuildNorm(cardWhitelist)
		tbl5.WhiteCount = whiteCount

		if flag16 and not tbl5.CardDDBusy then
			tbl5.refreshCardOptions()
		end

		return cardWhitelist
	end

	tbl19.inSet = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		if not arg2 then
			return false
		end
		local v15 = tbl5.cardKey(arg)
		local str11 = tostring(arg.title or "")
		if arg2[v15] or str11 ~= "" and arg2[str11] then
			return true
		end

		if not arg3 then
			return false
		end
		local v16 = ipairs
		local tbl20 = {}
		local v17 = tostring
		local stat = arg.stat or ""
		local v18 = table.pack(v17(stat))
		tbl20[1] = v15
		tbl20[2] = str11

		do
			local values = table.pack(table.unpack(v18, 1, v18.n))
			table.move(values, 1, values.n, 3, tbl20)
		end

		for _, v19 in v16(tbl20) do
			local v20 = tbl19.normKey(v19)
			if v20 ~= "" and arg3[v20] then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	tbl19.isWhitelisted = function(arg)
		return tbl19.inSet(arg, tbl5.CardWhitelist, tbl5.CardWhiteNorm)
	end

	tbl19.isBlacklisted = function(arg)
		return tbl19.inSet(arg, tbl5.CardBlacklist, tbl5.CardBlackNorm)
	end

	tbl19.score = function(arg)
		local str11 = tostring(arg.stat or "")
		local str12 = tostring(arg.title or "")
		local v15 = string.lower(tostring(arg.rtype or ""))
		local n16 = tonumber(arg.amount) or 0
		local n17 = tonumber(arg.points) or 0
		local v16 = string.match(string.lower(str12), "x(%d+%.?%d*)")
			or string.match(string.lower(str11), "x(%d+%.?%.?%d*)")
		if tbl19.isWhitelisted(arg) then
			return 1000000 + math.floor(math.max(n16, 0) * 1000) + 1
		end

		if tbl19.isBlacklisted(arg) then
			return 0
		end
		local v17 = tbl19.textHasAny(str11, tbl19.Damage) or tbl19.textHasAny(str12, tbl19.Damage)
		local flag16 = v15 == "points"
			or tbl19.textHasAny(str11, tbl19.Points) and not tbl19.textHasAny(str11, tbl19.NotPriority)
			or tbl19.textHasAny(str12, tbl19.Points) and not tbl19.textHasAny(str12, tbl19.NotPriority)
		if not v17 and not flag16 then
			return 0
		end
		local n18

		if v17 then
			n18 = 10000 + math.floor(n16 * 10000)
		elseif v16 then
			n18 = 5000 + math.floor((tonumber(v16) or 0) * 1000)
		else
			n18 = 1000 + math.floor(math.sqrt(math.max(0, n17)) * 10)
		end

		if arg.guaranteed then
			n18 += 25
		end

		return n18
	end

	tbl19.isPriority = function(arg)
		return arg >= 1000
	end

	local function fn38()
		local ouwigaharaOffers = localPlayer:FindFirstChild("OuwigaharaOffers")
		if not ouwigaharaOffers then
			return nil
		end
		local tbl20 = {}
		local tbl21 = {}
		local tbl22 = {}

		for _, child in ipairs(ouwigaharaOffers:GetChildren()) do
			local num = tonumber(child.Name)

			if num then
				local tbl23 = {
					id = child.Name,
					order = num,
					rtype = child:GetAttribute("Type"),
					title = child:GetAttribute("Title"),
					stat = child:GetAttribute("Stat"),
					amount = child:GetAttribute("Amount"),
					points = child:GetAttribute("Points"),
					rarity = child:GetAttribute("Rarity"),
					guaranteed = child:GetAttribute("Guaranteed") == true,
				}

				table.insert(tbl20, tbl23)
				tbl22[tbl23.id] = true
				table.insert(tbl21, tbl23.id .. ":" .. tostring(tbl23.title))
			end
		end

		if #tbl20 == 0 then
			return nil
		end

		table.sort(tbl20, function(arg, arg2)
			return arg.order < arg2.order
		end)

		table.sort(tbl21)
		local flag16 = false

		for _, v15 in ipairs(tbl20) do
			if tbl5.learnCard(tbl5.cardKey(v15)) then
				flag16 = true
			end
		end

		if flag16 then
			tbl5.refreshCardOptions()
		end

		local n16 = tonumber(ouwigaharaOffers:GetAttribute("Picks")) or 0
		local n17 = tonumber(ouwigaharaOffers:GetAttribute("TotalPicks")) or 0
		local str11 = tostring(ouwigaharaOffers:GetAttribute("Picked") or "")
		local n18 = tonumber(ouwigaharaOffers:GetAttribute("Rerolls")) or 0
		local bbCards = ouwigaharaOffers:FindFirstChild("BBCards")
		local n19

		if bbCards then
			n19 = math.max(n18, tonumber(bbCards:GetAttribute("Rerolls")) or 0)
		else
			n19 = n18
		end

		local num = tonumber(ouwigaharaOffers:GetAttribute("Countdown"))
		local num2 = tonumber(ouwigaharaOffers:GetAttribute("Target"))
		local v15 = num and num2
		local n20 = nil

		if v15 then
			n20 = num + num2 - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		end

		local str12 = table.concat(tbl21, "|")
		local n21

		if n17 > 0 then
			n21 = math.max(0, n17 - n16)
		else
			n21 = 1
		end

		return {
			cards = tbl20,
			ids = tbl22,
			signature = str12,
			made = n16,
			total = n17,
			left = n21,
			totalKnown = n17 > 0,
			picked = str11,
			rerolls = n19,
			expiresIn = n20,
			token = str12 .. "|m" .. n16 .. "|r" .. n19 .. "|p" .. str11,
		}
	end

	tbl19.button = function(name)
		local componentsHolder = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ComponentsHolder")
		local mainNotificationFrame = componentsHolder and componentsHolder:FindFirstChild("MainNotificationFrame")
		local ouwigaharaOffers = mainNotificationFrame and mainNotificationFrame:FindFirstChild("OuwigaharaOffers")
		local bbCards = ouwigaharaOffers and ouwigaharaOffers:FindFirstChild("BBCards")
		local cards = bbCards and bbCards:FindFirstChild("Cards")

		local child = cards:FindFirstChild(name)
		local card = child and child:FindFirstChild("Card")
		local child2 = card and card:FindFirstChild(name)
		local click = child2 and child2:FindFirstChild("Click")
		if click and click:IsA("GuiButton") then
			return click
		end
		return nil
	end

	tbl19.press = function(button)
		if not button then
			return false
		end

		if firesignal then
			if pcall(function()
				firesignal(button.MouseButton1Click)
			end) then
				return true
			end
		end

		return (pcall(function()
			button:Activate()
		end))
	end

	tbl19.signalModule = function()
		if tbl5.SignalMod ~= nil then
			return tbl5.SignalMod
		end
		local module = nil

		tbl5.SignalMod = pcall(function()
			local communication = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Communication")
			local serverAndClient = communication and communication:FindFirstChild("ServerAndClient")
			local signals = serverAndClient and serverAndClient:FindFirstChild("Signals")
			local signalEvent = signals and signals:FindFirstChild("SignalEvent")

			if signalEvent then
				module = require(signalEvent)
			end
		end) and module or false

		return tbl5.SignalMod or nil
	end

	tbl19.fireRemote = function(remote, arg)
		local v15 = tbl19.signalModule()

		if v15 and type(v15.ToServer) == "function" then
			if pcall(v15.ToServer, "OuwigaharaRequest", arg) then
				return 1
			end
		end

		if remote then
			if pcall(function()
				remote:FireServer("OuwigaharaRequest", arg)
			end) then
				return 2
			end
		end

		return 0
	end

	local function fn39(rec, via)
		local v15 = fn6()

		if via ~= 3 then
			local v16 = tbl19.fireRemote(v15, { action = "Pick", id = rec.id })
			if v16 ~= 0 then
				return v16
			end
		end

		if via ~= 2 and tbl19.press(tbl19.button(rec.id)) then
			return 3
		end
		return 0
	end

	local function fn40(via)
		local v15 = fn6()

		if via ~= 3 then
			local v16 = tbl19.fireRemote(v15, { action = "Reroll" })
			if v16 ~= 0 then
				return v16
			end
		end

		if via ~= 2 then
			local componentsHolder = playerGui:FindFirstChild("ComponentsHolder")
			local mainNotificationFrame = componentsHolder and componentsHolder:FindFirstChild("MainNotificationFrame")
			local ouwigaharaOffers = mainNotificationFrame and mainNotificationFrame:FindFirstChild("OuwigaharaOffers")
			local bbCards = ouwigaharaOffers and ouwigaharaOffers:FindFirstChild("BBCards")
			local cards = bbCards and bbCards:FindFirstChild("Cards")
			if tbl19.press(cards and cards:FindFirstChild("Reroll")) then
				return 3
			end
		end

		return 0
	end

	local tbl20 = {
		Fails = {},
		Hand = nil,
		Stuck = nil,
		StuckAt = 0,
		LastDone = nil,
		RerollUntil = 0,
		RetryAfter = 0,
		Via = 1,
	}

	local function fn41(rec, picked, made, arg)
		local deadline = os.clock() + (arg or 1.1)

		while os.clock() < deadline do
			task.wait(0.03)
			local v15 = fn38()
			if not v15 then
				return "hand over"
			end

			if v15.ids[rec.id] == nil then
				return "accepted"
			end

			if v15.picked ~= "" and v15.picked ~= picked then
				return "accepted"
			end

			if made ~= nil and v15.made > made then
				return "accepted"
			end
		end

		return "no answer"
	end

	local function fn42(token, arg)
		local deadline = os.clock() + (arg or 1.1)

		while os.clock() < deadline do
			task.wait(0.04)
			local v15 = fn38()
			if not v15 then
				return true
			end

			if v15.token == token then
				continue
			end
			return true
		end

		return false
	end

	SafeSpawn("auto-card", function()
		local state = 1
		local flag16, v15, now3, handAt, now4, flag17, flag18, now5, stuckAt, flag19, left, tbl21, count4, count5, v16, v17, match, lower, v18, title, title4, goodMult, goodMult2, flag20, tbl22, count6, flag21, fail, fail2, tbl23, fail3, tbl24, rec, v19, flag22, flag23, flag24, v20, n16, v21, title2, fail4, fail5, format, v22, title3, format2, flag25, str11, token, flag26, str12, str13

		while true do
			if state <= 51 then
				if state <= 21 then
					if state <= 10 then
						if state <= 5 then
							if state <= 2 then
								if state <= 1 then
									if state == 1 then
										if task.wait(0.06) then
											state = 3
										else
											state = 2
										end
									end
								elseif state == 2 then
									return
								end
							elseif state <= 3 then
								if state == 3 then
									flag16 = not flag7

									if flag16 then
										state = 5
									else
										state = 4
									end
								end
							elseif state <= 4 then
								if state == 4 then
									flag16 = not flag3
									state = 5
								end
							elseif state == 5 then
								if flag16 then
									state = 138
								else
									state = 6
								end
							end
						elseif state <= 7 then
							if state <= 6 then
								if state == 6 then
									if os.clock() < tbl20.RerollUntil then
										state = 137
									else
										state = 7
									end
								end
							elseif state == 7 then
								if os.clock() < tbl20.RetryAfter then
									state = 1
								else
									state = 8
								end
							end
						elseif state <= 8 then
							if state == 8 then
								v15 = fn38()

								if not v15 then
									state = 136

			local function getPosition()
				local character2 = localPlayer2.Character
				local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not humanoidRootPart then
					return nil
				end
				local filterDescendantsInstances = {}

				for _, instance in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("SwimParts")) do
					filterDescendantsInstances[#filterDescendantsInstances + 1] = instance.Parent or instance
				end

				if #filterDescendantsInstances == 0 then
					return nil
				end
				local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
				raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
				raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances
				raycastParams.BruteForceAllSlow = true
				local unit =
					Vector3.new(humanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, humanoidRootPart.CFrame.LookVector.Z).Unit
				local unit2 =
					Vector3.new(humanoidRootPart.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, humanoidRootPart.CFrame.RightVector.Z).Unit

				for _, v18 in ipairs({ unit, -unit, unit2, -unit2 }) do
					for i = 10, 80, 5 do
						local position = humanoidRootPart.Position + v18 * i
						local hit = workspace:Raycast(
							Vector3.new(position.X, position.Y + 50, position.Z),
							Vector3.new(0, -100, 0),
							raycastParams
						)
						if hit and hit.Position then
							return hit.Position
						end
					end
				end

				return nil
			end

					raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = filterDescendantsInstances

			local function fn82()
				local instance = nil
				local v18 = nil
				local v19 = nil

				for i = 1, 40 do
					if not gluFishOwner.Enabled then
						return
					end
					instance, v18, v19 = fn77()
					if instance and v18 and v19 then
						break
					end
					task.wait(0.04)
				end

				if not instance then
					fn50("Minigame: no CanvasGroup")
					return
				end

				if not v18 or not v19 then
					fn50("Minigame: no tracker/bar")
					return
				end
				fn49("Playing minigame...")
				local now4 = os.clock()
				local now5 = os.clock()
				local v20 = nil
				local now11 = nil
				local n16 = 0
				local flag16 = false
				local now12 = 0

				while os.clock() - now4 < tbl20.MINIGAME_TIMEOUT do
					if not gluFishOwner.Enabled then
						break
					end
					local v21, guiObject, guiObject2 = fn77()
					if not (v21 and guiObject and guiObject2 and instance.Parent) then
						break
					end
					local now6 = os.clock()

					if now6 - now5 >= 0.1 then
						fn70(
							tbl20.REEL_VALUE * (0.8 + math.clamp((now6 - now4) / tbl20.MINIGAME_TIMEOUT, 0, 1) * 0.2),
							false
						)
						now5 = now6
					end

					local n17 = guiObject2.AbsolutePosition.Y + guiObject2.AbsoluteSize.Y / 2

					if v20 and now11 then
						local elapsed = now6 - now11

						if elapsed > 0 then
							n16 = n16 * 0.55 + (n17 - v20) / elapsed * 0.45
						end
					end

					local y = guiObject.AbsolutePosition.Y
					local n18 = y + guiObject.AbsoluteSize.Y
					local n19 = (y + n18) / 2
					local n20 = n17 + n16 * tbl20.PREDICT_AHEAD
					local flag17

					if n18 - tbl20.SLACK_BOT < n20 then
						flag17 = true
					elseif n20 < y + tbl20.SLACK_TOP then
						flag17 = false
					else
						flag17 = n20 >= n19
					end

					if flag17 and not flag16 then
						fn78()
						flag16 = true
						now12 = now6
					elseif not flag17 and flag16 then
						if tbl20.HOLD_GRACE <= now6 - now12 then
							fn79()
							flag16 = false
						end
					end

					task.wait(tbl20.MINIGAME_TICK)
					v20 = n17
					now11 = now6
				end

				if flag16 then
					pcall(fn79)
				end

				fn70(tbl20.REEL_VALUE, true)
				task.wait(0.5)
			end

			local function fn83()
				local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")
				if not debree then
					return 0
				end
				local count4 = 0

				for _, child in ipairs(debree:GetChildren()) do
					if not child.Name:match("^FishingCatch") then
						continue
					end
					local descendants = {}

					for _, descendant in ipairs(child:GetDescendants()) do
						if descendant:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then
							descendants[#descendants + 1] = descendant
						end
					end

					for _, descendant in ipairs(descendants) do
						if not gluFishOwner.Enabled then
							return count4
						end

						if not descendant.Parent then
							continue
						end
						local keyboardKeyCode = descendant.KeyboardKeyCode
						local holdDuration = tbl20.HOLD_DURATION

						if VirtualInputManager_2 and keyboardKeyCode and keyboardKeyCode ~= Enum.KeyCode.Unknown then
							fn80(keyboardKeyCode)
							task.wait(holdDuration)
							fn81(keyboardKeyCode)
						else
							pcall(function()
								ProximityPromptService:InputHoldBegin(
									descendant,
									Enum.ProximityPromptInputType.Keyboard
								)
							end)

							task.wait(holdDuration)

							pcall(function()
								ProximityPromptService:InputHoldEnd(descendant, Enum.ProximityPromptInputType.Keyboard)
							end)
						end

						count4 += 1
						gluFishOwner.Catches = (gluFishOwner.Catches or 0) + 1

						pcall(function()
							GluWebhook.noteCatch(child)
						end)

						task.wait(tbl20.BETWEEN_CATCHES)
					end
				end

				return count4
			end

			local function fn84()
				local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")
				if not debree then
					return false
				end

				for _, child in ipairs(debree:GetChildren()) do
					if child.Name:match("^FishingCatch") then
						return true
					end
				end

				return false
			end

			local function fn85(arg)
				local deadline = os.clock() + (arg or 8)

				while os.clock() < deadline do
					if not gluFishOwner.Enabled then
						return false
					end

					if fn84() then
						return true
					end
					task.wait(0.1)
				end

				return false
			end

			local function fn86(consumedLine)
				if not consumedLine then
					return true
				end
				local deadline = os.clock() + tbl20.LINE_CLEAR_WAIT

				while os.clock() < deadline do
					if not gluFishOwner.Enabled then
						return false
					end
					local v18 = fn46()
					if not v18 or v18.name == consumedLine then
						return true
					end
					task.wait(0.15)
				end

				return false
			end

			local function fn87(run)
				local now4 = os.clock()
				local now5 = 0
				local count4 = 0
				local flag16

				while true do
					flag16 = false
					if not (os.clock() - now4 < tbl20.LINE_TIMEOUT) then
						break
					end

					if
						not (gluFishOwner.Enabled and not gluFishOwner.Buying and gluFishOwner.Run == run and fn60())
					then
						break
					end
					local v18 = fn46()

					if not v18 or gluFishOwner.LineInst and v18.inst ~= gluFishOwner.LineInst then
						if os.clock() - now5 > 0.3 then
							count4 += 1
							now5 = os.clock()
						end

						if count4 >= 2 and os.clock() - now4 > 0.8 then
							break
						end
					else
						count4 = 0
					end

					local attribute = localPlayer2:GetAttribute("FishingBite")
					local v19, v20, v21 = fn77()
					if not (attribute or v19 and v20 and v21) then
						task.wait(tbl20.BITE_POLL)
						continue
					end
					task.wait(0.06)

					for i = 1, 10 do
						if not gluFishOwner.Enabled then
							break
						end
						local v22, v23, v24 = fn77()

						if v22 and v23 and v24 then
							fn82()
							break
						else
							task.wait(0.1)
						end
					end

					flag16 = true
					return flag16
				end

				return flag16
			end

			local function fn88(run)
				local now4 = os.clock()

				while true do
					if getChild2() and os.clock() - now4 < 15 then
						if gluFishOwner.Enabled and gluFishOwner.Run == run then
							task.wait(0.15)
							continue
						end
					end

					break
				end

				fn85(8)
				task.wait(tbl20.POST_CATCH_WAIT)
				fn83()
				local now5 = os.clock()

				while true do
					if fn84() and os.clock() - now5 < 8 then
						if gluFishOwner.Enabled and gluFishOwner.Run == run then
							task.wait(0.2)
							continue
						end
					end

					break
				end

				fn86(gluFishOwner.ConsumedLine)
				gluFishOwner.ConsumedLine = nil
			end

			local function fn89(arg)
				local run = arg or gluFishOwner.Run
				fn50("Auto Fish started")
				fn49("Equipping rod...")
				v16 = nil

				if not fn59() then
					fn49("No fishing rod found")
					fn50("Cannot start - no rod")
					return
				end

				fn61(run)
				gluFishOwner.ConsumedLine = nil
				local v18 = fn46(true)
				gluFishOwner.LineInst = v18 and v18.inst or nil

				while gluFishOwner.Enabled and gluFishOwner.Run == run and fn60() do
					if not localPlayer2.Character then
						fn49("Waiting for character...")
						task.wait(2)
					elseif gluFishOwner.Buying then
						task.wait(0.5)
					elseif not fn59() then
						fn49("Rod not equipped - retrying...")
						task.wait(1)
					else
						fn69()
						fn49("Casting...")

						if fn46(true) then
							fn49("Reeling in stale line...")
							fn76()
							task.wait(0.2)
						end

						local flag16 = false

						for i = 1, tbl20.MAX_CAST_ATTEMPTS do
							if gluFishOwner.Enabled and not gluFishOwner.Buying then
								flag16 = fn75()
								if not flag16 then
									task.wait(tbl20.CAST_RETRY_WAIT)
									continue
								end
							end

							break
						end

						if not flag16 then
							fn49("No cast landed")
							task.wait(tbl20.RESET_WAIT)
						else
							fn49("Waiting for bite...")

							if fn87(run) then
								fn88(run)
							elseif gluFishOwner.Enabled then
								fn76()
							end
						end
					end

					task.wait(0.1)
				end

				fn50("Auto Fish stopped")
				fn49("Idle")
			end

			return {
				State = gluFishOwner,
				CFG = tbl20,
				getStatus = function()
					return gluFishOwner.Status
				end,
				wormCount = fn67,
				ownedRodNames = getNames2,
				ownedBaitNames = getNames3,
				equippedBaitId = fn62,
				equippedBaitName = getName3,
				baitNameById = getName2,
				ownedBaitCount = fn65,
				isBaitItem = fn55,
				savePos = function()
					local character2 = localPlayer2.Character
					local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
					if not humanoidRootPart then
						fn51("No character to save position")
						return false
					end
					gluFishOwner.SavedFarmPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
					fn50(
						string.format(
							"Saved farm pos: %.1f, %.1f, %.1f",
							humanoidRootPart.Position.X,
							humanoidRootPart.Position.Y,
							humanoidRootPart.Position.Z
						)
					)
					fn51("Saved farm position")
					return true
				end,
				start = function()
					if gluFishOwner.Enabled then
						return
					end

					if not gluFishOwner.SavedFarmPos then
						local character2 = localPlayer2.Character
						local humanoidRootPart = character2 and character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
						if not humanoidRootPart then
							fn51("Save a position first")
							return false
						end
						gluFishOwner.SavedFarmPos = humanoidRootPart.Position
						fn50(
							string.format(
								"Using current position: %.1f, %.1f, %.1f",
								humanoidRootPart.Position.X,
								humanoidRootPart.Position.Y,
								humanoidRootPart.Position.Z
							)
						)
					end

					if type(genv) == "table" then
						genv.GluFishOwner = gluFishOwner
					end

					gluFishOwner.Enabled = true
					gluFishOwner.ConsumedLine = nil
					gluFishOwner.Run = (gluFishOwner.Run or 0) + 1
					local run = gluFishOwner.Run

					if gluFishOwner.Thread then
						pcall(task.cancel, gluFishOwner.Thread)
						gluFishOwner.Thread = nil
					end

					gluFishOwner.Thread = task.spawn(function()
						local ok, result = pcall(fn89, run)

						if not ok and gluFishOwner.Run == run then
							warn("[Glu] auto fish loop crashed: " .. tostring(result))
						end
					end)

					return true
				end,
				stop = function()
					gluFishOwner.Enabled = false
					gluFishOwner.Run = (gluFishOwner.Run or 0) + 1

					if gluFishOwner.Thread then
						pcall(task.cancel, gluFishOwner.Thread)
						gluFishOwner.Thread = nil
					end

					if type(genv) == "table" and genv.GluFishOwner == gluFishOwner then
						genv.GluFishOwner = nil
					end

					fn50("Auto Fish stopped (toggled off)")
					fn49("Idle")
				end,
				startAutoBuy = function()
					if not gluFishOwner.AutoBuyBait then
						return
					end

					if not gluFishOwner.SavedFarmPos then
						fn51("Save a position first")
						gluFishOwner.AutoBuyBait = false
						return
					end

					gluFishOwner.LastBuyAt = 0
					fn68()
				end,
			}
		end)()
	)
end)

if ok and type(result) == "table" then
	AutoFish = result
else
	warn("[Glu] auto fish module failed to load: " .. tostring(result))

	AutoFish = {
		State = {

		},

			return nil
		end,
		CFG = {},
		getStatus = function()
			return "unavailable"
		end,
		wormCount = function()
			return 0
		end,
		savePos = function()
			return false
		end,
		start = function()
			return false
		end,
		stop = function() end,
		startAutoBuy = function() end,
	}
end

local function getGluStats()
	local ReplicatedStorage2 = ReplicatedStorage
	local localPlayer2 = localPlayer

	local function fn44(arg)
		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			local ReplicatedStorage3 = ReplicatedStorage2

			for _, name in ipairs(arg) do
				ReplicatedStorage3 = ReplicatedStorage3:FindFirstChild(name)

				if not ReplicatedStorage3 then
					error("missing " .. tostring(name))
				end
			end

			return require(ReplicatedStorage3)
		end)

		if ok2 then
			return result2
		end
		return nil
	end

	local v15 = fn44({ "CAM", "Global", "Utility" })
	local v16 = fn44({ "CAM", "Global", "SkillService", "Stats" })
	local v17 = fn44({ "CAM", "Global", "SkillService", "SkillTreeholder", "SkillTreeConfig" })

	local function fn45()
		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			return ReplicatedStorage2.Communication.ServerAndClient.Signals.SignalFunction.Function
		end)

		if ok2 then
			return result2
		end
		return nil
	end

	local tbl19 = {}
	local thread = nil

	local function getOk2()
		if not v15 then
			return nil
		end

		local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
			return v15.GetData(localPlayer2)
		end)

		return ok2 and result2 or nil
	end

	local function fn46()
		local tbl20 = {}
		local tbl21 = {}

		local function fn47(arg)
			if type(arg) == "string" and arg ~= "" and not tbl21[arg] then
				tbl21[arg] = true
				tbl20[#tbl20 + 1] = arg
			end
		end

		if type(v17) == "table" then
			for k in pairs(v17) do
				fn47(k)
			end
		end

		local ok2 = getOk2()
		local skillTreeUnlockedList = ok2 and ok2:FindFirstChild("SkillTreeUnlockedList")

		if skillTreeUnlockedList then
			for _, child in ipairs(skillTreeUnlockedList:GetChildren()) do
				fn47(child.Name)
			end
		end

		table.sort(tbl20)
		return tbl20
	end

	local gluStats

	gluStats = {
		Order = {
			"Max Health",
			"Max Stamina",
			"Stamina Regen Speed",
			"Health Regen Speed",
			"Block Points",
			"Block Regen",
			"Additional Damage",
		},
		Enabled = false,
		Reserve = 0,
		Delay = 0.05,
		Timeout = 2.5,
		Gives = 3,
		Status = "idle",
		Bought = 0,
		Refused = 0,
		Spent = 0,
		_last = nil,
		level = function(name)
			local ok2 = getOk2()
			local skillTreeUnlockedList = ok2 and ok2:FindFirstChild("SkillTreeUnlockedList")
			local child = skillTreeUnlockedList and skillTreeUnlockedList:FindFirstChild(name)
			return child and child.Value or 0
		end,
		spentOn = function(name)
			local ok2 = getOk2()
			local skillPointsSpent = ok2 and ok2:FindFirstChild("SkillPointsSpent")
			local child = skillPointsSpent and skillPointsSpent:FindFirstChild(name)
			return child and child.Value or 0
		end,
		points = function()
			local ok2 = getOk2()
			local skillPoints = ok2 and ok2:FindFirstChild("SkillPoints")
			return skillPoints and skillPoints.Value or 0
		end,
		maxLevel = function(arg)
			if not v16 then
				return 1
			end
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(v16.GetMaxIndexForCategory, arg)
			return ok2 and type(result2) == "number" and result2 or 1
		end,
		costAt = function(arg, arg2)
			if not v16 then
				return nil
			end
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(v16.GetRequirementsAt, localPlayer2, arg, arg2)
			if not ok2 or type(result2) ~= "table" then
				return nil
			end
			local skillPoints = result2.SkillPoints
			return type(skillPoints) == "number" and skillPoints or nil
		end,
		next = function(arg)
			local v18 = gluStats.level(arg)
			local v19 = gluStats.maxLevel(arg)
			if v19 <= v18 then
				return nil, v18, v19
			end
			local v20 = gluStats.costAt(arg, v18 + 1)
			if not v20 then
				return nil, v18, v19
			end
			return v20, v18, v19
		end,
		buyOnce = function(arg)
			local v18 = gluStats.next(arg)
			if not v18 then
				return false, "maxed or unpriceable"
			end

			if gluStats.points() - v18 < gluStats.Reserve then
				return false, "not enough points"
			end
			local remote = fn45()
			if not remote then
				return false, "remote unavailable"
			end
			local v19 = gluStats.level(arg)
			local v20 = gluStats.points()

			local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
				return remote:InvokeServer("UnlockSkillTreeNode", arg)
			end)

			if not ok2 then
				return false, "invoke error: " .. tostring(result2)
			end
			local deadline = os.clock() + gluStats.Timeout

			while os.clock() < deadline do
				if v19 < gluStats.level(arg) then
					local n16 = v20 - gluStats.points()
					gluStats.Bought += 1
					gluStats.Spent += n16
					gluStats.Status = ("bought %s -> level %d for %d pts"):format(arg, gluStats.level(arg), n16)
					gluStats._last = { stat = arg, level = gluStats.level(arg), paid = n16 }
					return true
				end

				task.wait(0.05)
			end

			if result2 == false then
				return false, "server refused"
			end
			return false, "no level change in " .. gluStats.Timeout .. "s"
		end,
		buy = function(arg, arg2)
			local v18 = arg2 or gluStats.maxLevel(arg)
			local count4 = 0

			while gluStats.Enabled ~= false and gluStats.level(arg) < v18 do
				local v19, v20 = gluStats.buyOnce(arg)

				if not v19 then
					if not tbl19[arg] then
						tbl19[arg] = true
						gluStats.Refused += 1
					end

					gluStats.Status = ("stopped on %s: %s"):format(arg, tostring(v20))
					break
				else
					tbl19[arg] = nil
					count4 += 1

					if gluStats.Delay > 0 then
						task.wait(gluStats.Delay)
					end
				end
			end

			return count4
		end,
		plan = function()
			local tbl20 = {}
			local n16 = gluStats.points() - gluStats.Reserve

			for _, v18 in ipairs(gluStats.Order) do
				local v19, v20, v21 = gluStats.next(v18)

				if v19 then
					tbl20[#tbl20 + 1] = { stat = v18, level = v20, cap = v21, cost = v19, afford = v19 <= n16 }

					if v19 <= n16 then
						n16 -= v19
					end
				else
					tbl20[#tbl20 + 1] =
						{ stat = v18, level = gluStats.level(v18), cap = gluStats.maxLevel(v18), cost = false }
				end
			end

			return tbl20
		end,
		start = function(arg)
			if type(arg) == "table" then
				for k, v18 in pairs(arg) do
					if gluStats[k] ~= nil and type(v18) == "number" then
						gluStats[k] = v18
					end
				end

				if type(arg.Order) == "table" then
					gluStats.Order = arg.Order
				end
			end

			if thread then
				return false
			end
			gluStats.Enabled = true
			tbl19 = {}
			local gluStats2 = gluStats
			local gluStats3 = gluStats
			gluStats.Bought = 0
			gluStats2.Refused = 0
			gluStats3.Spent = 0
			gluStats.Status = "running"

			thread = task.spawn(function()
				while gluStats.Enabled do
					local n16 = 0

					for _, v18 in ipairs(gluStats.Order) do
						if not gluStats.Enabled then
							break
						end

						if not tbl19[v18] then
							n16 += gluStats.buy(v18)
						end
					end

					if n16 == 0 then
						gluStats.Status = gluStats.points() - gluStats.Reserve <= 0 and "out of skill points"
							or "nothing left to buy"
						break
					end
				end

				gluStats.Enabled = false
				thread = nil
				gluStats.Status = ("done - %d level(s) bought, %d pts, %d refused"):format(
					gluStats.Bought,
					gluStats.Spent,
					gluStats.Refused
				)
			end)

			return true
		end,
		stop = function()
			gluStats.Enabled = false

			if thread then
				pcall(function()
					thread:Disconnect()
				end)

				thread = nil
			end

			gluStats.Status = "stopped"
			return true
		end,
		report = function()
			local tbl20 = {}

			local function fn47(arg)
				tbl20[#tbl20 + 1] = arg
			end

			local status = gluStats.Status
			fn47(
				("Enabled=%s  Status=%s  Points=%d  Reserve=%d"):format(
					tostring(gluStats.Enabled),
					status,
					gluStats.points(),
					gluStats.Reserve
				)
			)
			fn47(("Bought=%d  Spent=%d  Refused=%d"):format(gluStats.Bought, gluStats.Spent, gluStats.Refused))
			fn47("")
			fn47(("  %-22s %5s %5s %7s  %s"):format("stat", "lvl", "cap", "next", "note"))
			fn47("  " .. string.rep("-", 62))
			local tbl21 = {}

			for _, v18 in ipairs(gluStats.Order) do
				tbl21[v18] = true
			end

			local function fn48(arg)
				local v18 = gluStats.level(arg)
				local v19 = gluStats.maxLevel(arg)
				local v20 = gluStats.costAt(arg, v18 + 1)
				local str11 = tbl19[arg] and "parked" or v20 == nil and "maxed"
				str11 = str11 or gluStats.points() - v20 < gluStats.Reserve and "too expensive" or "ready"
				fn47(
					("  %-22s %5d %5d %7s  %s%s"):format(
						arg,
						v18,
						v19,
						v20 and tostring(v20) or "-",
						str11,
						tbl21[arg] and "" or "   (not in Order)"
					)
				)
			end

			for _, v18 in ipairs(gluStats.Order) do
				fn48(v18)
			end

			for _, v18 in ipairs(fn46()) do
				if not tbl21[v18] then
					fn48(v18)
				end
			end

			gluStats.Report = table.concat(tbl20, "\n")
			return gluStats.Report
		end,
		_debug = { statList = fn46, data = getOk2 },
	}

	if type(getgenv) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			getgenv().GluStats = gluStats
		end)
	end

	return gluStats
end

AutoStat = getGluStats()

local function fn44()
	local v15 = nil
	local v16 = nil
	local v17 = nil

	pcall(function()
		local cam = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CAM")

			return
		end
		local collectibles = global:FindFirstChild("Collectibles")
		local items = collectibles and collectibles:FindFirstChild("Items")

			local ok2, result2 = pcall(require, items)

			if ok2 then

			end
		end

		local shop = global:FindFirstChild("Shop")

		if shop then
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(require, shop)

			if ok2 then

			end
		end

		local utility = global:FindFirstChild("Utility")

		if utility then
			local ok2, result2 = pcall(require, utility)

			if ok2 then
				v17 = result2
			end
		end
	end)

	local function getFunction()
		local communication = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Communication")
		local serverAndClient = communication and communication:FindFirstChild("ServerAndClient")
		local signals = serverAndClient and serverAndClient:FindFirstChild("Signals")
		local signalFunction = signals and signals:FindFirstChild("SignalFunction")
		return signalFunction and signalFunction:FindFirstChild("Function")
	end

	local function getInventory()
		local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
		local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
		local child = data and data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name)
		local slots = child and child:FindFirstChild("slots")
		local slot1 = slots and slots:FindFirstChild("Slot1")
		local inventory = slot1 and slot1:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
		return inventory and inventory:FindFirstChild("Inventory")
	end

	local function fn45(instance)
		instance = instance and instance:FindFirstChild("Amount")
		if instance and instance:IsA("ValueBase") then
			return tonumber(instance.Value) or 0
		end
		return 1
	end

	local function fn46(name, instance)
		if not name or not instance then
			return false
		end

		if instance:FindFirstChild("NoSave") or instance:FindFirstChild("QuestGrant") then
			return false
		end

		if not v15 then
			return false
		end
		local v18 = v15[name]
		if not v18 then
			return false
		end

		if v18.NoDelete == true or v18.NoSell == true then
			return false
		end

		if v18.Requirements ~= nil or v18.NoSaveRequirements ~= nil then
			return false
		end
		return v18.Price ~= nil or v16 and v16.itemsforsale and v16.itemsforsale[name] ~= nil
	end

	local tbl19 = {
		Selected = {},
		Options = {},
		Owned = {},
		MaxQty = {},
		DropdownA = nil,
		DropdownB = nil,
		LabelA = nil,
		LabelB = nil,
		Syncing = false,
		gather = function()
			local inventory = getInventory()
			if not inventory then
				return nil
			end
			local tbl19 = {}

			for _, child in ipairs(inventory:GetChildren()) do
				if fn46(child.Name, child) then
					local v18 = fn45(child)

					if v18 > 0 then
						tbl19[child.Name] = (tbl19[child.Name] or 0) + v18
					end
				end
			end

			local tbl20 = {}

			for k, v18 in pairs(tbl19) do
				tbl20[#tbl20 + 1] = { name = k, owned = v18, max = math.min(v18, 999) }
			end

			table.sort(tbl20, function(arg, arg2)
				return arg.name < arg2.name
			end)

			return tbl20
		end,
		sellBatch = function(arg)
			local remote = getFunction()
			if not remote then
				return false, "sell remote missing"
			end

			if type(arg) ~= "table" or next(arg) == nil then
				return false, "nothing to sell"
			end

			pcall(function()
				fn22(Vector3.new(274.9, 943.5, 523), 0)
			end)

			task.wait(0.35)

			local ok2, result2 = pcall(function()
				remote:InvokeServer("SellItems", arg)
			end)

			return ok2, result2
		end,
	}

	local function fn47(arg, arg2)
		return tostring(arg) .. " " .. tostring(arg2) .. "x"
	end

	local function fn48(arg)
		return string.match(tostring(arg), "^(.-) %d+x$") or tostring(arg)
	end

	local function fn49(arg)
		if not arg then
			return false
		end
		return string.find(string.lower(tostring(arg)), "wen", 1, true) ~= nil
	end

	local function fn50(arg, text)
		if not arg then
			return
		end

		if arg.Set then
			if pcall(function()
				arg:Set(text)
			end) then
				return
			end
		end

		pcall(function()
			arg.Text = text
		end)

		pcall(function()
			arg:SetText(text)
		end)
	end

	local function fn51()
		if next(tbl19.Selected) == nil then
			return "nothing selected"
		end
		local tbl20 = {}

		for k in pairs(tbl19.Selected) do
			tbl20[#tbl20 + 1] = k
		end

		table.sort(tbl20)
		local tbl21 = {}

		for _, v18 in ipairs(tbl20) do
			local n16 = tbl19.Owned[v18] or 0
			tbl21[#tbl21 + 1] =
				string.format('<font color="%s">%s %dx</font>', fn49(v18) and "#7CE07C" or "#FF96C8", v18, n16)
		end

		return "selected: " .. table.concat(tbl21, ", ")
	end

	tbl19.updateLabels = function()
		local v18 = fn51()
		fn50(tbl19.LabelA, v18)
		fn50(tbl19.LabelB, v18)
	end

	local function fn52(arg)
		local tbl20 = {}

		if type(arg) == "table" then
			for k, v18 in pairs(arg) do
				if type(k) == "string" and v18 == true then
					tbl20[fn48(k)] = true
				else
					if type(k) ~= "number" then
						continue
					end

					if type(v18) == "string" and v18 ~= "" then
						tbl20[fn48(v18)] = true
					elseif v18 == true and tbl19.Options[k] then
						tbl20[fn48(tbl19.Options[k])] = true
					end
				end
			end
		elseif type(arg) == "string" and arg ~= "" then
			tbl20[fn48(arg)] = true
		end

		return tbl20
	end

	local function fn53(selected)
		local tbl20 = {}

		for k in pairs(selected) do
			tbl20[#tbl20 + 1] = fn47(k, tbl19.Owned[k] or 0)
		end

		return tbl20
	end

	tbl19.setSelected = function(arg, arg2)
		if tbl19.Syncing then
			return
		end
		tbl19.Syncing = true
		tbl19.Selected = fn52(arg)
		local dropdownA = arg2 == "B" and tbl19.DropdownA or tbl19.DropdownB

		if dropdownA then
			local v18 = fn53(tbl19.Selected)

			pcall(function()
				if dropdownA.SetValue then
					dropdownA:SetValue(v18)
				end
			end)
		end

		tbl19.updateLabels()
		tbl19.Syncing = false
	end

	tbl19.sellSelected = function()
		if next(tbl19.Selected) == nil then
			v:Warn("Seller", "Nothing selected", 3)
			return
		end
		local tbl20 = {}
		local count4 = 0

		for k in pairs(tbl19.Selected) do
			local n16 = tbl19.MaxQty[k] or 0

			if n16 > 0 then
				tbl20[k] = n16
				count4 += 1
			end
		end

		if count4 == 0 then
			v:Warn("Seller", "Selected items are not in inventory", 3)
			return
		end
		local v18, v19 = tbl19.sellBatch(tbl20)

		if v18 then
			v:Success("Seller", "Sold " .. count4 .. " type(s)", 3)
			tbl19.refresh()
		else
			v:Warn("Seller", "Sell failed: " .. tostring(v19), 3)
		end
	end

	tbl19.sellAll = function()
		local v18 = tbl19.gather()
		if not v18 or #v18 == 0 then
			v:Warn("Seller", "Nothing sellable", 3)
			return
		end
		local tbl20 = {}
		local count4 = 0

		for _, v19 in ipairs(v18) do
			tbl20[v19.name] = v19.max
			count4 += 1
		end

		local v19, v20 = tbl19.sellBatch(tbl20)

		if v19 then
			v:Success("Seller", "Sold everything sellable (" .. count4 .. " types)", 3)
			tbl19.refresh()
		else
			v:Warn("Seller", "Sell failed: " .. tostring(v20), 3)
		end
	end

	tbl19.clear = function()
		tbl19.Selected = {}
		tbl19.Syncing = true

		if tbl19.DropdownA then
			pcall(function()
				if tbl19.DropdownA.SetValue then
					tbl19.DropdownA:SetValue({})
				end
			end)
		end

		if tbl19.DropdownB then
			pcall(function()
				if tbl19.DropdownB.SetValue then
					tbl19.DropdownB:SetValue({})
				end
			end)
		end

		tbl19.Syncing = false
		tbl19.updateLabels()
	end

	tbl19.refresh = function()
		local tbl20 = tbl19.gather() or {}
		local owned = {}
		local maxQty = {}
		local options = {}

		for _, v18 in ipairs(tbl20) do
			owned[v18.name] = v18.owned
			maxQty[v18.name] = v18.max
			options[#options + 1] = fn47(v18.name, v18.owned)
		end

		tbl19.Options = options
		tbl19.Owned = owned
		tbl19.MaxQty = maxQty
		local selected = {}

		for k in pairs(tbl19.Selected) do
			if owned[k] then
				selected[k] = true
			end
		end

		tbl19.Selected = selected
		tbl19.Syncing = true

		if tbl19.DropdownA then
			pcall(function()
				if tbl19.DropdownA.SetOptions then
					tbl19.DropdownA:SetOptions(options)
				elseif tbl19.DropdownA.SetValues then
					tbl19.DropdownA:SetValues(options)
				elseif tbl19.DropdownA.SetList then
					tbl19.DropdownA:SetList(options)
				end
			end)
		end

		if tbl19.DropdownB then
			pcall(function()
				if tbl19.DropdownB.SetOptions then
					tbl19.DropdownB:SetOptions(options)
				elseif tbl19.DropdownB.SetValues then
					tbl19.DropdownB:SetValues(options)
				elseif tbl19.DropdownB.SetList then
					tbl19.DropdownB:SetList(options)
				end
			end)
		end

		tbl19.Syncing = false
		tbl19.updateLabels()
	end

	return tbl19
end
