World.ExtrasTab = nil

local function fn45()
	local tbl19 = {
		"finalselectiontimer",
		"finalselectioncountdown",
		"finalselectiontime",
		"finalselection",
		"selectiontimer",
		"selectioncountdown",
		"countdown",
		"countdowntimer",
		"countdowntext",
		"timeleft",
		"timeuntil",
		"startsin",
		"startingin",
		"intermission",
		"roundtimer",
		"roundtime",
		"lobbytimer",
		"selectiontime",
	}

	local tbl20 = { "finalselection", "finalselectionplains", "selectionplains" }

	local function fn46(name)
		return (string.lower(tostring(name or "")):gsub("[^%w]", ""))
	end

	local function fn47(name)
		local v16 = fn46(name)
		if v16 == "" then
			return false
		end

		for _, v17 in ipairs(tbl19) do
			if v16 == v17 or v16:find(v17, 1, true) then
				return true
			end
		end

		return false
	end

	local function fn48(instance)
		local tbl21 = {}

		while instance and instance ~= game and #tbl21 < 12 do
			table.insert(tbl21, 1, instance.Name)
			instance = instance.Parent
		end

		return table.concat(tbl21, ".")
	end

	local function fn49(instance)
		if not instance then
			return nil
		end

		local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
			if instance:IsA("ValueBase") then
				return instance.Value
			end
			return instance.Text
		end)

		if ok3 then
			return result3
		end
		return nil
	end

	local function fn50(instance)
		local v16 = fn46(instance.Name)
		local n16 = 0

		if v16:find("finalselection", 1, true) then
			n16 = 100
		end

		if v16:find("selection", 1, true) then
			n16 += 20
		end

		if v16:find("countdown", 1, true) or v16:find("countdowntext", 1, true) then
			n16 += 40
		end

		if v16:find("timer", 1, true) then
			n16 += 30
		end

		if v16:find("timeleft", 1, true) or v16:find("startsin", 1, true) then
			n16 += 35
		end

		if v16:find("intermission", 1, true) then
			n16 += 30
		end

		local v17 = fn49(instance)

		if typeof(v17) == "number" then
			n16 += 25
		end

		if typeof(v17) == "string" and v17:find("%d") then
			n16 += 15
		end

		if instance:IsA("TextLabel") or instance:IsA("TextButton") then
			n16 += 10
		end

		return n16
	end

	local function fn51(arg, instance)
		if not instance then
			return
		end

		if not (instance:IsA("ValueBase") or instance:IsA("TextLabel") or instance:IsA("TextButton")) then
			return
		end
		local v16 = fn47(instance.Name)
		local isTextLabel = instance:IsA("TextLabel") or instance:IsA("TextButton")
		local flag16 = false

		if isTextLabel then
			local str11 = tostring(instance.Text or "")
			flag16 = str11:match("^%s*%d+%s*$") ~= nil
				or str11:match("^%s*%d+:%d+") ~= nil
				or str11:match("%d%s*[sS]%s*$") ~= nil
		end

		if not v16 and not flag16 then
			return
		end
		table.insert(arg, {
			inst = instance,
			path = fn48(instance),
			value = fn49(instance),
			score = fn50(instance) + (flag16 and 20 or 0),
		})
	end

	local tbl21 = {
		Enabled = false,
		Status = "idle",
		Label = nil,
		Found = nil,
		FoundPath = "",
		Value = nil,
		LastScan = 0,
		LastDeep = 0,
		ScanDelay = 1,
		DeepDelay = 6,
		Candidates = {},
		scan = function(arg)
			local tbl21 = {}

			pcall(function()
				local count4 = 0

				for _, descendant in ipairs(playerGui:GetDescendants()) do
					count4 += 1
					if count4 > 6000 then
						break
					end
					fn51(tbl21, descendant)
				end
			end)

			if not arg then
				return tbl21
			end

			pcall(function()
				local count4 = 0

				for _, descendant in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
					count4 += 1
					if count4 > 9000 then
						break
					end

					if descendant:IsA("Model") or descendant:IsA("Folder") then
						local v16 = fn46(descendant.Name)

						for _, v17 in ipairs(tbl20) do
							if v16:find(v17, 1, true) then
								table.insert(
									tbl21,
									{ inst = descendant, path = fn48(descendant), value = nil, score = 5 }
								)
								break
							end
						end
					elseif descendant:IsA("ValueBase") or descendant:IsA("TextLabel") then
						fn51(tbl21, descendant)
					end
				end
			end)

			return tbl21
		end,
	}

	local function getCandidate(candidates)
		local score = nil
		local candidate2 = nil

		for _, candidate in ipairs(candidates) do
			if not score or (candidate.score or 0) > score then
				score = candidate.score

				if score then
					candidate2 = candidate
				else
					score = 0
					candidate2 = candidate
				end
			end
		end

		return candidate2
	end

	tbl21.update = function()
		if not tbl21.Enabled then
			return
		end
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if now3 - tbl21.LastScan < tbl21.ScanDelay then
			return
		end
		tbl21.LastScan = now3
		local flag16 = now3 - tbl21.LastDeep >= tbl21.DeepDelay

		if flag16 then
			tbl21.LastDeep = now3
		end

		local candidates = tbl21.scan(flag16)
		tbl21.Candidates = candidates
		local candidate = getCandidate(candidates)

		if candidate and candidate.inst and candidate.inst.Parent then
			tbl21.Found = candidate.inst
			tbl21.FoundPath = candidate.path
			tbl21.Value = fn49(candidate.inst) or candidate.value
			tbl21.Status = "tracking"
		else
			tbl21.Found = nil
			tbl21.FoundPath = ""
			tbl21.Value = nil
			tbl21.Status = "not found"
		end
	end

	tbl21.getBillboard = function()
		local debree = workspace:FindFirstChild("Debree")
		local finalSelectionAssets = debree and debree:FindFirstChild("Final Selection Assets")
		local persistentModel = finalSelectionAssets and finalSelectionAssets:FindFirstChild("PersistentModel")
		local billboardHandler = persistentModel and persistentModel:FindFirstChild("BillboardHandler")
		local billboardGui = billboardHandler and billboardHandler:FindFirstChild("BillboardGui")
		return billboardGui and billboardGui:FindFirstChild("TimedEventHolder")
	end

	tbl21.readBillboard = function()
		local billboard = tbl21.getBillboard()
		if not billboard then
			return nil
		end
		local counterHolder = billboard:FindFirstChild("CounterHolder")
		if not counterHolder then
			return nil
		end
		local tbl22 = {}

		for _, child in ipairs(counterHolder:GetChildren()) do
			local str11

			if child.Name:match("^Digit") then
				local value = child:FindFirstChild("Value")
				str11 = ""

				if value then
					if (value:IsA("TextLabel") or value:IsA("TextButton")) and value.Visible ~= false then
						str11 = tostring(value.Text or "")
					elseif value:IsA("ValueBase") then
						str11 = tostring(value.Value or "")
					end
				end
			else
				str11 = ""

				if child.Name:match("^Separator") then
					local colon = child:FindFirstChild("Colon")

					if colon and colon:IsA("ValueBase") then
						str11 = tostring(colon.Value or ":")
					elseif colon then
						str11 = tostring(colon.Text or ":")
					else
						str11 = ":"
					end
				end
			end

			if str11 ~= "" and str11 ~= " " then
				local x = 0

				pcall(function()
					x = child.AbsolutePosition.X
				end)

				table.insert(tbl22, { x = x, txt = str11 })
			end
		end

		if #tbl22 == 0 then
			return nil
		end

		table.sort(tbl22, function(arg, arg2)
			return arg.x < arg2.x
		end)

		local txts = {}

		for _, v16 in ipairs(tbl22) do
			table.insert(txts, v16.txt)
		end

		return table.concat(txts)
	end

	tbl21.requirements = function()
		local billboard = tbl21.getBillboard()
		if not billboard then
			return nil
		end
		local requirementsHolder = billboard:FindFirstChild("RequirementsHolder")
		if not requirementsHolder then
			return nil
		end
		local level = requirementsHolder:FindFirstChild("Level")
		local race = requirementsHolder:FindFirstChild("Race")
		local txt = level and level:FindFirstChild("Txt")
		local txt2 = race and race:FindFirstChild("Txt")
		local text = txt and txt.Text or nil
		local text2 = txt2 and txt2.Text or nil
		if not text and not text2 then
			return nil
		end
		return string.format("%s  %s", tostring(text or ""), tostring(text2 or ""))
	end

	tbl21.report = function()
		local v16 = tbl21.scan(true)

		table.sort(v16, function(arg, arg2)
			return (arg.score or 0) > (arg2.score or 0)
		end)

		DEV("[Glu] Final Selection scan: " .. #v16 .. " candidate(s)")

		for i, v17 in ipairs(v16) do
			if i > 25 then
				break
			end
			DEV(
				string.format(
					"[Glu]  #%d score=%d kind=%s value=%s\n        %s",
					i,
					v17.score or 0,
					v17.inst.ClassName,
					tostring(v17.value),
					v17.path
				)
			)
		end

		if #v16 == 0 then
			DEV("[Glu] No countdown found. Run this in Final Selection and try the button again.")
		end

		return v16
	end

	return tbl21
end

GluFS = fn45()

local function fn46()
	local tbl19 = {
		ESP = {
			Enabled = false,
			Boss = true,
			NPC = true,
			Dungeon = true,
			Chest = false,
			Loot = false,
			Players = true,
			Names = true,
			Health = true,
			Distance = true,
			Range = 2500,
			MaxDraw = 180,
			MaxTags = 60,
		},
		AntiAFK = false,
		AntiVoid = false,
		AntiFling = false,
		BunnyHop = false,
		FPSBoost = false,
		Start = os.clock(),
		LastAFK = 0,
		LastSafe = nil,
		Status = "idle",
	}

	local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

	local tbl20 = {
		Boss = Color3.fromRGB(255, 70, 70),
		NPC = Color3.fromRGB(255, 175, 70),
		Player = Color3.fromRGB(80, 180, 255),
		Dungeon = Color3.fromRGB(185, 120, 255),
		Chest = Color3.fromRGB(70, 220, 255),
		Loot = Color3.fromRGB(120, 255, 130),
	}

	local obj = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local obj2 = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	local v16 = nil

	local function fn47(parent, fillColor)
		local gluESP = obj[parent]

		if not gluESP or not gluESP.Parent then
			gluESP = Instance.new("Highlight")
			gluESP.Name = "GluESP"
			gluESP.FillTransparency = 0.85
			gluESP.OutlineTransparency = 0
			gluESP.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
			gluESP.Parent = parent
			obj[parent] = gluESP
		end

		gluESP.Adornee = parent
		gluESP.FillColor = fillColor
		gluESP.OutlineColor = fillColor
		gluESP.Enabled = true
	end

	local function fn48(parent, textColor3, text)
		local gluESPTag = obj2[parent]

		if not gluESPTag or not gluESPTag.Parent then
			gluESPTag = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
			gluESPTag.Name = "GluESPTag"
			gluESPTag.Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 30)
			gluESPTag.StudsOffsetWorldSpace = Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0)
			gluESPTag.AlwaysOnTop = true
			gluESPTag.MaxDistance = 100000
			gluESPTag.ResetOnSpawn = false
			gluESPTag.Parent = parent

			local info = Instance.new("TextLabel")
			info.Name = "Info"
			info.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			info.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
			info.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
			info.TextSize = 14
			info.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.3
			info.TextColor3 = textColor3
			info.Parent = gluESPTag
			gluESPTag.Adornee = parent
			obj2[parent] = gluESPTag
		end

		gluESPTag.Adornee = parent
		local info = gluESPTag:FindFirstChild("Info")

		if info then
			info.Text = text
			info.TextColor3 = textColor3
		end
	end

	local function fn49()
		local tbl21 = {}
		local instances = {}
		local v17, v18, v19 = fn13()
		local position = v19 and v19.Position or nil
		local range = tbl19.ESP.Range

		local function fn50(instance, arg, arg2)
			if not instance or instances[instance] or not instance.Parent then
				return
			end

			if arg2 and not arg2(instance) then
				return
			end
			local magnitude = math.huge

			if position then
				local v20 = fn15(instance)
				if not v20 then
					return
				end
				magnitude = (v20.Position - position).Magnitude
				if range < magnitude then
					return
				end
			end

			instances[instance] = true
			tbl21[#tbl21 + 1] = { inst = instance, kind = arg, dist = magnitude }
		end

		if tbl19.ESP.Boss then
			for _, allBossFolder in ipairs(getAllBossFolders()) do
				if allBossFolder then
					for _, child in ipairs(allBossFolder:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("Model") then
							fn50(child, "Boss", fn14)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if tbl19.ESP.NPC then
			local function fn51(instance, arg)
				if not instance or arg > 4 then
					return
				end

				if instance:IsA("Model") and not fn17(instance) then
					fn50(instance, "NPC", fn14)
				end

				if instance:IsA("Model") or instance:IsA("Folder") then
					for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
						fn51(child, arg + 1)
					end
				end
			end

			for _, instance in ipairs(fn18()) do
				for _, child in ipairs(instance:GetChildren()) do
					fn51(child, 0)
				end
			end
		end

		if tbl19.ESP.Players then
			for _, player2 in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
				if player2 ~= localPlayer and player2.Character then
					fn50(player2.Character, "Player", fn14)
				end
			end
		end

		if tbl19.ESP.Dungeon and (flag3 or World.IsDungeon) then
			for _, v20 in ipairs(scan()) do
				fn50(v20, "Dungeon", fn14)
			end
		end

		if tbl19.ESP.Chest then
			pcall(function()
				for _, v20 in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("Chest")) do
					fn50(v20, "Chest", function(instance)
						return instance:IsA("Model")
					end)
				end
			end)
		end

		if tbl19.ESP.Loot then
			pcall(function()
				for _, v20 in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged("LootDrop")) do
					fn50(v20, "Loot", function(instance)
						return instance:IsA("BasePart") or instance:IsA("Model")
					end)
				end
			end)
		end

		table.sort(tbl21, function(arg, arg2)
			return arg.dist < arg2.dist
		end)

		return tbl21
	end

	local function fn50(arg)
		local inst = arg.inst
		local names3 = {}

		if tbl19.ESP.Names then
			names3[#names3 + 1] = inst.Name
		end

		local humanoid = inst:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if tbl19.ESP.Health and humanoid and humanoid.MaxHealth > 0 then
			names3[#names3 + 1] = string.format("%d%%", math.floor(humanoid.Health / humanoid.MaxHealth * 100))
		end

		if tbl19.ESP.Distance and arg.dist < math.huge then
			names3[#names3 + 1] = string.format("%dm", math.floor(arg.dist))
		end

		if #names3 == 0 then
			return nil
		end
		return table.concat(names3, "  ")
	end

	tbl19.tickESP = function()
		local enabled = tbl19.ESP.Enabled and fn49() or {}
		local tbl21 = {}
		local count4 = 0

		for i, v17 in ipairs(enabled) do
			local inst = v17.inst
			local kind = v17.kind
			tbl21[inst] = true
			local npc = tbl20[kind] or tbl20.NPC

			if i <= tbl19.ESP.MaxDraw then
				fn47(inst, npc)
			end

			if i <= tbl19.ESP.MaxTags then
				local v18 = fn50(v17)

				if v18 then
					fn48(inst, npc, v18)
					count4 += 1
				end
			end
		end

		for k, instance in pairs(obj) do
			if not tbl21[k] or not instance.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					instance:Destroy()
				end)

				obj[k] = nil
			end
		end

		for k, instance in pairs(obj2) do
			if not tbl21[k] or not instance.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					instance:Destroy()
				end)

				obj2[k] = nil
			end
		end

		tbl19.Status = string.format("%s | %d target(s)", tbl19.ESP.Enabled and "on" or "off", count4)
	end

	tbl19.tickGuard = function()
		local v17, v18, primaryPart = fn13()
		if not primaryPart then
			return
		end

		if tbl19.AntiVoid then
			local fallenPartsDestroyHeight = (workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight or -500) + 150

			if fallenPartsDestroyHeight + 220 < primaryPart.Position.Y then
				tbl19.LastSafe = primaryPart.Position
			elseif primaryPart.Position.Y < fallenPartsDestroyHeight and tbl19.LastSafe then
				pcall(function()
					primaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					primaryPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
					local parent = primaryPart.Parent
					local cframe = CFrame.new(tbl19.LastSafe + Vector3.new(0, 12, 0))

					if parent and parent:IsA("Model") then
						if parent.PrimaryPart ~= primaryPart then
							parent.PrimaryPart = primaryPart
						end

						parent:PivotTo(cframe)
					else
						primaryPart.CFrame = cframe
					end
				end)
			end
		end

		if tbl19.AntiFling and not (v6 and v6.FlyEnabled) then
			local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
				return primaryPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity
			end)

			if ok3 and typeof(result3) == "Vector3" and result3.Magnitude > 420 then
				GluHold.killVelocity(localPlayer.Character, primaryPart, true)
			end
		end
	end

	local tbl21 = {
		ParticleEmitter = "Enabled",
		Trail = "Enabled",
		Beam = "Enabled",
		Smoke = "Enabled",
		Fire = "Enabled",
		Sparkles = "Enabled",
		PointLight = "Enabled",
		SpotLight = "Enabled",
		SurfaceLight = "Enabled",
	}

	tbl19.FpsSaved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
	tbl19.FpsQueue = {}
	tbl19.FpsHead = 1
	tbl19.FpsMuted = 0
	tbl19.FpsConns = {}
	tbl19.FpsCap = 0

	local function fn51(instance, arg, arg2)
		local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
			return instance[arg]
		end)

		if not ok3 or result3 == nil or result3 == arg2 then
			return
		end
		local tbl22 = tbl19.FpsSaved[instance]

		if not tbl22 then
			tbl22 = {}
			tbl19.FpsSaved[instance] = tbl22
			tbl19.FpsMuted += 1
		end

		if tbl22[arg] == nil then
			tbl22[arg] = result3
		end

		pcall(function()
			instance[arg] = arg2
		end)
	end

	local function fn52(instance)
		local character2 = localPlayer.Character
		if character2 and instance:IsDescendantOf(character2) then
			return true
		end

		if instance.Name == "GluESP" or instance.Name == "GluESPTag" then
			return true
		end
		return false
	end

	local function fn53(instance)
		if not tbl19.FPSBoost or not instance.Parent then
			return
		end
		local v17 = tbl21[instance.ClassName]

		if v17 and not fn52(instance) then
			fn51(instance, v17, false)
		end
	end

	local function fn54()
		local fpsQueue = tbl19.FpsQueue
		local deadline = os.clock() + (GluPace and GluPace.Weak and 0.0015 or 0.0025)
		local n16 = #fpsQueue

		while tbl19.FpsHead <= n16 do
			local v17 = fpsQueue[tbl19.FpsHead]
			tbl19.FpsHead += 1

			if v17 then
				pcall(fn53, v17)
			end

			if os.clock() > deadline then
				return
			end
		end

		tbl19.FpsQueue = {}
		tbl19.FpsHead = 1
	end

	local function onDescendantAdded(descendant)
		if descendant and tbl21[descendant.ClassName] then
			tbl19.FpsQueue[#tbl19.FpsQueue + 1] = descendant
		end
	end

	local function fn55()
		for _, fpsConn in ipairs(tbl19.FpsConns) do
			pcall(function()
				fpsConn:Disconnect()
			end)
		end

		tbl19.FpsConns = {}
	end

	tbl19.setCap = function(arg)
		local fpsCap

		if type(arg) == "string" and string.lower(arg) == "unlimited" then
			fpsCap = 0
		else
			fpsCap = tonumber(arg) or 0
		end

		tbl19.FpsCap = fpsCap
		local setFpsCap = type(setfpscap) == "function" and setfpscap
			or type(set_fps_cap) == "function" and set_fps_cap
			or type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.set_fps_cap) == "function" and syn.set_fps_cap
			or nil
		if not setFpsCap then
			return false
		end
		local fpsCap2 = fpsCap > 0 and fpsCap or 0
		local ok3 = pcall(setFpsCap, fpsCap2)

		if not ok3 and fpsCap2 == 0 then
			ok3 = pcall(setFpsCap, 9999)
		end

		return ok3
	end

	tbl19.setFPS = function(arg)
		if arg then
			if tbl19.FPSBoost then
				return
			end
			tbl19.FPSBoost = true

			local tbl22 = {
				Shadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
				FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
				FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
				EnvDiffuse = Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale,
				EnvSpecular = Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale,
				Quality = nil,
				Decoration = nil,
				Water = nil,
				Fx = {},
			}

			pcall(function()
				tbl22.Quality = settings().Rendering.QualityLevel
			end)

			pcall(function()
				tbl22.Decoration = workspace.Terrain.Decoration
			end)

			pcall(function()
				local terrain = workspace.Terrain
				tbl22.Water = {
					terrain.WaterWaveSize,
					terrain.WaterWaveSpeed,
					terrain.WaterReflectance,
					terrain.WaterTransparency,
				}
			end)

			for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
				if child:IsA("PostEffect") or child:IsA("Clouds") then
					pcall(function()
						tbl22.Fx[child] = child.Enabled
					end)
				end
			end

			v16 = tbl22

			pcall(function()
				settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
			end)

			pcall(function()
				Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
			end)

			pcall(function()
				Lighting.FogStart = 1000000
				Lighting.FogEnd = 1000000
			end)

			pcall(function()
				Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0
				Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
			end)

			for k in pairs(tbl22.Fx) do
				pcall(function()
					k.Enabled = false
				end)
			end

			pcall(function()
				local terrain = workspace.Terrain
				terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
				terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
				terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
				terrain.WaterTransparency = 1
				terrain.Decoration = false
			end)

			tbl19.FpsQueue = {}
			tbl19.FpsHead = 1
			fn55()

			task.spawn(function()
				local descendants = nil

				pcall(function()
					descendants = workspace:GetDescendants()
				end)

				if type(descendants) ~= "table" then
					return
				end

				for i = 1, #descendants do
					if not tbl19.FPSBoost then
						return
					end
					onDescendantAdded(descendants[i])

					if i % 500 == 0 then
						task.wait()
					end
				end
			end)

			tbl19.FpsConns[#tbl19.FpsConns + 1] = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(onDescendantAdded)

			tbl19.FpsConns[#tbl19.FpsConns + 1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
				if tbl19.FpsHead <= #tbl19.FpsQueue then
					fn54()
				end
			end)

			return
		end

		if not tbl19.FPSBoost then
			return
		end
		tbl19.FPSBoost = false
		fn55()
		tbl19.FpsQueue = {}
		tbl19.FpsHead = 1
		local v17 = v16

		if v17 then
			pcall(function()
				Lighting.GlobalShadows = v17.Shadows
			end)

			pcall(function()
				Lighting.FogEnd = v17.FogEnd
				Lighting.FogStart = v17.FogStart
			end)

			pcall(function()
				Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = v17.EnvDiffuse
				Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = v17.EnvSpecular
			end)

			for k, v18 in pairs(v17.Fx) do
				pcall(function()
					if k.Parent then
						k.Enabled = v18
					end
				end)
			end

			if v17.Quality then
				pcall(function()
					settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = v17.Quality
				end)
			end

			pcall(function()
				local terrain = workspace.Terrain

				if v17.Decoration ~= nil then
					terrain.Decoration = v17.Decoration
				end

				if v17.Water then
					local waterWaveSpeed = v17.Water[2]
					local waterReflectance = v17.Water[3]
					local waterTransparency = v17.Water[4]

					terrain.WaterWaveSize = v17.Water[1]
					terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = waterWaveSpeed
					terrain.WaterReflectance = waterReflectance
					terrain.WaterTransparency = waterTransparency
				end
			end)
		end

		v16 = nil
		local tbl22 = {}

		for k, v18 in pairs(tbl19.FpsSaved) do
			tbl22[#tbl22 + 1] = { k, v18 }
		end

		tbl19.FpsSaved = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })
		tbl19.FpsMuted = 0

		task.spawn(function()
			local deadline = os.clock() + 0.003

			for i, v18 in ipairs(tbl22) do
				if tbl19.FPSBoost then
					for i2 = i, #tbl22 do
						local v19 = tbl22[i2]
						if not v19[1].Parent then
							continue
						end
						local tbl23 = tbl19.FpsSaved[v19[1]]

						if not tbl23 then
							tbl23 = {}
							tbl19.FpsSaved[v19[1]] = tbl23
							tbl19.FpsMuted += 1
						end

						for k, v20 in pairs(v19[2]) do
							tbl23[k] = v20
						end
					end

					return
				end

				local instance = v18[1]

				if instance.Parent then
					for k, v19 in pairs(v18[2]) do
						pcall(function()
							instance[k] = v19
						end)
					end
				end

				if deadline < os.clock() then
					task.wait()
					deadline = os.clock() + 0.003
				end
			end
		end)
	end

	tbl19.NoPause = true
	tbl19.PauseAt = 0

	tbl19.applyPause = function()
		pcall(function()
			game:GetService("GuiService"):SetGameplayPausedNotificationEnabled(tbl19.NoPause ~= true)
		end)

		if not tbl19.NoPause then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

			local function fn56(instance)
				if not instance then
					return
				end
				local gameplayPaused = instance:FindFirstChild("GameplayPaused", true)
				if not gameplayPaused then
					return
				end

				if gameplayPaused:IsA("ScreenGui") then
					gameplayPaused.Enabled = false
				end

				if gameplayPaused:IsA("GuiObject") then
					gameplayPaused.Visible = false
				end
			end

			fn56(CoreGui)
			fn56(CoreGui:FindFirstChild("RobloxGui"))
		end)
	end

	tbl19.setNoPause = function(arg)
		tbl19.NoPause = arg == true
		tbl19.applyPause()
	end

	tbl19.applyPause()

	tbl19.statsText = function()
		return string.format(
			"session %.0fm | loot %d | chests %d | dungeon kills %d",
			(os.clock() - (tbl19.Start or os.clock())) / 60,
			v3 and v3.LootCollected or 0,
			v3 and v3.Opened or 0,
			kills or 0
		)
	end

	SafeSpawn("guard", function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.35)
			pcall(tbl19.tickGuard)
			pcall(tbl19.tickESP)

			if tbl19.NoPause and os.clock() - (tbl19.PauseAt or 0) > 4 then
				tbl19.PauseAt = os.clock()
				pcall(tbl19.applyPause)
			end
		end
	end)

	return tbl19
end

if World.FishTab then
	local function fn47()
		local v16 = World.FishTab:Section("auto fish", 1)

		local function fn48(arg)
			local v17 = v16:Label(arg)

			pcall(function()
				if v17 and v17.Object then
					v17.Object.RichText = true
					v17.Object.Text = '<font color="#FF5C5C">' .. tostring(arg) .. "</font>"
				end
			end)

			return v17
		end

		local function fn49(arg, arg2)
			pcall(function()
				if arg then
					v:Success("Auto Fish", arg2, 2)
				else
					v:Warn("Auto Fish", arg2, 2)
				end
			end)
		end

		local function fn50(arg)
			pcall(function()
				local toggle = Toggles and Toggles[arg]

				if toggle and toggle.SetValue then
					toggle:SetValue(false)
				end
			end)
		end

		v16:Toggle({
			Text = "enable auto fish",
			Flag = "glu_auto_fish",
			Default = false,
			Hint = "casts, waits for the bite, plays the reel minigame and collects every catch. Save a farm position first.",
			Callback = function(arg)
				if arg then
					if AutoFish.start() then
						fn49(true, "Auto fish enabled")
					else
						fn50("glu_auto_fish")
					end
				else
					AutoFish.stop()
					fn49(false, "Auto fish disabled")
				end
			end,
		})

		fn48("You have to save farm position to make the auto fish work")
		local ownedRodNames = AutoFish.ownedRodNames and AutoFish.ownedRodNames() or {}
		local ownedBaitNames = AutoFish.ownedBaitNames and AutoFish.ownedBaitNames() or {}

		if #ownedRodNames == 0 then
			ownedRodNames = { "(no rods owned)" }
		end

		if #ownedBaitNames == 0 then
			ownedBaitNames = { "(no bait owned)" }
		end

		local function fn51(arg)
			if #arg == 1 and string.sub(arg[1], 1, 1) == "(" then
				return { "(auto)" }
			end
			return arg
		end

		local v17 = v16:Dropdown({
			Text = "fishing rod",
			Flag = "glu_auto_fish_rod",

			Default = "(auto)",
			Hint = "the rod auto fish will equip. (auto) uses the best rod you own",
			Callback = function(pickedRod)
				if not pickedRod or pickedRod == "" or pickedRod == "(auto)" then
					AutoFish.State.PickedRod = nil
				else
					AutoFish.State.PickedRod = pickedRod
				end
			end,
		})

		local v18 = v16:Dropdown({
			Text = "bait",
			Flag = "glu_auto_fish_bait",
			Options = fn51(ownedBaitNames),

				pcall(function()
					equippedBaitName = AutoFish.equippedBaitName and AutoFish.equippedBaitName()
				end)

				local pickedBait = AutoFish.State and AutoFish.State.PickedBait
				local str11 = "equipped bait: " .. (equippedBaitName or "(none)")

				if pickedBait and pickedBait ~= "" and pickedBait ~= equippedBaitName then
					str11 ..= "  |  wanted: " .. tostring(pickedBait)
				end

				setLabel(v19, str11)

				if equippedBaitName and v18 then
					local value = nil

					pcall(function()
						value = v18:GetValue()
					end)

					if value ~= equippedBaitName then
						pcall(function()
							v18:SetValue(equippedBaitName)
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		v16:Button({

					v17:SetOptions(fn51(ownedRodNames2))
				end
			end)

			pcall(function()
				if v18 and v18.SetOptions then
					v18:SetOptions(fn51(ownedBaitNames2))
				end
			end)
		end)

		task.spawn(function()
			local v20 = v16:Label("fish: idle")

			while true do
				task.wait(0.5)

				pcall(function()
					AutoFish.State.LastWormCount = AutoFish.wormCount()
				end)

				local savedFarmPos = AutoFish.State.SavedFarmPos
				savedFarmPos = savedFarmPos
						and string.format("%.0f, %.0f, %.0f", savedFarmPos.X, savedFarmPos.Y, savedFarmPos.Z)
					or "none"

					v20,

						tostring(AutoFish.getStatus()),

						AutoFish.State.BaitsUsed or 0,
						AutoFish.State.BaitsBought or 0,
						AutoFish.State.LastWormCount or 0,
						savedFarmPos
					)
				)
			end
		end)
	end

	fn47()
end

	v13.applyPicked = function(arg)
		local allowed = {}

		if type(arg) == "table" then
			for k, v18 in pairs(arg) do
				if type(k) == "string" and v18 == true then
					allowed[k] = true
				else
					if type(k) ~= "number" then
						continue
					end

					if type(v18) == "string" and v18 ~= "" then
						allowed[v18] = true
					elseif v18 == true and v13.Options[k] then
						allowed[v13.Options[k]] = true
					end
				end
			end
		elseif type(arg) == "string" and arg ~= "" then
			allowed[arg] = true
		end

		v13.Allowed = allowed
		v13.AllowedPicked = next(allowed) ~= nil
		local tbl21 = {}

		for k in pairs(allowed) do
			table.insert(tbl21, k)
		end

		table.sort(tbl21)
		v13.queue(
			#tbl21 > 0 and "Casting: " .. table.concat(tbl21, ", ") or "Casting: every skill of the equipped weapon",
			3
		)
	end

					v13.NotifyText = nil

					pcall(function()
						v:Success("Skill", notifyText, v13.NotifyDur or 3)

	local v32 = World.BossTab:Section("auto boss", 1)
	names = getNames()

	local function fn48(arg)
		local tbl21 = {}

		if type(arg) == "table" then
			for k, v33 in pairs(arg) do
				if type(k) == "number" then
					if type(v33) == "string" and v33 ~= "" then
						tbl21[v33] = true
					elseif v33 == true then
						local name = names[k]

						if name then
							tbl21[name] = true
						end
					end
				elseif type(k) == "string" and v33 == true then
					tbl21[k] = true
				end
			end
		elseif type(arg) == "string" and arg ~= "" then
			tbl21[arg] = true
		end

		return tbl21
	end

	local function getMatches(arg)
		local matches = {}
		local matches2 = {}
		local names3 = names
		local names4

		if type(names3) ~= "table" or #names3 == 0 then
			local ok3
			ok3, names4 = pcall(getNames)

			if not (ok3 and type(names4) == "table") then
				names4 = names3
			end
		else
			names4 = names3
		end

		local matches3 = {}
		local v33 = ipairs
		names4 = names4 or {}

		for _, name in v33(names4) do
			matches3[string.lower(name)] = name
		end

		local gmatch = string.gmatch
		local v34 = tostring
		local str12 = arg or ""

		for k in gmatch(v34(str12), "[^,\n]+") do
			local match = string.lower(k:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"))
			local match2 = match ~= "" and matches3[match] or nil

			if match2 and not matches2[match2] then
				matches2[match2] = true
				table.insert(matches, match2)
			end
		end

		return matches
	end

	v2 = v32:Dropdown({
		Text = "boss rotation (multi-select)",
		Flag = "glu_boss_select",
		Options = names,
		Default = {},
		Multi = true,
		Callback = function(arg)
			local v33 = fn48(arg)
			local base = GluBossPriority.Base

			if type(base) ~= "table" or #base == 0 then
				base = matches4
			end

			local tbl21 = {}

			for _, v34 in ipairs(base) do
				tbl21[v34] = true
			end

			local tbl22 = {}

			for _, v34 in ipairs(base) do
				if v33[v34] then
					table.insert(tbl22, v34)
				end
			end

			local names3 = {}

			for _, name in ipairs(names) do
				if v33[name] and not tbl21[name] then
					table.insert(names3, name)
				end
			end

			for k in pairs(v33) do
				if not tbl21[k] and not table.find(names3, k) then
					table.insert(names3, k)
				end
			end

			local base2 = {}

			for _, v34 in ipairs(tbl22) do
				table.insert(base2, v34)
			end

			for _, name in ipairs(names3) do
				table.insert(base2, name)
			end

			local match = matches4[nextIdx]
			local savedEnabled2 = savedEnabled3
			local flag16 = savedEnabled2 ~= nil and savedEnabled2.Parent ~= nil and fn14(savedEnabled2)
			GluBossPriority.Base = base2
			matches4 = GluBossOrder()
			local n16 = nil

			for i, match2 in ipairs(matches4) do
				if match2 == match then
					n16 = i
					break
				end
				n16 = nil
			end

			n16 = n16 or math.min(nextIdx, #base2)

			if n16 < 1 then
				n16 = 1
			end

			nextIdx = n16
			n9 = n16
			BossResumeName = ""
			BossResumeAt = 0

			if flag16 then
				savedEnabled3 = savedEnabled2
				BossWaitName = ""
			else
				savedEnabled3 = nil
			end

			n10 = 0
			local tbl23 = {}

			for _, match2 in ipairs(matches4) do
				tbl23[match2] = true
			end

			for k in pairs(tbl14) do
				if not tbl23[k] then
					tbl14[k] = nil
				end
			end

			if #matches4 == 0 then
				str10 = "No boss selected"
			else
				str10 = string.format("Selected %d boss(es) - current: %s", #matches4, matches4[nextIdx])
			end
		end,
	})

	BossAuto = {
		Enabled = true,
		Every = 5,
		LastSync = 0,
		Syncing = false,
		Sig = "",
		Added = 0,
		Cycles = 0,
		Status = "idle",
	}

	BossAuto.push = function(arg)
		if not v2 then
			return false
		end

		return pcall(function()
			if type(v2.SetOptions) == "function" then
				v2:SetOptions(arg)
			elseif type(v2.SetValues) == "function" then
				v2:SetValues(arg)
			elseif type(v2.SetList) == "function" then
				v2:SetList(arg)
			else
				error("this dropdown has no option setter")
			end
		end)
	end

	BossAuto.sync = function(arg)
		if BossAuto.Syncing then
			return 0
		end
		BossAuto.Syncing = true
		local count4 = 0

		local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
			local names3 = getNames()
			if #names3 == 0 then
				return
			end
			local sig = table.concat(names3, "\1")
			if not arg and sig == BossAuto.Sig then
				return
			end
			local tbl21 = {}

			for _, name in ipairs(names) do
				tbl21[name] = true
			end

			for _, name in ipairs(names3) do
				if not tbl21[name] then
					tbl21[name] = true
					count4 += 1
				end
			end

			names = names3
			BossAuto.Sig = sig
			BossAuto.Added = (BossAuto.Added or 0) + count4
			BossAuto.LastSync = os.clock()
			BossAuto.Cycles = (BossAuto.Cycles or 0) + 1
			BossAuto.Status = string.format("%d boss(es), %d added", #names3, count4)
			BossAuto.push(names3)
			local opt = GluBossPriority.Opt

			if opt then
				pcall(function()
					if type(opt.SetOptions) == "function" then
						opt:SetOptions(names3)
					elseif type(opt.SetValues) == "function" then
						opt:SetValues(names3)
					elseif type(opt.SetList) == "function" then
						opt:SetList(names3)
					end
				end)
			end
		end)

		BossAuto.Syncing = false

		if not ok3 then
			BossAuto.Status = "sync failed"
			DEV("[Glu] boss auto-refresh:", result3)
		end

		return count4
	end

	SafeSpawn("loop", function()
		local state = 1
		local holder, count4, questString, code2, tasks, value, max, max2, max3, code, format, code3, str12, format2, code4

		while true do
			if state <= 12 then
				if state <= 6 then
					if state <= 3 then
						if state <= 1 then
							if state == 1 then
								task.wait(0.2)
								holder = getHolder()

								if not holder then
									state = 45
								else
									state = 2
								end
							end
						elseif state <= 2 then
							if state == 2 then
								count4 = 0
								questString = nil
								code2 = nil
								state = 3
							end
						else
							if state ~= 3 then
								continue
							end

							for _, child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
								state = 23

								while true do
									if state <= 26 then
										if state <= 24 then
											if state <= 23 then
												if state ~= 23 then
													break
												end
												count4 += 1

												if not questString then
													state = 24
												else
													state = 3
												end
											else
												if state ~= 24 then
													break
												end
												questString = child:FindFirstChild("QuestString")

												if questString then
													state = 25
												else
													state = 26
												end
											end
										elseif state <= 25 then
											if state ~= 25 then
												break
											end

	local function fn49()
		local now3 = os.clock()
		if
			not (
				savedEnabled and type(matches4) == "table" and #matches4 > 0
				or v10 and v10.Enabled
				or v11 and v11.Enabled
			)
		then
			GluCrowQuest.Boss = ""
			return
		end

		if now3 - (GluCrowQuest.ClickAt or 0) > 1.5 then
			GluCrowQuest.ClickAt = now3
			local descendant2 = nil

			pcall(function()
				local instances = GluDialogueRoots()

				local v44 = GluFindButtons(instances, function(arg, arg2)
					local v44 = string.lower(tostring(arg or "") .. " " .. tostring(arg2 or ""))
					return string.find(v44, "dispatch", 1, true) ~= nil
						or string.find(v44, "kasugai", 1, true) ~= nil
						or string.find(v44, "urgent", 1, true) ~= nil
				end)

				descendant2 = v44 and v44[1] or nil
				if descendant2 then
					return
				end

				for _, instance in ipairs(instances) do
					for _, descendant in ipairs(instance:GetDescendants()) do
						if descendant:IsA("TextButton") and descendant.Visible then
							local v45 =
								string.lower(tostring(descendant.Name) .. " " .. tostring(descendant.Text or ""))
							if string.find(v45, "dispatch", 1, true) or string.find(v45, "kasugai", 1, true) then
								descendant2 = descendant
								break
							end
						end
					end

					if descendant2 then
						break
					end
				end
			end)

			if descendant2 then
				pcall(function()
					GluClickGui(descendant2)
				end)
			end
		end

		local holder = getHolder()
		if not holder then
			return
		end
		local boss = ""
		local name = ""

		for _, child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
			local questString = child:FindFirstChild("QuestString")
			local str12 = questString and tostring(questString.Value) or tostring(child.Name)
			local v44 = string.lower(str12)

				if v45 ~= "" and string.find(v44, v45, 1, true) then
					boss = tostring(match)
					name = str12

				end
			end

			if boss ~= "" then

			end
		end

			GluCrowQuest.Name = name
			GluCrowQuest.At = now3
		elseif now3 - (GluCrowQuest.At or 0) > 300 then

				local child3

				if not child then
					local name2 = string.lower(name)

					for _, child2 in ipairs(training2:GetChildren()) do
						if string.find(string.lower(child2.Name), name2, 1, true) then
							child = child2
							break
						end
					end

					child3 = child
				else
					child3 = child
				end

				if child3 then
					local proximityPrompt = child3:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
					if proximityPrompt and proximityPrompt.Enabled then
						return proximityPrompt
					end
				end
			end

			local proximityPrompt4 = nil
			local magnitude2 = math.huge

			pcall(function()
				local giverPos2 = giverPos

				if not giverPos then
					local v44, v45
					v44, v45, giverPos2 = fn13()
					giverPos2 = giverPos2 and giverPos2.Position
				end

				if not giverPos2 then
					return
				end
				local overlapParams = OverlapParams.new()
				overlapParams.MaxParts = 900

				for _, instance in ipairs(workspace:GetPartBoundsInRadius(giverPos2, n16, overlapParams)) do
					local proximityPrompts = {}
					local proximityPrompt = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("ProximityPrompt")

					if proximityPrompt then
						table.insert(proximityPrompts, proximityPrompt)
					end

					local proximityPrompt2 = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)

					if proximityPrompt2 and proximityPrompt2 ~= proximityPrompt then
						table.insert(proximityPrompts, proximityPrompt2)
					end

					for _, proximityPrompt3 in ipairs(proximityPrompts) do
						if proximityPrompt3.Enabled and (arg2 or fn50(proximityPrompt3, gluStationWord, name)) then
							local magnitude = (instance.Position - giverPos2).Magnitude

							if magnitude < magnitude2 then
								magnitude2 = magnitude
								proximityPrompt4 = proximityPrompt3
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end)

			return proximityPrompt4
		end

		local function fn51(arg)
			local v44 = string.lower(tostring(arg or ""))
			if v44 == "" then
				return nil
			end

			if string.find(v44, "boulder push", 1, true) then
				return "Boulder Push"
			end

			if string.find(v44, "boulder split", 1, true) then
				return "Boulder Split"
			end

			if string.find(v44, "parkour", 1, true) then
				return "Parkour Dungeon"
			end

			if string.find(v44, "cup", 1, true) then
				return "Cup Game"
			end

			if
				string.find(v44, "push up", 1, true)
				or string.find(v44, "pushup", 1, true)
				or string.find(v44, "push-up", 1, true)
			then
				return "Pushups"
			end

			if
				string.find(v44, "aim", 1, true)
				or string.find(v44, "target", 1, true)
				or string.find(v44, "shoot", 1, true)
			then
				return "Target Shooting"
			end

			if string.find(v44, "squat", 1, true) or string.find(v44, "barbell", 1, true) then
				return "Squat"
			end

			if string.find(v44, "meditat", 1, true) then
				return "Meditation"
			end
			return nil
		end

		local function fn52(arg)
			local n16 = math.max(0, math.floor(tonumber(arg) or 0))
			local n17 = math.floor(n16 / 3600)
			local n18 = math.floor(n16 % 3600 / 60)
			local n19 = n16 % 60
			if n17 > 0 then
				return string.format("%dh %02dm", n17, n18)
			end
			return string.format("%dm %02ds", n18, n19)
		end

		GluParry = {
			Enabled = false,
			Key = Enum.KeyCode.F,
			KeyName = "F",
			Range = 40,
			HoldMulti = true,
			Window = 0.46,
			Lead = 0.14,
			DefaultHit = 0.2,
			FallbackHold = 0.7,
			Anim = {},
			Plan = {},
			Mobs = {},
			Starts = {},
			Conns = {},
			Seen = {},
			Stats = { pressed = 0, hits = 0, learned = 0, skipped = 0 },
			Status = "off",
			KeyDown = false,
			Running = false,
			LastScan = 0,
			Clock = { at = 0, offset = 0, ok = false },
			SkillCtrl = nil,
		}

		local tbl22 = {
			idle = true,
			walk = true,
			run = true,
			jump = true,
			fall = true,
			climb = true,
			sprint = true,
			strafe = true,
			swim = true,
			landing = true,
			slide = true,
			walkfast = true,
			runfast = true,
			idle2 = true,
			emote = true,
			dance = true,
		}

		GluParry.now = function()
			local clock = GluParry.Clock

			if os.clock() - (clock.at or 0) > 1 then
				local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
					return workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
				end)

				if ok3 and type(result3) == "number" and result3 > 0 then
					clock.offset = result3 - os.clock()
					clock.ok = true
				else
					clock.ok = false
				end

				clock.at = os.clock()
			end

			if clock.ok then
				return os.clock() + clock.offset
			end
			return os.clock()
		end

		GluParry.input = function(arg)
			local f = GluParry.Key or Enum.KeyCode.F

			local ok3 = pcall(function()
				VirtualInputManager_:SendKeyEvent(arg == true, f, false, game)
			end)

			if not ok3 and type(keypress) == "function" then
				pcall(keypress, 0.05)
			end

			return ok3
		end

		GluParry.controller = function()
			if GluParry.SkillCtrl ~= nil then
				return GluParry.SkillCtrl
			end
			local Skill_Controller = false

			pcall(function()
				Skill_Controller = require(ReplicatedStorage.CAM.Client.Controllers.Skill_Controller)
			end)

			if type(Skill_Controller) ~= "table" then
				Skill_Controller = false
			end

			GluParry.SkillCtrl = Skill_Controller
			return Skill_Controller
		end

		GluParry.press = function()
			if GluParry.KeyDown then
				return
			end
			GluParry.KeyDown = true
			local v44 = GluParry.controller()
			local flag16 = type(v44) == "table" and type(v44.Attempt_Hold) == "function"
			local ok3 = false

			if flag16 then
				ok3 = pcall(function()
					v44.Attempt_Hold("Blocking")
				end)
			end

			if not ok3 then
				GluParry.input(true)
			end

			GluParry.Stats.pressed = (GluParry.Stats.pressed or 0) + 1
		end

		GluParry.release = function()
			if not GluParry.KeyDown then
				return
			end
			GluParry.KeyDown = false
			local v44 = GluParry.controller()

			if type(v44) == "table" and type(v44.StopHold) == "function" then
				pcall(function()
					v44.StopHold("Blocking")
				end)
			end

			GluParry.input(false)
		end

		GluParry.record = function(arg, arg2, arg3)
			if type(arg) ~= "string" or arg == "" then
				return
			end
			local num = tonumber(arg3)
			if not num or num < 0.02 or num > 3.5 then
				return
			end
			local tbl23 = GluParry.Anim[arg]

			if not tbl23 then
				tbl23 = { samples = {}, label = arg2 }
				GluParry.Anim[arg] = tbl23
			end

			tbl23.label = tbl23.label or arg2
			table.insert(tbl23.samples, num)

			while #tbl23.samples > 12 do
				table.remove(tbl23.samples, 1)
			end

			local n16 = 0

			for _, sample in ipairs(tbl23.samples) do
				n16 += sample
			end

			tbl23.hit = n16 / #tbl23.samples
			tbl23.n = #tbl23.samples
			GluParry.Stats.learned = (GluParry.Stats.learned or 0) + 1
		end

		GluParry.hitFor = function(arg)
			local v44 = GluParry.Anim[arg]
			if v44 and v44.hit then
				return v44.hit, true
			end
			return GluParry.DefaultHit, false
		end

		GluParry.count = function()
			local count4 = 0

			for _, v44 in pairs(GluParry.Anim) do
				if v44.hit then
					count4 += 1
				end
			end

			return count4
		end

		GluParry.facesUs = function(instance)
			local v44, v45, v46 = fn13()
			instance = instance and instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not v46 or not instance then
				return true
			end
			local position = v46.Position - instance.Position
			local magnitude = position.Magnitude
			if magnitude <= 11 then
				return true
			end

			if (tonumber(GluParry.Range) or 40) < magnitude then
				return false
			end
			local vector = Vector3.new(position.X, 0, position.Z)
			if vector.Magnitude < 0.05 then
				return true
			end
			return instance.CFrame.LookVector:Dot(vector.Unit) > 0.02
		end

		GluParry.watch = function(instance)
			if GluParry.Mobs[instance] then
				return
			end
			local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			local animator = humanoid and humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")

			if not animator then
				animator = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("AnimationController")
				animator = animator and animator:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
			end

			if not animator then
				return
			end
			local tbl23 = { conns = {}, animator = animator }

			tbl23.conns[#tbl23.conns + 1] = animator.AnimationPlayed:Connect(function(arg)
				task.spawn(function()
					local ok3, result3 = pcall(GluParry.onAnim, instance, arg)

					if not ok3 then
						DEV("[Glu] parry anim:", result3)
					end
				end)
			end)

			GluParry.Mobs[instance] = tbl23

			pcall(function()
				for _, track in ipairs(animator:GetPlayingAnimationTracks()) do
					GluParry.onAnim(instance, track)
				end
			end)
		end

		GluParry.unwatch = function(arg)
			local mob = GluParry.Mobs[arg]
			if not mob then
				return
			end

			for _, conn in ipairs(mob.conns) do
				pcall(function()
					conn:Disconnect()
				end)
			end

			GluParry.Mobs[arg] = nil
		end

		GluParry.onAnim = function(instance, track)
			if not GluParry.Enabled then
				return
			end

			if not instance or not instance.Parent then
				return
			end

			if track.Looped then
				return
			end
			local name = string.lower(tostring(track.Name or ""))
			if tbl22[name] then
				return
			end

			if
				string.find(name, "block", 1, true)
				or string.find(name, "hurt", 1, true)
				or string.find(name, "stun", 1, true)
				or string.find(name, "death", 1, true)
				or string.find(name, "flinch", 1, true)
				or string.find(name, "knock", 1, true)
			then
				return
			end

			if not GluParry.facesUs(instance) then
				return
			end
			local seen = GluParry.Seen
			if seen[track] and os.clock() - seen[track] < 1.2 then
				return
			end
			seen[track] = os.clock()
			local animation = track.Animation
			local animationId = animation and animation.AnimationId

			if type(animationId) ~= "string" or animationId == "" then
				if name == "" then
					return
				end
				animationId = "name:" .. name
			end

			local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
			if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local humanoidRootPart = instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			local n16 = tonumber(track.TimePosition) or 0
			local n17 = GluParry.now() - math.clamp(n16, 0, 1.2)
			table.insert(GluParry.Starts, 1, {
				id = animationId,
				mob = instance,
				S = n17,
				pos = humanoidRootPart and humanoidRootPart.Position or nil,
				name = name,
			})

			while #GluParry.Starts > 24 do
				table.remove(GluParry.Starts)
			end

			local v44, v45 = GluParry.hitFor(animationId)
			local n18 = n17 + math.max(0.03, v44 - GluParry.Lead)
			local n19 = n18 + (v45 and GluParry.Window or GluParry.FallbackHold)
			if n19 <= GluParry.now() then
				return
			end
			table.insert(
				GluParry.Plan,
				{ pressAt = n18, releaseAt = n19, id = animationId, mob = instance, learnt = v45, hit = v44 }
			)

			table.sort(GluParry.Plan, function(arg, arg2)
				return arg.pressAt < arg2.pressAt
			end)

			while #GluParry.Plan > 8 do
				table.remove(GluParry.Plan)
			end
		end

		GluParry.runner = function()
			if GluParry.Running then
				return
			end
			GluParry.Running = true

			task.spawn(function()
				local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
					while GluParry.Enabled do
						local v44 = GluParry.Plan[1]
						if not v44 then
							task.wait(0.05)
							continue
						end
						local n16 = v44.pressAt - GluParry.now()
						if n16 > 0.02 then
							task.wait(math.min(n16, 0.1))
							continue
						end
						table.remove(GluParry.Plan, 1)
						local releaseAt = v44.releaseAt

						if GluParry.HoldMulti then
							while GluParry.Plan[1] and GluParry.Plan[1].pressAt <= releaseAt + 0.6 do
								releaseAt = math.max(releaseAt, table.remove(GluParry.Plan, 1).releaseAt)
							end
						end

						if not (GluParry.now() < releaseAt) then
							continue
						end
						GluParry.Status = v44.learnt and "blocking (learnt)" or "blocking"
						GluParry.press()

						while GluParry.now() < releaseAt and GluParry.Enabled do
							local v45 = GluParry.Plan[1]

							if v45 and v45.pressAt <= releaseAt + 0.4 then
								releaseAt = math.max(releaseAt, table.remove(GluParry.Plan, 1).releaseAt)
							end

							task.wait()
						end

						GluParry.release()
					end
				end)

				if not ok3 then
					DEV("[Glu] parry runner:", result3)
				end

				GluParry.release()
				GluParry.Plan = {}
				GluParry.Running = false
			end)
		end

		GluParry.bind = function()
			local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
			local values = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Values")
			local child2 = values and values:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name)
			if not child2 or GluParry.Bound == child2 then
				return
			end
			GluParry.Bound = child2
			local v44 = ipairs
			local conns = GluParry.Conns or {}

			for _, conn in v44(conns) do
				pcall(function()
					conn:Disconnect()
				end)
			end

			local conns2 = {}

			local function fn53(instance)
				conns2[#conns2 + 1] = instance:GetAttributeChangedSignal("LastAttacked"):Connect(function()
					task.spawn(function()
						local ok3, result3 = pcall(GluParry.onHurt, instance)

						if not ok3 then
							DEV("[Glu] parry hurt:", result3)
						end
					end)
				end)
			end

			local dmg = child2:FindFirstChild("DMG")

			if dmg then
				fn53(dmg)
			end

			conns2[#conns2 + 1] = child2.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
				if child.Name == "DMG" then
					fn53(child)
				end
			end)

			GluParry.Conns = conns2
		end

		GluParry.onHurt = function(instance)
			local attribute = instance:GetAttribute("LastAttacked")
			if type(attribute) ~= "number" or attribute <= 0 then
				return
			end
			local attribute2 = instance:GetAttribute("LastAttacker")

			if type(attribute2) ~= "string" then
				attribute2 = nil
			end

			GluParry.Stats.hits = (GluParry.Stats.hits or 0) + 1
			local v44 = nil
			local start2 = nil

			for i = 1, #GluParry.Starts do
				local start = GluParry.Starts[i]
				if not (start.mob and start.mob.Parent) then
					continue
				end

				if not attribute2 or attribute2 == "" or start.mob.Name == attribute2 then
					local n16 = attribute - start.S

					if n16 >= 0.05 and n16 <= 2.5 and (not v44 or n16 < v44) then
						v44 = n16
						start2 = start
					end
				end
			end

			if start2 then
				GluParry.record(start2.id, start2.name, v44)
			end
		end

		GluParry.scan = function()
			local v44, v45, v46 = fn13()
			if not v46 then
				return
			end
			local now3 = os.clock()
			if now3 - (GluParry.LastScan or 0) < 0.15 then
				return
			end
			GluParry.LastScan = now3
			local n16 = tonumber(GluParry.Range) or 25
			local n17 = n16 * 0.72
			local tbl23 = {}

			local function fn53(instance)
				if not instance or not instance.Parent then
					return
				end
				local humanoid = instance:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
					return
				end
				local humanoidRootPart = instance:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if not humanoidRootPart then
					return
				end
				local magnitude = (humanoidRootPart.Position - v46.Position).Magnitude
				if n16 < magnitude then
					return
				end

				if
					not (
						instance:GetAttribute("Aggroed") == true
						or instance == instance4
						or instance == savedEnabled3
						or magnitude <= n17
						or GluParry.facesUs(instance)
					)
				then
					return
				end
				tbl23[#tbl23 + 1] = { m = instance, d = magnitude }
			end

			for _, instance in ipairs(getInstances2()) do
				fn53(instance)
			end

			fn53(instance4)
			fn53(savedEnabled3)

			table.sort(tbl23, function(arg, arg2)
				return arg.d < arg2.d
			end)

			local tbl24 = {}

			for i = 1, math.min(10, #tbl23) do
				local m = tbl23[i].m
				tbl24[m] = true
				GluParry.watch(m)
			end

			for k in pairs(GluParry.Mobs) do
				if not tbl24[k] then
					GluParry.unwatch(k)
				end
			end
		end

		SafeSpawn("glu-parry", function()
			while true do
				task.wait(0.1)

				if not GluParry.Enabled then
					GluParry.release()
					GluParry.Status = "off"
					task.wait(0.5)
					continue
				end

				GluParry.bind()
				GluParry.scan()
				local v44 = GluParry.now()

				for i = #GluParry.Plan, 1, -1 do
					if GluParry.Plan[i].releaseAt < v44 - 1 then
						table.remove(GluParry.Plan, i)
					end
				end

				for i = #GluParry.Starts, 1, -1 do
					if not (v44 - GluParry.Starts[i].S > 4) then
						continue
					end
					table.remove(GluParry.Starts, i)
				end

				while #GluParry.Starts > 24 do
					table.remove(GluParry.Starts)
				end

				GluParry.runner()
			end
		end)

		local function getChild2(phrase)
			local holder = getHolder()
			if not holder then
				return nil
			end
			local phrase2 = string.lower(phrase)

			for _, child in ipairs(holder:GetChildren()) do
				local v46 = string.lower(tostring(child.Name))
				local questString = child:FindFirstChild("QuestString")
				questString = questString and string.lower(tostring(questString.Value)) or ""
				if
					string.find(v46, phrase2, 1, true)
					or questString ~= "" and string.find(questString, phrase2, 1, true)
				then
					return child
				end
			end

			return nil
		end

		local function fn53(instance, arg)
			if not instance then
				return false
			end
			local tasks = instance:FindFirstChild("Tasks")
			if not tasks then
				return false
			end
			local v46 = string.lower(tostring(arg))

			for _, child in ipairs(tasks:GetChildren()) do
				local v47 = string.lower(tostring(child.Name))
				local code = child:FindFirstChild("Code")
				local code2 = code and string.lower(tostring(code.Value)) or ""

				if
					v47 == v46
					or code2 == v46
					or string.find(v47, v46, 1, true)
					or code2 ~= "" and string.find(code2, v46, 1, true)
				then
					local value = child:FindFirstChild("Value")
					local max = child:FindFirstChild("Max")
					value = value and tonumber(value.Value) or 0
					max = max and tonumber(max.Value) or 0
					if max <= 0 then
						return true
					end
					return value >= max
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		local function fn54(instance)
			if not instance then
				return false
			end
			local tasks = instance:FindFirstChild("Tasks")
			if not tasks then
				return false
			end

			for _, child in ipairs(tasks:GetChildren()) do
				local code = child:FindFirstChild("Code")

				if fn51((code and tostring(code.Value) or "") .. " " .. tostring(child.Name)) then
					local value = child:FindFirstChild("Value")
					local max = child:FindFirstChild("Max")
					value = value and tonumber(value.Value) or 0
					local n16 = max and tonumber(max.Value) or 0
					if n16 <= 0 or value < n16 then
						return true
					end
				end
			end

			return false
		end

		GluBreathe.hasStyle = function(arg)
			local flag16 = false

			pcall(function()
				local playerService = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("Player_Service")
				local data = playerService and playerService:FindFirstChild("Data")
				local child = data and data:FindFirstChild(localPlayer.Name)
				local slots = child and child:FindFirstChild("slots")
				local slot1 = slots and slots:FindFirstChild("Slot1")
				if not slot1 then
					return
				end
				local v46 = string.lower(tostring(arg))

				for _, name in ipairs({ "Breathing", "BreathingStyle", "Style", "Power" }) do
					local child2 = slot1:FindFirstChild(name)
					if
						child2
						and tostring(child2.Value) ~= ""
						and string.find(string.lower(tostring(child2.Value)), v46, 1, true)
					then
						flag16 = true
						return
					end
				end
			end)

			return flag16
		end

		local function fn55(boss)
			if not boss or boss == "" then
				return
			end

			if GluBreathe.SavedBosses == nil then
				GluBreathe.SavedBosses = v2 and v2:GetValue() or matches4
				GluBreathe.SavedEnabled = savedEnabled
			end

			matches4 = { boss }
			nextIdx = 1
			n9 = 1
			savedEnabled3 = nil
			tbl15 = {}
			tbl14 = {}
			tbl18 = {}
			tbl17 = {}
			BossCenterAt = {}
			BossResumeName = ""
			BossResumeAt = 0
			BossWaitName = ""
			BossRestartAt = os.clock()

			if BossTargetLock then
				BossTargetLock.Name = ""
				BossTargetLock.Since = 0
			end

			pcall(function()
				v2:SetValue({ boss })
			end)

			if not savedEnabled then
				savedEnabled = true

				if Toggles and Toggles.glu_boss_enabled then
					pcall(function()
						Toggles.glu_boss_enabled:SetValue(true)
					end)
				end
			end

			if GluFarm and GluFarm.enter then
				GluFarm.enter("boss", "autoboss")
			end
		end

		local function fn56()
			local savedEnabled2 = GluBreathe.SavedEnabled
			local savedBosses = GluBreathe.SavedBosses
			GluBreathe.SavedBosses = nil
			GluBreathe.SavedEnabled = nil
			savedEnabled3 = nil
			tbl16.Phase = "idle"
			tbl16.Pos = nil
			tbl16.Until = 0
			tbl16.NextIdx = nil

			BossResumeName = ""
			BossResumeAt = 0

			if BossTargetLock then
				BossTargetLock.Name = ""

			if savedEnabled2 ~= nil then
				savedEnabled = savedEnabled2 == true

				if Toggles and Toggles.glu_boss_enabled then
					pcall(function()

					end)
				end
			end

			if type(savedBosses) == "table" then
				pcall(function()
					v2:SetValue(savedBosses)
				end)
			end

			if GluFarm and GluFarm.releaseLocks then
				GluFarm.releaseLocks("autoboss restore")
			end

			if GluFarm and GluFarm.refresh then
				GluFarm.refresh("autoboss restore")

		end

		GluBreathe.step = function(arg)
			if GluBreathe.Busy then
				return
			end
			GluBreathe.Busy = true

			local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
				if GluBreathe.hasStyle(arg.Key) then
					GluBreathe.Status = arg.Key .. " is already learnt"
					return
				end
				local child = getChild2(arg.Phrase)

				if not child then
					local v46 = GluPlayerLevel()
					if v46 > 0 and v46 < (arg.Level or 25) then
						GluBreathe.Status = string.format("%s needs lv %d (you: %d)", arg.Key, arg.Level or 25, v46)
						return
					end
					GluBreathe.Status = "asking " .. arg.Giver

					pcall(function()
						fn22(arg.GiverPos, 4, false)
					end)

					task.wait(0.7)
					local proximityPrompt = getProximityPrompt(nil, arg.GiverPos, 30, true)

					if proximityPrompt then
						GluPrompt.fire(proximityPrompt, { pin = false, duration = 1 })
						task.wait(0.5)
					end

					fn7(arg.Accept)
					task.wait(1.2)
					child = getChild2(arg.Phrase)
					if not child then
						GluBreathe.Status = arg.Key .. ": quest not open yet"
						return
					end
				end

				local str12 = "Defeat the " .. arg.Boss

				if fn54(child, arg) then
					local v46 = ipairs
					local steps = arg.Steps or {}

					for _, step in v46(steps) do
						child = getChild2(arg.Phrase) or child
						if not fn54(child, arg) then
							continue
						end
						local tasks = child and child:FindFirstChild("Tasks")
						local flag16 = false

						if tasks then
							for _, child2 in ipairs(tasks:GetChildren()) do
								local code = child2:FindFirstChild("Code")
								if
									fn51((code and tostring(code.Value) or "") .. " " .. tostring(child2.Name)) ~= step
								then
									continue
								end
								local value = child2:FindFirstChild("Value")
								local max = child2:FindFirstChild("Max")
								value = value and tonumber(value.Value) or 0
								local n16 = max and tonumber(max.Value) or 0

								if n16 <= 0 or value < n16 then
									flag16 = true
								end
							end
						end

						if flag16 then
							GluBreathe.Status = string.format("%s: %s is open, finish it yourself", arg.Key, step)
							return
						end
					end

					return
				end

				if not fn53(child, str12) then
					GluBreathe.Status = string.format("%s: fighting %s", arg.Key, arg.Boss)
					fn55(arg.Boss)
					return
				end

				GluBreathe.Status = arg.Key .. ": handing the finished quest in"

				pcall(function()
					fn22(arg.GiverPos, 4, false)
				end)

				task.wait(0.7)
				local proximityPrompt = getProximityPrompt(nil, arg.GiverPos, 30, true)

				if proximityPrompt then
					GluPrompt.fire(proximityPrompt, { pin = false, duration = 1 })
					task.wait(0.6)
					GluPrompt.fire(proximityPrompt, { pin = false, duration = 1 })
				end

				fn56()
				GluBreathe.Done = true
			end)

			GluBreathe.Busy = false

			if not ok3 then
				DEV("[Glu] breathing:", result3)
			end
		end

					end

				end
			end
		end)

				local serverTimeNow = workspace:GetServerTimeNow()

				if type(serverTimeNow) == "number" then
					every2 = every - serverTimeNow % every
				end
			end)

			if every2 < 0 or every2 > every then
				every2 = every
			end

			return every2
		end

				v:Warn("Dungeon", "Auto start dungeon disabled", 2)
			end
		end,
	})

	task.spawn(function()
		while task.wait(0.2) do
			if not tbl5.ReadyWatcher then
				continue
			end

			if tbl5.activeNpcsStarted() then
				tbl5.QueueState = "dungeon started - no queue needed"
				continue
			end
			character = localPlayer.Character
			if not character then
				continue
			end
			local humanoidRootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			if not humanoidRootPart then
				continue
			end
			local map = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
			local minigameMap = map and map:FindFirstChild("Minigame Map")
			local startPad = minigameMap and minigameMap:FindFirstChild("StartPad")
			if not startPad then
				tbl5.QueueState = "waiting for StartPad"
				continue
			end
			local cframe = nil

			if startPad:IsA("BasePart") then
				cframe = startPad.CFrame
			else
				local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
					return startPad:GetPivot()
				end)

				if ok3 and result3 then
					cframe = result3
				end

				if not cframe then
					local v45 = fn15(startPad)

					if v45 then
						cframe = v45.CFrame
					end
				end
			end

			if not cframe then
				continue
			end
			Aim.TeleportedAt = os.clock()

			if GluHold and GluHold.go then
				GluHold.go(cframe + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
			else
				pcall(function()
					character:PivotTo(cframe + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0))
					humanoidRootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
					humanoidRootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
				end)
			end

			task.wait(0.12)

			if not tbl5.ReadyWatcher then
			else
				if not startPad.Parent then
					continue
				end
				local readyUp = startPad:FindFirstChild("ReadyUp")

				if not (readyUp and readyUp:IsA("ProximityPrompt")) then
					readyUp = startPad:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
				end

				if readyUp and readyUp.Enabled then
					tbl5.firePromptBoth(readyUp, 0.2)
					tbl5.QueueState = "readied at StartPad"
				else
					tbl5.QueueState = "on StartPad - ReadyUp disabled"
				end
			end
		end
	end)

		local ok3, result3 = pcall(function()
			return require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").CAM.Global.PlayerProfile)
		end)

		local dash = ok3 and result3 and result3.skill_info and result3.skill_info.Dash

		if dash then
			GluDash.Name = dash.CoolDownName or "Dash"
		end

		return GluDash.Name or "Dash"
	end

	GluDash.unbind = function()
		for i = #GluDash.Conns, 1, -1 do
			pcall(function()
				GluDash.Conns[i]:Disconnect()
			end)

			GluDash.Conns[i] = nil
		end
	end

	GluDash.watch = function(instance)
		local name = GluDash.cdName()
		local child2 = instance:FindFirstChild(name)

		if child2 then
			pcall(function()
				child2:Destroy()
			end)
		end

		GluDash.Conns[#GluDash.Conns + 1] = instance.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if GluDash.On and child.Name == name then
				task.defer(function()
					pcall(function()
						child:Destroy()
					end)
				end)
			end
		end)
	end

	GluDash.bind = function(instance)
		GluDash.unbind()
		if not GluDash.On or not instance then
			return
		end
		local shc = instance:FindFirstChild("SHC")
		if shc then
			GluDash.watch(shc)
			return
		end
		local connection = nil

		GluDash.Conns[#GluDash.Conns + 1] = instance.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
			if child.Name == "SHC" and GluDash.On then
				pcall(function()
					connection:Disconnect()
				end)

				GluDash.watch(child)
			end
		end)
	end

	GluDash.set = function(arg)
		GluDash.On = arg == true

		if GluDash.CharConn then
			pcall(function()
				GluDash.CharConn:Disconnect()
			end)

			GluDash.CharConn = nil
		end

		if not GluDash.On then
			GluDash.unbind()
			return
		end
		GluDash.CharConn = GluTrack(localPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(GluDash.bind))
		GluDash.bind(localPlayer.Character)
	end

	local stockDropdown = nil

	local function fn50(arg)
		local stock = BlackMarketer.getStock(arg)
		local names3 = {}

		if stock and #stock > 0 then
			for _, v58 in ipairs(stock) do
				local name = v58.Name or tostring(v58)
				local rarity = v58.Rarity

				if rarity and tostring(rarity) ~= "" then
					name ..= "  [" .. tostring(rarity) .. "]"
				end

				names3[#names3 + 1] = name
			end
		end

		if #names3 == 0 then
			names3 = { "(no stock found)" }
		end

		local stockDropdown2 = stockDropdown

		if stockDropdown2 then
			BlackMarketer.StockPushing = true

			pcall(function()
				stockDropdown2:SetOptions(names3)
			end)

			pcall(function()
				stockDropdown2:SetValue(names3[1])
			end)

			BlackMarketer.StockPushing = false
		end

		return #names3, stock and #stock > 0 and true or false, BlackMarketer.StockIsCatalogue == true
	end

	local function fn52()
		local v59 = fn51()
		if #v59 == 0 then
			return false
		end

		for _, v60 in ipairs(v59) do
			tbl24[#tbl24 + 1] = v60
		end

		table.sort(tbl24)

		if v58 then
			local tbl26 = { "off" }

			for i, v60 in ipairs(tbl24) do
				tbl26[i + 1] = v60
			end

			pcall(function()
				v58:SetOptions(tbl26)
			end)
		end

		flag16 = true
		local watchLabel = BlackMarketer.WatchLabel

		if watchLabel then
			pcall(function()
				watchLabel:Set(string.format("restock watch: %d item(s) can be stocked", #tbl24))
			end)
		end

		return true
	end

	local function fn53(stock)
		local tbl27 = {}

		if type(stock) == "table" then
			for _, v59 in ipairs(stock) do
				local v60 = tostring
				v59 = v59.Name or v59
				local v61 = v60(v59)

				if v61 ~= "" then
					tbl27[v61] = true
				end
			end
		end

		tbl26 = tbl27
	end

	local function fn54(notifiedCycle)
		local restocks = BlackMarketer.Restocks
		if type(restocks) ~= "table" or next(restocks) == nil then
			return
		end

		if BlackMarketer.NotifiedCycle ~= notifiedCycle then
			BlackMarketer.NotifiedCycle = notifiedCycle
			BlackMarketer.Notified = {}
		end

		local notified = BlackMarketer.Notified

		if type(notified) ~= "table" then
			notified = {}
			BlackMarketer.Notified = notified
		end

		for k in pairs(restocks) do
			if tbl26[k] and not notified[k] then
				notified[k] = true
				v:Success("Black Market", k .. " is in stock now", 6)

				pcall(function()
					GluWebhook.push({
						username = "Glu Hub",
						embeds = {
							GluWebhook.embed(
								"boss",
								"Black Market restock - " .. k,
								"The Black Marketer is carrying this item right now.",
								{},
								"Glu Hub | black market"
							),
						},
					}, "blackmarket")
				end)
			end
		end
	end

		end,

	task.spawn(function()
		fn52()
		local cycle = nil
		local flag17 = false
		local now3 = 0

		while true do
			task.wait(1.5)
			local state = BlackMarketer.getState()

			if state.Cycle ~= cycle then
				local v59, v60, v61 = fn50(false)

				if not v61 then
					fn53(BlackMarketer.getStock(false))
				end

				cycle = state.Cycle

				if flag17 then
					fn54(state.Cycle)
				end

				flag17 = true

	end

	local tbl28 = Hazards or {}

	Hazards = {
		Climb = tbl28.Climb == true,
		Sun = tbl28.Sun == true,
		ClimbTable = nil,
		ClimbScan = 0,
		LastHP = nil,
		Hooked = false,
		Conn = nil,
	}

	Hazards.findClimb = function()
		if type(getgc) ~= "function" or type(debug.getupvalue) ~= "function" then
			return nil
		end

		for _, v76 in ipairs(getgc()) do
			if type(v76) ~= "function" then
				continue
			end
			local str12 = ""

			pcall(function()
				str12 = debug.info(v76, "s") or ""
			end)

			if string.find(str12, "Climbing", 1, true) then
				for i = 1, 25 do
					local ok4, result4, result5 = pcall(debug.getupvalue, v76, i)
					if not ok4 or result4 == nil then
						break
					end

					if type(result4) == "table" then
						result5 = result4
					end

					if type(result5) == "table" and rawget(result5, "CurrentStamina") ~= nil then
						return result5
					end
				end
			end
		end

		return nil
	end

	Hazards.ensureHook = function()
		if Hazards.Hooked or type(hookmetamethod) ~= "function" or type(getnamecallmethod) ~= "function" then
			return
		end
		Hazards.Hooked = true
		local v76 = nil

		local function fn59(arg, ...)
			local v77 = table.pack(...)
			local method = getnamecallmethod()
			local v78, v79

			if method == "FireServer" or method == "InvokeServer" then
				local tbl29 = {}
				local v80 = table.pack(...)
				table.move(v80, 1, v80.n, 1, tbl29)
				if Hazards.Sun and tbl29[1] == "SunDamage" then
					tbl29[2] = false
					return v76(arg, unpack(tbl29))
				end
				v78 = v76
				v79 = table.pack(table.unpack(v77, 1, v77.n))
			else
				v78 = v76
				v79 = table.pack(...)
			end

			return v78(arg, table.unpack(v79, 1, v79.n))
		end

		v76 = hookmetamethod
		v76 = v76(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(fn59))
	end

	Hazards.signal = function()
		local ok4, result4 = pcall(function()
			return require(ReplicatedStorage.Communication.ServerAndClient.Signals.SignalFunction)
		end)

		if ok4 and type(result4) == "table" and type(result4.ToServer) == "function" then
			return result4
		end
		return nil
	end

	Hazards.tick = function()
		if Hazards.Climb then
			if not Hazards.ClimbTable or os.clock() - Hazards.ClimbScan > 2 then
				Hazards.ClimbScan = os.clock()
				Hazards.ClimbTable = Hazards.findClimb()
			end

			local climbTable = Hazards.ClimbTable

			if climbTable then
				if (tonumber(climbTable.MaxClimbTime) or 7) < 30 then
					climbTable.MaxClimbTime = 999
				end

				climbTable.CurrentStamina = climbTable.MaxClimbTime
			end
		end

		if Hazards.Sun then
			Hazards.ensureHook()
			local v76 = Hazards.signal()

			if Hazards.Sun and v76 then
				pcall(v76.ToServer, "SunDamage", false)
			end
		end
	end

	if Hazards.Conn then
		pcall(function()
			Hazards.Conn:Disconnect()
		end)
	end

	pcall(function()
		RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("GluSnowHeal")
	end)

	Hazards.Conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if GluUnloaded then
			if Hazards.Conn then
				Hazards.Conn:Disconnect()
			end

			pcall(function()
				RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("GluSnowHeal")
			end)

			return
		end

		pcall(Hazards.tick)
	end)

	GluPS = {
		On = false,
		Owner = "",
		Status = "off",
		Next = 0,
		Started = os.clock(),
		File = "Slayers2Glu/autops.json",
	}

	GluPS.save = function()
		pcall(function()
			if not isfolder("Slayers2Glu") then
				makefolder("Slayers2Glu")
			end

			writefile(GluPS.File, game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode({ On = GluPS.On, Owner = GluPS.Owner }))
		end)
	end

	pcall(function()
		if isfile(GluPS.File) then
			local data = game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(readfile(GluPS.File))
			GluPS.On = data.On == true
			GluPS.Owner = tostring(data.Owner or "")
		end
	end)

	GluPS.owner = function()
		return (tostring(GluPS.Owner or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
	end

	GluPS.inside = function()
		return game.PrivateServerId ~= "" and not World.IsDungeon
	end

	GluPS.join = function()
		local v81 = GluPS.owner()
		if v81 == "" then
			GluPS.Status = "type the owner's username first"
			return false
		end
		local ReplicatedStorage2 = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

		local tbl29 = {
			placeId = World.MainId ~= 0 and World.MainId or 136406881576517,
			privateOwner = v81,
			allowFallback = false,
		}

		GluPS.Status = "joining " .. v81 .. "'s private server"
		GluPS.Next = os.clock() + 45

		local ok4, result4, result5 = pcall(function()
			return require(ReplicatedStorage2.CAM.Client.Modules.Teleporter).Request(
				tbl29,
				{ Title = "Joining Server", SubTitle = "Private Server" }
			)
		end)

		if not ok4 then
			ok4, result4, result5 = pcall(function()
				return require(ReplicatedStorage2.Communication.ServerAndClient.Signals.SignalFunction).ToServer(
					"TeleportServer",
					tbl29
				)
			end)
		end

		if ok4 and result4 == true then
			return true
		end
		GluPS.Status = "failed: " .. tostring(result5 or result4 or "no reply") .. " (retrying in 60s)"
		GluPS.Next = os.clock() + 60
		return false
	end

	GluTrack(game:GetService("TeleportService").TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(arg, arg2, arg3)
		if arg ~= localPlayer or not GluPS.On then
			return
		end
		GluPS.Status = "teleport failed: " .. tostring(arg3) .. " (retrying in 15s)"
		GluPS.Next = os.clock() + 15
	end))

	SafeSpawn("auto-ps", function()
		while not GluUnloaded do
			task.wait(2)

			if not GluPS.On then
				GluPS.Status = "off"
			elseif World.IsDungeon then
				GluPS.Status = "paused in dungeon"
			elseif GluPS.inside() then
				GluPS.Status = "in a private server"
			elseif GluPS.owner() == "" then
				GluPS.Status = "type the owner's username first"
			elseif os.clock() - GluPS.Started < 8 then
				GluPS.Status = "joining shortly"
			elseif GluPS.Next <= os.clock() then
				GluPS.join()
			end
		end
	end)
