	GluMobile = { On = false, Gui = nil, Button = nil }

	GluMobile.holder = function()
		local ok4, result4 = pcall(function()
			return gethui()
		end)

		if ok4 and result4 then
			return result4
		end

		local ok5, result5 = pcall(function()
			return game:GetService("CoreGui")
		end)

		if ok5 and result5 then
			return result5
		end
		local Players2 = game:GetService("Players")
		if Players2.LocalPlayer then
			return Players2.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
		end
		return nil
	end

	GluMobile.build = function()
		if game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled and v and v.Raw and v.Raw.MobileButton then
			return true
		end

		if GluMobile.Gui and GluMobile.Gui.Parent then
			GluMobile.Gui.Enabled = true
			return true
		end
		local parent = GluMobile.holder()
		if not parent then
			return false
		end
		local gluMenuButton = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		gluMenuButton.Name = "GluMenuButton"
		gluMenuButton.ResetOnSpawn = false
		gluMenuButton.IgnoreGuiInset = true
		gluMenuButton.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Global
		gluMenuButton.DisplayOrder = 2000000
		gluMenuButton.Parent = parent
		local gluMenu = Instance.new("TextButton")
		gluMenu.Name = "GluMenu"
		local flag17 = game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled == true
		gluMenu.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(flag17 and 52 or 44, flag17 and 52 or 44)
		gluMenu.Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.3, 0)
		gluMenu.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 138, 190)
		gluMenu.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
		gluMenu.Text = "GLU"
		gluMenu.TextSize = flag17 and 14 or 12
		gluMenu.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 18, 24)
		gluMenu.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		gluMenu.AutoButtonColor = false
		gluMenu.BorderSizePixel = 0
		gluMenu.Active = true
		gluMenu.Parent = gluMenuButton

		local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
		uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		uiCorner.Parent = gluMenu

		local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
		uiStroke.Thickness = 1.5
		uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		uiStroke.Transparency = 0.35
		uiStroke.Parent = gluMenu

		local flag18 = false
		local flag19 = false
		local position = nil
		local position2 = nil

		gluMenu.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
			if
				input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				return
			end
			flag18 = true
			flag19 = false
			position = input.Position
			position2 = gluMenu.Position

			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					flag18 = false
					GluMobile.clamp()
				end
			end)
		end)

		gluMenu.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if not flag18 or not position then
				return
			end

			if
				input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
				and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				return
			end
			local position3 = input.Position - position

			if math.abs(position3.X) + math.abs(position3.Y) > 10 then
				flag19 = true
			end

			gluMenu.Position = UDim2.new(
				position2.X.Scale,
				position2.X.Offset + position3.X,
				position2.Y.Scale,
				position2.Y.Offset + position3.Y
			)
		end)

		gluMenu.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if
				input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
				and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch
			then
				return
			end

			if not flag18 and flag19 then
				return
			end
			flag18 = false
			if flag19 then
				flag19 = false
				return
			end

			if not GluMenuToggle() then
				warn("[Glu] this ui build has no menu toggle for the on screen button")
			end
		end)

		GluMobile.Gui = gluMenuButton
		GluMobile.Button = gluMenu
		GluMobile.On = true
		return true
	end

	GluMobile.clamp = function()
		local button = GluMobile.Button
		if not button or not button.Parent then
			return
		end
		local currentCamera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local viewportSize = currentCamera and currentCamera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1280, 720)
		local absoluteSize = button.AbsoluteSize
		local height = 0

		pcall(function()
			local topbarInset = game:GetService("GuiService").TopbarInset

			if topbarInset and topbarInset.Height and topbarInset.Height > height then
				height = topbarInset.Height
			end
		end)

		local n16 = button.Position.Y.Scale * viewportSize.Y + button.Position.Y.Offset
		local n17 = math.clamp(
			button.Position.X.Scale * viewportSize.X + button.Position.X.Offset,
			0,
			math.max(0, viewportSize.X - absoluteSize.X)
		)
		local n18 = math.clamp(n16, height, math.max(height, viewportSize.Y - absoluteSize.Y))
		button.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(n17), math.floor(n18))
	end

	GluMobile.destroy = function()
		GluMobile.On = false

		if GluMobile.Gui then
			pcall(function()
				GluMobile.Gui:Destroy()
			end)
		end

		GluMobile.Gui = nil
		GluMobile.Button = nil
	end

	GluMobile.set = function(arg)
		if arg then
			GluMobile.build()
		else
			GluMobile.destroy()
		end
	end

	GluMenuToggle = function()
		if GluUnloaded or not v15 then
			return false
		end

		local ok4, result4 = pcall(function()
			local real = v15.Real
			if real and type(real.SetOpen) == "function" then
				real:SetOpen(not real.IsOpen)
				return true
			end
			return false
		end)

		return ok4 and result4 == true
	end

	GluUnload = function()
		if GluUnloaded then
			return
		end
		GluUnloaded = true

		for _, gluConn in ipairs(GluConns) do
			pcall(function()
				gluConn:Disconnect()
			end)
		end

		GluConns = {}
		local v83 = coroutine.running()

		for _, gluThread in ipairs(GluThreads) do
			if gluThread ~= v83 then
				pcall(task.cancel, gluThread)
			end
		end

		GluThreads = {}

		pcall(function()
			if GluDash then
				GluDash.set(false)
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			if GluExtras and GluExtras.setFPS then
				GluExtras.setFPS(false)
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			if GluPS then
				GluPS.On = false
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			if GluHold and GluHold.stopWatch then
				GluHold.stopWatch()
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			if Hazards and Hazards.Conn then
				Hazards.Conn:Disconnect()
			end

			RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("GluSnowHeal")
		end)

		pcall(function()
			if GluHold and GluHold.release then
				GluHold.release()
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			local genv = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or nil

			if type(genv) == "table" then
				genv.GluUnload = nil
				genv.GluHold = nil
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			local v84 = pairs
			local registry = v.Registry or {}

			for k, v85 in v84(registry) do
				if v.Flags[k] == true and type(v85.Set) == "function" then
					pcall(v85.Set, false)
				end
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			if type(GluParry) == "table" and type(GluParry.release) == "function" then
				GluParry.release()
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			if type(AutoBlockSkills) == "table" and type(AutoBlockSkills.release) == "function" then
				AutoBlockSkills.release()
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			GluMobile.destroy()
		end)

		if not pcall(function()
			v.Raw:Exit()
		end) then
			pcall(function()
				local raw2 = v.Raw

				if raw2.Holder then
					raw2.Holder.Instance:Destroy()
				end

				if raw2.UnusedHolder then
					raw2.UnusedHolder.Instance:Destroy()
				end

				local v84 = ipairs
				local layers = raw2.Layers or {}

				for _, layer in v84(layers) do
					pcall(function()
						layer.Instance:Destroy()
					end)
				end
			end)
		end

		print("[Glu] unloaded - execute the script again to load it back")
	end

	pcall(function()
		local genv = type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv() or nil

		if type(genv) == "table" then
			genv.GluUnload = GluUnload
		end
	end)

	GluSystemPanel = function(settings_2)
		if not (settings_2 and settings_2.Section) then
			return
		end
		local system = settings_2:Section("system", 1)

		system:Toggle({
			Text = "menu button on screen",
			Flag = "glu_mobile_button",
			Default = game:GetService("UserInputService").TouchEnabled == true,
			Hint = "a small draggable button that opens and closes the menu. it starts on for touch devices, where there is no keyboard for the menu keybind",
			Callback = function(arg)
				GluMobile.set(arg == true)
			end,
		})

		system:ButtonRow({
			{
				Text = "hide / show menu",
				Hint = "the same thing the menu keybind does",
				Callback = function()
					if not GluMenuToggle() then
						v:Warn("Interface", "this ui build has no menu toggle", 3)
					end
				end,
			},
			{
				Text = "centre window",
				Callback = function()
					if not pcall(function()
						v15.Real:Center()
					end) then
						v:Warn("Interface", "could not centre the window", 3)
					end
				end,
			},
		})

		system:Button({
			Text = "unload script",
			Hint = "switches every feature off, stops the loops and removes the ui. click it twice to confirm so a mis-tap cannot end a farm session",
			Callback = function()
				if os.clock() - (GluUnloadArmed or 0) > 4 then
					GluUnloadArmed = os.clock()
					v:Warn("Unload", "click unload again within 4 seconds", 4)
					return
				end

				GluUnload()
			end,
		})

		SafeSpawn("glu-mobile-button", function()
			while true do
				task.wait(1)
				if GluUnloaded then
					break
				end
				local flag17 = v.Flags.glu_mobile_button == true

				if flag17 ~= (GluMobile.Gui ~= nil and GluMobile.Gui.Parent ~= nil) then
					GluMobile.set(flag17)
				end
			end
		end)

		pcall(function()
			GluMobile.set(v.Flags.glu_mobile_button == true)
		end)
	end

	local v83 = settings_:Section("discord webhook", 2)
	local url = GluWebhook.Url

	local function fn60()
		if not GluWebhook.Enabled then
			return "webhook: off"
		end

		if not select(1, GluWebhook.valid(GluWebhook.Url)) then
			return "webhook: waiting for a url"
		end
		return "webhook: on"
	end

	v83:Input({
		Text = "webhook url (optional)",
		Flag = "glu_webhook_url",
		Default = "",
		Placeholder = "https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...",
		Hint = "leave this empty to keep using the url the script already ships with",
		Callback = function(arg)
			local url2 = tostring(arg or "")

			if url2 ~= "" then
				GluWebhook.Url = url2
			else
				GluWebhook.Url = url
			end
		end,
	})

	v83:ButtonRow({
		{
			Text = "test webhook",
			Callback = function()
				pcall(function()
					GluWebhook.test()
				end)
			end,
		},
		{
			Text = "send summary",
			Callback = function()
				pcall(function()
					GluWebhook.summary()
				end)
			end,
		},
	})

	v83:Toggle({
		Text = "enable webhook",
		Flag = "glu_webhook_enabled",
		Default = true,
		Callback = function(arg)
			GluWebhook.Enabled = arg == true
		end,
	})

	v83:Toggle({
		Text = "boss kills",
		Flag = "glu_webhook_boss",
		Default = true,
		Callback = function(arg)
			GluWebhook.Boss = arg == true
		end,
	})

	v83:Toggle({
		Text = "dungeon",
		Flag = "glu_webhook_dungeon",
		Default = true,
		Callback = function(arg)
			GluWebhook.Dungeon = arg == true
		end,
	})

	v83:Toggle({
		Text = "drops",
		Flag = "glu_webhook_drops",
		Default = true,
		Callback = function(arg)
			GluWebhook.Drops = arg == true
		end,
	})

	v83:Toggle({
		Text = "fishing",
		Flag = "glu_webhook_fish",
		Default = true,
		Callback = function(arg)
			GluWebhook.Fish = arg == true
		end,
	})

	v83:Toggle({
		Text = "wallet changes",
		Flag = "glu_webhook_purse",
		Default = true,
		Callback = function(arg)
			GluWebhook.Purse = arg == true
		end,
	})

	v83:Toggle({
		Text = "hide my name in alerts",
		Flag = "glu_webhook_privacy",
		Default = true,
		Callback = function(arg)
			GluWebhook.Privacy = arg == true
		end,
	})

	local v84 = v83:Label("webhook: idle")

	SafeSpawn("loop", function()
		while true do
			task.wait(0.6)

			pcall(function()
				setLabel(v84, fn60())
			end)
		end
	end)

	GluSystemPanel(settings_)

	pcall(function()
		saveManager:BuildConfigSection(settings_, 2)
	end)

	pcall(function()
		themeManager:Mount(v15)
	end)

	local section = saveManager.Section or settings_:Section("configs", 2)

	local v85 = section:Input({
		Text = "config json (paste here to import)",
		Flag = false,
		Default = "",
		Placeholder = "paste exported config JSON here",
	})

	section:ButtonRow({
		{
			Text = "import",
			Callback = function()
				local str12 = tostring(v85:Get() or "")

				if str12 == "" and type(getclipboard) == "function" then
					local ok4, result4 = pcall(getclipboard)

					if ok4 then
						str12 = tostring(result4 or "")
					end
				end

				if str12 == "" then
					v:Warn("Config", "Nothing to import", 4)
					return
				end

				local ok4, result4 = pcall(function()
					return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(str12)
				end)

				if not ok4 or type(result4) ~= "table" then
					v:Warn("Config", "That is not valid config JSON", 4)
					return
				end
				v:LoadConfig(result4, saveManager.Ignore)
				v:Success("Config", "Config imported", 3)
			end,
		},
		{
			Text = "export",
			Callback = function()
				local ok4, result4 = pcall(function()
					return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(v:GetConfig(saveManager.Ignore))
				end)

				if not ok4 then
					v:Warn("Config", "Export failed", 4)
					return
				end
				v85:Set(result4, true)

				if type(setclipboard) == "function" then
					pcall(setclipboard, result4)
					v:Success("Config", "Exported and copied to clipboard", 3)
				else
					v:Success("Config", "Exported into the box above", 3)
				end
			end,
		},
	})

	pcall(function()
		saveManager:LoadAutoloadConfig()
	end)

	task.delay(0.25, function()
		local v86 = GluResumeSaved()

		pcall(function()
			GluWebhook.applyFlags()
		end)

		DEV(string.format("[Glu] restored %d saved setting(s) from the config", v86))

		pcall(function()
			local flags = v.Flags or {}
			GluExtras.setCap(60)

			if Toggles and Toggles.glu_fps_cap then
				pcall(function()
					Toggles.glu_fps_cap:SetValue("60")
				end)
			end

			if flags.glu_no_pause_popup ~= false then
				GluExtras.setNoPause(true)
			end

			if flags.glu_fps_boost == true then
				GluExtras.setFPS(true)
			end

			if flags.glu_no_dash_cd == true then
				GluDash.set(true)
			end

			if flags.glu_ps_auto == true then
				GluPS.On = true
				GluPS.Next = 0
			end
		end)
	end)

	showWorldTab = function()
		local dungeon2 = (World.IsDungeon or World.IsMenu) and dungeon or farm
		if not dungeon2 or not dungeon2.Real then
			return
		end

		if v15.ActiveTab == dungeon2 then
			return
		end

		pcall(function()
			v15:SetTab(dungeon2)
		end)
	end

	showWorldTab()
	task.delay(0.6, showWorldTab)
	DEV("[Glu] config loaded")
	DEV("[Glu] ui built - all tabs and sections created")
end
